"**The way home.** At the end of July, Li Ming finished his master's in Britain and got ready to come
home. He booked a ticket from London to Beijing through a travel agency. The schedule was tight: first a
coach from the city where he studied to London, then a flight back to Beijing. Before he left, he gave the books he no longer needed to his classmates
and had a farewell meal with his friends. Harry and Carlos wished him a good journey.

On the day he left, the forecast said there would be a rainstorm in the evening. To catch his plane he
set off first thing in the morning. Unexpectedly, halfway there it began to pour, so hard that you couldn't see the car in front, and then fog came
down on the road, so the driver had to take a detour, and they arrived an hour late. Li Ming was anxious
the whole way; luckily he had left early, and in the end he still got to the airport in time. Once he'd checked in, he sent Wang Fang a
message: 'I'm on the plane. See you tomorrow!'

After ten hours in the air, the plane landed in Beijing. Coming out of customs, Li Ming spotted Wang
Fang, who had come to meet him. They hadn't seen each other for a year. Wang Fang laughed and said,
'You've got thinner!' Li Ming said, 'And you haven't changed a bit.' Wang Fang was holding a cup of soy milk: 'I knew you'd
been missing this, so I bought it on the way.' Li Ming took it and had a sip: home still tasted best.

In his first few days back in Beijing, because of the seven-hour time difference, Li Ming was terribly
sleepy in the daytime but couldn't sleep at night. Still, looking at the familiar sky outside the window,
he felt especially at ease. On his first weekend he went straight to the little shop he used to go
to, and had the fried dough sticks he'd been missing for a year. In this one year he had not only learned his subject but also made many
friends. He says this time studying abroad is one of the most precious things in his life. He plans to rest for a few days first, then start looking
for work as a translator."

### Task 2: an essay on a theme (at least 200 characters)

The theme in the reported sample is something you tried for the first time and how you felt. Here:
{写|xiě}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{你|nǐ}{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{尝试|cháng shì}{做|zuò}{的|de}{事情|shì qing}，{说说|shuō shuo}{你|nǐ}{当时|dāng shí}{的|de}{感受|gǎn shòu}。 (Write about something you tried for the first time, and how you felt.)

Plan:

1. **Opening**: what you tried, and when (one or two sentences).
2. **Before**: why you did it, what you were afraid of ({当时|dāng shí}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{担心|dān xīn}…).
3. **What happened**: two or three steps, with time words ({刚|gāng}{开始|kāi shǐ}, {后来|hòu lái}, {最后|zuì hòu}).
4. **Feelings and what you learned**: ({通过|tōng guò}{这|zhè}{次|cì}…，{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}{了|le}…), ending on a sentence that sums up.

<details>
<summary>A model (about 270 characters)</summary>

> **{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{旅行|lǚ xíng}**
>
> {去年|qù nián}{夏天|xià tiān}，{我|wǒ}{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{去|qù}{旅行|lǚ xíng}。{出发|chū fā}{以前|yǐ qián}，{我|wǒ}{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}：{我|wǒ}{从来|cóng lái}{没有|méi yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{出|chū}{过|guo}{远|yuǎn}{门|mén}，{担心|dān xīn}{自己|zì jǐ}{会|huì}{迷路|mí lù}，{也|yě}{担心|dān xīn}{遇到|yù dào}{问题|wèn tí}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{帮忙|bāng máng}。
>
> {我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{预订|yù dìng}{了|le}{往返|wǎng fǎn}{的|de}{车票|chē piào}{和|hé}{住宿|zhù sù}，{又|yòu}{把|bǎ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{的|de}{行程|xíng chéng}{和|hé}{路线|lù xiàn}{都|dōu}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{本子|běn zi}{上|shàng}。{刚|gāng}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{一切|yí qiè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{顺利|shùn lì}。{没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}{下|xià}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{暴雨|bào yǔ}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小镇|xiǎo zhèn}{上|shàng}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{回|huí}{酒店|jiǔ diàn}{的|de}{路|lù}。{这|zhè}{时|shí}，{一|yí}{位|wèi}{卖|mài}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{的|de}{阿姨|ā yí}{看|kàn}{我|wǒ}{着急|zháo jí}{的|de}{样子|yàng zi}，{主动|zhǔ dòng}{走|zǒu}{过来|guò lái}，{带|dài}{我|wǒ}{走|zǒu}{到|dào}{了|le}{酒店|jiǔ diàn}{门口|mén kǒu}。{那|nà}{一|yí}{刻|kè}，{我|wǒ}{心里|xīn li}{特别|tè bié}{感动|gǎn dòng}。
>
> {这|zhè}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{五|wǔ}{天|tiān}，{却|què}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{到|dào}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。{我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}，{只要|zhǐ yào}{提前|tí qián}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}{准备|zhǔn bèi}，{遇到|yù dào}{困难|kùn nan}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{冷静|lěng jìng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{能|néng}{把|bǎ}{事情|shì qing}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}。{而且|ér qiě}，{陌生|mò shēng}{人|rén}{的|de}{热心|rè xīn}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{相信|xiāng xìn}，{世界|shì jiè}{上|shàng}{好|hǎo}{人|rén}{比|bǐ}{我们|wǒ men}{想象|xiǎng xiàng}{的|de}{多|duō}。{从|cóng}{那|nà}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{变|biàn}{得|de}{更|gèng}{有|yǒu}{勇气|yǒng qì}{了|le}。

"**My first trip alone.** Last summer I travelled on my own for the first time. Before I set off I was
very nervous: I'd never travelled far by myself, and I was afraid of getting lost and of having no one to
help if something went wrong. I booked return tickets and accommodation online, and wrote each day's
itinerary and route in a notebook. At first everything went smoothly. But on the second evening a
rainstorm came down, and in a small town I couldn't find my way back to the hotel. Then a woman selling
fruit saw how worried I looked, came over of her own accord and walked me to the hotel door. At that
moment I was really moved. The trip was only five days long, but it taught me a lot. I found that if you
prepare well in advance and stay calm when there's a problem, you can manage on your own. And the
kindness of a stranger made me believe there are more good people in the world than we imagine. Since
then I've become braver." {小镇|xiǎo zhèn}: a small town; {出远门|chū yuǎn mén}: to travel far from home.
</details>

**Checklist for both tasks**: a title for the essay; a clear order (time words, connectors); one or two
patterns of the level (A{着|zhe}A{着|zhe}, {没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}, {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù}, {不但|bú dàn}…{还|hái}…, {从|cóng}{那|nà}{以后|yǐ hòu}); register right for a story (not {便|biàn}, {此时|cǐ shí},
{如何|rú hé} in every line); characters counted: at least 100 and 200; a last read for {的|de} / {地|de} / {得|de} and missing {了|le}.

## The speaking test

As reported, the speaking test has three parts, with preparation time before the last two: retelling
two passages you hear, telling a story from three numbered photos, and answering two questions with
your opinion. About 23 minutes in all, including preparation. Practise each part out loud, with a timer.

### Retell a passage

Listen to the passage, or read it aloud once, then retell it in about a minute without looking. Keep the
people, the order and the ending; your words can be simpler.

```speak
# A passage to retell
{张大爷|Zhāng dà ye}{今年|jīn nián}{七十|qī shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}，{从来|cóng lái}{没|méi}{坐|zuò}{过|guo}{高铁|gāo tiě}。{上|shàng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{他|tā}{的|de}{孙子|sūn zi}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{预订|yù dìng}{了|le}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{的|de}{车票|chē piào}。{出发|chū fā}{那|nà}{天|tiān}，{孙子|sūn zi}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{送|sòng}{到|dào}{了|le}{站台|zhàn tái}，{又|yòu}{告诉|gào su}{了|le}{乘务员|chéng wù yuán}{他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{坐|zuò}{车|chē}。{一路|yí lù}{上|shang}，{乘务员|chéng wù yuán}{时常|shí cháng}{来|lái}{看|kàn}{他|tā}，{还|hái}{帮|bāng}{他|tā}{倒|dào}{了|le}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{热|rè}{水|shuǐ}。{到达|dào dá}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{张大爷|Zhāng dà ye}{给|gěi}{孙子|sūn zi}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}{说|shuō}："{高铁|gāo tiě}{又|yòu}{快|kuài}{又|yòu}{舒服|shū fu}，{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{想象|xiǎng xiàng}{的|de}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。{下|xià}{次|cì}{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{要|yào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{坐|zuò}！"
= Grandpa Zhang is seventy and had never been on a high-speed train. Last month his grandson booked him a ticket to Shanghai online. On the day, the grandson took him to the platform and told the attendant he was travelling alone. The attendant came to check on him often on the way, and even poured him a cup of hot water. When he got to Shanghai, Grandpa Zhang rang his grandson: "The high-speed train is fast and comfortable, much better than I imagined. Next time I'll go on my own again!"
```

{倒|dào} is "to pour" here (HSK 4).

### Tell a story from three photos

> {照片|zhào piàn}{一|yī}：{傍晚|bàng wǎn}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{女孩|nǚ hái}{在|zài}{山|shān}{上|shàng}{拍照|pāi zhào}，{天空|tiān kōng}{很|hěn}{美|měi}。
>
> {照片|zhào piàn}{二|èr}：{起|qǐ}{雾|wù}{了|le}，{她|tā}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清|qīng}{路|lù}，{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{路边|lù biān}{很|hěn}{着急|zháo jí}。
>
> {照片|zhào piàn}{三|sān}：{一|yí}{位|wèi}{老人|lǎo rén}{拿|ná}{着|zhe}{手电筒|shǒu diàn tǒng}，{带|dài}{她|tā}{走|zǒu}{下|xià}{了|le}{山|shān}。

{手电筒|shǒu diàn tǒng} is a torch. Give the story a beginning (who, where), a problem ({照片|zhào piàn}{二|èr}) and an ending ({照片|zhào piàn}{三|sān}), in two
minutes.

<details>
<summary>A model</summary>

{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{女孩|nǚ hái}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{摄影|shè yǐng}。{一|yì}{天|tiān}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}，{她|tā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}，{山|shān}{上|shàng}{的|de}{天空|tiān kōng}{特别|tè bié}{美|měi}，{她|tā}{拍|pāi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{照片|zhào piàn}。{可是|kě shì}{拍|pāi}{着|zhe}{拍|pāi}{着|zhe}，{山|shān}{上|shàng}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{大|dà}{雾|wù}，{她|tā}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清|qīng}{下|xià}{山|shān}{的|de}{路|lù}{了|le}，{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{路边|lù biān}，{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{该|gāi}{怎么办|zěn me bàn}。{这|zhè}{时|shí}，{一|yí}{位|wèi}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{山|shān}{上|shàng}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{过来|guò lái}。{老人|lǎo rén}{拿|ná}{着|zhe}{手电筒|shǒu diàn tǒng}，{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{告诉|gào su}{她|tā}{哪儿|nǎr}{要|yào}{小心|xiǎo xīn}，{最后|zuì hòu}{把|bǎ}{她|tā}{安全|ān quán}{地|de}{送|sòng}{到|dào}{了|le}{山|shān}{下|xià}。{女孩|nǚ hái}{非常|fēi cháng}{感谢|gǎn xiè}{这|zhè}{位|wèi}{老人|lǎo rén}，{从|cóng}{那|nà}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{她|tā}{再|zài}{也|yě}{不|bú}{在|zài}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{了|le}。

"A girl loved photography. One evening she went up a mountain alone; the sky up there was beautiful, and
she took lots of photos. But while she was taking them, a thick fog came down on the mountain, and she
couldn't see the way down. She stood by the path, not knowing what to do. Just then an old person who lived
on the mountain came over. Holding a torch, the old person told her where to be careful as they walked,
and in the end saw her safely to the bottom. The girl was very grateful; since then she's never gone up a
mountain alone in the evening."
</details>

### Give your opinion

```speak
# {一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{好|hǎo}，{还是|hái shi}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一起|yì qǐ}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{好|hǎo}？
{我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{方式|fāng shì}{各|gè}{有|yǒu}{好处|hǎo chù}，{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{更|gèng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{旅行|lǚ xíng}。
= I think both have their advantages, but I prefer travelling alone.
{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{行程|xíng chéng}{和|hé}{路线|lù xiàn}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{决定|jué dìng}，{比较|bǐ jiào}{自由|zì yóu}。
= When you travel alone you decide the itinerary and the route yourself: it's freer.
{而且|ér qiě}，{没有|méi yǒu}{朋友|péng you}{在|zài}{身边|shēn biān}，{你|nǐ}{会|huì}{更|gèng}{主动|zhǔ dòng}{地|de}{跟|gēn}{当地|dāng dì}{人|rén}{交流|jiāo liú}。
= And without friends beside you, you talk to local people more readily.
{当然|dāng rán}，{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一起|yì qǐ}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{更|gèng}{安全|ān quán}，{也|yě}{更|gèng}{热闹|rè nao}。
= Of course, travelling with friends is safer, and more fun.
{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{是|shì}：{短途|duǎn tú}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{可以|kě yǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{去|qù}，{长途|cháng tú}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{最好|zuì hǎo}{找|zhǎo}{个|gè}{伙伴|huǒ bàn}。
= So my view is: go alone on short trips, but find a companion for long ones.
```

{短途|duǎn tú} is short-distance, the opposite of {长途|cháng tú}.

## Say it

```speak
# On the road
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{预订|yù dìng}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}{往返|wǎng fǎn}{的|de}{车票|chē piào}。
= I'd like to book two return tickets.
{请问|qǐng wèn}，{去|qù}{西安|Xī'ān}{的|de}{列车|liè chē}{在|zài}{几|jǐ}{号|hào}{站台|zhàn tái}？
= Excuse me, which platform is the train to Xi'an?
{天气|tiān qì}{预报|yù bào}{说|shuō}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{雨|yǔ}。
= The forecast says there'll be a shower this evening.
{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{迷路|mí lù}{了|le}，{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{一下|yí xià}{吗|ma}？
= I'm lost: could you help me?
{前面|qián miàn}{堵车|dǔ chē}，{我们|wǒ men}{绕|rào}{一下|yí xià}{吧|ba}。
= There's a jam ahead: let's go round.
{祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng}！
= Have a good trip!
```

## Pronunciation

- {行|xíng} in {行程|xíng chéng}, {行走|xíng zǒu}, {旅行社|lǚ xíng shè} and {飞行|fēi xíng}; {行|háng} in {行业|háng yè} (lesson 01).
- {一路|yí lù} yí lù and {一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng} yí lù shùn fēng: {一|yī} before a fourth tone is yí.
- {降水|jiàng shuǐ} jiàng shuǐ: {降|jiàng} is jiàng (to fall), as in {下降|xià jiàng} and {降温|jiàng wēn}.
- {车厢|chē xiāng} chē xiāng, {乘务员|chéng wù yuán} chéng wù yuán, {傍晚|bàng wǎn} bàng wǎn: don't swap the *-ang* of {傍|bàng} and the *-an* of {晚|wǎn}.
- {诗|shī} shī and {时|shí} shí, {十|shí} shí: the same syllable, different tones.
- {雾|wù} wù and {务|wù} wù are said exactly alike: {务|wù} gives {雾|wù} its sound.

## Common mistakes

- ~~{前往|qián wǎng}{到|dào}{北京|Běi jīng}~~, ~~{到达|dào dá}{到|dào}{上海|Shàng hǎi}~~: {前往|qián wǎng} and {到达|dào dá} already contain "to": {前往|qián wǎng}{北京|Běi jīng}, {到达|dào dá}{上海|Shàng hǎi}.
- ~~{我|wǒ}{迷路|mí lù}{了|le}{北京|Běi jīng}~~: {迷路|mí lù} takes no object: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{迷路|mí lù}{了|le}。
- ~~{一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{天|tiān}~~: {阵|zhèn} counts short spells of weather or sound: {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{雨|yǔ}, {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{风|fēng}, {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{笑|xiào}{声|shēng}.
- In a story, {他|tā}{便|biàn}{上|shàng}{车|chē}{了|le}，{此时|cǐ shí}{车厢|chē xiāng}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{多|duō} isn't wrong, but written words in a story told aloud sound stiff: say
  {他|tā}{上|shàng}{了|le}{车|chē}，{这|zhè}{时|shí}{车厢|chē xiāng}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{多|duō}.

## Key points

- Booking: {旅行社|lǚ xíng shè}, {预订|yù dìng}, {住宿|zhù sù}, {行程|xíng chéng}, {路线|lù xiàn} / {线路|xiàn lù}, {往返|wǎng fǎn}, {长途|cháng tú}. On the way: {列车|liè chē}, {车厢|chē xiāng}, {站台|zhàn tái}, {乘务员|chéng wù yuán}, {停留|tíng liú}, {飞行|fēi xíng}, {时差|shí chā}, {海关|hǎi guān}.
- Written ↔ spoken: {前往|qián wǎng} / {去|qù}, {到达|dào dá} / {到|dào}, {返回|fǎn huí} / {回|huí}; {行走|xíng zǒu} / {走|zǒu}. {游览|yóu lǎn}, {迷路|mí lù} (no object), {绕|rào}, {一路|yí lù}, {一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng}.
- Weather: {天空|tiān kōng}, {天上|tiān shàng}, {雾|wù}, {暴雨|bào yǔ}, {雨水|yǔ shuǐ}, {降水|jiàng shuǐ}, {预报|yù bào}, {傍晚|bàng wǎn}; {阵|zhèn} counts spells ({一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{雨|yǔ}).
- Writing: a four-picture story (≥ 100 characters: who and where, events with time words, the turn, the end) and
  a themed essay (≥ 200: opening, before, what happened, feelings and lesson).
- Speaking: retell (keep people, order, ending), three-photo story (beginning, problem, ending), opinion
  (view, reasons, conclusion).
- New characters: {傍|bàng} {暴|bào} {厢|xiāng} {返|fǎn} {诗|shī} {雾|wù} {慧|huì} {阵|zhèn} (✎ {诗|shī}).

The words from this lesson are listed below; they join your vocabulary reviews when you complete
the lesson.

lessons.title: The HSK 5 exam
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

You now know the 3,600 words and 1,527 characters that the new HSK 5 covers, 550 of them to write
by hand, and the grammar of the level. This last lesson is about the exam: how it's built, what each
kind of task asks, how to use your time, and a short practice set written for this course. It adds
no new words.

The counts and times below are on the HSK 5 page of the official site (HSK 3.0 version); the task
details come from reports on the official sample papers, which we couldn't open ourselves. Formats can change: before you register, check the official HSK website of Chinese
Testing International (chinesetest.cn) and work through an official sample paper.

## How the new HSK 5 is built

| Part | Questions | Time | Tasks, as reported |
|---|---|---|---|
| Listening | 35 | about 25 minutes | dialogues and talks, each with questions and four choices (two parts: 19 and 16) |
| Reading | 35 | 35 minutes | a word or a sentence for each gap in a passage (10); five paragraphs to put in order, two passages (10); passages with questions (15); four choices |
| Writing | 2 | 40 minutes | a story from four pictures, at least 100 characters; an essay on a set theme, at least 200 characters |
| **Written exam** | **72** | **105 minutes**, including 5 minutes to transfer the listening answers (about 110 with personal details, as reported) | |
| Speaking | 5 | about 23 minutes, including 10 minutes' preparation | retelling a passage you hear (2, about 1½ minutes each); a story from three numbered photos (1: 3 minutes' preparation, 2 to speak); two questions on which you give your view (3½ minutes' preparation, 2½ to speak) |

The counts and times agree with the reports we found, which are based on the official sample papers
(reported as published in late 2025); the task details come mainly from one report, so treat them as a guide. Reports differ on
whether the speaking test is taken in the same session as the written exam. The level-5
standard describes the listening as talks and dialogues of up to 500 characters at 200 to 220 characters a
minute, understood despite a noisy setting, needless repetition and pauses, and the reading texts as up to
700 characters, read at no less than 160 characters a minute: faster and longer than your lesson texts.

### Listening

Dialogues between two people and short talks (a notice read out, a news item, a story, someone's
opinion), each with one or more questions. Typical questions:

- **details**: when, where, how much, who did what (listen for numbers and their {了|le} / {到|dào}: lesson 28);
- **attitude**: what the speaker thinks or feels ({赞成|zàn chéng}, {不满|bù mǎn}, {担心|dān xīn}; {说实话|shuō shí huà}…, {我|wǒ}{倒|dào}{觉得|jué de}…, {先|xiān}{别|bié}{着急|zháo jí});
- **what happens next**: the last line usually tells you ({那|nà}{我们|wǒ men}…{吧|ba}, {我|wǒ}{这|zhè}{就|jiù}{去|qù}…);
- **the main point** of a talk: often in its first or last sentence ({总之|zǒng zhī}, {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}, {关键|guān jiàn}{在于|zài yú}).

Read the four choices before the audio starts: they tell you what to listen for.

### Reading

- **Gaps in a passage** (3–4 gaps per passage): each gap takes a word or a whole sentence. Decide by
  **[[collocation]]** (which words go together: {采取|cǎi qǔ}{措施|cuò shī}, {提高|tí gāo}{水平|shuǐ píng}, {缩小|suō xiǎo}{差距|chā jù}, {满足|mǎn zú}{需求|xū qiú}), by grammar (a connector needs its
  partner: {不但|bú dàn}…{还|hái}, {即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě}, {一旦|yí dàn}…{就|jiù}), and by register (a notice takes {需|xū}, {至|zhì}, {如|rú}; a chat {得|de}, {到|dào}, {要是|yào shi}). For a sentence
  gap, check the sentences either side: the right one picks up what comes before and leads into what comes
  after.
- **[[Paragraph order]]** (five paragraphs, A–E): look for the paragraph that can stand first (it introduces
  people or a topic; it has no {这|zhè}, {此外|cǐ wài}, {但是|dàn shì} pointing back), the one that can stand last ({总之|zǒng zhī}, {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}, {最后|zuì hòu}, {从|cóng}{那|nà}{以后|yǐ hòu}),
  and the links between the rest: a pronoun or {这|zhè} + noun points back ({这|zhè}{份|fèn}{报告|bào gào}, {这个|zhè ge}{比例|bǐ lì}, {他|tā}); {此外|cǐ wài}, {也|yě}, {另外|lìng wài} add
  to something; {然而|rán ér}, {不过|bú guò} turn against something; time words follow each other ({最初|zuì chū} → {后来|hòu lái} → {如今|rú jīn}).
- **Passages with questions**: read the questions first, then the passage. Questions on the main idea
  ({这|zhè}{段|duàn}{话|huà}{主要|zhǔ yào}{谈|tán}{的|de}{是|shì}…), a detail, a word in context, and the writer's view or what they imply.

### Writing

- **The four-picture story** (at least 100 characters): who, where, what happens in each picture, the turn,
  the end. Lesson 29 has the plan and a model.
- **The essay** (at least 200 characters): on a theme given in a sentence or two. Plan the four parts
  (opening, two or three points or steps, conclusion) before you write a character. Lessons 26 and 29
  have the plans, models and checklists.

### Speaking

- **Retelling** (two passages): you hear a short passage and retell it. Keep the people, the order of events
  and the ending; use your own, simpler words.
- **Three photos**: a story with a beginning, a problem and an ending, using all three photos in order.
- **Two opinion questions**: state your view, give two reasons with an example, and conclude: the shape of
  lesson 26's essay, spoken.

## Scoring

The official site gives the new HSK 5 four scores (listening, reading, writing and a total out of 300),
but no pass mark had been published when this course was written. Under the old HSK 2.0, level 5 also
had 300 points, and 180 was the pass. Check the official site for the current rules.

## Strategies

### Before the exam

- Do at least one complete official sample paper, timed: 105 minutes for the written part, without breaks.
- Revise by register: the written words of lesson 27 ({便|biàn}, {较|jiào}, {其|qí}, {需|xū}, {至|zhì}, {因而|yīn ér}, {从而|cóng ér}) turn up in every reading text.
- Learn **[[collocations]]**, not lone words: {采取|cǎi qǔ}{措施|cuò shī}, {发挥|fā huī}{作用|zuò yòng}, {达成|dá chéng}{协议|xié yì}, {提高|tí gāo}{效率|xiào lǜ}, {满足|mǎn zú}{需求|xū qiú}, {扩大|kuò dà}{规模|guī mó}, {缩小|suō xiǎo}{差距|chā jù}, {引起|yǐn qǐ}{重视|zhòng shì}.
- Write by hand: the 150 handwriting characters of this course are below; the 400 earlier ones are in the
  character reference.
- Practise speaking with a timer: 1½ minutes for a retelling, 2 for the photo story, 2½ for an opinion.

### During the exam

- In the reading part, don't get stuck: a gap you can't fill now may be clear after the next sentence.
- For paragraph order, first find the start and the end, then link the middle by its first words.
- In the writing part, spend five minutes planning each task; count your characters roughly by lines.
- In the speaking test, use the preparation time to note key words, not to write sentences.
- When you're not sure in a choice question, cross out the choices that are certainly wrong: a choice that
  repeats words from the text but changes one detail (a number, "by" for "to", {将近|jiāng jìn} for {超过|chāo guò}) is a common trap.

<summary>Answers</summary>

1. Memory can be trained: forgetting is often a question of method, not of intelligence
   ({{记忆|jì yì}{是|shì}{可以|kě yǐ}{训练|xùn liàn}{的|de}…{记|jì}{不|bu}{住|zhù}{不|bù}{一定|yí dìng}{是|shì}{因为|yīn wèi}{不|bù}{聪明|cōng ming}，{很|hěn}{可能|kě néng}{只是|zhǐ shì}{方法|fāng fǎ}{不|bú}{对|duì}}).
2. Several short reviews spread out (straight after learning, the next day, a week later) rather than many
   repetitions at once; and linking new words to situations you know.
3. That it's probably the method: try spacing your reviews and connecting new things to what you know.
</details>

### E. Writing

1. **Four pictures**: {图|tú}{一|yī}：{一|yí}{个|gè}{女孩|nǚ hái}{在|zài}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{看见|kàn jiàn}{一|yì}{只|zhī}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}，{旁边|páng biān}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}。{图|tú}{二|èr}：{她|tā}{在|zài}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{身边|shēn biān}{等|děng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}，{天|tiān}{快|kuài}{黑|hēi}{了|le}。{图|tú}{三|sān}：{她|tā}{把|bǎ}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{的|de}{照片|zhào piàn}{发|fā}{到|dào}{了|le}{网上|wǎng shàng}。
   {图|tú}{四|sì}：{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{男孩|nán hái}{和|hé}{他|tā}{的|de}{妈妈|mā ma}{来|lái}{到|dào}{她|tā}{家|jiā}，{接|jiē}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}，{男孩|nán hái}{非常|fēi cháng}{高兴|gāo xìng}。 Write a story of at least 100 characters.
2. **Essay**: {生活|shēng huó}{中|zhōng}{总|zǒng}{有|yǒu}{一些|yì xiē}{变化|biàn huà}，{有的|yǒu de}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{高兴|gāo xìng}，{有的|yǒu de}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{不安|bù ān}。{请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{一|yi}{写|xiě}{你|nǐ}{生活|shēng huó}{中|zhōng}{的|de}{一|yí}{次|cì}{变化|biàn huà}，{以及|yǐ jí}{你|nǐ}{是|shì}{怎样|zěn yàng}{面对|miàn duì}{它|tā}{的|de}。 (Life always brings
   changes; write about one change in your life and how you faced it.) At least 200 characters.

<summary>A model for the four pictures</summary>

> {一|yì}{天|tiān}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}，{小青|Xiǎo Qīng}{在|zài}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{散步|sàn bù}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{看见|kàn jiàn}{一|yì}{只|zhī}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{独自|dú zì}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{路边|lù biān}，{旁边|páng biān}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}。{小青|Xiǎo Qīng}{担心|dān xīn}{它|tā}{的|de}{主人|zhǔ rén}{着急|zháo jí}，{就|jiù}{在|zài}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{身边|shēn biān}{等|děng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}，{可是|kě shì}{一直|yì zhí}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{来|lái}。{天|tiān}{快|kuài}{黑|hēi}{了|le}，{她|tā}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{先|xiān}{把|bǎ}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{带|dài}{回|huí}{了|le}{家|jiā}，{又|yòu}{把|bǎ}{它|tā}{的|de}{照片|zhào piàn}{发|fā}{到|dào}{了|le}{网上|wǎng shàng}。{没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}，{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{一大早|yí dà zǎo}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{男孩|nán hái}{和|hé}{他|tā}{的|de}{妈妈|mā ma}{就|jiù}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{她|tā}{家|jiā}。{原来|yuán lái}，{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{是|shì}{男孩|nán hái}{的|de}，{前|qián}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{跟|gēn}{着|zhe}{他|tā}{出来|chū lái}{玩|wán}，{走丢|zǒu diū}{了|le}。{看|kàn}{到|dào}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}，{男孩|nán hái}{高兴|gāo xìng}{得|de}{跳|tiào}{了|le}{起来|qǐ lái}，{一|yí}{次|cì}{又|yòu}{一|yí}{次|cì}{地|de}{对|duì}{小青|Xiǎo Qīng}{说|shuō}"{谢谢|xiè xie}"。

"One evening, as Xiao Qing was walking in the park, she saw a puppy sitting alone by the path with no one
nearby. Worried that its owner would be anxious, she waited beside it for a long time, but nobody came.
As it was getting dark, she had to take it home for now, and she posted its photo online. To her
surprise, first thing the next morning a little boy and his mother found her home. The puppy was the
boy's: it had followed him out the day before and got lost. When he saw it, the boy jumped for joy and
said 'thank you' to Xiao Qing again and again."
</details>

<details>
<summary>A plan for the essay</summary>

Opening: the change and when ({搬|bān}{到|dào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{城市|chéng shì}, {换|huàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}, {第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{离开|lí kāi}{家|jiā}). Before: how you felt ({刚|gāng}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{不安|bù ān}…). What you
did: two steps ({首先|shǒu xiān}…{后来|hòu lái}…). Conclusion: what the change taught you ({这|zhè}{次|cì}{变化|biàn huà}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}…; {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}… is too formal for a

At first there were very few customers and she worried every day. Later she put lots of books in the café and often held reading groups, and more and more people came. Now her café has become the favourite place of the young people nearby. She says that although she's more tired than before, every day is a happy one.

"I think each has its advantages, but I'd rather live in a small city. First, big cities have more
opportunities, but living there costs too much: rent and transport are expensive, and there's a lot of
pressure. Second, life in a small city moves more slowly, the air is better, and after work you have time
for your family and the things you like. Of course, for young people just out of university, a few years

## A study plan for the last month

| Week | Focus |
|---|---|
| 1 | One complete sample paper, timed. Mark it and list your weak parts. Review modules 1–2 (work, lifestyles). |
| 2 | Reading: two gap passages and two paragraph-order texts a day. Review modules 3–4 (relationships, study and technology) and the written words of lesson 27. |
| 3 | Writing: one picture story and one essay every other day, timed; check them against the checklists of lessons 26 and 29. Review module 5 (society, nature, tradition). |
| 4 | Listening and speaking every day (a retelling, a photo story, an opinion, timed). A second sample paper. Rest the day before. |

## Can you do this?

- Follow a talk of about 500 characters at normal speed and say what the speaker thinks.
- Read a 600-character report, find its main idea and the writer's view, and put shuffled paragraphs in order.
- Choose the right word for a gap by collocation and register ({采取|cǎi qǔ}{措施|cuò shī}; {需|xū} / {需要|xū yào}; {因而|yīn ér} / {从而|cóng ér}).
- Write a four-picture story of 100+ characters and an essay of 200+ characters with a clear structure.
- Retell a short passage, tell a story from three photos, and argue a view for two minutes.
- Write the 150 handwriting characters of HSK 5 from memory.

## Common mistakes in the exam

- Choosing the choice that repeats words from the passage: check the detail (by / to, {将近|jiāng jìn} / {超过|chāo guò}, {以前|yǐ qián} / {以后|yǐ hòu}).
- In paragraph order, putting first a paragraph that points back ({这|zhè}{份|fèn}{报告|bào gào}, {此外|cǐ wài}, {然而|rán ér}): it can't open the text.
- In the essay, writing a list of facts with no view, or a view with no reasons.
- Mixing registers in the writing part: {便|biàn} and {此时|cǐ shí} in a chatty story, or {吧|ba} and {啊|a} in an argued essay.
- In the speaking test, stopping after one sentence: use the time with reasons and an example.
- Leaving a writing task too short: 100 and 200 characters are minimums.

## Key points

- New HSK 5, as reported: listening 35, reading 35, writing 2 (72 questions, 105 minutes); speaking 5
  tasks in about 23 minutes. Pass mark not published.
- Reading: gaps by collocation, grammar and register; paragraph order by the first and last paragraphs and the
  links ({这|zhè} / {此外|cǐ wài} / {然而|rán ér} / time words); questions first, then the passage.
- Writing: four-picture story (≥ 100) and themed essay (≥ 200): plan first, count, check register.
- Speaking: retell (people, order, ending), three photos (beginning, problem, ending), opinion (view, reasons,
  conclusion).
- The 150 handwriting characters of HSK 5 are above; the character reference has all 431 new characters and the
  550 handwriting characters of levels 1–5.

lessons.title: Mencius
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

{孟子|Mèng zǐ} (Mencius) is, after Confucius, the best-known thinker of the Confucian tradition, and two of his
sayings are still often quoted in China, in speeches, essays and newspaper headlines. This honors
lesson reads them in the original, with pinyin, notes, a modern Chinese version and our own
translation, and puts them in their time. It is history of ideas: what Mencius argued, and how his
words are used today, not advice.

## Mencius and his book

Mencius lived in the Warring States period. His traditional dates are about 372 to 289 BCE, and the
meetings with rulers recorded in his book fall in the 320s and 310s BCE. Sima Qian's *Records of the
Grand Historian* places him in Zou, a small state near Lu, Confucius's home. Tradition links him to the
school of Confucius's grandson {子思|Zǐ sī}, though modern scholars doubt that he studied with Zisi
himself. He travelled from court to court, urging rulers to govern through benevolence ({仁|rén}) rather
than force, and argued that human nature is good at root: everyone has the beginnings of compassion.

The book that bears his name, 《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}》, records his conversations with rulers and students in seven
books. Much later, Neo-Confucian scholars such as {朱熹|Zhū Xī} (Zhu Xi, 1130–1200) counted it among the
"Four Books" that every educated person read.

## {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}

From the book's chapter 《{公孙丑|Gōng sūn Chǒu}》 (part two). The passage opens by weighing the right moment,
the lie of the land and the support of the people, and ends with this:

> {得|dé}{道|dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失|shī}{道|dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}。{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}{之|zhī}{至|zhì}，{亲戚|qīn qi}{畔|pàn}{之|zhī}；{多|duō}{助|zhù}{之|zhī}{至|zhì}，{天下|tiān xià}{顺|shùn}{之|zhī}。

### Words

| Word | Here | Modern Chinese |
|---|---|---|
| {得|dé}{道|dào} | to have the Way: to rule justly | {符合|fú hé}{正义|zhèng yì} |
| {者|zhě} | the one who…, a person who… | …{的|de}{人|rén} |
| {助|zhù} | help, support | {帮助|bāng zhù} |
| {寡|guǎ} | few, little | {少|shǎo} |
| {失|shī}{道|dào} | to lose the Way: to rule unjustly | {违反|wéi fǎn}{正义|zhèng yì} |
| {之|zhī}{至|zhì} | at its extreme ({至|zhì}: the furthest point) | {到|dào}{了|le}{极点|jí diǎn} |
| {亲戚|qīn qi} | relatives, one's own family | {亲人|qīn rén} |
| {畔|pàn} | to turn against (here written for 叛) | {背叛|bèi pàn} |
| {天下|tiān xià} | all under heaven: the whole world | {全|quán}{天下|tiān xià}{的|de}{人|rén} |
| {顺|shùn} | to follow, submit to | {服从|fú cóng} |

{正义|zhèng yì} is justice, {极点|jí diǎn} the extreme, {背叛|bèi pàn} to betray and {服从|fú cóng} to obey (all beyond HSK 5).

### In modern Chinese

{符合|fú hé}{正义|zhèng yì}{的|de}{人|rén}，{帮助|bāng zhù}{他|tā}{的|de}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{多|duō}；{违反|wéi fǎn}{正义|zhèng yì}{的|de}{人|rén}，{帮助|bāng zhù}{他|tā}{的|de}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{少|shǎo}。{帮助|bāng zhù}{的|de}{人|rén}{少|shǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{极点|jí diǎn}，{连|lián}{亲人|qīn rén}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{背叛|bèi pàn}{他|tā}；{帮助|bāng zhù}{的|de}{人|rén}{多|duō}{到|dào}{了|le}{极点|jí diǎn}，{全|quán}{天下|tiān xià}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{服从|fú cóng}{他|tā}。

### Our translation

"One who has the Way finds many to help; one who loses the Way finds few. When help is at its fewest,
even one's own family turns away; when help is at its greatest, the whole world follows."

The {者|zhě} of {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě} is the same {者|zhě} you know as a suffix from {志愿者|zhì yuàn zhě} (lesson 03) and {消费者|xiāo fèi zhě} (lesson 04): "a person
who…". Today the saying is usually shortened to the four-character {得道|dé dào}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}, and used of any cause,
team or country: a just cause wins support, an unjust one loses it.

## {老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}

From the book's first chapter, 《{梁惠王|Liáng Huì wáng}》 (part one), in a conversation with a king about how
to win the people's hearts:

> {老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以|yǐ}{及|jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}；{幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu}，{以|yǐ}{及|jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{幼|yòu}。

### Words

| Word | Here | Modern Chinese |
|---|---|---|
| {老|lǎo} (first) | a verb: to respect and care for (as the old should be cared for) | {尊敬|zūn jìng}, {照顾|zhào gù} |
| {吾|wú} | my, our | {我|wǒ}{的|de} |
| {老|lǎo} (second) | a noun: the old, one's elders | {老人|lǎo rén} |
| {以|yǐ} | and thereby, and so | {并且|bìng qiě} |
| {及|jí} | to reach, extend to | {推广|tuī guǎng}{到|dào} |
| {人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo} | other people's old ({之|zhī} = {的|de}) | {别人|bié ren}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén} |
| {幼|yòu} (first) | a verb: to love and care for (as the young should be) | {爱护|ài hù} |
| {幼|yòu} (second) | a noun: the young, children | {孩子|hái zi} |

### In modern Chinese

{尊敬|zūn jìng}、{照顾|zhào gù}{自己|zì jǐ}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}，{并且|bìng qiě}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{尊敬|zūn jìng}{推广|tuī guǎng}{到|dào}{别人|bié ren}{家|jiā}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}；{爱护|ài hù}{自己|zì jǐ}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}，{并且|bìng qiě}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{爱|ài}{推广|tuī guǎng}{到|dào}{别人|bié ren}{家|jiā}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}。

### Our translation

"Treat your own elders as elders should be treated, and extend it to the elders of others; treat your
own young as the young should be treated, and extend it to the young of others."

Two things make the line work. The same word is used twice in a row as a verb and then a noun: {老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo} is
"elder (verb) my elders", {幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu} "young (verb) my young". And {以及|yǐ jí} here is still two words, {以|yǐ} (and thereby)
and {及|jí} (to reach): care that starts at home reaches outwards. In modern Chinese {以及|yǐ jí} has become one word,
"as well as" (lesson 27), and {及|jí} (and) stands on its own in written texts.

The line is often quoted today where care for the old and the young is the topic: in reports on homes for
the elderly, in school campaigns, in speeches at the Double Ninth Festival ({重阳节|chóng yáng jié}).

## Reading: two sayings, still in use

> {两千|liǎng qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{以前|yǐ qián}，{孟子|Mèng zǐ}{带|dài}{着|zhe}{学生|xué sheng}{在|zài}{各|gè}{国|guó}{之间|zhī jiān}{奔走|bēn zǒu}，{希望|xī wàng}{君主|jūn zhǔ}{们|men}{能|néng}{用|yòng}"{仁|rén}"{来|lái}{治理|zhì lǐ}{国家|guó jiā}。{在|zài}{他|tā}{看来|kàn lái}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{国家|guó jiā}{强大|qiáng dà}{不|bu}{强大|qiáng dà}，{不|bú}{在于|zài yú}{土地|tǔ dì}{有|yǒu}{多|duō}{大|dà}、{军队|jūn duì}{有|yǒu}{多少|duō shao}，{而|ér}{在于|zài yú}{人心|rén xīn}。{他|tā}{说|shuō}"{得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}"，{意思|yì si}{是|shì}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{符合|fú hé}{正义|zhèng yì}，{就|jiù}{会|huì}{得到|dé dào}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{的|de}{支持|zhī chí}；{不|bù}{符合|fú hé}{正义|zhèng yì}，{支持|zhī chí}{的|de}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{少|shǎo}，{最后|zuì hòu}{连|lián}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{亲人|qīn rén}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{离开|lí kāi}。{他|tā}{还|hái}{举|jǔ}{过|guo}{一|yí}{个|gè}{例子|lì zi}：{一|yí}{座|zuò}{城|chéng}{的|de}{城墙|chéng qiáng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}，{粮食|liáng shi}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{可是|kě shì}{守|shǒu}{城|chéng}{的|de}{人|rén}{却|què}{丢下|diū xià}{城|chéng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。{这|zhè}{就|jiù}{是|shì}{他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}"{地利|dì lì}{不如|bù rú}{人和|rén hé}"：{地方|dì fang}{再|zài}{好|hǎo}，{也|yě}{比|bǐ}{不|bu}{上|shàng}{人|rén}{和|hé}{人|rén}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{团结|tuán jié}。
>
> {如今|rú jīn}，{这|zhè}{句|jù}{话|huà}{常常|cháng cháng}{被|bèi}{简单|jiǎn dān}{地|de}{说|shuō}{成|chéng}"{得道|dé dào}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}"，{用来|yòng lái}{说明|shuō míng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{道理|dào li}：{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{做|zuò}{正确|zhèng què}{的|de}{事|shì}，{才|cái}{能|néng}{赢得|yíng dé}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}。{不管|bù guǎn}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}、{一|yì}{家|jiā}{企业|qǐ yè}，{还是|hái shi}{一|yí}{个|gè}{团队|tuán duì}，{都|dōu}{是|shì}{如此|rú cǐ}。
>
> {孟子|Mèng zǐ}{的|de}{另|lìng}{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}"{老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}；{幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{幼|yòu}"，{也|yě}{为|wéi}{人|rén}{们|men}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī}。{这|zhè}{句|jù}{话|huà}{的|de}{意思|yì si}{是|shì}：{先|xiān}{照顾|zhào gù}{好|hǎo}{自己|zì jǐ}{家|jiā}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}，{再|zài}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{份|fèn}{关心|guān xīn}{推广|tuī guǎng}{到|dào}{别人|bié ren}{家|jiā}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}{身上|shēn shang}。{孟子|Mèng zǐ}{认为|rèn wéi}，{人|rén}{天生|tiān shēng}{就|jiù}{有|yǒu}{同情|tóng qíng}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{心|xīn}，{只要|zhǐ yào}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{心|xīn}{扩大|kuò dà}，{社会|shè huì}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{变|biàn}{得|de}{更加|gèng jiā}{美好|měi hǎo}。{他|tā}{举|jǔ}{的|de}{例子|lì zi}{是|shì}：{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{突然|tū rán}{看见|kàn jiàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{孩子|hái zi}{快要|kuài yào}{掉|diào}{进|jìn}{井|jǐng}{里|lǐ}，{心里|xīn li}{一定|yí dìng}{会|huì}{又|yòu}{着急|zháo jí}{又|yòu}{难过|nán guò}。{这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}{为了|wèi le}{得到|dé dào}{孩子|hái zi}{父母|fù mǔ}{的|de}{感谢|gǎn xiè}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{人|rén}{本来|běn lái}{就|jiù}{有|yǒu}{的|de}{同情|tóng qíng}{心|xīn}。
>
> {今天|jīn tiān}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{社区|shè qū}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{为|wèi}{老人|lǎo rén}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}{服务|fú wù}{的|de}{志愿者|zhì yuàn zhě}。{在|zài}{介绍|jiè shào}{这些|zhè xiē}{活动|huó dòng}{的|de}{文章|wén zhāng}{里|lǐ}，{人|rén}{们|men}{常常|cháng cháng}{会|huì}{引用|yǐn yòng}{孟子|Mèng zǐ}{的|de}{这|zhè}{句|jù}{话|huà}。{有|yǒu}{的|de}{社区|shè qū}{还|hái}{会|huì}{在|zài}{重阳节|Chóng yáng jié}{组织|zǔ zhī}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{去|qù}{看望|kàn wàng}{附近|fù jìn}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}，{或者|huò zhě}{请|qǐng}{退休|tuì xiū}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}{帮|bāng}{孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{复习|fù xí}{功课|gōng kè}。{可见|kě jiàn}，{两千|liǎng qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{前|qián}{的|de}{思想|sī xiǎng}，{到|dào}{今天|jīn tiān}{仍然|réng rán}{有|yǒu}{它|tā}{的|de}{价值|jià zhí}。

{奔走|bēn zǒu} is to travel about busily; {君主|jūn zhǔ} a ruler; {治理|zhì lǐ} to govern; {人心|rén xīn} people's hearts; {城墙|chéng qiáng} a city wall; {地利|dì lì} the advantages of the ground; {人和|rén hé} harmony among people;
{团结|tuán jié} (HSK 6) unity; {井|jǐng} (HSK 6) a well; {同情心|tóng qíng xīn} compassion; {引用|yǐn yòng} to quote; {重阳节|Chóng yáng jié} the Double Ninth
Festival, when older people are honoured; {功课|gōng kè} schoolwork.

1. According to the reading, what did Mencius think made a state strong?
2. How is the first saying usually said and used today?
3. What does the writer conclude with {可见|kě jiàn}?

<details>
<summary>Answers and translation</summary>

1. Not land or armies but people's hearts ({{不|bú}{在于|zài yú}{土地|tǔ dì}{有|yǒu}{多|duō}{大|dà}、{军队|jūn duì}{有|yǒu}{多少|duō shao}，{而|ér}{在于|zài yú}{人心|rén xīn}}).
2. As {得道|dé dào}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}, meaning that only by doing what is right do you win other people's help, whether
   you're a person, a company or a team.
3. That ideas from over two thousand years ago still have value today ({{两千|liǎng qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{前|qián}{的|de}{思想|sī xiǎng}，{到|dào}{今天|jīn tiān}{仍然|réng rán}{有|yǒu}{它|tā}{的|de}{价值|jià zhí}}).

"Over two thousand years ago, Mencius travelled from state to state with his students, hoping that
rulers would govern by benevolence. In his view, whether a state was strong lay not in how much land or
how many soldiers it had, but in the hearts of its people. He said, 'One who has the Way finds many to
help; one who loses the Way finds few': act justly and many will support you; act unjustly and your
supporters will dwindle until even your family leaves you. He also gave an example: a city's walls are high and it has plenty
of grain, yet its defenders abandon it and leave. That is what he meant by 'the advantages of the ground
are not as good as harmony among people': however good the place, it can't match people standing
together.

Today the saying is often shortened to {得道|dé dào}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}, and used to make a point: only by doing the
right thing can you win others' help. That's as true of a person or a company as of a team.

Another saying of his, 'Treat your own elders as elders, and extend it to the elders of others; treat
your own young as the young, and extend it to the young of others', is also familiar. It means: first
look after the old and the young of your own family, then extend that care to other people's. Mencius
believed people are born with compassion for others, and that if this feeling is enlarged, society
becomes better. His example: anyone who suddenly sees a small child about to fall into a well will feel
alarm and distress, not to win the parents' thanks, but out of the compassion people have from the
start.

Today many city neighbourhoods have volunteers who serve the old and the young, and articles about
their work often quote this saying. Some neighbourhoods also arrange, at the Double Ninth Festival,
for young people to visit older people nearby, or ask retired teachers to help children with their
schoolwork. So ideas from over two thousand years ago still have their value."
</details>

## Say it

```speak
# {孟子|Mèng zǐ}
{得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}。
= One who has the Way finds many to help; one who loses it finds few.
{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}{之|zhī}{至|zhì}，{亲戚|qīn qi}{畔|pàn}{之|zhī}；{多|duō}{助|zhù}{之|zhī}{至|zhì}，{天下|tiān xià}{顺|shùn}{之|zhī}。
= At the fewest, even one's family turns away; at the most, the whole world follows.
{老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}；{幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{幼|yòu}。
= Care for your own elders and extend it to others'; care for your own young and extend it to others'.
```

## Key points

- {孟子|Mèng zǐ} (Mencius, traditionally about 372–289 BCE): a Confucian thinker of the Warring States period; his book
  has seven books and became one of the Four Books.
- {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù} (《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}·{公孙丑|Gōng sūn Chǒu}{下|xià}》): a just ruler finds many to help; today {得道|dé dào}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}.
- {老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}；{幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{幼|yòu} (《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}·{梁惠王|Liáng Huì wáng}{上|shàng}》): the first {老|lǎo} and {幼|yòu} are verbs; {以及|yǐ jí} is still {以|yǐ} + {及|jí} here.
- Classical grammar you can now recognise: {者|zhě} (one who), {之|zhī} ({的|de}; or "him" after a verb: {畔|pàn}{之|zhī}, {顺|shùn}{之|zhī}), {吾|wú} (my), a word
  used as a verb and then as a noun.

lessons.title: Wang Wei and Li Bai: mountains and water
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

Chinese poems about mountains and rivers ({山水|shān shuǐ}{诗|shī}, landscape poetry) are among the most loved in
the language, and three of the best known are short enough to learn by heart: two by {王维|Wáng Wéi} (Wang Wei)
and one by {李白|Lǐ Bái} (Li Bai). This honors lesson reads each in full, with pinyin, notes, a modern Chinese
version and our own translation, and ends with what "poetry in painting" means.

## Two poets of the Tang

Both lived in the Tang dynasty's most famous century, and were born at about the same time.

- **{王维|Wáng Wéi}** (by the usual reckoning 701–761; some scholars put his birth a few years earlier) was a poet, a painter
  and a musician, who passed the imperial examination young and served as an official in the capital. His
  courtesy name was {摩诘|Mó jié}. His late poems come from his country estate at {辋川|Wǎng chuān}, south-east of
  the capital Chang'an, and are quiet, with few people in them.
- **{李白|Lǐ Bái}** (701–762) spent much of his life on the road, and his poems are bold, full of wine, moonlight and
  exaggeration. Later readers called him the {诗仙|shī xiān}, the "immortal of poetry".

Both poems by Wang Wei are short {绝句|jué jù}: four lines of five characters. Li Bai's has seven characters a
line.

## 《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》, by {王维|Wáng Wéi}

{鹿柴|Lù zhài} (Deer Enclosure) is one of the places on Wang Wei's estate. 柴 is read zhài here: a fence, an
enclosure.

> {空|kōng}{山|shān}{不|bú}{见|jiàn}{人|rén}，{但|dàn}{闻|wén}{人|rén}{语|yǔ}{响|xiǎng}。
>
> {返|fǎn}{景|jǐng}{入|rù}{深|shēn}{林|lín}，{复|fù}{照|zhào}{青|qīng}{苔|tái}{上|shàng}。

### Words

| Word | Here | Modern Chinese |
|---|---|---|
| {空|kōng}{山|shān} | an empty, quiet mountain | {空旷|kōng kuàng}{的|de}{山|shān} |
| {但|dàn} | only | {只|zhǐ} |
| {闻|wén} | to hear | {听|tīng}{到|dào} |
| {人|rén}{语|yǔ}{响|xiǎng} | the sound of people's voices | {人|rén}{说话|shuō huà}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn} |
| {返|fǎn}{景|jǐng} | light thrown back: the evening sun | {傍晚|bàng wǎn}{的|de}{阳光|yáng guāng} |
| {复|fù} | again | {又|yòu} |
| {青|qīng}{苔|tái} | green moss | {青苔|qīng tái} |

{景|jǐng} here means sunlight. Some annotations write {返景|fǎn jǐng} as {返|fǎn}{影|yǐng}, the light thrown back as the sun sets, and 景
can also stand for 影, read yǐng, so some readers say fǎn yǐng; we give jǐng, the dictionary reading of 景 as
"sunlight". You may hear both.

### In modern Chinese

{空旷|kōng kuàng}{的|de}{山|shān}{里|lǐ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{见|jiàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{只|zhǐ}{听|tīng}{到|dào}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{说话|shuō huà}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}。{傍晚|bàng wǎn}{的|de}{阳光|yáng guāng}{照|zhào}{进|jìn}{了|le}{深深|shēn shēn}{的|de}{树林|shù lín}，{又|yòu}{照|zhào}{在|zài}{了|le}{青苔|qīng tái}{上|shàng}。

### Our translation

"On the empty mountain, no one to be seen; only the sound of voices, heard. The evening light comes back
into the deep wood, and falls again on the green moss."

The poem is all sound and light: a voice you can't place, a ray of low sun. The person who sees and hears
is never named.

## 《{鸟鸣涧|Niǎo míng jiàn}》, by {王维|Wáng Wéi}

{鸟鸣涧|Niǎo míng jiàn} (Birds Calling in the Ravine): a spring night in the hills.

> {人|rén}{闲|xián}{桂|guì}{花|huā}{落|luò}，{夜|yè}{静|jìng}{春|chūn}{山|shān}{空|kōng}。
>
> {月|yuè}{出|chū}{惊|jīng}{山|shān}{鸟|niǎo}，{时|shí}{鸣|míng}{春|chūn}{涧|jiàn}{中|zhōng}。

### Words

| Word | Here | Modern Chinese |
|---|---|---|
| {闲|xián} | at leisure, still (lesson 06) | {闲静|xián jìng} |
| {桂|guì}{花|huā} | osmanthus (or a spring-flowering shrub of the same name) | {桂花|guì huā} |
| {惊|jīng} | to startle | {惊动|jīng dòng} |
| {时|shí} | now and then | {时时|shí shí} |
| {鸣|míng} | (of birds) to call | {叫|jiào} |
| {涧|jiàn} | a ravine, a mountain stream | {山沟|shān gōu} |

### In modern Chinese

{人|rén}{很|hěn}{闲静|xián jìng}，{桂花|guì huā}{轻轻|qīng qīng}{地|de}{落|luò}{下来|xià lái}。{夜晚|yè wǎn}{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}，{春天|chūn tiān}{的|de}{山|shān}{里|lǐ}{空空|kōng kōng}{的|de}。{月亮|yuè liang}{升|shēng}{起来|qǐ lái}，{惊动|jīng dòng}{了|le}{山|shān}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{鸟|niǎo}，{它们|tā men}{不时|bù shí}{在|zài}{春天|chūn tiān}{的|de}{山沟|shān gōu}{里|lǐ}{叫|jiào}{几|jǐ}{声|shēng}。

### Our translation

"Nobody stirs; the osmanthus petals fall. The night is still; the spring hills are empty. The moon comes
out and startles the mountain birds, who call now and then in the spring ravine."

The quiet is so deep that falling petals can be heard, and moonrise is enough to wake the birds.

## 《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》, by {李白|Lǐ Bái}

{庐山|Lú shān} is a mountain in Jiangxi, near the city of Jiujiang; {香炉|xiāng lú} (Incense Burner) is the name of one
of its peaks, wrapped in mist like smoke from an incense burner.

### Our translation

"The sun on Incense Burner Peak raises a purple haze; far off, the waterfall hangs over the river ahead.
Its flying stream plunges straight down three thousand feet: can it be the Milky Way, falling from the
ninth heaven?"

Three thousand {尺|chǐ} is nearly a kilometre, far higher than any real waterfall there, and the poem doesn't
mean it to be measured. The exaggeration ({夸张|kuā zhāng}) is Li Bai's signature.

## Poetry in painting

Wang Wei was also a painter, and about three centuries later the Song poet {苏轼|Sū Shì} (Su Shi) wrote of him:

> {味|wèi}{摩诘|Mó jié}{之|zhī}{诗|shī}，{诗|shī}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{画|huà}；{观|guān}{摩诘|Mó jié}{之|zhī}{画|huà}，{画|huà}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{诗|shī}。

"Savour Mojie's poems, and there are paintings in them; look at Mojie's paintings, and there are poems in
them." (From an inscription on one of Wang Wei's paintings.) {味|wèi} is "to savour", {观|guān} "to look at", {之|zhī} the
written {的|de}. {诗|shī}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{画|huà} is now a set phrase for any poem that makes you see a scene: the empty mountain, the
evening light on the moss, the moon over the ravine.

{信佛|xìn fó} to be a Buddhist; {晚年|wǎn nián} one's later years; {长安|Cháng ān} Chang'an, the Tang capital (today's Xi'an); {笔|bǐ}{下|xià} under
someone's pen, in their writing; {激情|jī qíng} is passion; {夸张|kuā zhāng} exaggeration; {背|bèi} here "to learn by heart" (the character of {背|bēi} bēi, to carry, HSK 4).

1. How does the reading describe the difference between the two poets?
2. In 《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》, what does the poet write about instead of describing people?
3. Why, according to the reading, are both poets still read today?

<details>
<summary>Answers and translation</summary>

1. Wang Wei's landscape poems are quiet and like paintings; Li Bai's are full of imagination and passion,
   with exaggeration ({{一|yí}{个|gè}{安静|ān jìng}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{热烈|rè liè}；{一|yí}{个|gè}{像|xiàng}{画家|huà jiā}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{像|xiàng}{歌手|gē shǒu}}).
2. Sound and light: voices with no one in sight, and the evening sun on the moss.
3. The poems are short, flow well and are easy to remember; above all, the poets put into words what
   many people feel but can't say (the quiet of being alone in the hills, the excitement of nature), so a
   thousand years later readers still find them close ({{诗人|shī rén}{写|xiě}{出|chū}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{心里|xīn li}{有|yǒu}、{却|què}{说|shuō}{不|bu}{出来|chū lái}{的|de}{感受|gǎn shòu}}).

"Wang Wei and Li Bai both lived in the Tang dynasty and both wrote many poems about mountains and rivers,
but their styles are very different. Wang Wei was a Buddhist who liked a quiet life and in his later
years often stayed in the hills near Chang'an; Li Bai loved wine and travelled to many places in his life. Their
different lives gave their poems different shapes too. Wang Wei's landscape poems are mostly quiet. In 'Deer Enclosure' the
poet doesn't say whom he saw, only sounds and light: no one in sight on the mountain, yet voices can be
heard; the evening sun shines into the wood and falls on the moss. The whole poem is only twenty characters long, yet it makes the mountain feel
especially still. In 'Birds Calling in the Ravine' the
night is so still you can hear the osmanthus falling, and when the moon comes out even the birds on the
mountain are startled awake. Reading such poems is like looking at a painting, which is why Su Shi said
there are 'paintings in his poems'. Li Bai's landscape poems, by contrast, are full of imagination and
passion. 'Gazing at the Waterfall on Mount Lu' begins with purple mist rising over Incense Burner Peak,
then the waterfall in the distance, hanging as it were in front of the mountain, and the last two lines
exaggerate even more: the water plunges from three thousand feet, as if the Milky Way were falling from
the sky. Most people seeing a waterfall might just say 'how high!'; Li Bai links it to the Milky Way. In his
writing, mountains and rivers seem to be alive. One
quiet, one passionate; one like a painter, one like a singer. Different as their styles are,
both poets' works have come down to the present day, and become poems Chinese children learn by heart.
The poems are short, flow well and are easy to remember; more important, the poets put into words what
many people feel but can't say: the quiet of being alone in the hills, the excitement of seeing nature.
That is why, more than a thousand years later, readers still find them close."
</details>

## Key points

- {王维|Wáng Wéi} (by the usual reckoning 701–761): poet and painter; 《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》 and 《{鸟鸣涧|Niǎo míng jiàn}》 are quiet five-character {绝句|jué jù} of sound
  and light. 柴 is zhài in {鹿柴|Lù zhài}.
- {李白|Lǐ Bái} (701–762): 《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》, seven characters a line, famous for its exaggeration ({三千|sān qiān}{尺|chǐ}, {银河|yín hé}{落|luò}{九天|jiǔ tiān}).
- {苏轼|Sū Shì} on Wang Wei: {诗|shī}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{画|huà}，{画|huà}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{诗|shī} ("paintings in his poems, poems in his paintings").
- Classical words: {闻|wén} (to hear), {但|dàn} (only), {复|fù} (again), {时|shí} (now and then), {遥|yáo} (far), {疑|yí} (to wonder whether), {之|zhī} ({的|de}).

questions.explanation: {曾经|céng jīng} is "once, at one time": a past state that is over, which {后来|hòu lái}{辞职|cí zhí}{了|le} confirms. {已经|yǐ jīng} would say he is a civil servant now ("already"), {正在|zhèng zài} is "in the middle of", and {一直|yì zhí} "all along", which contradicts the resignation.

questions.stem: Which sentence says she has a job now?
choices: {她|tā}{曾经|céng jīng}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{过|guo}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}。
{她|tā}{曾|céng}{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{实习|shí xí}。
{她|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{工作|gōng zuò}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {已经|yǐ jīng} + verb + {了|le}: the action is done and its result is still here, so she has a job. {曾经|céng jīng}…{过|guo}, {曾|céng} (written) and {以前|yǐ qián}…{过|guo} all put the experience in the past: we don't know whether it lasted.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (Please sign the contract.)
choices: {请|qǐng}{您|nín}{在|zài}{合同|hé tong}{上|shàng}{签字|qiān zì}。
questions.explanation: {签字|qiān zì} has its object built in ({签|qiān} + {字|zì}, sign + one's name), so it can't take {合同|hé tong} after it. Say {在|zài}{合同|hé tong}{上|shàng}{签字|qiān zì} (sign on the contract) or {签|qiān}{合同|hé tong} / {签订|qiān dìng}{合同|hé tong}.

questions.stem: Read the passage and choose the words for the gaps: {王芳|Wáng Fāng}{大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}，（①）{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{实习|shí xí}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}。{自从|zì cóng}{去年|qù nián}{秋天|qiū tiān}（②），{她|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{三十|sān shí}{多|duō}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}。{今年|jīn nián}{一|yī}{月|yuè}，{她|tā}{和|hé}{公司|gōng sī}（③）{了|le}{三|sān}{年|nián}{的|de}{合同|hé tong}，{成|chéng}{了|le}{正式|zhèng shì}{的|de}{记者|jì zhě}。
choices: ① {已经|yǐ jīng} ② {以后|yǐ hòu} ③ {签字|qiān zì}
① {曾经|céng jīng} ② {以来|yǐ lái} ③ {签订|qiān dìng}
① {曾经|céng jīng} ② {以前|yǐ qián} ③ {签字|qiān zì}
① {一直|yì zhí} ② {以来|yǐ lái} ③ {签名|qiān míng}
questions.explanation: ① {曾经|céng jīng}…{过|guo}: a past experience (the internship is over). ② {自从|zì cóng}…{以来|yǐ lái}: since, up to now. ③ {签订|qiān dìng} takes {合同|hé tong} as its object; {签字|qiān zì} and {签名|qiān míng} have their objects built in, so the first, third and fourth sets fail at ③ (and {以前|yǐ qián} can't close a {自从|zì cóng} phrase). {已经|yǐ jīng} and {以后|yǐ hòu} would be possible in ① and ②, but not with {签字|qiān zì}.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {各行各业|gè háng gè yè} naturally?
choices: {我|wǒ}{各行各业|gè háng gè yè}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年|nián}。
{他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{各行各业|gè háng gè yè}。
{来|lái}{参加|cān jiā}{培训|péi xùn}{的|de}{人|rén}{来自|lái zì}{各行各业|gè háng gè yè}。
{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{很|hěn}{各行各业|gè háng gè yè}。
questions.explanation: {各行各业|gè háng gè yè} (every trade and profession) works like a noun: here it's the object of {来自|lái zì} (come from). It can also be a subject with {都|dōu} ({各行各业|gè háng gè yè}{都|dōu}{需要|xū yào}{人才|rén cái}) or come before {的|de} ({各行各业|gè háng gè yè}{的|de}{人|rén}). It isn't a verb or an adjective.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {培训|péi xùn} péi xùn (training): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {证书|zhèng shū} zhèng shū (certificate): a falling tone, then a high level one, 4+1.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {培|péi}___ (training)
questions.explanation: {培训|péi xùn} péi xùn: 训 is 讠 (speech) + 川. 川 alone is a river; 顺 (smooth, {顺利|shùn lì}) has 页 on the right; 讯 xùn (news, message) has the same radical and sound but a different right side. {=Shapes as in simplified: 训 讠 + 川, 顺 with 页, 讯 with 讠.=} In traditional the speech radical is 言: {+训+}, {+顺+}, {+讯+}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {新|xīn}{员工|yuán gōng}{要|yào}{参加|cān jiā}{两|liǎng}{周|zhōu}{的|de}{培|péi}___。 (New staff have to attend two weeks of training.)
questions.explanation: {培训|péi xùn} péi xùn. {=训: 讠 + 川, five strokes=} (traditional {+训+}: 言 + 川, ten strokes).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我们|wǒ men}{下|xià}{周|zhōu}___ {合同|hé tong}。 (We sign the contract next week.)
questions.explanation: {签|qiān}{合同|hé tong} qiān hé tong (to sign a contract). Not 欠 qiàn (to owe).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Since she came here as an intern last year, she has written more than thirty articles.
questions.explanation: {自从|zì cóng}{去年|qù nián}{来|lái}{这儿|zhèr}{实习|shí xí}{以来|yǐ lái}，{她|tā}{写|xiě}{了|le}{三十|sān shí}{多|duō}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}。 The starting point ({去年|qù nián}{来|lái}{这儿|zhèr}{实习|shí xí}) sits between {自从|zì cóng} and {以来|yǐ lái}; the main clause follows. {以前|yǐ qián} (before) doesn't fit the frame; {自从|zì cóng}…{以后|yǐ hòu} would also be correct, but there is no {以后|yǐ hòu} tile.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker doing?

audio.text: 您好，我是新来的记者王芳，今天来报到。请问人事部在几楼？

choices: asking where to report on the first day at work
interviewing someone for a news story
questions.explanation: "{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{新|xīn}{来|lái}{的|de}{记者|jì zhě}…{今天|jīn tiān}{来|lái}{报到|bào dào}。{请问|qǐng wèn}{人事部|rén shì bù}{在|zài}{几|jǐ}{楼|lóu}？": she's a new reporter reporting for work and asks which floor Personnel is on.

questions.stem: Listen. What do we learn about the speaker?

audio.text: 我曾经在一家大公司工作过三年，收入很高，可是每天加班。现在这份工作挣得少一些，但是我更喜欢。

choices: They still work at the big company.
They earn less now but prefer the new job.
They want to go back to the big company.
questions.explanation: {曾经|céng jīng}…{工作|gōng zuò}{过|guo}{三|sān}{年|nián} puts the big company in the past; {现在|xiàn zài}{这|zhè}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}{挣|zhèng}{得|de}{少|shǎo}{一些|yì xiē}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{更|gèng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}: the new job pays less, but the speaker prefers it.

questions.stem: Listen to the short exchange. When does the new employee start the training?

audio.text: 新员工什么时候开始培训？下周一下午，一共三天。

questions.explanation: {下|xià}{周|zhōu}{一|yī}{下午|xià wǔ}，{一共|yí gòng}{三|sān}{天|tiān}: next Monday afternoon, three days in all.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's attitude to the job?

audio.text: 这份工作时间不固定，周末也常常要加班，挣得也不多。可是能做自己喜欢的事，我觉得很值得。

choices: happy with it in spite of the drawbacks
questions.explanation: The speaker lists the drawbacks (irregular hours, weekend work, low pay) and then turns with {可是|kě shì}: doing what they like makes it worth it ({很|hěn}{值得|zhí de}; {值得|zhí de} zhí de, HSK 4: worth it).

choices: to sell Chinese courses to students
to find two Chinese teachers to hire
to tell staff about a new training course
to announce that the company has been founded
questions.explanation: {招聘|zhāo pìn} (HSK 4) is "to recruit", and the company {需要|xū yào}{聘请|pìn qǐng}{两|liǎng}{名|míng}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{老师|lǎo shī} (needs to hire two Chinese teachers). The rest is what every advertisement has: the work ({工作|gōng zuò}{内容|nèi róng}), requirements ({要求|yāo qiú}), hours, pay and conditions ({待遇|dài yù}), and how to apply. ({气氛|qì fēn} qì fēn: atmosphere; {备|bèi}{课|kè} bèi kè: to prepare lessons; {编写|biān xiě} biān xiě: to write, compile; {优先|yōu xiān} yōu xiān: given priority; {教学|jiào xué} jiào xué: teaching; {照|zhào}{发|fā} zhào fā: paid as usual.)

questions.stem: Read part of an advertisement: “{要求|yāo qiú}：{本科|běn kē}{以上|yǐ shàng}{学历|xué lì}，{具备|jù bèi}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}{以上|yǐ shàng}{教学|jiào xué}{经验|jīng yàn}，{有|yǒu}{教师|jiào shī}{资格|zī gé}{证书|zhèng shū}{的|de}{优先|yōu xiān}。” ({教学|jiào xué}: teaching; {优先|yōu xiān} yōu xiān: given priority) Who is most likely to get the job?
choices: someone with a degree, three years of teaching and a teaching certificate
someone who has just left secondary school
someone with a degree but no teaching experience
someone with a teaching certificate but only six months of teaching
questions.explanation: The requirements are a first degree or above ({本科|běn kē}{以上|yǐ shàng}{学历|xué lì}) and at least two years' teaching ({两|liǎng}{年|nián}{以上|yǐ shàng}{教学|jiào xué}{经验|jīng yàn}); a teaching certificate gives priority ({有|yǒu}…{证书|zhèng shū}{的|de}{优先|yōu xiān}). Only the first person meets all three.

questions.stem: Read part of an advertisement: “{工作|gōng zuò}{时间|shí jiān}{固定|gù dìng}，{周|zhōu}{一|yī}{到|dào}{周|zhōu}{五|wǔ}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}。{待遇|dài yù}：{每|měi}{月|yuè}{工资|gōng zī}{八千|bā qiān}{到|dào}{一万|yí wàn}{元|yuán}，{另|lìng}{有|yǒu}{奖金|jiǎng jīn}。{本|běn}{公司|gōng sī}{为|wèi}{新|xīn}{员工|yuán gōng}{提供|tí gōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{培训|péi xùn}。” Which of these is NOT promised?
choices: a bonus on top of the salary
questions.explanation: The text promises fixed hours ({工作|gōng zuò}{时间|shí jiān}{固定|gù dìng}), a bonus ({另|lìng}{有|yǒu}{奖金|jiǎng jīn}: there is also a bonus) and a month's training ({提供|tí gōng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè} {的|de}{培训|péi xùn}). Nothing is said about housing.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (Our department is made up of five people.)
choices: {五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}{由|yóu}{我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{组成|zǔ chéng}。
{我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{由|yóu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}{组成|zǔ chéng}。
{我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{组成|zǔ chéng}{由|yóu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
{由|yóu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}{我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{组成|zǔ chéng}。
questions.explanation: The whole comes first, then {由|yóu} + the parts + {组成|zǔ chéng}: {我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{由|yóu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}{组成|zǔ chéng}. Putting the parts first turns the meaning upside down, and {由|yóu} must stand before the parts, with {组成|zǔ chéng} at the end.

questions.stem: Choose the word for a formal notice: {请|qǐng}{带|dài}{上|shàng}{照片|zhào piàn}、{简历|jiǎn lì}___ {学历|xué lì}{证书|zhèng shū}。 (Please bring a photo, your CV and your degree certificate.)
questions.explanation: {以及|yǐ jí} is the written "and, as well as", joining the last item of a list of nouns. {而且|ér qiě} and {并且|bìng qiě} join clauses ("and also"), not nouns in a list, and {还是|hái shi} is "or" in a question.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {会议|huì yì}___ {了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{就|jiù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{了|le}。 (The meeting was brought forward by half an hour: it started at half past nine.)
questions.explanation: {提前|tí qián} + a length of time moves a time earlier than planned: {提前|tí qián}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. {事先|shì xiān} (in advance, beforehand) goes before a verb and isn't followed by an amount of time ({事先|shì xiān}{通知|tōng zhī}{大家|dà jiā}). {以前|yǐ qián} and {先|xiān} don't take {了|le} + an amount here.

questions.stem: A notice says: “{本|běn}{周|zhōu}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{会议|huì yì}{室|shì}{开会|kāi huì}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{事先|shì xiān}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}{意见|yì jiàn}。” What does {本|běn}{周|zhōu}{五|wǔ} mean?
choices: a Friday some weeks from now
questions.explanation: {本|běn} before a noun is the written "this": {本|běn}{周|zhōu} = {这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}, {本|běn}{公司|gōng sī} = {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}, {本人|běn rén} = I myself. So {本|běn}{周|zhōu}{五|wǔ} is this Friday. {事先|shì xiān} is "in advance".

questions.stem: Choose the verb: {下|xià}{周|zhōu}{一|yī}{公司|gōng sī}{要|yào}___ {一|yí}{个|gè}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{会议|huì yì}。 (The company is holding an important meeting next Monday.)
questions.explanation: {召开|zhào kāi} is "to convene, hold" a meeting ({召开|zhào kāi}{会议|huì yì}: formal). {接待|jiē dài} is to receive guests, {担任|dān rèn} to hold a post, {转告|zhuǎn gào} to pass on a message.

questions.stem: Read the passage and choose the words for the gaps: {本|běn}{公司|gōng sī}（①）2010{年|nián}，{总部|zǒng bù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}。{公司|gōng sī}（②）{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{部门|bù mén}{组成|zǔ chéng}，{主要|zhǔ yào}{业务|yè wù}{包括|bāo kuò}{员工|yuán gōng}{培训|péi xùn}、{管理|guǎn lǐ}{培训|péi xùn}（③）{外语|wài yǔ}{培训|péi xùn}。
choices: ① {成立|chéng lì}{于|yú} ② {由|yóu} ③ {以及|yǐ jí}
① {设立|shè lì} ② {把|bǎ} ③ {而且|ér qiě}
① {成立|chéng lì}{于|yú} ② {被|bèi} ③ {或者|huò zhě}
① {召开|zhào kāi} ② {由|yóu} ③ {但是|dàn shì}
questions.explanation: ① {成立|chéng lì}{于|yú}: "was founded in" (written; {设立|shè lì} is for setting up a part, {召开|zhào kāi} for meetings). ② {由|yóu}…{组成|zǔ chéng}: be made up of. ③ {以及|yǐ jí}: written "and", before the last item of a list; {而且|ér qiě} and {但是|dàn shì} join clauses, and {或者|huò zhě} would make it "or".

questions.stem: Which word fits? {下|xià}{周|zhōu}{三|sān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}___ {要|yào}{来|lái}{公司|gōng sī}，{经理|jīng lǐ}{会|huì}{亲自|qīn zì}{接待|jiē dài}。 ({亲自|qīn zì}: in person, lesson 15)
questions.explanation: The visitor the manager receives in person is a client: {客户|kè hù}, a business's client. {主任|zhǔ rèn} (department head), {秘书|mì shū} (secretary) and {老板|lǎo bǎn} (the boss) are people inside the company.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {秘书|mì shū} mì shū (secretary): a falling tone, then a high level one, 4+1. 秘 is mì, not bì.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {企业|qǐ yè} qǐ yè (enterprise): a dipping tone, then a falling one, 3+4.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {主|zhǔ}___ (chairperson)
questions.explanation: {主席|zhǔ xí} zhǔ xí: 席 has 广 on top, a short horizontal with two verticals inside, and 巾 at the bottom. 度 (degree), 座 (seat; measure word) and 店 (shop) share the 广 top but not the 巾.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {房间|fáng jiān}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{包|bāo}___ {早饭|zǎo fàn}。 (The room price includes breakfast.)
questions.explanation: {包括|bāo kuò} bāo kuò (to include). 括 is 扌 + a 舌-shaped part; nine strokes.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}___ {立|lì}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。 (The company has set up an office in Shanghai.)
questions.explanation: {设立|shè lì} shè lì (to set up). {=设 is 讠 + 殳; six strokes=} (traditional {+设+}: 言 + 殳, eleven strokes).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: The project group is made up of the client's people and our company's staff.
questions.explanation: {这个|zhè ge}{项目|xiàng mù}{组|zǔ}{由|yóu}{客户|kè hù}{和|hé}{我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{员工|yuán gōng}{组成|zǔ chéng}。 The whole ({这个|zhè ge}{项目|xiàng mù}{组|zǔ}) is the subject; {由|yóu} introduces the members; {组成|zǔ chéng} closes the sentence. The two members can come in either order.

questions.stem: Listen. Where is the manager today?

audio.text: 吴经理今天去总部开会，明天才回来。有什么事，我可以转告他。

choices: meeting a client in his office
questions.explanation: {吴经理|Wú jīng lǐ}{今天|jīn tiān}{去|qù}{总部|zǒng bù}{开会|kāi huì}，{明天|míng tiān}{才|cái}{回来|huí lái}: he's gone to a meeting at headquarters and won't be back till tomorrow. The speaker (probably his secretary) offers to pass on a message ({转告|zhuǎn gào}).

questions.stem: Listen. What has happened to the plan?

audio.text: 这个方案原则上已经批准了，可是还有几个地方需要改一改。

choices: It is approved in principle but needs some changes.
It has been approved with no changes.
questions.explanation: {原则|yuán zé}{上|shàng}{已经|yǐ jīng}{批准|pī zhǔn}{了|le} (approved in principle), {可是|kě shì}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{地方|dì fang}{需要|xū yào}{改一改|gǎi yi gǎi} (but a few points need changing).

questions.stem: Listen to the short exchange. What will the first speaker do this afternoon?

audio.text: 我的鼠标坏了，怎么办？你下午去秘书那儿领一个新的吧。

choices: collect a new mouse from the secretary
ask the manager for a new computer
questions.explanation: {下午|xià wǔ}{去|qù}{秘书|mì shū}{那儿|nàr}{领|lǐng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{的|de}: go to the secretary this afternoon and collect a new one ({领|lǐng}: to receive, collect).

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true of the company?

audio.text: 本公司成立于2010年，总部在北京，由五个部门组成，在上海和广州设立了办公室。

choices: It has offices only in Beijing.
It is made up of five departments.
questions.explanation: {由|yóu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{部门|bù mén}{组成|zǔ chéng}: it's made up of five departments. It was founded in 2010 ({成立|chéng lì}{于|yú}, written "founded in"), has its headquarters in Beijing and has set up offices in Shanghai and Guangzhou.

questions.stem: Which sentence sounds natural?
choices: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{合作|hé zuò}{重要|zhòng yào}{极其|jí qí}。
{这|zhè}{次|cì}{合作|hé zuò}{极其|jí qí}{重要|zhòng yào}。
{极其|jí qí}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{合作|hé zuò}{重要|zhòng yào}。
questions.explanation: {极其|jí qí} (extremely, written) goes before an adjective or verb of two syllables or more: {极其|jí qí}{重要|zhòng yào}. Before a single syllable it sounds wrong (for "extremely good" say {非常|fēi cháng}{好|hǎo} or {好|hǎo}{极|jí}{了|le}), and it never follows the adjective or stands before the subject.

questions.stem: What does {格外|gé wài} add in "{下|xià}{过|guo}{雨|yǔ}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{空气|kōng qì}{格外|gé wài}{新鲜|xīn xiān}。"?
choices: The air is fresher than usual.
The air is only a little fresh.
The air is no longer fresh.
questions.explanation: {格外|gé wài} compares with the usual state: after the rain, the air is especially fresh, fresher than it normally is. "Too" would be {过于|guò yú} or {太|tài}, and "a little" {有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}.

questions.stem: Choose the pair: ___ {出|chū}{了|le}{问题|wèn tí}，{我们|wǒ men}___ {要|yào}{马上|mǎ shàng}{处理|chǔ lǐ}。 (If ever a problem comes up, we must deal with it at once.)
questions.explanation: {一旦|yí dàn}…{就|jiù}: once / if ever this happens, then… The result follows as soon as the condition is met. {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} is "although…", {不但|bú dàn}…{而且|ér qiě} "not only… but also", {一边|yì biān}…{一边|yì biān} "while".

questions.stem: Choose the word for a warning notice: ___ {发现|fā xiàn}{问题|wèn tí}，{请|qǐng}{马上|mǎ shàng}{报告|bào gào}。 (Should you find a problem, report it at once.)
questions.explanation: {一旦|yí dàn} sets up a condition that may or may not happen, and says what to do as soon as it does: typical of rules and warnings. {一直|yì zhí} is "all along", {一共|yí gòng} "in all", {一边|yì biān} "while".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我们|wǒ men}{跟|gēn}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{已经|yǐ jīng}___ {了|le}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}，{关系|guān xi}{一直|yì zhí}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 (We've worked with this company as partners for five years.)
questions.explanation: {合作|hé zuò} is two sides working together as partners. {达成|dá chéng} needs an object such as {协议|xié yì} or {一致|yí zhì}; {分配|fēn pèi} is to allocate ({分配|fēn pèi}{任务|rèn wu}); {集合|jí hé} is to gather at a place.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {经过|jīng guò}{几|jǐ}{次|cì}{讨论|tǎo lùn}，{双方|shuāng fāng}{终于|zhōng yú}___ {了|le}{协议|xié yì}。 (After several discussions, the two sides finally reached an agreement.)
questions.explanation: {达成|dá chéng}{协议|xié yì} (reach an agreement) and {达成|dá chéng}{一致|yí zhì} (reach a consensus) are the set collocations. {发挥|fā huī} is "make the most of" ({发挥|fā huī}{优势|yōu shì}), {投入|tóu rù} "throw oneself into", {避免|bì miǎn} "avoid".

questions.stem: Read the passage and choose the words for the gaps: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{时间|shí jiān}，（①）{紧|jǐn}。{大家|dà jiā}{要|yào}{互相|hù xiāng}（②），{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{要|yào}（③）{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{优势|yōu shì}。
choices: ① {极其|jí qí} ② {合作|hé zuò} ③ {发起|fā qǐ}
① {过于|guò yú} ② {达成|dá chéng} ③ {发挥|fā huī}
① {相当|xiāng dāng} ② {配合|pèi hé} ③ {发挥|fā huī}
① {格外|gé wài} ② {集合|jí hé} ③ {避免|bì miǎn}
questions.explanation: ① {相当|xiāng dāng}{紧|jǐn}: quite tight ({极其|jí qí} sounds wrong before one syllable). ② {互相|hù xiāng}{配合|pèi hé}: work in with each other ({达成|dá chéng} needs {协议|xié yì} or {一致|yí zhì}; {集合|jí hé} is to gather). ③ {发挥|fā huī}{优势|yōu shì}: make the most of one's strengths ({发起|fā qǐ} is to launch, {避免|bì miǎn} to avoid).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{优|yōu}___ {是|shì}{价格|jià gé}{便宜|pián yi}。 (Our advantage is a low price.)
questions.explanation: {优势|yōu shì} yōu shì (advantage). {=势 is 执 over 力; eight strokes=} (traditional {+势+}: 埶 over 力, thirteen strokes).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{我|wǒ}___ {担|dān}。 (I'll take this on.)
questions.explanation: {承担|chéng dān} chéng dān (to take on). 承 has the hand radical 手 hidden in the middle; eight strokes.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: If it pours on the day of the event, we'll put it back a week.
questions.explanation: {一旦|yí dàn}{活动|huó dòng}{当天|dàng tiān}{下|xià}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{推迟|tuī chí}{一|yì}{周|zhōu}{举行|jǔ xíng}。 {一旦|yí dàn} sets the condition, {就|jiù} the result; {一旦|yí dàn} can also follow the time phrase ({活动|huó dòng}{当天|dàng tiān}{一旦|yí dàn}{下|xià}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}…). {才|cái} doesn't pair with {一旦|yí dàn}. ({当天|dàng tiān} dàng tiān: that day; {推迟|tuī chí}: to postpone.)

questions.stem: Choose the word: {带|dài}{上|shàng}{伞|sǎn}{吧|ba}，___ {下雨|xià yǔ}{呢|ne}。 (Take an umbrella, in case it rains.)
questions.explanation: {万一|wàn yī} is "in case, if by any chance": an unlikely, unwelcome possibility, here with {呢|ne} at the end. {要不是|yào bu shì} is "if it weren't for" (a real fact), {哪怕|nǎ pà} "even if" (needs {也|yě}), {不然|bù rán} "otherwise".

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {你|nǐ}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}，{我|wǒ}{早|zǎo}{就|jiù}{放弃|fàng qì}{了|le}。 (If it weren't for your help, I'd have given up long ago.)
questions.explanation: {要不是|yào bu shì} takes a real fact (you did help) and imagines it away: "if it weren't for…". The result often has {早|zǎo}{就|jiù} or {就|jiù}. {万一|wàn yī} and {假如|jiǎ rú} suppose something that hasn't happened, and {哪怕|nǎ pà} needs {也|yě}.

questions.stem: Choose the pair: ___ {失败|shī bài}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}___ {不|bú}{后悔|hòu huǐ}。 (Even if I fail, I won't regret it.)
questions.explanation: {哪怕|nǎ pà}…{也|yě}: even if (the extreme case doesn't change the result). The blank after {我|wǒ} needs an adverb, so {也|yě} fits; {所以|suǒ yǐ} and {但是|dàn shì} start a clause and can't follow the subject, and {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} ("as long as I fail") makes no sense.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {快|kuài}{走|zǒu}{吧|ba}，___ {要|yào}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}。 (Let's go, or we'll be late.)
questions.explanation: {不然|bù rán} (otherwise) starts the clause saying what will happen if you don't follow the advice. {要不|yào bù} or {要不然|yào bù rán} would also work; {可见|kě jiàn}, {假如|jiǎ rú} and {哪怕|nǎ pà} don't.
