questions.explanation: {春节|Chūn jié}{的|de}{活动|huó dòng}{丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}: the idiom works as the predicate, "rich and varied", and the list after the colon shows the variety. {酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là} is a noun phrase (life's ups and downs), {悠久|yōu jiǔ} goes with {历史|lì shǐ}, and {神秘|shén mì} (mysterious) doesn't fit happy activities.

questions.stem: Read: "{春节|Chūn jié}{的|de}{活动|huó dòng} [1]：{有的|yǒu de}{地方|dì fang}{舞龙|wǔ lóng}，{有的|yǒu de}{地方|dì fang}{看|kàn}{灯|dēng}，{大人|dà ren}{孩子|hái zi}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{开心|kāi xīn}。{很|hěn}{多|duō}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{风俗|fēng sú}，[2] {还|hái}{保留|bǎo liú}{着|zhe}。" ({舞龙|wǔ lóng}: to perform a dragon dance) Which word goes in gap [2]?
questions.explanation: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{风俗|fēng sú}，{至今|zhì jīn}{还|hái}{保留|bǎo liú}{着|zhe}: "to this day they are still kept". {即将|jí jiāng} points to the future, {纷纷|fēn fēn} needs people reacting, and {为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì} gives a purpose.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {我|wǒ}{属|shǔ} ___。 (I was born in a dragon year.)
questions.explanation: {龙|lóng}, the dragon, the fifth animal of the zodiac. {={龙|lóng} has five strokes=}; traditional {+{龙|lóng}+} has sixteen.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {除|chú} ___ (New Year's Eve)
questions.explanation: {除夕|chú xī}: the evening ({夕|xī}) when the old year is removed ({除|chú}). {={夕|xī} has three strokes: left-falling, horizontal-turn, dot=}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: However busy he is, he goes back to his home town to celebrate New Year with his parents.
questions.explanation: {他|tā}{再|zài}{忙|máng}{也|yě}{要|yào}{回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā}{和|hé}{父母|fù mǔ}{一起|yì qǐ}{过年|guò nián}。 {再|zài} + {忙|máng}, then {也|yě} + {要|yào} before the rest of the verb phrase. {和|hé}{父母|fù mǔ}{一起|yì qǐ} can also come before {回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā} (going home with them). {才|cái} (only then) would contradict the meaning.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "However tired I am, I'll finish today's work"?
choices: {我|wǒ}{再|zài}{累|lèi}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{把|bǎ}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
{我|wǒ}{再|zài}{累|lèi}{也|yě}{要|yào}{把|bǎ}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
{我|wǒ}{累|lèi}{也|yě}{再|zài}{要|yào}{把|bǎ}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
{再|zài}{我|wǒ}{累|lèi}{也|yě}{要|yào}{把|bǎ}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
questions.explanation: {再|zài} goes right before the adjective ({再|zài}{累|lèi}) and {也|yě} before the verb of the second half. {就|jiù} doesn't pair with {再|zài} here; {再|zài} can't move behind {也|yě} or in front of the subject.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì}{赶|gǎn}{第|dì}{一|yī}{班|bān}{地铁|dì tiě}，{他|tā}{每天|měi tiān}{早|zǎo}{起|qǐ}。
{他|tā}{为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì}{每天|měi tiān}{早|zǎo}{起|qǐ}，{赶|gǎn}{第|dì}{一|yī}{班|bān}{地铁|dì tiě}。
{他|tā}{每天|měi tiān}{早|zǎo}{起|qǐ}，{为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì}{赶|gǎn}{第|dì}{一|yī}{班|bān}{地铁|dì tiě}。
{他|tā}{每天|měi tiān}{早|zǎo}{起|qǐ}，{为了|wèi le}{是|shì}{赶|gǎn}{第|dì}{一|yī}{班|bān}{地铁|dì tiě}。
questions.explanation: {为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì} comes after the action, introducing its purpose. To put the purpose first, say {为了|wèi le}{赶|gǎn}{第|dì}{一|yī}{班|bān}{地铁|dì tiě}，{他|tā}{每天|měi tiān}{早|zǎo}{起|qǐ}. {为了|wèi le}{是|shì} is not a form: it's {是|shì}{为了|wèi le} or {为|wèi}{的|de}{是|shì}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{桥|qiáo}{建于|jiàn yú}1920{年|nián}，___ {已经|yǐ jīng}{一百|yì bǎi}{多|duō}{年|nián}{了|le}。 (The bridge was built in 1920: it's over a hundred years old now.)
questions.explanation: {至今|zhì jīn}: up to now, to this day. {即将|jí jiāng} is "about to", {从前|cóng qián} "in the past", {当时|dāng shí} "at that time".

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi} correctly?
choices: {学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{课|kè}{外|wài}{活动|huó dòng}{丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}。
{我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}{地|de}{去|qù}{上班|shàng bān}。
{他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}。
{这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi} (rich and varied) describes activities, events or a life, as the predicate or before {的|de} + noun ({丰富多彩|fēng fù duō cǎi}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}). It isn't a manner of going to work, a noun after {一|yí}{个|gè}, or a verb.

questions.stem: In "{留学|liú xué}{一|yì}{年|nián}，{酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}。", what does {酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là} mean?
choices: every kind of experience, good and bad
questions.explanation: {酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là} is literally sour, sweet, bitter and spicy: the four tastes stand for every experience, the ups and downs. "A year abroad: it's had everything."

questions.stem: Someone asks you: "{你|nǐ}{属|shǔ}{什么|shén me}？" What do they want to know?
questions.explanation: {属|shǔ} + animal: born in that animal's year ({我|wǒ}{属|shǔ}{马|mǎ}). The question is also a roundabout way of asking someone's age.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {小说|xiǎo shuō}, a novel: third tone + first tone.

questions.stem: Which of these is a work of history, written at the end of the third century?
choices: 《{三国演义|Sān guó yǎn yì}》 (the Romance of the Three Kingdoms)
《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》 (Journey to the West)
《{三国志|Sān guó zhì}》 (the Records of the Three Kingdoms)
a modern film about {诸葛亮|Zhū gě Liàng}
questions.explanation: 《{三国志|Sān guó zhì}》, by {陈寿|Chén Shòu}, is the history of the period, written soon after it ended. 《{三国演义|Sān guó yǎn yì}》 is the novel of the Ming dynasty; 《{西游记|Xī yóu jì}》 is another Ming novel (HSK 3).

questions.stem: Who is traditionally said to have written 《{三国演义|Sān guó yǎn yì}》?
questions.explanation: The novel is traditionally attributed to {罗贯中|Luó Guàn zhōng}, a writer who probably lived in the 14th century and of whom little is known. {陈寿|Chén Shòu} wrote the history; {诸葛亮|Zhū gě Liàng} and {曹操|Cáo Cāo} are characters.

questions.stem: When was the Three Kingdoms period?
questions.explanation: The Three Kingdoms are usually dated 220 (the end of the Han) to 280 (reunification under the Jin). The 14th century is the novel's; 1522 is its oldest surviving printed edition, and 618–907 is the Tang dynasty.

questions.stem: Which of these was NOT one of the three kingdoms?
questions.explanation: {魏|Wèi} (in the north), {蜀|Shǔ} (in the south-west) and {吴|Wú} (in the south-east) were the three kingdoms. {唐|Táng} is the Tang dynasty, centuries later.

questions.stem: What does the 《{三国志|Sān guó zhì}》 say about {刘备|Liú Bèi}, {关羽|Guān Yǔ} and {张飞|Zhāng Fēi}?
choices: They swore an oath in a peach garden.
They were as close as brothers, though it mentions no oath.
questions.explanation: The history says the three were {恩若兄弟|ēn ruò xiōng dì} (as close as brothers) and even shared a bed, but records no oath. The peach garden oath ({桃园结义|táo yuán jié yì}) is the novel's scene, built on lines like these.

questions.stem: In history, whose boat was shot so full of arrows on one side that it had to be turned round?
questions.explanation: An early history quoted in the notes to the 《{三国志|Sān guó zhì}》 tells it of {孙权|Sūn Quán}, ruler of {吴|Wú}, at {濡须|Rú xū} in 213. The novel gave the trick to {诸葛亮|Zhū gě Liàng} and added the fog, the straw and the hundred thousand arrows.

questions.stem: People describe 《{三国演义|Sān guó yǎn yì}》 as "{七分事实|qī fēn shì shí}，{三分虚构|sān fēn xū gòu}". What do they mean?
choices: It is mostly based on history, with a good part made up.
It has seven parts and three chapters.
questions.explanation: {七分事实|qī fēn shì shí}，{三分虚构|sān fēn xū gòu}: seven parts fact, three parts fiction ({虚构|xū gòu}, to make up). The outline is history; many scenes and details are the author's.

questions.stem: The novel opens: "{天下|tiān xià}{大势|dà shì}，{分久必合|fēn jiǔ bì hé}，{合久必分|hé jiǔ bì fēn}。" What does it say about history?
choices: A land long divided will unite, and a land long united will divide.
Every war ends in peace for ever.
questions.explanation: {分久必合|fēn jiǔ bì hé} (long divided, it must unite), {合久必分|hé jiǔ bì fēn} (long united, it must divide): the novel sees history as a cycle of union and division. {天下|tiān xià}, all under heaven; {大势|dà shì}, the general trend.

questions.stem: Listen. In the novel, where do the three men become sworn brothers?

audio.text: 在小说里，刘备、关羽和张飞是在桃园发誓成为兄弟的。

choices: on a boat in the fog
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{里|lǐ}，{刘备|Liú Bèi}、{关羽|Guān Yǔ}{和|hé}{张飞|Zhāng Fēi}{是|shì}{在|zài}{桃园|táo yuán}{发誓|fā shì}{成为|chéng wéi}{兄弟|xiōng dì}{的|de}。 "In the novel, Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei swore in a peach garden to be brothers." {桃园|táo yuán} is a peach orchard; {发誓|fā shì}, to swear (the lesson's {结为|jié wéi}{兄弟|xiōng dì}: to become sworn brothers).

questions.stem: Read Anna's answer to a visitor: "{安娜|Ān nà}{笑|xiào}{着|zhe}{说|shuō}："{我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{要|yào}{分清楚|fēn qīng chu}{两|liǎng}{样|yàng}{东西|dōng xi}：{一|yí}{个|gè}{是|shì}{历史|lì shǐ}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{是|shì}{小说|xiǎo shuō}。{小说|xiǎo shuō}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{人物|rén wù}、{国家|guó jiā}{和|hé}{大|dà}{的|de}{事件|shì jiàn}，{大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{历史|lì shǐ}{上|shàng}{真实|zhēn shí}{存在|cún zài}{的|de}。{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{细节|xì jié}，{比如|bǐ rú}{草船借箭|cǎo chuán jiè jiàn}，{是|shì}{作者|zuò zhě}{加进去|jiā jìn qù}{的|de}。{你们|nǐ men}{看|kàn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}、{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{都|dōu}{没问题|méi wèn tí}，{就是|jiù shì}{别|bié}{把|bǎ}{它|tā}{当成|dàng chéng}{历史|lì shǐ}{书|shū}。"" ({分清楚|fēn qīng chu}: to tell apart; {存在|cún zài} (lesson 26): to exist; {大多|dà duō} (lesson 28): mostly; {细节|xì jié} (lesson 26): details; {草船借箭|cǎo chuán jiè jiàn}: borrowing arrows with straw boats) What is her advice?
choices: Don't read the novel at all.
Enjoy the novel and the films, but don't treat them as history.
Read only the history, never the novel.
Believe every detail of the film.
questions.explanation: {你们|nǐ men}{看|kàn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}、{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{都|dōu}{没问题|méi wèn tí}，{就是|jiù shì}{别|bié}{把|bǎ}{它|tā}{当成|dàng chéng}{历史|lì shǐ}{书|shū}: reading and watching are fine; just don't take the novel for a history book. {当成|dàng chéng} (lesson 12): to take as.

questions.stem: Read Anna's answer to a visitor: "{安娜|Ān nà}{笑|xiào}{着|zhe}{说|shuō}："{我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{要|yào}{分清楚|fēn qīng chu}{两|liǎng}{样|yàng}{东西|dōng xi}：{一|yí}{个|gè}{是|shì}{历史|lì shǐ}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{是|shì}{小说|xiǎo shuō}。{小说|xiǎo shuō}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{人物|rén wù}、{国家|guó jiā}{和|hé}{大|dà}{的|de}{事件|shì jiàn}，{大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{历史|lì shǐ}{上|shàng}{真实|zhēn shí}{存在|cún zài}{的|de}。{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{细节|xì jié}，{比如|bǐ rú}{草船借箭|cǎo chuán jiè jiàn}，{是|shì}{作者|zuò zhě}{加进去|jiā jìn qù}{的|de}。{你们|nǐ men}{看|kàn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}、{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{都|dōu}{没问题|méi wèn tí}，{就是|jiù shì}{别|bié}{把|bǎ}{它|tā}{当成|dàng chéng}{历史|lì shǐ}{书|shū}。"" ({分清楚|fēn qīng chu}: to tell apart; {存在|cún zài} (lesson 26): to exist; {大多|dà duō} (lesson 28): mostly; {细节|xì jié} (lesson 26): details; {草船借箭|cǎo chuán jiè jiàn}: borrowing arrows with straw boats) According to Anna, what in the novel is mostly real?
choices: the people, the states and the big events
questions.explanation: {小说|xiǎo shuō}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{人物|rén wù}、{国家|guó jiā}{和|hé}{大|dà}{的|de}{事件|shì jiàn}，{大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{历史|lì shǐ}{上|shàng}{真实|zhēn shí}{存在|cún zài}{的|de}: the characters, the states and the big events mostly really existed; details such as the straw boats were added.

questions.stem: A friend says "{说|shuō}{曹操|Cáo Cāo}，{曹操|Cáo Cāo}{到|dào}！" as someone walks in. What does it mean?
choices: Speak of the devil: we were just talking about you.
Cao Cao is coming to fight.
Please tell a story about Cao Cao.
You are as clever as Cao Cao.
questions.explanation: {说|shuō}{曹操|Cáo Cāo}，{曹操|Cáo Cāo}{到|dào}: "speak of Cao Cao, and Cao Cao arrives": said when the person you're talking about turns up, like "speak of the devil".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {舞台|wǔ tái}, a stage: third tone + second tone.

questions.stem: What are the figures of Chinese shadow puppetry made of, in UNESCO's description?
questions.explanation: UNESCO describes "colourful silhouette figures made from leather or paper". Leather figures are scraped thin enough for light to shine through, then carved and coloured.

questions.stem: How are the figures worked?
choices: with rods, behind a screen lit from behind
with strings, from above a stage
by hand, in front of the audience
questions.explanation: Puppeteers move the figures with thin rods ({杆子|gān zi}) behind a white cloth screen ({幕布|mù bù}) with a light behind it; the main rod holds the figure at the neck.

questions.stem: In which year was Chinese shadow puppetry inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List?
questions.explanation: Chinese shadow puppetry was inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2011.

questions.stem: How many moveable joints does a shadow figure have, according to UNESCO?
questions.explanation: UNESCO gives twelve to twenty-four moveable joints ({关节|guān jié}), at the neck, shoulders, elbows, waist and knees, so a figure can walk, bow and fight.

questions.stem: How have the skills of shadow puppetry been handed down?
choices: in families, in troupes, and from master to pupil
questions.explanation: UNESCO: the skills are "handed down in families, in troupes, and from master to pupil". Master Kong in the reading learned from his father, who learned from his grandfather.

questions.stem: What is the story of Emperor Wu of the Han and the shadow of his lost consort?
choices: the first written record of a shadow play
the plot of the most famous shadow play
a story from the 《{三国演义|Sān guó yǎn yì}》
a legend about the origin of shadow plays, not a historical record
questions.explanation: The story links shadow theatre to {汉武帝|Hàn Wǔ dì}, but historians of puppetry treat it as a legend. What is clear is that shadow plays were popular in the cities by the Song dynasty.

questions.stem: Listen. In what order is a shadow figure made?

audio.text: 皮影是用驴皮做的，先把皮刮得很薄，再刻出花纹，最后上颜色。

choices: scrape the hide thin, carve the patterns, then colour it
colour the hide, then carve it, then scrape it
carve the hide, then scrape it, then sew it
paint the paper, then cut it, then dry it in the sun
questions.explanation: {皮影|pí yǐng}{是|shì}{用|yòng}{驴皮|lǘ pí}{做|zuò}{的|de}，{先|xiān}{把|bǎ}{皮|pí}{刮|guā}{得|de}{很|hěn}{薄|báo}，{再|zài}{刻|kè}{出|chū}{花纹|huā wén}，{最后|zuì hòu}{上颜色|shàng yán sè}。 "Shadow figures are made of donkey hide: first it is scraped thin, then the patterns are carved out, and last of all it is coloured." {先|xiān}…{再|zài}…{最后|zuì hòu}: first, then, finally.

questions.stem: Read Anna's account: "{演出|yǎn chū}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{一|yí}{位|wèi}{姓|xìng}{孔|Kǒng}{的|de}{老艺人|lǎo yì rén}{请|qǐng}{我们|wǒ men}{到|dào}{幕布|mù bù}{后面|hòu miàn}{去|qù}{看看|kàn kan}。{原来|yuán lái}，{台|tái}{上|shàng}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{三|sān}{个|gè}{人|rén}：{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{唱|chàng}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{打鼓|dǎ gǔ}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{用|yòng}{三|sān}{根|gēn}{细细|xì xì}{的|de}{杆子|gān zi}{同时|tóng shí}{操作|cāo zuò}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{皮影|pí yǐng}。{孔师傅|Kǒng shī fu}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}，{这些|zhè xiē}{皮影|pí yǐng}{是|shì}{用|yòng}{驴皮|lǘ pí}{做|zuò}{的|de}，{先|xiān}{把|bǎ}{皮|pí}{刮|guā}{得|de}{很|hěn}{薄|báo}，{再|zài}{一刀一刀|yì dāo yì dāo}{地|de}{刻|kè}{出|chū}{花纹|huā wén}，{最后|zuì hòu}{上颜色|shàng yán sè}。" ({艺人|yì rén}: a performer; {幕布|mù bù}: the screen; {杆子|gān zi}: a rod; {皮影|pí yǐng}: a shadow figure; {驴皮|lǘ pí}: donkey hide; {刮|guā}{得|de}{很|hěn}{薄|báo}: scraped very thin; {花纹|huā wén}: a pattern) How many people were performing behind the screen?
questions.explanation: {台|tái}{上|shàng}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{三|sān}{个|gè}{人|rén}：{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{唱|chàng}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{打鼓|dǎ gǔ}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}…{操作|cāo zuò}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{皮影|pí yǐng}: one singing, one drumming and one working two figures. UNESCO says small troupes have two to five performers.

questions.stem: Read Anna's account: "{演出|yǎn chū}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{一|yí}{位|wèi}{姓|xìng}{孔|Kǒng}{的|de}{老艺人|lǎo yì rén}{请|qǐng}{我们|wǒ men}{到|dào}{幕布|mù bù}{后面|hòu miàn}{去|qù}{看看|kàn kan}。{原来|yuán lái}，{台|tái}{上|shàng}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{三|sān}{个|gè}{人|rén}：{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{唱|chàng}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{打鼓|dǎ gǔ}，{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{用|yòng}{三|sān}{根|gēn}{细细|xì xì}{的|de}{杆子|gān zi}{同时|tóng shí}{操作|cāo zuò}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{皮影|pí yǐng}。{孔师傅|Kǒng shī fu}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}，{这些|zhè xiē}{皮影|pí yǐng}{是|shì}{用|yòng}{驴皮|lǘ pí}{做|zuò}{的|de}，{先|xiān}{把|bǎ}{皮|pí}{刮|guā}{得|de}{很|hěn}{薄|báo}，{再|zài}{一刀一刀|yì dāo yì dāo}{地|de}{刻|kè}{出|chū}{花纹|huā wén}，{最后|zuì hòu}{上颜色|shàng yán sè}。" ({艺人|yì rén}: a performer; {幕布|mù bù}: the screen; {杆子|gān zi}: a rod; {皮影|pí yǐng}: a shadow figure; {驴皮|lǘ pí}: donkey hide; {刮|guā}{得|de}{很|hěn}{薄|báo}: scraped very thin; {花纹|huā wén}: a pattern) How did one performer work two figures at once?
choices: with strings tied to his fingers
questions.explanation: {用|yòng}{三|sān}{根|gēn}{细细|xì xì}{的|de}{杆子|gān zi}{同时|tóng shí}{操作|cāo zuò}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{皮影|pí yǐng}: with three thin rods ({根|gēn}, lesson 22's measure word for long thin things) he worked two figures at the same time.

questions.stem: What does {皮影戏|pí yǐng xì} mean, word for word?
questions.explanation: {皮|pí} (leather, skin) + {影|yǐng} (shadow) + {戏|xì} (play, drama): a play of leather shadows.

questions.stem: According to UNESCO, how many performers does a large shadow-puppet troupe have?
questions.explanation: UNESCO: large troupes have seven to nine performers; small ones two to five.

questions.stem: At a show, the coloured figures glow on the screen instead of looking black. Why?
choices: The hide is scraped so thin that the light shines through its colours.
The figures are lit from the front by the audience.
The figures are made of glass.
questions.explanation: Leather figures are scraped very thin, then carved and coloured, so the lamp behind the screen shines through them "like glass", as Anna writes.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{全|quán}{班|bān}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{做|zuò}{对|duì}{了|le}，___ {难度|nán dù}{相当|xiāng dāng}{大|dà}。 (Only two people in the class got this question right: it must be really hard.)
questions.explanation: The first clause is a fact, the second the conclusion it shows: {可见|kě jiàn} (so it can be seen that). {因为|yīn wèi} would make the difficulty the cause of something, {于是|yú shì} (and so, then) tells what happened next, and {不然|bù rán} is "otherwise".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {那|nà}{次|cì}{失败|shī bài}___ {他|tā}{重新|chóng xīn}{考虑|kǎo lǜ}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{计划|jì huà}。 (That failure prompted him to rethink his plans.)
questions.explanation: {促使|cù shǐ} + person + action: something pushes someone into doing something. {在于|zài yú} is "to lie in", {属于|shǔ yú} "to belong to" and {针对|zhēn duì} "to be aimed at": none of them takes a person and a verb after it.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {成功|chéng gōng}{的|de}{关键|guān jiàn}___ {坚持|jiān chí}。 (The key to success lies in keeping at it.)
questions.explanation: X {在于|zài yú} Y: X lies in Y, the heart of the matter ({问题|wèn tí}{在于|zài yú}, {关键|guān jiàn}{在于|zài yú}, {区别|qū bié}{在于|zài yú}). {属于|shǔ yú} is "to belong to (a class)", {处于|chǔ yú} "to be in (a state)", and {对于|duì yú} (concerning) starts a phrase; it isn't a verb.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {公司|gōng sī}{现在|xiàn zài}___ {困难|kùn nan}{时期|shí qī}，{大家|dà jiā}{要|yào}{一起|yì qǐ}{努力|nǔ lì}。 (The company is going through a difficult time: everyone must pull together.)
questions.explanation: {处于|chǔ yú} (chǔ yú) + a state or period: {处于|chǔ yú}{困难|kùn nan}{时期|shí qī}, {处于|chǔ yú}{不利|bú lì}{的|de}{位置|wèi zhì}. {属于|shǔ yú} puts something in a class ({这|zhè}{属于|shǔ yú}{技术|jì shù}{问题|wèn tí}), {在于|zài yú} names where the point lies, and {关于|guān yú} (about) isn't a verb.

questions.stem: What does "{这|zhè}{次|cì}{讨论|tǎo lùn}{围绕|wéi rào}{网上|wǎng shàng}{评价|píng jià}{展开|zhǎn kāi}。" mean?
choices: The discussion went round in circles about online reviews.
The discussion was held online after the reviews.
The discussion centred on online reviews.
questions.explanation: {围绕|wéi rào} is literally "to go round" ({地球|dì qiú}{围绕|wéi rào}{着|zhe}{太阳|tài yang}{转|zhuàn}), and with a topic it means "to centre on": everything in the discussion turned on online reviews. {展开|zhǎn kāi} is "to unfold, to take place".

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Many people regard tea as one of the symbols of Chinese culture."?
choices: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{把|bǎ}{茶|chá}{视为|shì wéi}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{的|de}{代表|dài biǎo}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{视为|shì wéi}{茶|chá}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{的|de}{代表|dài biǎo}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{把|bǎ}{茶|chá}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{的|de}{代表|dài biǎo}{之|zhī}{一|yī}{视为|shì wéi}。
{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{茶|chá}{把|bǎ}{视为|shì wéi}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{的|de}{代表|dài biǎo}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
questions.explanation: {把|bǎ} A {视为|shì wéi} B: {把|bǎ} and the thing come before the verb, and what you regard it as comes after {视为|shì wéi}. (Passive: {茶|chá}{被|bèi}{视为|shì wéi}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{的|de}{代表|dài biǎo}{之|zhī}{一|yī}.) The other orders break the {把|bǎ} pattern: {把|bǎ} + object + verb + the rest.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{对|duì}，{这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}___ {的|de}{证据|zhèng jù}。 (You're right: that's a very strong piece of evidence.)
questions.explanation: Strong evidence is {有力|yǒu lì}{的|de}{证据|zhèng jù} ({力|lì}, strength). {有利|yǒu lì} sounds exactly the same (yǒu lì) but means "favourable, good for": {有利|yǒu lì}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn} (favourable conditions), {对|duì}{我们|wǒ men}{有利|yǒu lì}. {必然|bì rán} is "inevitable" and {单一|dān yī} "single, uniform".

questions.stem: Your colleague says: "{他|tā}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{太|tài}{主观|zhǔ guān}{了|le}。" What is the colleague criticising?
choices: The view is based on personal feeling rather than facts.
The view was given by his boss.
questions.explanation: {主观|zhǔ guān} is "subjective": shaped by one's own feelings and position. Its opposite is {客观|kè guān} (objective): {写|xiě}{报道|bào dào}{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{客观|kè guān}. "Too specific" would be {太|tài}{具体|jù tǐ}{了|le}, which is rarely a criticism.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {观点|guān diǎn} (point of view): a high level tone, then a dipping one, 1+3.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {证据|zhèng jù} (evidence): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{次|cì}{调查|diào chá}{的|de}___ {围|wéi}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}。 (The scope of this survey is too small.)
questions.explanation: {范围|fàn wéi} (scope). {={范|fàn}: 艹 on top, 氵 and 㔾 below, 8 strokes. In traditional script the word is 範圍, with 範 ({竹|zhú} on top)=}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {因|yīn}___ (factor)
questions.explanation: {因素|yīn sù} (a factor). {={素|sù} has the top of {青|qīng} over 糸 (silk). {索|suǒ} (in {搜索|sōu suǒ}, to search) has {十|shí} and a cover over 糸; {紧|jǐn} and {累|lèi} end in 糸 too, but with other parts on top ({累|lèi} has 田)=}.

questions.stem: Listen: one friend speaks and the other replies. What does the second speaker suggest?

audio.text: 网上说这家饭馆特别好吃，好评有好几千条。——网上的评价不能完全相信，我们还是自己去尝尝，再做判断吧。

choices: writing a good review of the restaurant
choosing the restaurant with the most reviews
going to try the restaurant and judging for themselves
questions.explanation: {{我们|wǒ men}{还是|hái shi}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}{尝尝|cháng chang}，{再|zài}{做|zuò}{判断|pàn duàn}{吧|ba}}: let's go and try it ourselves, then decide. The second speaker doesn't say never read reviews: only that they can't be believed completely ({{不|bù}{能|néng}{完全|wán quán}{相信|xiāng xìn}}). {好|hǎo}{几|jǐ}{千|qiān}{条|tiáo}: several thousand (reviews).

questions.stem: Listen. Why isn't the speaker convinced by the survey?

audio.text: 这次调查只问了二十个人，范围太小了。我们不能因此就说，所有年轻人都这么想。

questions.explanation: {{只|zhǐ}{问|wèn}{了|le}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{范围|fàn wéi}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}}: only twenty people, too small a scope, so the conclusion about "all young people" goes further than the evidence ({{不|bù}{能|néng}{因此|yīn cǐ}{就|jiù}{说|shuō}}…).

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's attitude to the plan?

audio.text: 你说得很有道理，我赞成这个计划。不过我想补充一点：我们需要先算一算要花多少钱。

questions.explanation: {{我|wǒ}{赞成|zàn chéng}{这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}} (I'm in favour of the plan), then {{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}} (but I'd like to add one point): the cost has to be worked out first. {补充|bǔ chōng} adds to an idea; it doesn't reject it.

questions.stem: Listen: an editor asks and a reporter answers. What does the reporter say the deadline depends on?

audio.text: 现在的问题在于时间，这篇报道下星期三以前能完成吗？——只要问卷调查顺利，应该没问题。

questions.explanation: {{只要|zhǐ yào}{问卷|wèn juàn}{调查|diào chá}{顺利|shùn lì}，{应该|yīng gāi}{没|méi}{问题|wèn tí}}: as long as the survey goes smoothly, it should be fine. {问题|wèn tí}{在于|zài yú}{时间|shí jiān} sets the issue (time); the answer names the condition.

questions.stem: Read: "{如今|rú jīn}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{之前|zhī qián}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{先|xiān}{看|kàn}{网上|wǎng shàng}{的|de}{评价|píng jià}。{可是|kě shì}{有的|yǒu de}{商家|shāng jiā}{为了|wèi le}{让|ràng}{商品|shāng pǐn}{卖|mài}{得|de}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo}，{花|huā}{钱|qián}{请|qǐng}{人|rén}{写|xiě}{好评|hǎo píng}。{另外|lìng wài}，{评价|píng jià}{本来|běn lái}{就是|jiù shì}{很|hěn}{主观|zhǔ guān}{的|de}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{口味|kǒu wèi}{和|hé}{要求|yāo qiú}{不同|bù tóng}。{由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}，{网上|wǎng shàng}{的|de}{评价|píng jià}{可以|kě yǐ}{参考|cān kǎo}，{但是|dàn shì}{不|bù}{能|néng}{完全|wán quán}{相信|xiāng xìn}。" What is the writer's conclusion?
choices: Sellers should stop paying for reviews.
Online reviews are useful, but shouldn't be trusted completely.
questions.explanation: The conclusion follows {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}: {{网上|wǎng shàng}{的|de}{评价|píng jià}{可以|kě yǐ}{参考|cān kǎo}，{但是|dàn shì}{不|bù}{能|néng}{完全|wán quán}{相信|xiāng xìn}}, reviews are worth consulting but not to be trusted completely. The paid reviews and different tastes are the two reasons that lead to it.

questions.stem: Read: "{个别|gè bié}{差评|chà píng}{可能|kě néng}{只是|zhǐ shì}{偶然|ǒu rán}{现象|xiàn xiàng}，{但是|dàn shì}{如果|rú guǒ}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{针对|zhēn duì}{同一|tóng yī}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}{提出|tí chū}{意见|yì jiàn}，{那|nà}{就|jiù}{说明|shuō míng}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{很|hěn}{可能|kě néng}{真|zhēn}{的|de}{存在|cún zài}。" What does the writer imply?
choices: One bad review proves nothing, but many about the same problem probably do.
Every bad review should be believed.
Bad reviews are always written by chance.
People only complain about small problems.
questions.explanation: {个别|gè bié} (a few, isolated) bad reviews may be chance ({{偶然|ǒu rán}{现象|xiàn xiàng}}), but many complaints aimed at the same problem ({{针对|zhēn duì}{同一|tóng yī}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}}) mean the problem probably exists. The writer weighs the number and the agreement of the complaints.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: To a great extent, this phenomenon reflects changes in the way people live.
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{现象|xiàn xiàng}{在|zài}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{程度|chéng dù}{上|shàng}{体现|tǐ xiàn}{了|le}{人|rén}{们|men}{生活|shēng huó}{方式|fāng shì}{的|de}{变化|biàn huà}。 {在|zài}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{程度|chéng dù}{上|shàng} (to a great extent) goes before the verb, after the subject, or at the very start. {体现|tǐ xiàn} (to reflect, embody) takes the object {人|rén}{们|men}{生活|shēng huó}{方式|fāng shì}{的|de}{变化|biàn huà}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{同意|tóng yì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{观点|guān diǎn}，{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}___ {充|chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}。 (I agree with you, but I'd like to add one point.)
questions.explanation: {补充|bǔ chōng} (to add, supplement). {={补|bǔ}: 衤 (clothing) and 卜, which gives the sound bǔ. Traditional 補 has the same 衤, with 甫=}.

questions.stem: Which sentence suits a notice at a museum entrance?
choices: {参观|cān guān}{需|xū}{提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē}。
{参观|cān guān}{要不|yào bù}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{约|yuē}{一下|yí xià}{吧|ba}。
{参观|cān guān}{你|nǐ}{得|děi}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{约|yuē}{一下|yí xià}{哦|ò}。
{参观|cān guān}{的话|de huà}{最好|zuì hǎo}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{说|shuō}{一|yì}{声|shēng}{啊|a}。
questions.explanation: {需|xū} (written {需要|xū yào}) and {提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē} are the language of notices: short, with no particles. The others are chat: {哦|ò}, {吧|ba} and {啊|a} at the end, {早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}, {约|yuē}{一下|yí xià}, {说|shuō}{一|yì}{声|shēng}. In speech any of them would be fine.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (He started work the moment he got to the office.)
choices: {他|tā}{便|biàn}{一|yí}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
{他|tā}{一|yí}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}，{便|biàn}{他|tā}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
{便|biàn}{他|tā}{一|yí}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
{他|tā}{一|yí}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{便|biàn}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
questions.explanation: {便|biàn} is the written {就|jiù}: an adverb, so it comes after the subject and before the verb of its clause, and it pairs with {一|yī}: {一|yī}…{便|biàn}…. It can't stand before the subject (×{便|biàn}{他|tā}) or at the very start.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {今年|jīn nián}{来|lái}{参观|cān guān}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}___ {去年|qù nián}{多|duō}。 (There are more visitors this year than last year.)
questions.explanation: {较|jiào} before a noun is the written {比|bǐ}: {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}{较|jiào}{去年|qù nián}{多|duō} = {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{多|duō}. {更|gèng} and {最|zuì} can't introduce what you compare with, and {很|hěn} doesn't compare at all.

questions.stem: What does {某|mǒu} tell you in "{某|mǒu}{公司|gōng sī}{正在|zhèng zài}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{工程师|gōng chéng shī}。"?
choices: The company is a large one.
The company isn't named: "a certain company".
The company is looking for several engineers.
The company is the one just mentioned.
questions.explanation: {某|mǒu} is "a certain (unnamed)": the writer knows or doesn't need to say which. The one just mentioned would be {该|gāi} or {这|zhè}{家|jiā} / {其|qí}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{车辆|chē liàng}{较|jiào}{多|duō}，___ {经常|jīng cháng}{堵车|dǔ chē}。 (There's a lot of traffic on this road, so it's often jammed.)
questions.explanation: {因而|yīn ér} (therefore) gives a result that follows from a situation. {从而|cóng ér} (thereby) joins an action to what it achieves ({他|tā}{坚持|jiān chí}{练习|liàn xí}，{从而|cóng ér}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{水平|shuǐ píng}), and a road having traffic isn't an action. {不然|bù rán} is "otherwise" and {尽管|jǐn guǎn} "although".

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This story is familiar to people."?
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{为|wéi}{人|rén}{们|men}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī}。
{人|rén}{们|men}{为|wéi}{这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī}。
{这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{为|wéi}{所|suǒ}{人|rén}{们|men}{熟悉|shú xī}。
{这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{所|suǒ}{人|rén}{们|men}{为|wéi}{熟悉|shú xī}。
questions.explanation: The written passive is {为|wéi} + doer + {所|suǒ} + verb: {为|wéi}{人|rén}{们|men}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī}. {人|rén}{们|men}{为|wéi}{这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī} would make the people the ones who are known, and the other two put {所|suǒ} and {为|wéi} in the wrong places.

questions.stem: What does "{这个|zhè ge}{班|bān}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{以|yǐ}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{为|wéi}{主|zhǔ}。" mean?
choices: The class is run by young people.
Young people are the best students in the class.
The students in this class are mostly young people.
The class is only for young people.
questions.explanation: {以|yǐ} X {为|wéi}{主|zhǔ}: X is the main part. Most of the students are young, but not necessarily all ("only for young people" would be {只|zhǐ}{收|shōu}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {新|xīn}{的|de}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}{从|cóng}{七|qī}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{起|qǐ}___。 (The new opening hours take effect from 1 July.)
questions.explanation: Rules and plans are {实施|shí shī} (put into effect): {新|xīn}{规定|guī dìng}{从|cóng}…{起|qǐ}{实施|shí shī}. {具有|jù yǒu} is "to have (qualities)", {属于|shǔ yú} "to belong to" and {满足|mǎn zú} "to satisfy".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {公平|gōng píng} (fair): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {结构|jié gòu} (structure): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): ___ {公司|gōng sī}{正在|zhèng zài}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{工程师|gōng chéng shī}。 (A certain company is recruiting engineers.)
questions.explanation: {某|mǒu} (a certain). {={某|mǒu}: 甘 over {木|mù}, 9 strokes=}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{受|shòu}{教育|jiào yù}{的|de}___ {利|lì}。 (Everyone has the right to an education.)
questions.explanation: {权利|quán lì} (a right). {={权|quán}: {木|mù} and {又|yòu}, 6 strokes; traditional 權 has 雚 on the right (22 strokes)=}.

questions.stem: Which character is jiǎ, "first (in a list), A"?
questions.explanation: {={甲|jiǎ}: the vertical goes down through the bottom. In {由|yóu} ({由于|yóu yú}) it goes up through the top, in {申|shēn} ({申请|shēn qǐng}) through both ends, and in 田 it stays inside=}.

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. What does it say?

audio.text: 各位观众，本馆今日闭馆。如有疑问，请咨询服务台。

choices: The museum is closing early today.
The information desk is closed today.
questions.explanation: {{本馆|běn guǎn}{今日|jīn rì}{闭馆|bì guǎn}}: this museum ({本馆|běn guǎn}) is closed ({闭馆|bì guǎn}) today ({今日|jīn rì}, the written {今天|jīn tiān}). {如|rú}{有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn} is "if you have any questions".

questions.stem: Listen. What happened to the speaker?

audio.text: 我们到的时候博物馆已经关门了，白跑了一趟。

choices: The trip was wasted: the museum was closed.
They walked all the way there.
questions.explanation: {白|bái}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{一|yí}{趟|tàng}: made the trip for nothing ({白|bái}, in vain). {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{关|guān}{门|mén}{了|le} explains why.

questions.stem: Listen to the news item. When does the museum stay open late?

audio.text: 城市博物馆近日宣布，暑假期间，每周五和周六将开放至晚上八点。

choices: every evening in the summer holidays
on Fridays and Saturdays in the summer holidays
only on the day of the announcement
on Fridays and Saturdays all year
questions.explanation: {{暑假|shǔ jià}{期间|qī jiān}}: during the summer holidays; {{每|měi}{周|zhōu}{五|wǔ}{和|hé}{周|zhōu}{六|liù}}: every Friday and Saturday; {{开放|kāi fàng}{至|zhì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}}: open until 8 p.m. {近日|jìn rì} (recently) tells when it was announced.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's attitude to the new rule?

audio.text: 这个新规定对每个人都很公平，我觉得没有什么问题，应该早点儿实行。

questions.explanation: {{对|duì}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{公平|gōng píng}} (fair to everyone), {{没有|méi yǒu}{什么|shén me}{问题|wèn tí}} (no problem with it) and {{应该|yīng gāi}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{实行|shí xíng}} (it should be put into practice soon): the speaker supports it.

questions.stem: Read the museum's rules: "{讲解员|jiǎng jiě yuán}{分为|fēn wéi}{甲|jiǎ}、{乙|yǐ}{两|liǎng}{类|lèi}：{甲|jiǎ}{类|lèi}{讲解员|jiǎng jiě yuán}{可以|kě yǐ}{用|yòng}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{以上|yǐ shàng}{语言|yǔ yán}{讲解|jiǎng jiě}，{乙|yǐ}{类|lèi}{讲解员|jiǎng jiě yuán}{用|yòng}{中文|Zhōng wén}{讲解|jiǎng jiě}。{志愿|zhì yuàn}{讲解员|jiǎng jiě yuán}{每|měi}{月|yuè}{服务|fú wù}{时间|shí jiān}{应当|yīng dāng}{不|bù}{少于|shǎo yú}{八|bā}{小时|xiǎo shí}。" ({讲解员|jiǎng jiě yuán}: a guide) A volunteer guides only in Chinese. Which is true?
choices: They are a class {甲|jiǎ} guide and must serve at least eight hours a month.
They are a class {乙|yǐ} guide and must serve no more than eight hours a month.
They are a class {乙|yǐ} guide and must serve at least eight hours a month.
questions.explanation: Class {甲|jiǎ} guides use two or more languages, class {乙|yǐ} guides Chinese. {{不|bù}{少于|shǎo yú}{八|bā}{小时|xiǎo shí}} is "no less than eight hours": eight is the minimum, not the maximum.

questions.stem: Choose the words for the three gaps: "{本馆|běn guǎn}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}{为|wéi}{周|zhōu}{二|èr}(1){周|zhōu}{日|rì}。(2){有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn}，{请|qǐng}{咨询|zī xún}{服务|fú wù}{台|tái}。{参观|cān guān}(3){提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē}。"
questions.explanation: {周|zhōu}{二|èr}{至|zhì}{周|zhōu}{日|rì} (Tuesday to Sunday: {至|zhì} = {到|dào}), {如|rú}{有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn} (if: {如|rú} = {如果|rú guǒ} in notices), {需|xū}{提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē} ({需|xū} = {需要|xū yào}). {及|jí} (and) would list two days instead of a range, {如何|rú hé} is "how", and {其|qí} (its) can't come before a verb.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: By practising every day, he raised his level.
questions.explanation: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{坚持|jiān chí}{练习|liàn xí}，{从而|cóng ér}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{水平|shuǐ píng}。 {从而|cóng ér} starts the second clause and joins the means (practising every day) to the result it brought. {因为|yīn wèi} would need a {所以|suǒ yǐ} clause after it.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Sales rose to 20,000 units."?
choices: {销量|xiāo liàng}{增长|zēng zhǎng}{到|dào}{两万|liǎng wàn}{件|jiàn}。
{销量|xiāo liàng}{增长|zēng zhǎng}{了|le}{两万|liǎng wàn}{件|jiàn}。
{销量|xiāo liàng}{增长|zēng zhǎng}{过|guo}{两万|liǎng wàn}{件|jiàn}。
{销量|xiāo liàng}{两万|liǎng wàn}{件|jiàn}{增长|zēng zhǎng}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: Verb + {到|dào} (or written {至|zhì}) + amount gives the level reached: {增长|zēng zhǎng}{到|dào}{两万|liǎng wàn}{件|jiàn}, rose to 20,000. Verb + {了|le} + amount gives the size of the change: {增长|zēng zhǎng}{了|le}{两万|liǎng wàn}{件|jiàn}, rose by 20,000. {过|guo} (experience) doesn't fit, and the amount can't come before the verb.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {最近|zuì jìn}{菜|cài}{价|jià}___ {了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。 (Vegetable prices have gone up quite a bit lately.)
questions.explanation: Prices (and water levels) {上涨|shàng zhǎng} or {涨|zhǎng}. {提升|tí shēng} is raising a level or quality by effort ({提升|tí shēng}{服务|fú wù}{质量|zhì liàng}), {扩大|kuò dà} is expanding ({规模|guī mó}, {范围|fàn wéi}) and {延长|yán cháng} is extending a time or length.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}___ {三|sān}{年|nián}{得|dé}{了|le}{冠军|guàn jūn}。 (He won the championship three years running.)
questions.explanation: {连续|lián xù} counts units in a row: three years, one after the other. {持续|chí xù} is "going on without a break" ({雨|yǔ}{持续|chí xù}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}), {继续|jì xù} is "to carry on" ({继续|jì xù}{工作|gōng zuò}) and {陆续|lù xù} (lesson 24) "one after another" of different people or things arriving.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {在|zài}{来|lái}{参观|cān guān}{的|de}{人|rén}{当中|dāng zhōng}，{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}___ {总数|zǒng shù}{的|de}{一半|yí bàn}。 (Young people make up half of the visitors.)
questions.explanation: {占|zhàn} (to make up, take up) + the share: {占|zhàn}{总数|zǒng shù}{的|de}{一半|yí bàn}. {比例|bǐ lì} is the noun "proportion" ({年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{的|de}{比例|bǐ lì}{是|shì}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{五十|wǔ shí}), {平均|píng jūn} "average" and {对比|duì bǐ} "to contrast".

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (I've lived in Beijing for nearly ten years.)
choices: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{住|zhù}{了|le}{十|shí}{年|nián}{将近|jiāng jìn}。
{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{住|zhù}{了|le}{上下|shàng xià}{十|shí}{年|nián}。
{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{将近|jiāng jìn}{住|zhù}{了|le}{十|shí}{年|nián}{以上|yǐ shàng}。
{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{住|zhù}{了|le}{将近|jiāng jìn}{十|shí}{年|nián}。
questions.explanation: {将近|jiāng jìn} (nearly) is an adverb that goes straight before the number: {将近|jiāng jìn}{十|shí}{年|nián}. {上下|shàng xià} (about) goes after the number ({十|shí}{年|nián}{上下|shàng xià}), and {将近|jiāng jìn} (just under) can't go with {以上|yǐ shàng} (over).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {为了|wèi le}{让|ràng}{大家|dà jiā}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{回|huí}{家|jiā}，{我们|wǒ men}{把|bǎ}{会议|huì yì}{时间|shí jiān}___ {了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 (So that everyone could get home earlier, we cut the meeting by half an hour.)
questions.explanation: Time and length are {缩短|suō duǎn} (shortened) or {延长|yán cháng} (extended). {缩小|suō xiǎo} and {扩大|kuò dà} are for size, scope and gaps ({缩小|suō xiǎo}{差距|chā jù}, {扩大|kuò dà}{规模|guī mó}), and {上升|shàng shēng} is rising on a scale.

questions.stem: What does "{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{宽|kuān}{二十|èr shí}{米|mǐ}。" mean?
choices: The road widens after twenty metres.
The road is twenty metres long.
The road is twenty metres wide.
The road is twenty metres away.
questions.explanation: {宽|kuān} + number gives the width: {宽|kuān}{二十|èr shí}{米|mǐ}, twenty metres wide. Long would be {长|cháng}{二十|èr shí}{米|mǐ}, and {宽度|kuān dù} (width) is the noun: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{的|de}{宽度|kuān dù}{是|shì}{二十|èr shí}{米|mǐ}.

questions.stem: How much is {三|sān}{亿|yì}?
questions.explanation: {亿|yì} is a hundred million ({一万|yí wàn}{个|gè}{万|wàn}), so {三|sān}{亿|yì} is 300 million. Thirty million is {三千万|sān qiān wàn}, and three billion {三十|sān shí}{亿|yì}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {趋势|qū shì} (a trend): a high level tone, then a falling one, 1+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {平均|píng jūn} (average): a rising tone, then a high level one, 2+1.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{的|de}___ {度|dù}{是|shì}{二十|èr shí}{米|mǐ}。 (This road is twenty metres wide.)
questions.explanation: {宽度|kuān dù} (width). {={宽|kuān}: 宀 over 艹 and {见|jiàn}, 10 strokes; traditional 寬 has 見 and a dot at the bottom right=}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{平|píng}___ {每|měi}{天|tiān}{工作|gōng zuò}{十|shí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 (On average he works ten hours a day.)
questions.explanation: {平均|píng jūn} (average). {={均|jūn}: {土|tǔ} and 匀, 7 strokes=}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {大|dà} (huge)
questions.explanation: {巨大|jù dà} (huge). {={巨|jù} is four strokes; {拒|jù} ({拒绝|jù jué}, to refuse) is 扌 + {巨|jù}, {具|jù} ({具体|jù tǐ}) has two short legs below, and {区|qū} (an area) has 乂 inside an open frame=}.

questions.stem: Listen to the report. What happened to sales?

audio.text: 今年第三季度，公司的销量比第二季度增长了百分之四十。

choices: They rose by forty per cent on the second quarter.
They rose to forty per cent of the total.
They fell by forty per cent.
questions.explanation: {比|bǐ}{第|dì}{二|èr}{季度|jì dù}{增长|zēng zhǎng}{了|le}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{四十|sì shí}: up by 40% on the second quarter ({了|le} + amount: "by"). "To 40%" would be {增长|zēng zhǎng}{到|dào}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{四十|sì shí}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is expected for next year?

audio.text: 根据统计，预计明年的产量将超出两万吨。

choices: Output will be just under 20,000 tonnes.
Output will be the same as this year.
Output will be more than 20,000 tonnes.
questions.explanation: {预计|yù jì} (it is expected), {将|jiāng} (will, written), {超出|chāo chū}{两万|liǎng wàn}{吨|dūn} (go beyond 20,000 tonnes). "Just under" would be {将近|jiāng jìn} or {接近|jiē jìn}{两万|liǎng wàn}{吨|dūn}.

questions.stem: Listen: one business partner speaks and the other replies. What is the second speaker's attitude?

audio.text: 报名的人越来越多，我们是不是应该扩大规模？——先别着急。成本也在上涨，利润的增长没有那么明显。

questions.explanation: {先|xiān}{别|bié}{着急|zháo jí} (not so fast), then the reason: {成本|chéng běn}{也|yě}{在|zài}{上涨|shàng zhǎng} (costs are going up too), so profits aren't growing as clearly. The second speaker holds back without rejecting the idea.

questions.stem: Listen. How long did it rain?

audio.text: 这场大雨持续了整整两天，河水涨了将近一米。

choices: on and off for two weeks
questions.explanation: {持续|chí xù}{了|le}{整整|zhěng zhěng}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}: went on for two whole days ({整整|zhěng zhěng}, a full). {将近|jiāng jìn} (nearly) goes with the river: it rose nearly a metre.

questions.stem:
Put the five paragraphs of a report in order.
A. {此外|cǐ wài}，{从|cóng}{阅读|yuè dú}{方式|fāng shì}{来|lái}{看|kàn}，{电子书|diàn zǐ shū}{的|de}{比例|bǐ lì}{迅速|xùn sù}{扩大|kuò dà}。2029{年|nián}，{读|dú}{电子书|diàn zǐ shū}{的|de}{人|rén}{首次|shǒu cì}{超出|chāo chū}{了|le}{读|dú}{纸质书|zhǐ zhì shū}{的|de}{人|rén}。 B. {为|wèi}{了解|liǎo jiě}{市民|shì mín}{的|de}{阅读|yuè dú}{习惯|xí guàn}，{某|mǒu}{市|shì}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{近日|jìn rì}{公布|gōng bù}{了|le}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{调查|diào chá}{报告|bào gào}。 C. {报告|bào gào}{最后|zuì hòu}{预计|yù jì}，{在|zài}{今后|jīn hòu}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{里|lǐ}，{电子|diàn zǐ}{阅读|yuè dú}{仍|réng}{将|jiāng}{保持|bǎo chí}{上升|shàng shēng}{的|de}{趋势|qū shì}。 D. {这|zhè}{份|fèn}{报告|bào gào}{显示|xiǎn shì}，{近年来|jìn nián lái}，{市民|shì mín}{的|de}{阅读|yuè dú}{时间|shí jiān}{明显|míng xiǎn}{增长|zēng zhǎng}。 E. {不过|bú guò}，{这个|zhè ge}{比例|bǐ lì}{在|zài}{不同|bù tóng}{年龄|nián líng}{的|de}{人群|rén qún}{当中|dāng zhōng}{差距|chā jù}{很|hěn}{大|dà}：{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{大多|dà duō}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{读书|dú shū}，{老人|lǎo rén}{仍|réng}{以|yǐ}{纸质书|zhǐ zhì shū}{为|wéi}{主|zhǔ}。 ({纸质书|zhǐ zhì shū}: a paper book)
questions.explanation: B introduces the report ({近日|jìn rì}{公布|gōng bù}{了|le}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{调查|diào chá}{报告|bào gào}), and D refers back to it ({这|zhè}{份|fèn}{报告|bào gào}{显示|xiǎn shì}), so B D. A begins {此外|cǐ wài} (in addition): another finding after D's. E's {这个|zhè ge}{比例|bǐ lì} (this proportion) points back to A's share of e-book readers, so E follows A. C says {最后|zuì hòu} (finally) and looks ahead ({今后|jīn hòu}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}), so it ends the text.

questions.stem: Read: "2025{年|nián}，{读|dú}{电子书|diàn zǐ shū}{的|de}{人|rén}{只|zhǐ}{占|zhàn}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí}；{到|dào}{了|le}2029{年|nián}，{这个|zhè ge}{比例|bǐ lì}{已经|yǐ jīng}{提升|tí shēng}{到|dào}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{五十五|wǔ shí wǔ}。" By how much did the share of e-book readers rise?
questions.explanation: It rose from 30% to 55% ({提升|tí shēng}{到|dào}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{五十五|wǔ shí wǔ}: "to"), so by 25 points. 55 is where it ended, not how much it grew.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Next year's output is expected to grow ten per cent on this year.
questions.explanation: {预计|yù jì}{明年|míng nián}{的|de}{产量|chǎn liàng}{将|jiāng}{比|bǐ}{今年|jīn nián}{增长|zēng zhǎng}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{十|shí}。 {预计|yù jì} can start the sentence or follow the subject ({明年|míng nián}{的|de}{产量|chǎn liàng}{预计|yù jì}{将|jiāng}…). {比|bǐ}{今年|jīn nián} goes before the verb, and the amount after it gives the size of the change ("by"). {增长|zēng zhǎng}{到|dào} would give the level reached.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (They leave for Beijing tomorrow.)
choices: {他们|tā men}{明天|míng tiān}{前往|qián wǎng}{北京|Běi jīng}。
{他们|tā men}{明天|míng tiān}{北京|Běi jīng}{前往|qián wǎng}。
{他们|tā men}{明天|míng tiān}{前往|qián wǎng}{到|dào}{北京|Běi jīng}。
{他们|tā men}{明天|míng tiān}{前往|qián wǎng}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}。
questions.explanation: {前往|qián wǎng} (to go to, leave for: written {去|qù}) takes the place straight after it: {前往|qián wǎng}{北京|Běi jīng}. It already means "go to", so {到|dào} is one "to" too many, and {在|zài} (at) doesn't fit a movement.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I got lost in Beijing."?
questions.explanation: {迷路|mí lù} (to get lost) takes no object: the place goes before it with {在|zài}: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{迷路|mí lù}{了|le}. It can't take {把|bǎ} either, since nothing is done to Beijing.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {刚才|gāng cái}{下|xià}{了|le}{一|yí}___ {雨|yǔ}，{现在|xiàn zài}{停|tíng}{了|le}。 (There was a shower just now, but it's stopped.)
questions.explanation: {阵|zhèn} counts short spells of weather or sound: {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{雨|yǔ}, {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{风|fēng}, {一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{笑|xiào}{声|shēng}. {个|gè} doesn't count rain, {张|zhāng} is for flat things and {条|tiáo} for long, thin ones.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{的|de}___ {安排|ān pái}{得|de}{很|hěn}{紧|jǐn}，{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{去|qù}{三|sān}{个|gè}{地方|dì fang}。 (The schedule of this trip is tight: three places every day.)
questions.explanation: {行程|xíng chéng} (xíng chéng) is a trip's plan, its itinerary: {行程|xíng chéng}{安排|ān pái}{得|de}{很|hěn}{紧|jǐn}. {时差|shí chā} is a time difference, {海关|hǎi guān} customs and {天空|tiān kōng} the sky.

questions.stem: Which spoken word means the same as written {返回|fǎn huí}?
questions.explanation: {返回|fǎn huí} (to return) is the written {回|huí}: {返回|fǎn huí}{北京|Běi jīng} = {回|huí}{北京|Běi jīng}. {前往|qián wǎng} is the written {去|qù}, and {到达|dào dá} the written {到|dào}.

questions.stem: Your friend is setting off for the station. What do you say?
choices: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng}！
questions.explanation: {一路顺风|yí lù shùn fēng} (have a good trip; literally "a following wind all the way") is said to someone setting off. {欢迎|huān yíng}{光临|guāng lín} welcomes a customer or guest in, and {好久|hǎo jiǔ}{不见|bú jiàn} greets someone you haven't seen for a long time.

questions.stem: In a story, what does {坐|zuò}{着|zhe}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe} add to "{他|tā}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe}{就|jiù}{睡着|shuì zháo}{了|le}。"?
choices: He had to sit because he was tired.
While he was sitting there, without noticing, he fell asleep.
He sat down and then woke up.
questions.explanation: A{着|zhe}A{着|zhe} ({坐|zuò}{着|zhe}{坐|zuò}{着|zhe}, {拍|pāi}{着|zhe}{拍|pāi}{着|zhe}) says that while one action went on, something else happened without the person noticing: sitting there, he dozed off. Stories use it for the turn of events.

questions.stem: An essay on "something you tried for the first time" has an opening, the event and an ending. Which sentence makes the best ending?
choices: {去年|qù nián}{夏天|xià tiān}，{我|wǒ}{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{去|qù}{旅行|lǚ xíng}。
{通过|tōng guò}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}，{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}{了|le}：{只要|zhǐ yào}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}{准备|zhǔn bèi}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{能|néng}{把|bǎ}{事情|shì qing}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}。
{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{傍晚|bàng wǎn}，{突然|tū rán}{下|xià}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{暴雨|bào yǔ}。
{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{预订|yù dìng}{了|le}{车票|chē piào}{和|hé}{住宿|zhù sù}。
questions.explanation: The ending sums up what you learned and how you felt: {通过|tōng guò}{这|zhè}{次|cì}…，{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}{了|le}…. The first choice is an opening, and the other two belong to the middle, where the events are told in order.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {海关|hǎi guān} (customs): a dipping tone, then a high level one, 3+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {暴雨|bào yǔ} (a rainstorm): a falling tone, then a dipping one, 4+3.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {李白|Lǐ Bái}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}___ {人|rén}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。 (Li Bai is one of China's most famous poets.)
questions.explanation: {诗人|shī rén} (a poet). {={诗|shī}: 讠 (speech) and {寺|sì}, 8 strokes; traditional 詩 has {言|yán} (13 strokes)=}.

questions.stem: Which character is wù, "fog"?
questions.explanation: {=All four have {雨|yǔ} on top. {雾|wù} has {务|wù} ({服务|fú wù}) below, which gives the sound wù; {雪|xuě} (snow) has 彐, {零|líng} (zero) has {令|lìng} and {需|xū} (to need) has {而|ér}=}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{明天|míng tiān}___ {回|huí}{学校|xué xiào}。 (He returns to school tomorrow.)
questions.explanation: {返回|fǎn huí} (to return, written {回|huí}). {={返|fǎn} is {反|fǎn} (fǎn, reverse, which gives the sound) inside 辶 (walking), written last: going the reverse way=}. Its partner {往返|wǎng fǎn} is "there and back".

questions.stem: Listen to the station announcement. What does it say?

audio.text: 开往西安的列车即将到达三号站台，请旅客们做好准备。

choices: The train from Xi'an has been delayed.
The train for Xi'an has left from platform 3.
Passengers for Xi'an should change trains.
The train for Xi'an will soon arrive at platform 3.
questions.explanation: {开|kāi}{往|wǎng}{西安|Xī'ān} (going to Xi'an), {即将|jí jiāng}{到达|dào dá} (about to arrive), {三|sān}{号|hào}{站台|zhàn tái} (platform 3). {请|qǐng}…{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}{准备|zhǔn bèi}: please get ready.

questions.stem: Listen to the forecast. When will it rain?

audio.text: 天气预报说，明天上午天气不错，傍晚有一阵暴雨。

questions.explanation: {傍晚|bàng wǎn}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{暴雨|bào yǔ}: a spell of heavy rain in the early evening; the morning is fine ({上午|shàng wǔ}{天气|tiān qì}{不错|bú cuò}).

questions.stem: Listen: one friend asks and the other answers. How is the second speaker travelling?

audio.text: 你是坐火车往返吗？——去的时候坐火车，回来的时候坐飞机。

choices: by train there and by plane back
by plane there and by train back
questions.explanation: {去|qù}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{坐|zuò}{火车|huǒ chē}，{回来|huí lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{坐|zuò}{飞机|fēi jī}: train on the way there, plane on the way back. {往返|wǎng fǎn} in the question is "there and back".

questions.stem: Listen. Why did he sleep badly?

audio.text: 他在英国读完硕士回国。因为有七个小时的时差，回来以后的头几天，晚上他都睡不好。

choices: He was ill after the flight.
He was worried about a new job.
He had jet lag: a seven-hour time difference.
questions.explanation: {{因为|yīn wèi}{有|yǒu}{七|qī}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{时差|shí chā}}: the seven-hour time difference (jet lag) is the reason given. {头几天|tóu jǐ tiān} is "the first few days".

questions.stem: Read: "{汽车|qì chē}{开|kāi}{到|dào}{一半|yí bàn}，{天上|tiān shàng}{就|jiù}{下|xià}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}，{路上|lù shang}{又|yòu}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{雾|wù}，{司机|sī jī}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{绕|rào}{了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}{路|lù}，{结果|jié guǒ}{晚|wǎn}{到|dào}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。{李明|Lǐ Míng}{一路|yí lù}{上|shang}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{着急|zháo jí}，{好在|hǎo zài}{他|tā}{出发|chū fā}{得|de}{早|zǎo}，{最后|zuì hòu}{还是|hái shi}{按时|àn shí}{到达|dào dá}{了|le}{机场|jī chǎng}。" ({好在|hǎo zài}: luckily) Which is true?
choices: The coach arrived an hour early.
The driver got lost in the rain.
Li Ming missed his flight because of the fog.
Li Ming reached the airport in time because he had left early.
questions.explanation: {好在|hǎo zài}{他|tā}{出发|chū fā}{得|de}{早|zǎo}，{最后|zuì hòu}{还是|hái shi}{按时|àn shí}{到达|dào dá}{了|le}{机场|jī chǎng}: luckily he'd set off early, so he was still on time. The driver took a detour ({绕|rào}{了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}{路|lù}) on purpose: he didn't get lost; and the coach was an hour late, not early.

questions.stem: Choose the words for the three gaps: "{他|tā}{通过|tōng guò}{旅行社|lǚ xíng shè}(1){了|le}{往返|wǎng fǎn}{的|de}{机票|jī piào}。{出发|chū fā}{那|nà}{天|tiān}，{路上|lù shang}{起|qǐ}{了|le}(2)，{司机|sī jī}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}(3){了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}{路|lù}。"
questions.explanation: {预订|yù dìng}{机票|jī piào} (to book tickets), {起|qǐ}{了|le}{雾|wù} (fog came down), {绕|rào}{了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}{路|lù} (made a detour). {预报|yù bào} is "to forecast", {阵|zhèn} is a measure word ({一|yí}{阵|zhèn}{雨|yǔ}), and {迷路|mí lù} takes no object, so ×{迷路|mí lù}{了|le}{一|yí}{段|duàn}{路|lù}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: We chatted the whole way and didn't feel tired at all.
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{一路|yí lù}{上|shang}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{聊天|liáo tiān}，{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bù}{觉得|jué de}{累|lèi}。 {一路|yí lù}{上|shang} (on the way) can follow the subject or start the sentence. {一点儿|yì diǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bù} + verb is "not at all" ({一点儿|yì diǎnr}{都|dōu}{不|bù} is said too). {把|bǎ} has no place here: nothing is moved or dealt with.

questions.stem: According to the reports on the sample papers, how many questions does the written part of the new HSK 5 have?
questions.explanation: Listening 35, reading 35 and writing 2: 72 questions in 105 minutes (official site). 35 is the number of listening or of reading questions alone.

questions.stem: As reported, what are the minimum lengths of the two writing tasks of the new HSK 5?
questions.explanation: The four-picture story needs at least 100 characters, and the essay on a set theme at least 200. They're minimums: a good answer usually goes a little over.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT one of the speaking tasks reported for the new HSK 5?
choices: telling a story from three photos
answering two questions with your opinion
questions.explanation: The reported tasks are retelling (2), a story from three numbered photos (1) and two opinion questions (2): five in about 23 minutes. Reading a text aloud isn't among them.

questions.stem: You must put five paragraphs in order. Which of these paragraphs cannot be the first?
choices: {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{附近|fù jìn}{的|de}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{小|xiǎo}{街|jiē}{上|shàng}，{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{开|kāi}{了|le}{二十|èr shí}{多|duō}{年|nián}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{书店|shū diàn}。
{为|wèi}{了解|liǎo jiě}{市民|shì mín}{的|de}{阅读|yuè dú}{习惯|xí guàn}，{某|mǒu}{市|shì}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{近日|jìn rì}{公布|gōng bù}{了|le}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{调查|diào chá}{报告|bào gào}。
{此外|cǐ wài}，{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{书店|shū diàn}{每|měi}{个|gè}{周末|zhōu mò}{还|hái}{会|huì}{请|qǐng}{作家|zuò jiā}{来|lái}{做|zuò}{讲座|jiǎng zuò}。
{每|měi}{年|nián}{夏天|xià tiān}，{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{外国|wài guó}{学生|xué sheng}{来|lái}{北京|Běi jīng}{学习|xué xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
questions.explanation: {此外|cǐ wài} (in addition) adds to something already said, so its paragraph needs one before it. The others introduce a place, a report or a group of people, with nothing pointing back: any of them could open a text.

questions.stem: Choose the word by collocation: {针对|zhēn duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{公司|gōng sī}___ {了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{措施|cuò shī}。 (The company has taken new measures to deal with this problem.)
questions.explanation: {措施|cuò shī} (measures) goes with {采取|cǎi qǔ}: {采取|cǎi qǔ}{措施|cuò shī}. {发挥|fā huī} goes with {作用|zuò yòng} ({发挥|fā huī}{作用|zuò yòng}, to play a role), {满足|mǎn zú} with {需求|xū qiú} or {要求|yāo qiú}, and {达成|dá chéng} with {协议|xié yì} or {一致|yí zhì} (to reach an agreement).

questions.stem: Choose the word by collocation: {近年来|jìn nián lái}，{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{差距|chā jù}{正在|zhèng zài}___。 (In recent years the gap between the two cities has been narrowing.)
questions.explanation: {差距|chā jù} (a gap) is {缩小|suō xiǎo} (narrowed) or {扩大|kuò dà} (widened). {提高|tí gāo} goes with {水平|shuǐ píng} or {质量|zhì liàng}, {满足|mǎn zú} with {需求|xū qiú} and {发挥|fā huī} with {作用|zuò yòng}.

questions.stem: Choose the word that fits the register of a notice: {如|rú}{有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn}，{请|qǐng}___ {服务|fú wù}{台|tái}{联系|lián xì}。 (If you have any questions, please contact the information desk.)
questions.explanation: {与|yǔ} (written {跟|gēn}) + someone + {联系|lián xì}: to contact someone. {及|jí} joins nouns ("and"), {以|yǐ} is "with, by means of", and {其|qí} (its, their) can't introduce the person you contact.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {失败|shī bài}{了|le}，{也|yě}{要|yào}{再|zài}{试|shì}{一|yí}{次|cì}。 (Even if you fail, try once more.)
questions.explanation: {哪怕|nǎ pà}…{也|yě} (even if): the {也|yě} in the second clause tells you the pair. {虽然|suī rán} pairs with {但是|dàn shì} and describes a fact, not a supposition; {因为|yīn wèi} needs {所以|suǒ yǐ}, and {只要|zhǐ yào} (as long as) goes with {就|jiù}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {写作|xiě zuò} (writing): a dipping tone, then a falling one, 3+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {口语|kǒu yǔ} (spoken language): two third tones, 3+3. You hear the first one rise (kóu yǔ); both answers count.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {针对|zhēn duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{公司|gōng sī}___ {取|qǔ}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{措施|cuò shī}。 (The company has taken new measures to deal with this problem.)
questions.explanation: {采取|cǎi qǔ} (to take: measures). {={采|cǎi}: 爫 (a hand) over {木|mù}, 8 strokes; traditional 採 adds 扌 on the left=}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {比赛|bǐ sài}{最后|zuì hòu}，{我们|wǒ men}{队|duì}{取得|qǔ dé}{了|le}___ {利|lì}。 (In the end our team won.)
questions.explanation: {胜利|shèng lì} (victory). {={胜|shèng}: {月|yuè} and {生|shēng}, 9 strokes; traditional 勝 has {月|yuè}, {关|guān}-like strokes and {力|lì} (12 strokes)=}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {来|lái} (the future)
questions.explanation: {未来|wèi lái} (the future). {=In {未|wèi} the upper horizontal is the shorter one; in {末|mò} ({周末|zhōu mò}, the end) the upper one is longer. {米|mǐ} (rice) has dots, and 朱 begins with a left-falling stroke=}.

questions.stem: Listen. What hasn't the speaker finished?

audio.text: 还差一点儿。数据我都统计完了，就是结论还没写。

questions.explanation: {数据|shù jù}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{统计|tǒng jì}{完|wán}{了|le} (the figures are all added up), {就是|jiù shì}{结论|jié lùn}{还|hái}{没|méi}{写|xiě} (it's just the conclusion that isn't written). {还|hái}{差|chà}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}: almost done.

questions.stem: Listen to the guide. Why is the museum on today's programme?

audio.text: 明天是周一，博物馆闭馆，所以我们把它安排在了今天。

questions.explanation: {明天|míng tiān}{是|shì}{周一|zhōu yī}，{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{闭馆|bì guǎn} (tomorrow is Monday, and the museum is closed), so ({所以|suǒ yǐ}) the visit is today. {闭馆|bì guǎn} is the written way to say a museum is closed.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's view about expanding the company?

audio.text: 说实话，我们还在犹豫。成本上涨得太快了，我倒觉得先把服务做好更重要。

choices: undecided, and would rather improve the service first
questions.explanation: {还|hái}{在|zài}{犹豫|yóu yù} (still undecided), and {我|wǒ}{倒|dào}{觉得|jué de}{先|xiān}{把|bǎ}{服务|fú wù}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}{更|gèng}{重要|zhòng yào} (actually, I think getting the service right first matters more). {倒|dào} introduces a view that differs from what was suggested.

questions.stem: Listen to the talk. What is its main point?

audio.text: 很多人以为记忆力好的人天生就聪明。其实，记忆是可以训练的。记不住不一定是因为不聪明，很可能只是方法不对。

choices: Memory can be trained: forgetting is often a matter of method.
People forget most of what they learn.
Only some people can train their memory.
questions.explanation: {其实|qí shí} (in fact) corrects the common belief, and the last sentence sums up: {记|jì}{不|bu}{住|zhù}…{很|hěn}{可能|kě néng}{只是|zhǐ shì}{方法|fāng fǎ}{不|bú}{对|duì} (if you can't remember, it's probably just the method). The main point often comes after {其实|qí shí} or at the end.

questions.stem:
Put the five paragraphs in order.
A. {后来|hòu lái}，{书店|shū diàn}{的|de}{生意|shēng yi}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{难|nán}{做|zuò}，{来|lái}{店|diàn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{人|rén}{一|yì}{年|nián}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{年|nián}{少|shǎo}。{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}，{店主|diàn zhǔ}{甚至|shèn zhì}{想|xiǎng}{把|bǎ}{店|diàn}{关|guān}{了|le}。 B. {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{附近|fù jìn}{的|de}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{小|xiǎo}{街|jiē}{上|shàng}，{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{开|kāi}{了|le}{二十|èr shí}{多|duō}{年|nián}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{书店|shū diàn}。 C. {如今|rú jīn}，{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{小|xiǎo}{书店|shū diàn}{不但|bú dàn}{没有|méi yǒu}{关|guān}{门|mén}，{反而|fǎn ér}{成|chéng}{了|le}{附近|fù jìn}{居民|jū mín}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{去|qù}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。 D. {最初|zuì chū}，{书店|shū diàn}{只|zhǐ}{卖|mài}{学生|xué sheng}{用|yòng}{的|de}{教材|jiào cái}{和|hé}{参考|cān kǎo}{书|shū}，{生意|shēng yi}{一直|yì zhí}{不错|bú cuò}。 E. {然而|rán ér}，{店主|diàn zhǔ}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{放弃|fàng qì}。{他|tā}{把|bǎ}{书店|shū diàn}{的|de}{一半|yí bàn}{改|gǎi}{成|chéng}{了|le}{阅读区|yuè dú qū}，{周末|zhōu mò}{还|hái}{请|qǐng}{作家|zuò jiā}{来|lái}{做|zuò}{讲座|jiǎng zuò}。
questions.explanation: B introduces the shop. {最初|zuì chū} (at first, D), {后来|hòu lái} (later, A) and {如今|rú jīn} (today, C) give the time order. E's {然而|rán ér} (however) turns against A's {想|xiǎng}{把|bǎ}{店|diàn}{关|guān}{了|le}, so E follows A, and C gives the result: {不但|bú dàn}{没有|méi yǒu}{关|guān}{门|mén}，{反而|fǎn ér}… .

questions.stem: Choose the words for the four gaps: "(1){生活|shēng huó}{水平|shuǐ píng}{的|de}{提高|tí gāo}，{人|rén}{们|men}{的|de}{旧|jiù}{衣服|yī fu}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。{很|hěn}{多|duō}{旧|jiù}{衣服|yī fu}{还|hái}{能|néng}{穿|chuān}，(2){不|bù}{少|shǎo}{人|rén}{直接|zhí jiē}{扔|rēng}{掉|diào}{了|le}。{一些|yì xiē}{城市|chéng shì}{在|zài}{小区|xiǎo qū}{里|lǐ}{放|fàng}{了|le}{旧|jiù}{衣服|yī fu}{回收箱|huí shōu xiāng}，(3){扔|rēng}{掉|diào}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{明显|míng xiǎn}{减少|jiǎn shǎo}{了|le}。(4)，{只要|zhǐ yào}{方便|fāng biàn}，{大|dà}{多数|duō shù}{人|rén}{是|shì}{愿意|yuàn yì}{参与|cān yù}{回收|huí shōu}{的|de}。" ({回收箱|huí shōu xiāng}: a recycling bin)
choices: (1) {随着|suí zhe} (2) {因而|yīn ér} (3) {然而|rán ér} (4) {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}
(1) {随着|suí zhe} (2) {然而|rán ér} (3) {因而|yīn ér} (4) {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}
(1) {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} (2) {然而|rán ér} (3) {因而|yīn ér} (4) {随着|suí zhe}
(1) {随着|suí zhe} (2) {然而|rán ér} (3) {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} (4) {因而|yīn ér}
questions.explanation: {随着|suí zhe} + a change (as living standards rise); {然而|rán ér} turns against "they can still be worn"; {因而|yīn ér} gives the result of the bins; {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} draws the conclusion at the end. {因而|yīn ér} can't introduce a contrast, and {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} needs facts before it.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: As long as you prepare well in advance, you can manage things on your own.
questions.explanation: {只要|zhǐ yào}{提前|tí qián}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}{准备|zhǔn bèi}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{也|yě}{能|néng}{把|bǎ}{事情|shì qing}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}。 {只要|zhǐ yào} sets a condition that is enough; the result clause has {也|yě} or {就|jiù} ({才|cái} goes with {只有|zhǐ yǒu}). {把|bǎ}{事情|shì qing}{做|zuò}{好|hǎo}: {把|bǎ} + object + verb + result.

questions.stem: In which period did Mencius ({孟子|Mèng zǐ}) live?
questions.explanation: Mencius lived in the Warring States period (traditionally about 372–289 BCE), about a century after Confucius. Zhu Xi, who counted his book among the Four Books, lived in the Song dynasty.

questions.stem: What does "{得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}。" (《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}·{公孙丑|Gōng sūn Chǒu}{下|xià}》) mean?
choices: One who learns a lot helps many people; one who learns little helps few.
The more help you give, the more you lose.
Those who travel far need much help.
One who has the Way finds many to help; one who loses the Way finds few.
questions.explanation: {得道|dé dào} is to have the Way (to rule justly), {者|zhě} "one who", {多|duō}{助|zhù} "much help", {寡|guǎ} "few, little": a just ruler finds many supporters, an unjust one few. Today it's often said as {得道|dé dào}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}.

questions.stem: In "{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}", what does {寡|guǎ} mean?
questions.explanation: {寡|guǎ} is "few, little" (modern {少|shǎo}), the opposite of {多|duō} in {多|duō}{助|zhù}. {失|shī} is "to lose" and {助|zhù} "to help".

questions.stem: What does {者|zhě} do in {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}, and which modern word has the same {者|zhě}?
choices: "one who…": as in {志愿者|zhì yuàn zhě} (a volunteer)
questions.explanation: {者|zhě} after a verb phrase makes "a person who…": {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}, one who has the Way. It's the suffix of {志愿者|zhì yuàn zhě} (volunteer) and {消费者|xiāo fèi zhě} (consumer). In {或者|huò zhě} it's just part of a word.

questions.stem: In "{老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}" (《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}·{梁惠王|Liáng Huì wáng}{上|shàng}》), what is the first {老|lǎo}?
choices: a verb: to treat (one's elders) as elders should be treated
questions.explanation: The first {老|lǎo} is a verb, "to respect and care for (as the old should be cared for)", and the second a noun, "the old": {老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}, care for my elders. The same pattern gives {幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu}, care for my young.

questions.stem: How does {以及|yǐ jí} in "{老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}" differ from modern {以及|yǐ jí}?
choices: In Mencius it is two words, {以|yǐ} (and thereby) + {及|jí} (to reach, extend to).
There is no difference: both mean "as well as".
In Mencius it is a name.
questions.explanation: Here {以|yǐ} is "and thereby" and {及|jí} "to reach, extend to": care that begins at home reaches other people's elders. Modern {以及|yǐ jí} (lesson 27) is one word, "as well as".

questions.stem: In "{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}", which modern word does {之|zhī} stand for?
questions.explanation: {之|zhī} between two nouns is the written {的|de}: {人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}, other people's old. You know it from {之|zhī}{一|yī} (one of) and {之间|zhī jiān} (between).

questions.stem: In "{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}{之|zhī}{至|zhì}，{亲戚|qīn qi}{畔|pàn}{之|zhī}", what does {畔|pàn} mean?
questions.explanation: {畔|pàn} is written here for 叛, "to turn against, rebel": when help is at its fewest, even one's own family turns away. "To follow" is {顺|shùn}, in the next clause: {天下|tiān xià}{顺|shùn}{之|zhī}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which saying do you hear?

audio.text: 得道者多助，失道者寡助。

choices: {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}
questions.explanation: {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}: one who has the Way finds many to help; one who loses it finds few (《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}·{公孙丑|Gōng sūn Chǒu}{下|xià}》).

questions.stem: Listen. What happens, according to the speaker, to someone who doesn't act justly?

audio.text: 做事不符合正义，支持他的人就会越来越少，最后连自己的亲人都会离开他。

choices: His supporters dwindle until even his family leaves him.
questions.explanation: {支持|zhī chí}{他|tā}{的|de}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{少|shǎo} (fewer and fewer supporters), {最后|zuì hòu}{连|lián}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{亲人|qīn rén}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{离开|lí kāi}{他|tā} (in the end even his family leaves him): a modern retelling of {寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}{之|zhī}{至|zhì}，{亲戚|qīn qi}{畔|pàn}{之|zhī}.

questions.stem: Read: "{在|zài}{他|tā}{看来|kàn lái}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{国家|guó jiā}{强大|qiáng dà}{不|bu}{强大|qiáng dà}，{不|bú}{在于|zài yú}{土地|tǔ dì}{有|yǒu}{多|duō}{大|dà}、{军队|jūn duì}{有|yǒu}{多少|duō shao}，{而|ér}{在于|zài yú}{人心|rén xīn}。" According to this sentence about Mencius, what makes a state strong?
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{在于|zài yú}…{而|ér}{在于|zài yú}… (lesson 26): not land, not armies, but {人心|rén xīn}, people's hearts, their support.

questions.stem: Read: "{这|zhè}{句|jù}{话|huà}{的|de}{意思|yì si}{是|shì}：{先|xiān}{照顾|zhào gù}{好|hǎo}{自己|zì jǐ}{家|jiā}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}，{再|zài}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{份|fèn}{关心|guān xīn}{推广|tuī guǎng}{到|dào}{别人|bié ren}{家|jiā}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{和|hé}{孩子|hái zi}{身上|shēn shang}。" Which saying is being explained?
choices: {得道|dé dào}{者|zhě}{多|duō}{助|zhù}，{失道|shī dào}{者|zhě}{寡|guǎ}{助|zhù}
{老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}；{幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{幼|yòu}
questions.explanation: Care for your own old and young first, then extend it to other people's: {老|lǎo}{吾|wú}{老|lǎo}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{老|lǎo}；{幼|yòu}{吾|wú}{幼|yòu}，{以及|yǐ jí}{人|rén}{之|zhī}{幼|yòu} (《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}·{梁惠王|Liáng Huì wáng}{上|shàng}》).

questions.stem: Who wrote 《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》 (Gazing at the Waterfall on Mount Lu)?
questions.explanation: 《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》 is by {李白|Lǐ Bái} (Li Bai, 701–762). {王维|Wáng Wéi} wrote 《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》 and 《{鸟鸣涧|Niǎo míng jiàn}》; {苏轼|Sū Shì} (Su Shi) is the Song poet who said Wang Wei's poems have "paintings in them"; {孟子|Mèng zǐ} is Mencius.

questions.stem: How is 柴 read in the title 《鹿柴》 (Deer Enclosure)?
questions.explanation: In {鹿柴|Lù zhài} the character is read zhài, "a fence, an enclosure". Its everyday reading is chái (firewood).

questions.stem: What does "{空|kōng}{山|shān}{不见|bú jiàn}{人|rén}，{但|dàn}{闻|wén}{人|rén}{语|yǔ}{响|xiǎng}。" ({王维|Wáng Wéi}《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》) mean?
choices: People talk loudly on the empty mountain.
The mountain is empty because people have left it.
On the empty mountain no one is seen; only voices are heard.
Nobody hears the voices on the mountain.
questions.explanation: {不见|bú jiàn}{人|rén}: no one seen; {但|dàn} is "only" (modern {只|zhǐ}), {闻|wén} "to hear": only the sound of people's voices ({人|rén}{语|yǔ}{响|xiǎng}) is heard.

questions.stem: Su Shi wrote of Wang Wei: "{味|wèi}{摩诘|Mó jié}{之|zhī}{诗|shī}，{诗|shī}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{画|huà}；{观|guān}{摩诘|Mó jié}{之|zhī}{画|huà}，{画|huà}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{诗|shī}。" What does {诗|shī}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{画|huà} mean here?
choices: Wang Wei wrote poems on his paintings.
His poems make you see a scene, like a painting.
questions.explanation: {诗|shī}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{画|huà}: there are paintings in his poems: they let you see the scene (the empty mountain, the light on the moss). {摩诘|Mó jié} is Wang Wei's courtesy name; {味|wèi} is "to savour" and {观|guān} "to look at".

questions.stem: What does "{月|yuè}{出|chū}{惊|jīng}{山|shān}{鸟|niǎo}，{时|shí}{鸣|míng}{春|chūn}{涧|jiàn}{中|zhōng}。" ({王维|Wáng Wéi}《{鸟鸣涧|Niǎo míng jiàn}》) say?
choices: The birds sing all night long.
The moon is hidden by the birds.
The birds fly away from the moon.
The moon rises and startles the mountain birds, who call now and then in the ravine.
questions.explanation: {月|yuè}{出|chū} (the moon comes out) {惊|jīng} (startles) {山|shān}{鸟|niǎo} (the mountain birds); {时|shí} is "now and then" and {鸣|míng} "to call": they call now and then in the spring ravine ({春|chūn}{涧|jiàn}).

questions.stem: In {李白|Lǐ Bái}《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》, the waterfall falls {三千|sān qiān}{尺|chǐ} and looks like the Milky Way falling from the ninth heaven. What kind of description is this?
questions.explanation: Three thousand {尺|chǐ} is nearly a kilometre, far beyond any real waterfall there: the figure is an exaggeration, the bold style Li Bai is known for.

questions.stem: How many characters does each line of {王维|Wáng Wéi}《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》 and 《{鸟鸣涧|Niǎo míng jiàn}》 have?
questions.explanation: Both are five-character {绝句|jué jù} (four lines of five characters). Li Bai's 《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》 has seven characters a line.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {银河|yín hé} (the Milky Way): two rising tones, 2+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which poem are these lines from?

audio.text: 空山不见人，但闻人语响。

questions.explanation: {空|kōng}{山|shān}{不见|bú jiàn}{人|rén}，{但|dàn}{闻|wén}{人|rén}{语|yǔ}{响|xiǎng} is the first couplet of {王维|Wáng Wéi}'s 《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》. 《{鸟鸣涧|Niǎo míng jiàn}》 begins {人|rén}{闲|xián}{桂花|guì huā}{落|luò}, and 《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》 {日|rì}{照|zhào}{香炉|xiāng lú}{生|shēng}{紫|zǐ}{烟|yān}.

questions.stem: Listen. What do the lines describe?

audio.text: 飞流直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天。

questions.explanation: {飞|fēi}{流|liú}{直|zhí}{下|xià} (a flying stream plunging straight down) and {银河|yín hé}{落|luò}{九天|jiǔ tiān} (the Milky Way falling from the ninth heaven): the waterfall of {李白|Lǐ Bái}'s 《{望|wàng}{庐山|Lú shān}{瀑布|pù bù}》.

questions.stem: Read: "{李白|Lǐ Bái}{的|de}{山水|shān shuǐ}{诗|shī}{却|què}{充满|chōng mǎn}{了|le}{想象|xiǎng xiàng}{和|hé}{激情|jī qíng}。{一般|yì bān}{人|rén}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{瀑布|pù bù}，{可能|kě néng}{只|zhǐ}{会|huì}{说|shuō}"{真|zhēn}{高|gāo}{啊|a}"，{李白|Lǐ Bái}{却|què}{把|bǎ}{它|tā}{跟|gēn}{天上|tiān shàng}{的|de}{银河|yín hé}{联系|lián xì}{在|zài}{了|le}{一起|yì qǐ}。" ({激情|jī qíng}: passion) What does the writer say about Li Bai?
choices: He wrote mostly about quiet scenes.
He never saw a real waterfall.
His landscape poems are full of imagination and passion.
questions.explanation: {充满|chōng mǎn}{了|le}{想象|xiǎng xiàng}{和|hé}{激情|jī qíng}: full of imagination and passion. {却|què} contrasts him with Wang Wei's quiet poems, and with ordinary people, who would just say "how high!".

questions.stem: Read: "{在|zài}《{鹿柴|Lù zhài}》{里|lǐ}，{诗人|shī rén}{没有|méi yǒu}{写|xiě}{自己|zì jǐ}{看见|kàn jiàn}{了|le}{什么|shén me}{人|rén}，{只|zhǐ}{写|xiě}{了|le}{声音|shēng yīn}{和|hé}{光线|guāng xiàn}。{读|dú}{这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{诗|shī}，{就|jiù}{像|xiàng}{在|zài}{看|kàn}{一|yì}{幅|fú}{画|huà}。" Why does reading the poem feel like looking at a painting?
choices: Because it was written on a painting.
Because it shows a scene through sound and light, without a story about people.
questions.explanation: The poet shows the scene ({只|zhǐ}{写|xiě}{了|le}{声音|shēng yīn}{和|hé}{光线|guāng xiàn}: only sound and light) rather than telling what people did, so the reader sees it as in a painting: Su Shi's {诗|shī}{中|zhōng}{有|yǒu}{画|huà}.
