vocab.note: For life, the future, memories, wishes: {美好|měi hǎo}{的|de}{将来|jiāng lái}, {美好|měi hǎo}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}.
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{你们|nǐ men}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{美好|měi hǎo}{的|de}{将来|jiāng lái}！
vocab.exampleEn: I wish you a bright future!

vocab.note: {读|dú}{硕士|shuò shì}: to do a master's.
vocab.example: {英国|Yīng guó}{的|de}{硕士|shuò shì}{只|zhǐ}{要|yào}{一|yì}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: A master's in Britain only takes a year.

vocab.note: {读|dú}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}: to do a postgraduate degree.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{想|xiǎng}{读|dú}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She wants to go on to postgraduate study after she graduates.

vocab.note: Pass an exam ({通过|tōng guò}{考试|kǎo shì}); as a preposition, "through, by way of": {通过|tōng guò}{朋友|péng you}{认识|rèn shi}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{通过|tōng guò}{了|le} HSK {三级|sān jí}{考试|kǎo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He passed the HSK 3 exam.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{一生|yì shēng}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He worked in a school all his life.

vocab.note: {祝|zhù} + person + wish, for the future: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè}, {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一切|yí qiè}{顺利|shùn lì}. For something achieved, {祝贺|zhù hè}.
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè}！
vocab.exampleEn: Happy birthday!

vocab.note: {祝贺|zhù hè} + person + what was achieved: {祝贺|zhù hè}{你|nǐ}{毕业|bì yè}{了|le}. Not for wishes (that's {祝|zhù}).
vocab.example: {祝贺|zhù hè}{你|nǐ}{获奖|huò jiǎng}！
vocab.exampleEn: Congratulations on your prize!

vocab.note: {一切|yí qiè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}; {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一切|yí qiè}{顺利|shùn lì} (all the best). Before a noun: {一切|yí qiè}{问题|wèn tí}.
vocab.example: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{为|wèi}{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{的|de}{一切|yí qiè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you for everything you've done for me.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le}，{鼻子|bí zi}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got a cold, and my nose is really bothering me.

vocab.note: Read dàifu, with a light second syllable: the spoken word, and what patients call a doctor to their face. {医生|yī shēng} is the neutral word, and the one for your own job.
vocab.example: {大夫|dài fu}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{病|bìng}{严重|yán zhòng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Doctor, is it serious?

vocab.note: Light second syllable: gēbo.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{胳膊|gē bo}{受伤|shòu shāng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He hurt his arm playing basketball.

vocab.example: {护士|hù shi}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{量|liáng}{了|le}{体温|tǐ wēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The nurse took my temperature.

vocab.note: {肚子|dù zi}{疼|téng} is a stomach ache.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{肚子|dù zi}{疼|téng}，{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got a stomach ache and don't feel like eating anything.

vocab.note: Also a verb, close to {觉得|jué de}: {我|wǒ}{感觉|gǎn jué}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le} (I feel much better).
vocab.example: {吃|chī}{了|le}{药|yào}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{感觉|gǎn jué}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After taking the medicine I feel much better.

meanings: to give or have an injection
vocab.note: Separable: {打|dǎ}{了|le}{一|yì}{针|zhēn} (had an injection).
vocab.example: {小|xiǎo}{孩子|hái zi}{都|dōu}{怕|pà}{打针|dǎ zhēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Little children are all scared of injections.

vocab.note: Mostly before {得|de} ({咳|ké}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}) or in {咳嗽|ké sou}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{晚上|wǎn shang}{咳|ké}{得|de}{睡|shuì}{不|bu}{好|hǎo}{觉|jiào}。
vocab.exampleEn: At night he coughs so much he can't sleep properly.

vocab.note: Light second syllable: késou.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{咳嗽|ké sou}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has a bad cough; it's been three days.

vocab.note: For a likely, unwelcome outcome, before the verb phrase or the clause. "To be afraid of" is {怕|pà}.
vocab.example: {这么|zhè me}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{他|tā}{恐怕|kǒng pà}{不|bú}{会|huì}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's so late: I'm afraid he won't come now.

vocab.note: liáng as the verb; as the noun "amount" ({少量|shǎo liàng}, {数量|shù liàng}) it's liàng.
vocab.example: {护士|hù shi}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{量|liáng}{了|le}{一下|yí xià}{体温|tǐ wēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The nurse took his temperature.

vocab.note: Before a verb ({及时|jí shí}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}) or after {得|de} ({来|lái}{得|de}{很|hěn}{及时|jí shí}, just in time).
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{请|qǐng}{及时|jí shí}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: If there's a problem, let me know promptly.

vocab.note: After {得|de} it says "badly": {疼|téng}{得|de}{厉害|lì hai}. On its own it's often praise: {你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{厉害|lì hai}！
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{头|tóu}{疼|téng}{得|de}{厉害|lì hai}。
vocab.exampleEn: Last night I had a terrible headache.

vocab.example: {多|duō}{喝|hē}{水|shuǐ}{对|duì}{皮肤|pí fū}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Drinking plenty of water is good for your skin.

vocab.example: {大夫|dài fu}，{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？
vocab.exampleEn: Doctor, how is my mother doing?

vocab.note: Separable: {受|shòu}{了|le}{伤|shāng}, {受|shòu}{了|le}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{伤|shāng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{受伤|shòu shāng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He got hurt playing football.

vocab.note: For the body or the mind: {我|wǒ}{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{难受|nán shòu} (I feel awful about it).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{头|tóu}{疼|téng}{得|de}{厉害|lì hai}，{很|hěn}{难受|nán shòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: My head hurts badly; I feel awful.

vocab.note: Before {要|yào}, {别|bié}, {不要|bú yào} or {不|bù}{能|néng} in advice and warnings. In numbers it's still "ten million".
vocab.example: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{开车|kāi chē}{千万|qiān wàn}{要|yào}{小心|xiǎo xīn}！
vocab.exampleEn: It's raining: be sure to drive carefully!

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{体温|tǐ wēn}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your temperature's a little high.

vocab.note: Read xuè; in everyday speech some phrases are also said xiě.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{手|shǒu}{出|chū}{血|xuè}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His hand is bleeding.

vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{每|měi}{年|nián}{都|dōu}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company sends us to the hospital for a check-up every year.

vocab.note: More written than {疼|téng}, and mostly in compounds: {头痛|tóu tòng}, {肚子|dù zi}{痛|tòng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{胳膊|gē bo}{受伤|shòu shāng}{了|le}，{痛|tòng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}。
vocab.exampleEn: His arm was injured, and it hurt badly.

vocab.note: Also {头|tóu}{疼|téng} in speech.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{头痛|tóu tòng}，{没|méi}{去|qù}{上课|shàng kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I had a headache yesterday and didn't go to class.

vocab.note: For illnesses, problems and mistakes, not for people.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{病|bìng}{不|bù}{严重|yán zhòng}，{休息|xiū xi}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His illness isn't serious; a few days' rest and he'll be fine.

vocab.note: {戴|dài}{眼镜|yǎn jìng} is to wear glasses ({戴|dài}, lesson 09).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't find my glasses.

vocab.note: {院|yuàn} a hospital or college, {长|zhǎng} its head.
vocab.example: {医院|yī yuàn}{的|de}{院长|yuàn zhǎng}{也|yě}{来|lái}{看|kàn}{他|tā}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Even the head of the hospital came to see him.

vocab.example: {体温|tǐ wēn}{三十六|sān shí liù}{度|dù}{五|wǔ}，{很|hěn}{正常|zhèng cháng}。
vocab.exampleEn: 36.5 degrees: perfectly normal.

vocab.note: Also "stage, step" in a process ({下|xià}{一|yí}{步|bù}, the next step).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{至少|zhì shǎo}{走|zǒu}{六千|liù qiān}{步|bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I walk at least six thousand steps a day.

vocab.note: At the time that was set: {按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}, {按时|àn shí}{交|jiāo}{作业|zuò yè}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{要|yào}{按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: You must take your medicine at the right times.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{动作|dòng zuò}{不|bù}{难|nán}，{你|nǐ}{试试|shì shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This movement isn't hard: try it.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. {下功夫|xià gōng fu}: to put in the effort.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{学|xué}{中国|Zhōng guó}{功夫|gōng fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has learned kung fu since he was little.

vocab.note: {出|chū}{汗|hàn}: to sweat; {一|yì}{身|shēn}{汗|hàn}: sweating all over.
vocab.example: {跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{步|bù}，{我|wǒ}{出|chū}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{汗|hàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: After my run I was sweating a lot.

vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{要|yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{放松|fàng sōng}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the weekend you need to relax properly.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {好好|hǎo hǎo}{休息|xiū xi}, {好好|hǎo hǎo}{学习|xué xí}. In Beijing speech often hǎohāor ({好好儿|hǎo hāor}).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{要|yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{休息|xiū xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: You're ill: you need a proper rest.

vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{旁边|páng biān}{新|xīn}{开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{健身房|jiàn shēn fáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: A new gym has opened next to the company.

vocab.note: {教|jiāo} is jiào here.
vocab.example: {教练|jiào liàn}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{跑|pǎo}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The trainer had me run for ten minutes first.

vocab.note: Light second syllable: lìqi. {力气|lì qi}{大|dà}: strong.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{力气|lì qi}{了|le}，{休息|xiū xi}{一下|yí xià}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got no strength left: let's take a break.

vocab.note: Literally "add oil": a cheer, encouragement, and filling up at a petrol station ({加油站|jiā yóu zhàn}).
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{考试|kǎo shì}，{加油|jiā yóu}！
vocab.exampleEn: You've got your exam tomorrow: good luck!

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{健身|jiàn shēn}{三|sān}{次|cì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I work out three times a week.

vocab.note: Sleepy, not tired from effort ({累|lèi}). Traditional {睏|kùn}; {困难|kùn nan} (difficulty) keeps {={困|kùn}=}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{太|tài}{困|kùn}{了|le}，{先|xiān}{睡|shuì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm too sleepy: I'm going to bed.

vocab.note: Spoken; light second syllable. For a neutral habit use {总是|zǒng shì}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{老是|lǎo shi}{迟到|chí dào}？
vocab.exampleEn: Why are you always late?

vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{学校|xué xiào}{排球|pái qiú}{队|duì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's on the university volleyball team.

vocab.note: Played with {打|dǎ}: {打|dǎ}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}.
vocab.example: {下课|xià kè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go and play table tennis after class.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{球队|qiú duì}{又|yòu}{赢|yíng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our team won again.

vocab.note: {迷|mí} is a fan of anything: {足球|zú qiú}{迷|mí}, {歌|gē}{迷|mí}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{足球|zú qiú}{迷|mí}，{每|měi}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{都|dōu}{看|kàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a football fan: he watches every match.

vocab.example: {跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{步|bù}，{我|wǒ}{全身|quán shēn}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{汗|hàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: After my run I was sweating all over.

vocab.note: Mostly in words and set phrases: {全身|quán shēn}, {一|yì}{身|shēn}{汗|hàn}, {身|shēn}{上|shàng} (on you).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{身|shēn}{上|shàng}{没|méi}{带|dài}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I haven't got any money on me.

vocab.note: Separable; doubled as {散|sàn}{散步|sàn bù} (have a little walk).
vocab.example: {晚饭|wǎn fàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{散散步|sàn san bù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go for a walk after dinner.

vocab.note: An adverb ({我|wǒ}{平常|píng cháng}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}) or an adjective ({平常|píng cháng}{的|de}{一|yì}{天|tiān}).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{平常|píng cháng}{不|bù}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I don't usually drink coffee.

vocab.note: Opposite of {重|zhòng}. {轻|qīng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr} is also "more gently".
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{箱子|xiāng zi}{很|hěn}{轻|qīng}，{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{搬|bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This box is light: I can carry it on my own.

vocab.note: A state; the verb "to relax" is {放松|fàng sōng}.
vocab.example: {考|kǎo}{完|wán}{试|shì}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{轻松|qīng sōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the exam everyone was relaxed.

vocab.note: Only before a noun: {日常|rì cháng}{生活|shēng huó}, {日常|rì cháng}{用语|yòng yǔ}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{讲|jiǎng}{的|de}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}{的|de}{日常|rì cháng}{生活|shēng huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book is about Chinese people's everyday life.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{偶尔|ǒu ěr}{也|yě}{喝|hē}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{咖啡|kā fēi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have a coffee once in a while too.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{体重|tǐ zhòng}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{少|shǎo}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{公斤|gōng jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I weigh five kilos less than last year.

vocab.note: {效果|xiào guǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}: it works well.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{药|yào}{的|de}{效果|xiào guǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This medicine works really well.

vocab.note: {压力|yā lì}{很|hěn}{大|dà}: under a lot of pressure.
vocab.example: {最近|zuì jìn}{工作|gōng zuò}{压力|yā lì}{很|hěn}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's been a lot of pressure at work lately.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{把|bǎ}{桌子|zhuō zi}{抬|tái}{进去|jìn qù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's carry the table in between the two of us.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{抬头|tái tóu}{看|kàn}{了|le}{看|kàn}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looked up at the sky.

vocab.note: {躺|tǎng}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{上|shàng}: lying on the bed.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{躺|tǎng}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's lying on the sofa watching television.

vocab.note: Said at bedtime, not as a goodbye in the evening (that's {再见|zài jiàn}).
vocab.example: {晚安|wǎn ān}，{明天|míng tiān}{见|jiàn}！
vocab.exampleEn: Good night, see you tomorrow!

vocab.note: The moment of waking; getting up is {起床|qǐ chuáng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{早上|zǎo shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{醒|xǐng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I woke up at six this morning.

vocab.example: {别|bié}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{压|yā}{在|zài}{下面|xià miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't squash the book underneath.

vocab.note: Sums up a pattern in a situation, from experience; not for plans or requests ({常常|cháng cháng}).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{他|tā}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends he tends to go hiking.

vocab.note: A little more formal than {早上|zǎo shang}.
vocab.example: {早晨|zǎo chén}{的|de}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: The park is busy in the early morning.

vocab.note: zhòng ({重|zhòng}#chong2, chóng, is "again", lesson 02). {体重|tǐ zhòng}: body weight.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{箱子|xiāng zi}{太|tài}{重|zhòng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This box is too heavy.

vocab.note: Almost always with {习惯|xí guàn}: {养成|yǎng chéng}{好|hǎo}{习惯|xí guàn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{养成|yǎng chéng}{了|le}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{跑步|pǎo bù}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's got into the habit of running every day.

meanings: to touch (zháo, the result in falling asleep)
vocab.note: zháo, after a verb: {睡|shuì}{着|zháo} (fall asleep), {找|zhǎo}{着|zháo} (find); also {着火|zháo huǒ} (catch fire). The particle zhe is another word.
vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{一直|yì zhí}{没|méi}{睡|shuì}{着|zháo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I couldn't get to sleep at all last night.

vocab.note: Before a noun usually {尤其|yóu qí}{是|shì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{尤其|yóu qí}{是|shì}{游泳|yóu yǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I love sport, especially swimming.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{至少|zhì shǎo}{等|děng}{了|le}{你|nǐ}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}！
vocab.exampleEn: I waited at least half an hour for you!

vocab.note: A "dry cake": {饼|bǐng} (a round flat cake) + "dry". Traditional {餅乾|bǐng gān}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{饿|è}{了|le}，{先|xiān}{吃|chī}{几|jǐ}{块|kuài}{饼干|bǐng gān}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm hungry: I'll have a few biscuits first.

vocab.note: The leaves you buy; the drink is {茶|chá}.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{茶叶|chá yè}{是|shì}{朋友|péng you}{从|cóng}{杭州|Háng zhōu}{带|dài}{来|lái}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: These tea leaves were brought by a friend from Hangzhou.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{厨房|chú fáng}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our kitchen is very small.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{厨师|chú shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a chef at a restaurant.

vocab.note: Counted with {把|bǎ}: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}，{你|nǐ}{小心|xiǎo xīn}{点儿|diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: This knife is very sharp: be careful.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{苹果|píng guǒ}{汁|zhī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like a glass of apple juice.

vocab.note: {四|sì}{道|dào}{菜|cài} (four dishes), {一|yí}{道|dào}{题|tí} (a question). Also "road, way" in {道路|dào lù} (lesson 16).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{晚饭|wǎn fàn}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{道|dào}{菜|cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are four dishes for dinner today.

vocab.note: dào. Read dǎo it's "to fall over".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{倒|dào}{杯|bēi}{茶|chá}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let me pour you a cup of tea.

vocab.note: {够|gòu}{了|le} (that's enough); {够|gòu} + adjective + {的|de}: really… ({够|gòu}{辣|là}{的|de}).
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{吃|chī}{这些|zhè xiē}{菜|cài}{够|gòu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is enough food for two.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{顿|dùn}{饭|fàn}, {三|sān}{顿|dùn}{饭|fàn}; {说|shuō}{了|le}{他|tā}{一|yí}{顿|dùn} (gave him a talking-to).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{吃|chī}{一|yí}{顿|dùn}{饭|fàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let me treat you to a meal.

vocab.example: {别|bié}{吃|chī}{太|tài}{多|duō}{零食|líng shí}，{快|kuài}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't eat too many snacks: it's nearly dinner time.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. With a filling it's a {包子|bāo zi}.
vocab.example: {北方|běi fāng}{人|rén}{早上|zǎo shang}{常常|cháng cháng}{吃|chī}{馒头|mán tou}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the north people often have steamed buns in the morning.

meanings: to have a meal together (as a group)
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{聚餐|jù cān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our class is having a meal together at the weekend.

vocab.note: {烤|kǎo}{鸭|yā} (roast duck), {烤|kǎo}{面包|miàn bāo} (toast).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{只|zhī}{鸡|jī}{烤|kǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{香|xiāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This chicken is nicely roasted.

vocab.note: Also of a hard life: {生活|shēng huó}{很|hěn}{苦|kǔ}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{药|yào}{太|tài}{苦|kǔ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This medicine is too bitter.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{太|tài}{能|néng}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't really eat spicy food.

vocab.note: Of food and drink: {菜|cài}{凉|liáng}{了|le} (the food's gone cold). HSK 3's {凉快|liáng kuai} is pleasantly cool weather.
vocab.example: {汤|tāng}{凉|liáng}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{热|rè}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The soup's gone cold: I'll heat it up.

vocab.example: {杯子|bēi zi}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{水|shuǐ}{太|tài}{满|mǎn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The glass is too full.

vocab.note: The weight, ten to a {斤|jīn}. "Two liang" is {二两|èr liǎng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{二两|èr liǎng}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like two liang (100 g) of dumplings.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{葡萄|pú tao}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: These grapes are very sweet.

vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{喝|hē}{汽水|qì shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children all love fizzy drinks.

vocab.note: A sound borrowing, like {咖啡|kā fēi}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{块|kuài}{巧克力|qiǎo kè lì}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of chocolate is very sweet.

vocab.note: Packaged and sold: {食品|shí pǐn}{店|diàn} (a food shop), {食品|shí pǐn}{安全|ān quán} (food safety).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{商店|shāng diàn}{卖|mài}{各种|gè zhǒng}{食品|shí pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop sells all sorts of food.

vocab.note: Food as what people or animals eat.
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{要|yào}{多|duō}{吃|chī}{热|rè}{的|de}{食物|shí wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: In winter you should eat more hot food.

vocab.note: Written style (recipes, instructions); in speech {一点儿|yì diǎnr}.
vocab.example: {放|fàng}{少量|shǎo liàng}{的|de}{盐|yán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Add a small amount of salt.

vocab.note: {生|shēng}{鸡蛋|jī dàn} (a raw egg); the opposite is {熟|shú}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{块|kuài}{肉|ròu}{还是|hái shi}{生|shēng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of meat is still raw.

vocab.note: shú (in speech often shóu). Also "familiar" in {熟悉|shú xī} (lesson 01).
vocab.example: {鸡蛋|jī dàn}{熟|shú}{了|le}，{可以|kě yǐ}{吃|chī}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The eggs are done: you can eat them.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {公斤|gōng jīn}.
vocab.example: {水果|shuǐ guǒ}{店|diàn}{门口|mén kǒu}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}：{苹果|píng guǒ}{每|měi}{千克|qiān kè}{十二|shí èr}{元|yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sign at the fruit shop door says: apples, 12 yuan a kilo.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{早饭|zǎo fàn}{喝|hē}{一|yì}{瓶|píng}{酸奶|suān nǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have a bottle of yoghurt for breakfast.

vocab.note: {喝|hē}{汤|tāng} (to have soup).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{汤|tāng}{很|hěn}{鲜|xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This soup is very tasty.

vocab.note: After a noun: {鱼|yú}{味|wèi} (a fishy taste).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{汤|tāng}{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{鱼|yú}{味|wèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This soup tastes a bit of fish.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{味道|wèi dao}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？
vocab.exampleEn: How does this dish taste?

vocab.note: Also {番茄|fān qié} fānqié.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{买|mǎi}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{西红柿|xī hóng shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I want to buy two tomatoes.

vocab.example: {汤|tāng}{里|lǐ}{再|zài}{放|fàng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{盐|yán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Put a little more salt in the soup.

vocab.note: The action; "smells good" is {香|xiāng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{闻闻|wén wen}，{这|zhè}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{味道|wèi dao}？
vocab.exampleEn: Smell this: what is that smell?

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{苹果|píng guǒ}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{酸|suān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This apple is a bit sour.

vocab.example: {刚|gāng}{买|mǎi}{的|de}{鱼|yú}{做|zuò}{的|de}{汤|tāng}{特别|tè bié}{鲜|xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Soup made with freshly bought fish is especially tasty.

vocab.example: {汤|tāng}{太|tài}{咸|xián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The soup is too salty.

vocab.note: {好|hǎo}{香|xiāng}！ (That smells wonderful!)
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{做|zuò}{的|de}{菜|cài}{真|zhēn}{香|xiāng}！
vocab.exampleEn: The food you've cooked smells wonderful!

vocab.note: {加油|jiā yóu} (come on!) is lesson 07's.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{油|yóu}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This dish has too much oil in it.

vocab.note: Eaten at the Mid-Autumn Festival.
vocab.example: {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{吃|chī}{月饼|yuè bǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the Mid-Autumn Festival everyone eats mooncakes.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{的|de}{做法|zuò fǎ}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This dish is simple to make.

vocab.note: A noun ({达到|dá dào}{标准|biāo zhǔn}) and an adjective ({标准|biāo zhǔn}{的|de}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}{标准|biāo zhǔn}{的|de}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He speaks standard Putonghua.

vocab.note: A {不如|bù rú} B (+ a good quality): {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{不如|bù rú}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{好吃|hǎo chī}. Before a verb, a suggestion: {不如|bù rú}{打车|dǎ chē}{吧|ba}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{不如|bù rú}{他|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: My Chinese isn't as good as his.

vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{低价|dī jià}{卖|mài}{旧|jiù}{货|huò}。
vocab.exampleEn: They sell second-hand goods cheaply.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{用|yòng}{高价|gāo jià}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{这|zhè}{辆|liàng}{旧|jiù}{车|chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: He paid a high price for this old car.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{顾客|gù kè}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop has lots of customers.

vocab.note: Separable: {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé} (20 % off: you pay eight tenths).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}。
vocab.exampleEn: This sweater is 20 % off.

meanings: to wear (glasses, a hat, a watch)
vocab.note: For things put on (hats, glasses, watches); clothes and shoes take {穿|chuān}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{戴|dài}{着|zhe}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's wearing glasses.

vocab.note: {付|fù}{钱|qián}, {付|fù}{房租|fáng zū}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{付|fù}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm paying today.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{购买|gòu mǎi}{门票|mén piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please buy tickets online.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{购物|gòu wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: She loves shopping.

vocab.note: {逛|guàng}{街|jiē}, {逛|guàng}{商店|shāng diàn}, {逛|guàng}{公园|gōng yuán}.
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{逛|guàng}{商店|shāng diàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go round the shops at the weekend.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{份|fèn}{饭|fàn}, {两|liǎng}{份|fèn}{报纸|bào zhǐ}, {一|yí}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like a portion of dumplings.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{超市|chāo shì}{的|de}{会员|huì yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm a member of this supermarket.

vocab.note: {新|xīn}{到|dào}{的|de}{货|huò} (new stock), {送|sòng}{货|huò} (deliver goods), {假|jiǎ}{货|huò} (fakes).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{货|huò}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{新|xīn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everything in this shop is new stock.

vocab.note: The general word, written and spoken.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{价格|jià gé}{不|bù}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Prices here aren't high.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {价钱|jià qian}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？
vocab.exampleEn: How's the price?

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{快递|kuài dì}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My parcel has arrived.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{是|shì}{妈妈|mā ma}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mum bought me this sweater.

vocab.note: Worn with {戴|dài}; counted with {顶|dǐng}.
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{戴|dài}{上|shàng}{帽子|mào zi}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's cold outside: put a hat on.

vocab.note: {降|jiàng} is "to fall"; a price rise is {涨价|zhǎng jià}.
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{快|kuài}{过去|guò qù}{了|le}，{毛衣|máo yī}{都|dōu}{降价|jiàng jià}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Winter's nearly over, and sweaters have all come down in price.

vocab.note: jiǎ. {假|jiǎ}{货|huò} (fakes). The same character read jià is HSK 3's {放假|fàng jià}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{包|bāo}{是|shì}{假|jiǎ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bag is a fake.

vocab.note: On signs and labels: {男士|nán shì}{衬衫|chèn shān} (men's shirts).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{男士|nán shì}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: These are all men's clothes.

vocab.note: {什么|shén me}{牌子|pái zi}{的|de}？ (What brand is it?)
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{牌子|pái zi}{的|de}？
vocab.exampleEn: What make is your phone?

vocab.example: {他|tā}{穿|chuān}{了|le}{一|yì}{双|shuāng}{新|xīn}{皮鞋|pí xié}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's wearing a new pair of leather shoes.

vocab.example: {超市|chāo shì}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{商品|shāng pǐn}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of goods in the supermarket.

vocab.note: Also the market in the economic sense.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{常常|cháng cháng}{去|qù}{市场|shì chǎng}{买|mǎi}{菜|cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: I often go to the market for food.

vocab.note: Only "free of charge"; "not busy" is {有空|yǒu kòng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{公园|gōng yuán}{是|shì}{免费|miǎn fèi}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This park is free.

vocab.note: Separable: {排|pái}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{队|duì}.
vocab.example: {买|mǎi}{票|piào}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{排队|pái duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The people buying tickets are all queuing.

vocab.example: {扫码|sǎo mǎ}{就|jiù}{可以|kě yǐ}{付|fù}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can pay just by scanning the code.

meanings: to come to the door (to deliver, serve)
vocab.note: {送|sòng}{货|huò}{上门|shàng mén} (home delivery).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{可以|kě yǐ}{送|sòng}{货|huò}{上门|shàng mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: They can deliver to your door.

vocab.example: {送|sòng}{货|huò}{上门|shàng mén}{要|yào}{收费|shōu fèi}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you charge for delivery?

vocab.note: Counted with {双|shuāng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{三|sān}{双|shuāng}{袜子|wà zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought three pairs of socks.

vocab.example: {天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{穿|chuān}{件|jiàn}{外套|wài tào}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's got cold: put a jacket on.

vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{用|yòng}{现金|xiàn jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hardly anyone uses cash now.

vocab.example: {进|jìn}{门|mén}{请|qǐng}{脱|tuō}{鞋|xié}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please take your shoes off when you come in.

vocab.note: {跟|gēn} / {和|hé} / {与|yǔ} B {相比|xiāng bǐ}, …
vocab.example: {跟|gēn}{去年|qù nián}{相比|xiāng bǐ}，{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{高|gāo}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Compared with last year, prices are a good deal higher this year.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{质量|zhì liàng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The clothes in this shop are good quality.

vocab.note: Written and in apps; in speech {付|fù}.
vocab.example: {可以|kě yǐ}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{支付|zhī fù}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can pay by phone.

vocab.note: The plain word; {卫生间|wèi shēng jiān} is politer.
vocab.example: {请问|qǐng wèn}，{厕所|cè suǒ}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}？
vocab.exampleEn: Excuse me, where's the toilet?

vocab.note: In words: {窗口|chuāng kǒu}, {窗|chuāng}{外|wài} (outside the window).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{窗|chuāng}{边|biān}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's sitting by the window reading.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {风|fēng}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}，{把|bǎ}{窗户|chuāng hu}{关|guān}{上|shàng}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's very windy: shut the window.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{桌子|zhuō zi}{擦|cā}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've wiped the table clean.

vocab.note: The owner's verb; the tenant's is {租|zū}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{套|tào}{房子|fáng zi}{出租|chū zū}。
vocab.exampleEn: This flat is to let.

vocab.note: With an unwanted event, {差点儿|chà diǎnr} and {差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi} both mean "nearly happened, but didn't".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{迟到|chí dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was nearly late today.

vocab.note: Double negation: something forces you.
vocab.example: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{不得不|bù dé bú}{坐|zuò}{出租车|chū zū chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: It was raining, so we had no choice but to take a taxi.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. {床|chuáng}{底下|dǐ xia} (under the bed).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{鞋|xié}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{底下|dǐ xia}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your shoes are under the bed.

vocab.note: {杯子|bēi zi}{底|dǐ} (the bottom of the cup), {年底|nián dǐ} (end of the year).
vocab.example: {杯子|bēi zi}{底|dǐ}{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{水|shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a little water in the bottom of the cup.

vocab.example: {超市|chāo shì}{在|zài}{银行|yín háng}{对面|duì miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The supermarket is opposite the bank.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{房东|fáng dōng}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our landlady is really nice.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{的|de}{房租|fáng zū}{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{付|fù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've already paid this month's rent.

vocab.note: Also "to hang up" (the phone): {挂|guà}{电话|diàn huà}.
vocab.example: {把|bǎ}{衣服|yī fu}{挂|guà}{起来|qǐ lái}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hang your clothes up.

vocab.note: Counted with {件|jiàn}. Traditional {家具|jiā jù} here (s2tw gives {傢俱|jiā jù}).
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{家具|jiā jù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{新|xīn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: All the furniture in the new flat is new.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{镜子|jìng zi}{前面|qián miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's standing in front of the mirror.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{客厅|kè tīng}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're watching television in the living room.

vocab.note: Opposite of {推|tuī}.
vocab.example: {门|mén}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}"{拉|lā}"。
vocab.exampleEn: The door says "Pull".

vocab.note: The second syllable is fà (hair, as in {头发|tóu fa}). {理发|lǐ fà}{店|diàn}: a barber's.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{去|qù}{理发|lǐ fà}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm getting my hair cut tomorrow.

vocab.note: kōng; {空|kòng} (free time) is lesson 15's.
vocab.example: {冰箱|bīng xiāng}{是|shì}{空|kōng}{的|de}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{点儿|diǎnr}{东西|dōng xi}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: The fridge is empty: let's go and buy something.

vocab.note: {灯|dēng}{不|bú}{亮|liàng}{了|le} (the light isn't working).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{很|hěn}{亮|liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This room is very bright.

vocab.example: {房间|fáng jiān}{太|tài}{乱|luàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The room is a mess.

vocab.note: Nearly always with a result: {弄|nòng}{坏|huài}, {弄|nòng}{脏|zāng}, {弄|nòng}{好|hǎo}, {弄|nòng}{丢|diū}.
vocab.example: {谁|shéi}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{弄|nòng}{坏|huài}{了|le}？
vocab.exampleEn: Who broke my phone?

vocab.note: Glass, clothes, skin; machines that stop working are {坏|huài}.
vocab.example: {窗户|chuāng hu}{的|de}{玻璃|bō li}{破|pò}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The window glass is broken.

vocab.note: {敲|qiāo}{门|mén} (to knock at the door).
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{人|rén}{在|zài}{敲|qiāo}{门|mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Someone's knocking at the door.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. {收拾|shōu shi}{东西|dōng xi} (to pack).
vocab.example: {快|kuài}{把|bǎ}{房间|fáng jiān}{收拾|shōu shi}{一下|yí xià}！
vocab.exampleEn: Tidy your room!

vocab.note: Opposite of {拉|lā}; {推迟|tuī chí} (to postpone) is lesson 17's.
vocab.example: {门|mén}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}"{推|tuī}"。
vocab.exampleEn: The door says "Push".

vocab.note: {电话|diàn huà}{响|xiǎng}{了|le} (the phone's ringing).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{响|xiǎng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My phone's ringing.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{坏|huài}{了|le}，{得|děi}{修|xiū}{一|yi}{修|xiū}。
vocab.exampleEn: My bike's broken: it needs fixing.

vocab.note: {修理|xiū lǐ}{费|fèi}: repair costs.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{师傅|shī fu}{来|lái}{修理|xiū lǐ}{窗户|chuāng hu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The repairman is coming to fix the window tomorrow.

vocab.note: {打扫|dǎ sǎo}{卫生|wèi shēng} (to do the cleaning).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{很|hěn}{卫生|wèi shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This restaurant is very clean.

vocab.note: Light second syllable; counted with {把|bǎ}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钥匙|yào shi}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't find my keys.

vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{在|zài}{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}{玩儿|wánr}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are playing in the yard.

vocab.example: {房子|fáng zi}{周围|zhōu wéi}{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's quiet around the house.

vocab.note: {着|zháo} is zháo, as in {睡|shuì}{着|zhe}.
vocab.example: {厨房|chú fáng}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{着火|zháo huǒ}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: The kitchen nearly caught fire!

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{整理|zhěng lǐ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm sorting out my books.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{租|zū}{了|le}{一|yí}{套|tào}{两|liǎng}{室|shì}{一|yì}{厅|tīng}{的|de}{房子|fáng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've rented a two-bedroom flat.

vocab.note: After a reason: what you did because nothing else would do.
vocab.example: {商店|shāng diàn}{关|guān}{门|mén}{了|le}，{他|tā}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: The shop was shut, so he'll have to come back tomorrow.

vocab.note: What an employer does: {招聘|zhāo pìn}{广告|guǎng gào} (a job advertisement). The person who answers it {应聘|yìng pìn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{两|liǎng}{名|míng}{司机|sī jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our company is recruiting two drivers.

vocab.note: The applicant's side of {招聘|zhāo pìn}. {应|yìng} is fourth tone here, not {应该|yīng gāi}'s first.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{去|qù}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{应聘|yìng pìn}{编辑|biān jí}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: She applied for an editor's job at a website.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{广告|guǎng gào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I saw a job advertisement online.

vocab.note: Met with {符合|fú hé}: {符合|fú hé}{条件|tiáo jiàn}. Also living conditions: {条件|tiáo jiàn}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}{不|bú}{太|tài}{高|gāo}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{符合|fú hé}。
vocab.exampleEn: The requirements for this job aren't very high; plenty of students meet them.

vocab.note: Takes a condition, requirement or rule, never a person: {我|wǒ}{符合|fú hé}{你们|nǐ men}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}。
vocab.example: {要是|yào shi}{你|nǐ}{符合|fú hé}{条件|tiáo jiàn}，{就|jiù}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you meet the requirements, give us a call.

vocab.note: The word of forms and advertisements; in speech, ask {多|duō}{大|dà} or {几|jǐ}{岁|suì}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{对|duì}{年龄|nián líng}{没有|méi yǒu}{要求|yāo qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: This job has no age requirement.

vocab.note: A form asks {性别|xìng bié}; the answer is {男|nán} or {女|nǚ}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}、{年龄|nián líng}{和|hé}{性别|xìng bié}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your name, age and sex on the form.

vocab.note: Formal (news, forms, statistics); in speech {男|nán}{的|de} or {男人|nán rén}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{男性|nán xìng}、{女性|nǚ xìng}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{做|zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Both men and women can do this job.

vocab.note: Formal (news, forms, statistics); in speech {女|nǚ}{的|de} or {女人|nǚ rén}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{职业|zhí yè}{的|de}{女性|nǚ xìng}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are more and more women in this profession.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{工资|gōng zī}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{发|fā}{一|yí}{次|cì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The pay for this job is paid once a month.

vocab.note: Takes the job as its object: {我|wǒ}{负责|fù zé}{写|xiě}{广告|guǎng gào}。 As an adjective, "conscientious": {他|tā}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{负责|fù zé}。
vocab.example: {小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}{负责|fù zé}{写|xiě}{广告|guǎng gào}，{我|wǒ}{负责|fù zé}{找|zhǎo}{资料|zī liào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Xiao Li is in charge of writing the advert, and I'll find the material.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{的|de}{负责人|fù zé rén}{是|shì}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The person in charge of this round of hiring is Ms Zheng.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{责任心|zé rèn xīn}: to have a sense of responsibility.
vocab.example: {照顾|zhào gù}{好|hǎo}{孩子|hái zi}{是|shì}{爸爸|bà ba}{妈妈|mā ma}{的|de}{责任|zé rèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Looking after their children well is parents' responsibility.

vocab.note: Work for someone else for a time, often while studying: {暑假|shǔ jià}{打工|dǎ gōng}. A career is {工作|gōng zuò}.
vocab.example: {暑假|shǔ jià}{他|tā}{在|zài}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{打工|dǎ gōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He works in a restaurant in the summer holidays.

meanings: to work (spoken, often with the hands)
vocab.note: {干|gàn} is the {干|gàn} of {干|gàn}{什么|shén me}; in traditional it is written {+{干活儿|gàn huór}+}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{从|cóng}{早上|zǎo shang}{干活儿|gàn huór}{干|gàn}{到|dào}{晚上|wǎn shang}。
vocab.exampleEn: They work from morning till night.

meanings: worker (in a factory or on a site)
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工厂|gōng chǎng}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{多|duō}{个|gè}{工人|gōng rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: This factory has over three hundred workers.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{去|qù}{了|le}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{工厂|gōng chǎng}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: After graduating he went to work at a factory.

vocab.note: In names and in speech: {厂|chǎng}{里|lǐ} (at the factory). Traditional {+{厂|chǎng}+}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{在|zài}{厂|chǎng}{里|lǐ}{上班|shàng bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dad works at the factory.

vocab.note: Used to address drivers, cooks and repairers politely: {师傅|shī fu}，{去|qù}{火车站|huǒ chē zhàn}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}？
vocab.example: {修|xiū}{空调|kōng tiáo}{的|de}{师傅|shī fu}{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: The repairman is coming tomorrow morning to fix the air conditioner.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{以后|yǐ hòu}{想|xiǎng}{做|zuò}{什么|shén me}{职业|zhí yè}？
vocab.exampleEn: What would you like to do for a living?

vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{职业|zhí yè}{是|shì}{律师|lǜ shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a lawyer by profession.

vocab.note: {你|nǐ}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}{了|le}！ thanks someone for their effort.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}，{有|yǒu}{时候|shí hou}{晚上|wǎn shang}{也|yě}{要|yào}{干活儿|gàn huór}。
vocab.exampleEn: This job is hard work; sometimes you have to work in the evening too.

vocab.note: Before a verb, "for this one purpose"; before a noun, "specialised": {专门|zhuān mén}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{专门|zhuān mén}{来|lái}{看|kàn}{你|nǐ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: I came specially to see you.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{只是|zhǐ shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{普通|pǔ tōng}{的|de}{工人|gōng rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's just an ordinary worker.

vocab.note: Written; usually + a two-syllable verb: {无法|wú fǎ}{回答|huí dá}. In speech, {没|méi}{办法|bàn fǎ}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{我|wǒ}{无法|wú fǎ}{回答|huí dá}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm unable to answer this question.

vocab.note: {做|zuò}{生意|shēng yi}: to do business. The second syllable is light.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{生意|shēng yi}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Business at this restaurant is getting better and better.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{经济|jīng jì}{发展|fā zhǎn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The economy here has grown fast in the last few years.

vocab.note: Starts the second clause: what happens if the first doesn't. A little formal; in speech {不然|bù rán} or {要不|yào bù}.
vocab.example: {出门|chū mén}{要|yào}{带|dài}{上|shàng}{钥匙|yào shi}，{否则|fǒu zé}{就|jiù}{进不了|jìn bu liǎo}{门|mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Take your keys when you go out, or you won't be able to get in.

vocab.note: Used like {如果|rú guǒ}, with {就|jiù} after the subject of the second clause. Sounds the same as {钥匙|yào shi} (keys).
vocab.example: {要是|yào shi}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

meanings: interview (for a job or a place)
vocab.note: A noun as often as a verb: {明天|míng tiān}{有|yǒu}{面试|miàn shì}, {参加|cān jiā}{面试|miàn shì}. The interviewer is the {面试官|miàn shì guān}.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{面试|miàn shì}，{今天|jīn tiān}{得|děi}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{准备|zhǔn bèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have an interview tomorrow morning, so I need to prepare properly today.

vocab.note: Knowledge or skill gained by doing: {有|yǒu}{经验|jīng yàn}, {积累|jī lěi}{经验|jīng yàn}. {经历|jīng lì} (lesson 20) is something you went through.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{工作|gōng zuò}{过|guo}{三|sān}{年|nián}，{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{经验|jīng yàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: She worked at this company for three years and is very experienced.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{需要|xū yào}{很|hěn}{强|qiáng}{的|de}{学习|xué xí}{能力|néng lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This job needs a strong ability to learn.

vocab.note: {能力|néng lì}{很|hěn}{强|qiáng}: very capable.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{能力|néng lì}{很|hěn}{强|qiáng}，{什么|shén me}{事|shì}{都|dōu}{做|zuò}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very capable at work: he does everything well.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{口语|kǒu yǔ}{不错|bú cuò}，{但是|dàn shì}{听力|tīng lì}{还|hái}{要|yào}{加强|jiā qiáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your spoken Chinese is good, but your listening needs strengthening.

vocab.note: Read jī lěi: {累|lěi} here, not {累|lèi} (tired).
vocab.example: {打工|dǎ gōng}{可以|kě yǐ}{积累|jī lěi}{工作|gōng zuò}{经验|jīng yàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: A part-time job is a way to build up work experience.

meanings: to be able to (a little formal)
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{能够|néng gòu}{保证|bǎo zhèng}{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{来|lái}{三|sān}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can guarantee to come three days a week.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{优点|yōu diǎn}{是|shì}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{认真|rèn zhēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her strong point is that she's conscientious.

vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{缺点|quē diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone has shortcomings.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{最|zuì}{优秀|yōu xiù}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's the best student in our class.

vocab.note: {积极|jī jí}{参加|cān jiā}{活动|huó dòng}: to take an active part in events.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{上课|shàng kè}{很|hěn}{积极|jī jí}，{常常|cháng cháng}{回答|huí dá}{问题|wèn tí}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very active in class and often answers questions.

vocab.note: An adjective ({她|tā}{很|hěn}{自信|zì xìn}) and a noun ({有|yǒu}{自信|zì xìn}). Confidence about one thing is {信心|xìn xīn}.
vocab.example: {面试|miàn shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{自信|zì xìn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: Be a bit more self-confident at the interview.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{信心|xìn xīn}: to be confident about…
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{信心|xìn xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm confident about this exam.

meanings: to perform (show how good one is)
vocab.note: Also a noun: {他|tā}{的|de}{表现|biǎo xiàn}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (he did well).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{面试|miàn shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{表现|biǎo xiàn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She did very well at the interview.

vocab.note: As a noun, a certificate or letter: {工作|gōng zuò}{证明|zhèng míng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{得|děi}{用|yòng}{例子|lì zi}{证明|zhèng míng}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{能力|néng lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: You have to prove your ability with examples.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{保证|bǎo zhèng}{明天|míng tiān}{以前|yǐ qián}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
vocab.exampleEn: I promise to finish it by tomorrow.

meanings: to reach (a level or a goal)
vocab.note: {达到|dá dào}{要求|yāo qiú}: to meet the requirements; {达到|dá dào}{目标|mù biāo}: to reach a target.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{达到|dá dào}{了|le}{这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: His Chinese already meets the requirements of this job.

vocab.note: {取得|qǔ dé}{好|hǎo}{成绩|chéng jì}, {取得|qǔ dé}{成功|chéng gōng}. {得到|dé dào} (HSK 3) is the everyday "to get".
vocab.example: {他|tā}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{取得|qǔ dé}{了|le}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{成绩|chéng jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He got very good results in this exam.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{竞争|jìng zhēng}{很|hěn}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: The competition for this job is tough.

vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{学会|xué huì}{面对|miàn duì}{困难|kùn nan}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone has to learn to face difficulties.

vocab.note: An adjective and a noun: {很|hěn}{困难|kùn nan}, {遇到|yù dào}{困难|kùn nan}. The second syllable is light.
vocab.example: {遇到|yù dào}{困难|kùn nan}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{可以|kě yǐ}{找|zhǎo}{老师|lǎo shī}{帮忙|bāng máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you run into difficulties, you can ask a teacher for help.

vocab.example: {运动|yùn dòng}{能|néng}{减轻|jiǎn qīng}{压力|yā lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Exercise can ease stress.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{老师|lǎo shī}{很|hěn}{重视|zhòng shì}{口语|kǒu yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our teacher puts a lot of weight on speaking.

vocab.note: With a one-syllable object: {缺|quē}{钱|qián}, {缺|quē}{人|rén}. With longer ones, {缺少|quē shǎo}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{店|diàn}{最近|zuì jìn}{很|hěn}{缺|quē}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our shop is very short-staffed at the moment.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{刚|gāng}{毕业|bì yè}，{还|hái}{缺少|quē shǎo}{工作|gōng zuò}{经验|jīng yàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's just graduated and still lacks work experience.

vocab.note: A verb with an object: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{适合|shì hé}{你|nǐ}。 {合适|hé shì} (HSK 3) is the adjective and takes none.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{很|hěn}{适合|shì hé}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of clothing really suits you.

vocab.example: {会|huì}{用|yòng}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{是|shì}{这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{基本|jī běn}{要求|yāo qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: Being able to use a computer is a basic requirement of this job.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{基本上|jī běn shang}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{懂|dǒng}{英文|Yīng wén}{新闻|xīn wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can basically understand English news.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{流利|liú lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She speaks Chinese fluently.

vocab.note: Usually starts the sentence: {作为|zuò wéi}{学生|xué sheng}，…. Not a time word: "when I was a student" is {上学|shàng xué}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}.
vocab.example: {作为|zuò wéi}{负责人|fù zé rén}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{跟|gēn}{大家|dà jiā}{说|shuō}{几|jǐ}{句|jù}{话|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: As the person in charge, I'd like to say a few words to everyone.

vocab.note: Read wéi; in words such as {成为|chéng wéi}, {作为|zuò wéi}, {分为|fēn wéi}. HSK 3's {为|wèi} (for) is fourth tone.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{想|xiǎng}{成为|chéng wéi}{一|yì}{名|míng}{律师|lǜ shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He'd like to become a lawyer.

vocab.note: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}: whose job it is (not {被|bèi}). Also written "from": {由此|yóu cǐ}{进入|jìn rù} (enter here).
vocab.example: {你们|nǐ men}{写|xiě}{的|de}{文章|wén zhāng}{都|dōu}{由|yóu}{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{查看|chá kàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll look over everything you write first.

meanings: according to (a rule, plan or instructions)
vocab.note: Following rules or instructions: {按照|àn zhào}{规定|guī dìng}. {根据|gēn jù} (HSK 3) is "on the basis of" facts or information.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{按照|àn zhào}{说明书|shuō míng shū}{使用|shǐ yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please use it according to the instructions.

vocab.note: Before one syllable and in set phrases: {按时|àn shí}, {按|àn}{月|yuè} (monthly). As a verb, to press: {按|àn}{电梯|diàn tī}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{工资|gōng zī}{按|àn}{月|yuè}{发|fā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our wages are paid monthly.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {发|fā}{通知|tōng zhī} (to send out a notice).
vocab.example: {时间|shí jiān}{定|dìng}{了|le}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{会|huì}{马上|mǎ shàng}{通知|tōng zhī}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Once the time is fixed, I'll let you know at once.

vocab.note: Most often a noun: {按照|àn zhào}{规定|guī dìng} (under the rules).
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{规定|guī dìng}{上班|shàng bān}{不|bù}{能|néng}{迟到|chí dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company's rule is that you can't be late for work.

vocab.note: Also "to show, indicate": {这|zhè}{说明|shuō míng}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{重视|zhòng shì}{这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò} (this shows he takes the job seriously).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{说明|shuō míng}{一下|yí xià}{这个|zhè ge}{表格|biǎo gé}{怎么|zěn me}{填写|tián xiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: Could you explain how to fill in this form?

vocab.example: {用|yòng}{以前|yǐ qián}，{最好|zuì hǎo}{先|xiān}{看看|kàn kan}{说明书|shuō míng shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's best to read the instructions before you use it.

vocab.note: Written; in speech, {填|tián}: {填|tián}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{表|biǎo}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{内|nèi}{填写|tián xiě}{这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{表格|biǎo gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please fill in this form within three days.

vocab.example: {表格|biǎo gé}{上|shàng}{要|yào}{写|xiě}{清楚|qīng chu}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{电话|diàn huà}{号码|hào mǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Write your phone number clearly on the form.

vocab.note: In speech: {填|tián}{表|biǎo}, {时间表|shí jiān biǎo} (lesson 02). The {表|biǎo} of {手表|shǒu biǎo} (a watch) is another word, {+{手表|shǒu biǎo}+} in traditional.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{先|xiān}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{表|biǎo}{填|tián}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Fill in this form first.

vocab.note: Building materials, or the papers you hand in: {申请|shēn qǐng}{材料|cái liào} (application documents).
vocab.example: {申请|shēn qǐng}{材料|cái liào}{要|yào}{在|zài}{月底|yuè dǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{交|jiāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The application documents must be handed in before the end of the month.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{文件|wén jiàn}{你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{完|wán}{以后|yǐ hòu}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Send me this document when you've read it.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{详细|xiáng xì}{地|de}{说明|shuō míng}{了|le}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: He explained the job's requirements to us in detail.

vocab.note: {正式|zhèng shì}{员工|yuán gōng}: a permanent member of staff.
vocab.example: {实习|shí xí}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{她|tā}{成为|chéng wéi}{了|le}{正式|zhèng shì}{员工|yuán gōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the internship she became a permanent member of staff.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{暂时|zàn shí}{还|hái}{可以|kě yǐ}{用|yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This method will do for the time being.

vocab.note: Written, before a noun: {现有|xiàn yǒu}{的|de}{人员|rén yuán} (the present staff).
vocab.example: {办公室|bàn gōng shì}{现有|xiàn yǒu}{的|de}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{太|tài}{旧|jiù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The computers the office has at present are too old.

vocab.note: After a time or a place: {三|sān}{天|tiān}{内|nèi}, {办公室|bàn gōng shì}{内|nèi}. In speech, {以内|yǐ nèi} or {里|lǐ}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{内|nèi}{把|bǎ}{表|biǎo}{交|jiāo}{上来|shàng lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please hand the form in within a week.

meanings: so as to make it easy to
vocab.note: Written, often after a request: …，{便于|biàn yú}{联系|lián xì} (so that we can contact you easily).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{电话|diàn huà}{号码|hào mǎ}，{便于|biàn yú}{联系|lián xì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your phone number, so that we can contact you easily.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{十二|shí èr}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are twelve people in our department.

vocab.note: {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{哪个|nǎ ge}{单位|dān wèi}{工作|gōng zuò}？ (Where do you work?) Also a unit of measurement.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{单位|dān wèi}{离|lí}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: My workplace is very close to my home.

vocab.note: After a role: {工作|gōng zuò}{人员|rén yuán} (staff), {管理|guǎn lǐ}{人员|rén yuán} (managers).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{工作|gōng zuò}{人员|rén yuán}{先|xiān}{进去|jìn qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Staff please go in first.

vocab.note: The second syllable is light: rèn wu.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{的|de}{任务|rèn wu}{是|shì}{熟悉|shú xī}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: This week's task is to get to know the work.

vocab.example: {郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{安排|ān pái}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Ms Zheng has given us a lot of work.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{部门|bù mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: She manages a department of a dozen or so people.

meanings: to look after (be in charge of)
vocab.note: Everyday: {谁|shéi}{管|guǎn}{这个|zhè ge}？ (Who's in charge of this?)
vocab.example: {办公室|bàn gōng shì}{的|de}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{由|yóu}{小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}{管|guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Xiao Li looks after the office computers.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{办公|bàn gōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our offices are on the third floor.

vocab.note: {办理|bàn lǐ}{手续|shǒu xù}: to go through the formalities.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{同事|tóng shì}{第|dì}{一|yī}{天|tiān}{要|yào}{去|qù}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{办理|bàn lǐ}{手续|shǒu xù}。
vocab.exampleEn: New colleagues have to go through the formalities at the office on their first day.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{出去|chū qù}{办|bàn}{点儿|diǎnr}{事|shì}，{一会儿|yí huìr}{回来|huí lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm going out to do something; I'll be back in a little while.

vocab.example: {新闻|xīn wén}{多|duō}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{加班|jiā bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: When there's a lot of news, we have to work overtime.

meanings: to go on a business trip
vocab.note: 差 is chāi here, not {差|chà} as in {差点儿|chà diǎnr}.
vocab.example: {大卫|Dà wèi}{下|xià}{星期|xīng qī}{要|yào}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{出差|chū chāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: David's going to Shanghai on business next week.

vocab.note: {跟|gēn}…{联系|lián xì}. Traditional {+{联系|lián xì}+}.
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{请|qǐng}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{联系|lián xì}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you have any questions, please contact me.

vocab.note: Formal, with a two-syllable verb: {进行|jìn xíng}{讨论|tǎo lùn}, {进行|jìn xíng}{调查|diào chá}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{进行|jìn xíng}{面试|miàn shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company is holding interviews tomorrow morning.

vocab.note: Formal; in speech {用|yòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{台|tái}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{暂时|zàn shí}{由|yóu}{你|nǐ}{使用|shǐ yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can use this computer for now.

vocab.note: At the start of a clause: "at the same time, also": {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}，{同时|tóng shí}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}。
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{同时|tóng shí}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{他|tā}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
vocab.exampleEn: We started at the same time, and he finished before me.

vocab.example: {开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{定|dìng}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Has the time of the meeting been fixed?

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{查看|chá kàn}{一下|yí xià}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{邮件|yóu jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please take a look at your email.

meanings: to put forward (an idea, a question)
vocab.note: Often split: {提|tí}{出来|chū lái}.
vocab.example: {开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{她|tā}{提出|tí chū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{的|de}{办法|bàn fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the meeting she put forward a new way of doing it.

vocab.example: {郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{指出|zhǐ chū}{了|le}{文章|wén zhāng}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{错误|cuò wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Ms Zheng pointed out two mistakes in the article.

vocab.note: A conjunction with {但是|dàn shì}, {可是|kě shì}, {还是|hái shi} or {却|què} in the second clause; as an adverb before a verb, "feel free to": {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{问|wèn}。 Traditional {+{尽管|jǐn guǎn}+}.
vocab.example: {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}，{但是|dàn shì}{她|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{累|lèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Although the work is hard, she never says she's tired.

vocab.note: Formal, at the start of a clause; in speech {但是|dàn shì} or {不过|bú guò}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。{然而|rán ér}，{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{人|rén}{太|tài}{少|shǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a good plan. However, there are too few of us.

vocab.note: Softer than {但是|dàn shì}; also "only": {他|tā}{不过|bú guò}{是|shì}{个|gè}{孩子|hái zi}。
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{不错|bú cuò}，{不过|bú guò}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{麻烦|má fan}。
vocab.exampleEn: This method isn't bad, but it's a bit of a hassle.

vocab.note: An adverb: after the subject, before the verb: {他|tā}{却|què}{反对|fǎn duì}. Never before a subject.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{却|què}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{休息|xiū xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very tired, yet he doesn't want to rest.

vocab.note: Before {不|bù} or {没|méi}, it corrects an expectation: {他|tā}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}。 In writing, also "and": {填写|tián xiě}{表格|biǎo gé}，{并|bìng}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。 Traditional {+{并|bìng}+}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{生气|shēng qì}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{担心|dān xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm not angry at all, don't worry.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{支持|zhī chí}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{建议|jiàn yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I support your suggestion.

vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}，{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{他|tā}{反对|fǎn duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone agreed; only he was against it.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{建议|jiàn yì}{我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{讨论|tǎo lùn}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: I suggest we discuss it first.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{意见|yì jiàn}: to have objections to, complaints about.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{意见|yì jiàn}？
vocab.exampleEn: What do you think of this plan?

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{讨论|tǎo lùn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{还|hái}{没有|méi yǒu}{决定|jué dìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We discussed it for an hour and still haven't decided.

vocab.note: To decide together, often in pairs or families: {跟|gēn}…{商量|shāng liang}. The second syllable is light.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{跟|gēn}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}{商量|shāng liang}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: I need to talk this over with my family.

vocab.example: {同事|tóng shì}{们|men}{应该|yīng gāi}{多|duō}{交流|jiāo liú}。
vocab.exampleEn: Colleagues should talk to each other more.

vocab.note: {谈谈|tán tan} or {谈一谈|tán yi tán}: to have a talk.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{谈谈|tán tan}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's talk about next month's work.

vocab.note: {提|tí}{意见|yì jiàn}, {提|tí}{问题|wèn tí}; also "to carry in the hand": {提|tí}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{包|bāo}.
vocab.example: {开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他|tā}{提|tí}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the meeting he raised a question.

vocab.note: Read dā ying: first tone, then light. {答应|dā ying} + a request or a person: {他|tā}{答应|dā ying}{我|wǒ}{了|le}。
vocab.example: {他|tā}{答应|dā ying}{明天|míng tiān}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{搬家|bān jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's promised to help me move tomorrow.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{拒绝|jù jué}{了|le}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: She turned down the job at that company.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{接受|jiē shòu}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{建议|jiàn yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I accept your suggestion.

vocab.note: {我|wǒ}{理解|lǐ jiě}{你|nǐ} (I understand how you feel). {了解|liǎo jiě} (HSK 3) is knowing about something well.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{理解|lǐ jiě}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{意思|yì si}，{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{同意|tóng yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I understand what you mean, but I don't agree.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{听|tīng}{我|wǒ}{解释|jiě shì}，{事情|shì qing}{不|bú}{是|shì}{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{的|de}{那样|nà yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let me explain: it isn't what you think.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {一|yí}{个|gè}{误会|wù huì}. {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{误会|wù huì} softens what you've just said.
vocab.example: {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{误会|wù huì}{你|nǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sorry, I misunderstood you.

vocab.example: {同事|tóng shì}{们|men}{应该|yīng gāi}{互相|hù xiāng}{帮助|bāng zhù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Colleagues should help each other.

vocab.note: More written than {互相|hù xiāng}; can also go before a noun: {相互|xiāng hù}{的|de}{理解|lǐ jiě} (mutual understanding).
vocab.example: {同事|tóng shì}{们|men}{需要|xū yào}{相互|xiāng hù}{理解|lǐ jiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: Colleagues need to understand each other.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{共同|gòng tóng}{的|de}{目标|mù biāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have a common goal.

vocab.example: {讨论|tǎo lùn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{要|yào}{多|duō}{听听|tīng ting}{对方|duì fāng}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: In a discussion, listen carefully to what the other side thinks.

vocab.note: {另|lìng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}, {另|lìng}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}. {另外|lìng wài} (lesson 04) also starts a clause.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{不行|bù xíng}，{我们|wǒ men}{试试|shì shi}{另|lìng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: This method doesn't work: let's try another.

vocab.note: Gives a second reason: …，{再说|zài shuō}…. Also "let's leave it till later": {以后|yǐ hòu}{再说|zài shuō}{吧|ba}。
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{太|tài}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{再说|zài shuō}{外面|wài miàn}{还|hái}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too late today, and besides, it's still raining outside.

vocab.note: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}"{老师|lǎo shī}"{是|shì}{指|zhǐ}{郑华|Zhèng Huá} (by "teacher" he means Zheng Hua).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{指|zhǐ}{了|le}{指|zhǐ}{窗|chuāng}{外|wài}，{说|shuō}："{你|nǐ}{看|kàn}，{下|xià}{雪|xuě}{了|le}。"
vocab.exampleEn: He pointed out of the window and said: "Look, it's snowing."

vocab.note: No object: {向|xiàng} / {跟|gēn} + person + {道歉|dào qiàn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{向|xiàng}{你|nǐ}{道歉|dào qiàn}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{就|jiù}{原谅|yuán liàng}{他|tā}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's already apologised to you, so forgive him.

vocab.note: An adjective: {很|hěn}{抱歉|bào qiàn}. More formal than {对不起|duì bu qǐ}.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{抱歉|bào qiàn}，{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm sorry I'm late.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{原谅|yuán liàng}{我|wǒ}，{我|wǒ}{真|zhēn}{的|de}{忘|wàng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please forgive me: I really did forget.

vocab.example: {感谢|gǎn xiè}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{支持|zhī chí}！
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you all for your support!

vocab.note: {打扰|dǎ rǎo}{一下|yí xià} (sorry to bother you); leaving, {打扰|dǎ rǎo}{了|le} (sorry to have taken up your time).
vocab.example: {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{打扰|dǎ rǎo}{一下|yí xià}，{请问|qǐng wèn}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{在|zài}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Sorry to bother you: is Ms Zheng here?

vocab.note: Asking a favour: {麻烦|má fan}{你|nǐ}…. The second syllable is light.
vocab.example: {麻烦|má fan}{你|nǐ}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{一下|yí xià}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Could I trouble you to look over this article for me?

vocab.note: Splits: {打|dǎ}{了|le}{个|gè}{招呼|zhāo hu}. Also "to tell someone beforehand".
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{都|dōu}{跟|gēn}{大家|dà jiā}{打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He says hello to everyone every morning.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{点|diǎn}{头|tóu}，{表示|biǎo shì}{同意|tóng yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She nodded in agreement.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{向|xiàng}{大家|dà jiā}{表示|biǎo shì}{感谢|gǎn xiè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to express my thanks to everyone.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}，{被|bèi}{经理|jīng lǐ}{批评|pī píng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He was late and got told off by the manager.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{不满|bù mǎn}, {表示|biǎo shì}{不满|bù mǎn} (to express dissatisfaction).
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{规定|guī dìng}{很|hěn}{不满|bù mǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many people are unhappy with this rule.

vocab.note: The opposite of {必须|bì xū}; a little more formal than {不用|bú yòng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{不必|bú bì}{道歉|dào qiàn}，{这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{错|cuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: You needn't apologise: it's not your fault.

vocab.note: As an adverb, "really, truly": {实在|shí zài}{抱歉|bào qiàn}. As an adjective, "honest": {他|tā}{这|zhè}{个|ge}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{实在|shí zài}。
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{实在|shí zài}{太|tài}{累|lèi}{了|le}，{想|xiǎng}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{睡|shuì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm really too tired; I'd like to go to bed early.

vocab.note: After the number + measure word or a time: {三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{左右|zuǒ yòu}, {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{左右|zuǒ yòu}. Also "left and right".
vocab.example: {一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{生活费|shēng huó fèi}{三千|sān qiān}{块|kuài}{左右|zuǒ yòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: A month's living costs are three thousand yuan or so.

vocab.note: Only after a time: {春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}. For amounts, {左右|zuǒ yòu}.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}，{火车|huǒ chē}{票|piào}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{买|mǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Around the Spring Festival, train tickets are hard to get.

vocab.example: {从|cóng}{这儿|zhèr}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{大约|dà yuē}{要|yào}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: It takes about forty minutes from here to the office.

vocab.note: A {是|shì} B {的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} (A is twice B); {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (doubled).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{工资|gōng zī}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: His pay is twice mine.

vocab.note: Written, often before numbers: {仅|jǐn}{五十|wǔ shí}{元|yuán}. In speech, {={只|zhǐ}=}.
vocab.example: {能|néng}{拿|ná}{到|dào}{奖学金|jiǎng xué jīn}{的|de}{人|rén}{仅|jǐn}{占|zhàn}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{十|shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: Only ten per cent of people get a scholarship.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{仅仅|jǐn jǐn}{用|yòng}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{做|zuò}{完|wán}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We finished it in only three days.

vocab.note: Before a noun, "the whole": {全家|quán jiā}, {全班|quán bān}; before a verb, "all, completely": {我|wǒ}{全|quán}{忘|wàng}{了|le}。
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{全|quán}{家|jiā}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This weekend our whole family is going hiking.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{的|de}{钱|qián}{我|wǒ}{全部|quán bù}{花|huā}{完|wán}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've spent all this month's money.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{全都|quán dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{他|tā}{的|de}{建议|jiàn yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We all agree with his suggestion.

vocab.note: Before a noun, usually with {的|de} and {都|dōu}: {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.example: {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: All the students came.

vocab.note: One whole thing: {整个|zhěng gè}{下午|xià wǔ}, {整个|zhěng gè}{城市|chéng shì}. Members of a group take {所有|suǒ yǒu}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{整个|zhěng gè}{下午|xià wǔ}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{算|suàn}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: He spent the whole afternoon working out money.

vocab.note: {整天|zhěng tiān} (all day), {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{整|zhěng} (eight o'clock sharp). The verb "to put in order" is {整理|zhěng lǐ} (lesson 10).
vocab.example: {会议|huì yì}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{整|zhěng}{开始|kāi shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The meeting starts at eight o'clock sharp.

vocab.example: {许多|xǔ duō}{同学|tóng xué}{到|dào}{了|le}{月底|yuè dǐ}，{钱|qián}{就|jiù}{花|huā}{完|wán}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many students have spent all their money by the end of the month.

vocab.note: {收入|shōu rù}{很|hěn}{高|gāo} (a high income). As a verb (to take in, earn) it is mostly written.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{收入|shōu rù}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{高|gāo}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: His income is quite a bit higher than last year.

vocab.example: {暑假|shǔ jià}{打工|dǎ gōng}，{她|tā}{赚|zhuàn}{了|le}{五千|wǔ qiān}{块|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: She earned five thousand yuan from her summer job.

vocab.note: {存|cún}{钱|qián} (to put money in, save), the opposite of {取|qǔ}{钱|qián}. Also "to store": {把|bǎ}{东西|dōng xi}{存|cún}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{存|cún}{一千|yì qiān}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I save a thousand yuan every month.

vocab.note: {取|qǔ}{钱|qián} (to take money out), {取|qǔ}{快递|kuài dì} (to collect a parcel).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{银行|yín háng}{取|qǔ}{点儿|diǎnr}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm going to the bank to take out some money.

vocab.note: After the thing paid for: {电|diàn}{费|fèi}, {水|shuǐ}{费|fèi}, {学费|xué fèi}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{的|de}{电|diàn}{费|fèi}{比|bǐ}{上|shàng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This month's electricity bill is higher than last month's.

vocab.example: {去|qù}{英国|Yīng guó}{读书|dú shū}{的|de}{费用|fèi yòng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The costs of studying in Britain are high.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{所|suǒ}{大学|dà xué}{的|de}{学费|xué fèi}{很|hěn}{贵|guì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The tuition fees at this university are high.

vocab.example: {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{零钱|líng qián}，{能|néng}{扫码|sǎo mǎ}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Sorry, I haven't got any change. Can I pay by scanning the code?

vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{有|yǒu}{五十|wǔ shí}{块|kuài}{零花钱|líng huā qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child gets fifty yuan pocket money a week.

vocab.note: {值|zhí}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}？ (what's it worth?); {很|hěn}{值|zhí} (good value). {值得|zhí de} (lesson 18) is "worth doing".
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{手机|shǒu jī}{用|yòng}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{还|hái}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{用|yòng}，{真|zhēn}{值|zhí}。
vocab.exampleEn: This phone still works well after five years: it was really worth it.

vocab.example: {银行卡|yín háng kǎ}{的|de}{密码|mì mǎ}{别|bié}{告诉|gào su}{别人|bié ren}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't tell anyone your bank card PIN.

vocab.note: Takes an object: {降低|jiàng dī}{价格|jià gé}. Something that falls by itself {下降|xià jiàng}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{想|xiǎng}{降低|jiàng dī}{费用|fèi yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company wants to reduce costs.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{手机|shǒu jī}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{下降|xià jiàng}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Phone prices have fallen quite a lot over the last few months.

vocab.note: {不|bú} + {够|gòu} (enough, lesson 08): {钱|qián}{不够|bú gòu}{用|yòng} (the money doesn't go far enough).
vocab.example: {要是|yào shi}{钱|qián}{不够|bú gòu}，{我|wǒ}{可以|kě yǐ}{借|jiè}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you haven't got enough money, I can lend you a bit.

vocab.note: {还|hái}{剩|shèng}{多少|duō shao}？ {剩下|shèng xià}{的|de}{钱|qián} (the money that's left).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{只|zhǐ}{剩|shèng}{两百|liǎng bǎi}{块|kuài}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've only got two hundred yuan left this month.

vocab.note: On purpose: {给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{留|liú}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}; also "to stay": {他|tā}{留|liú}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{工作|gōng zuò}{了|le}。
vocab.example: {蛋糕|dàn gāo}{别|bié}{吃|chī}{完|wán}，{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{留|liú}{一|yí}{块|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't eat all the cake: save a piece for Mum.

vocab.note: Read shù: {人数|rén shù} (the number of people). The verb "to count" is read shǔ (a later word).
vocab.example: {参加|cān jiā}{活动|huó dòng}{的|de}{人数|rén shù}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: More people are taking part than last year.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{数字|shù zì}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{算|suàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This figure is too big: I can't work it out.

vocab.example: {东西|dōng xi}{的|de}{数量|shù liàng}{不|bù}{多|duō}，{可是|kě shì}{质量|zhì liàng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: There aren't many of them, but the quality is good.

vocab.note: {算|suàn}{一|yi}{算|suàn} (work it out); also "to count as": {这|zhè}{不|bú}{算|suàn}{贵|guì} (that's not expensive, as prices go).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{算|suàn}{一下|yí xià}，{我们|wǒ men}{一共|yí gòng}{花|huā}{了|le}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Work out how much we spent altogether.

vocab.note: {十|shí}{减|jiǎn}{三|sān}{等于|děng yú}{七|qī} (ten minus three is seven).
vocab.example: {要是|yào shi}{申请|shēn qǐng}{到|dào}{了|le}{奖学金|jiǎng xué jīn}，{学费|xué fèi}{能|néng}{减|jiǎn}{三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: If I get the scholarship, the fees come down by a third.

vocab.note: Written, on bills and notices: {共|gòng}{三十|sān shí}{元|yuán}. In speech, {一共|yí gòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}{共|gòng}{有|yǒu}{两百|liǎng bǎi}{人|rén}{参加|cān jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Two hundred people took part in this event in all.

vocab.note: {千克|qiān kè} (a kilogram, lesson 08) is 1,000 {克|kè}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{包|bāo}{茶叶|chá yè}{一百|yì bǎi}{克|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This packet of tea weighs a hundred grams.

vocab.example: {目前|mù qián}{还|hái}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{报名|bào míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: No one has signed up so far.

vocab.example: {到|dào}{年底|nián dǐ}，{我|wǒ}{能|néng}{存|cún}{三万|sān wàn}{来|lái}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: By the end of the year I can save thirty thousand yuan or so.

vocab.note: {七月份|qī yuè fèn} (July), {哪个|nǎ ge}{月份|yuè fèn}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{年|nián}{七|qī}{月份|yuè fèn}{是|shì}{最|zuì}{热|rè}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}。
vocab.exampleEn: July is the hottest time of the year.

vocab.note: {三|sān}{天|tiān}{以内|yǐ nèi}, {一百|yì bǎi}{块|kuài}{以内|yǐ nèi}. Written {内|nèi} (lesson 13).
vocab.example: {礼物|lǐ wù}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{最好|zuì hǎo}{在|zài}{一百|yì bǎi}{块|kuài}{以内|yǐ nèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The present should cost no more than a hundred yuan.

vocab.note: Fourth tone: {你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{有|yǒu}{空|kòng}{吗|ma}？, {有|yǒu}{空儿|kòngr}. The {空|kōng} of lesson 10 is "empty".
vocab.example: {在|zài}{那边|nà biān}{有|yǒu}{空|kòng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{可以|kě yǐ}{打工|dǎ gōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can do some part-time work over there when I'm free.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路上|lù shang}{车速|chē sù}{不|bù}{能|néng}{太|tài}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can't drive too fast on this road.

vocab.example: {停车场|tíng chē chǎng}{里|lǐ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{没有|méi yǒu}{车位|chē wèi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are no parking spaces left in the car park.

vocab.example: {各位|gè wèi}{乘客|chéng kè}，{前方|qián fāng}{到站|dào zhàn}{是|shì}{北京|Běi jīng}{站|zhàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Dear passengers, the next station is Beijing Station.

vocab.note: Also "to export" (the opposite of {进|jìn}{口|kǒu}). {入口|rù kǒu} is the entrance.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{从|cóng}B{出口|chū kǒu}{出站|chū zhàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please leave the station by exit B.

vocab.note: With a number: more than ({超过|chāo guò}{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}); with a car: to overtake.
vocab.example: {高速|gāo sù}{公路|gōng lù}{上|shàng}{车速|chē sù}{不|bù}{能|néng}{超过|chāo guò}{每|měi}{小时|xiǎo shí}{一百二十|yì bǎi èr shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the expressway you mustn't go over 120 km an hour.

vocab.note: Notices write {乘坐|chéng zuò}; in speech say {坐|zuò}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{乘坐|chéng zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{前往|qián wǎng}{机场|jī chǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please take the metro to the airport.

vocab.note: Going out and about, usually locally; common in notices: {出行|chū xíng}{方便|fāng biàn}.
vocab.example: {假期|jià qī}{开车|kāi chē}{出行|chū xíng}{的|de}{人|rén}{特别|tè bié}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the holidays a lot of people get about by car.

vocab.note: Written and short: {乘|chéng}{车|chē}, {乘|chéng}{飞机|fēi jī}. Same sound as {城|chéng} (a city).
vocab.example: {乘|chéng}{车|chē}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì}{安全|ān quán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please take care when riding.

vocab.note: {给|gěi}{您|nín}{带|dài}{来|lái}{不便|bú biàn}，{很|hěn}{抱歉|bào qiàn}: sorry for the inconvenience. Speech says {不|bù}{方便|fāng biàn}.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{停车|tíng chē}{不便|bú biàn}，{最好|zuì hǎo}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: Parking is inconvenient here: better come by metro.

vocab.example: {从|cóng}{机场|jī chǎng}{到|dào}{我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{大巴|dà bā}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can take a coach from the airport to our university.

vocab.note: The written, general word: {道路|dào lù}{两|liǎng}{边|biān} (both sides of the road). {路|lù} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {下|xià}{大雪|dà xuě}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{道路|dào lù}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{能|néng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the heavy snow, many roads were closed.

vocab.note: In China usually an electric bike or scooter; an electric car is {电|diàn}{动|dòng}{汽车|qì chē}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{骑|qí}{电动车|diàn dòng chē}{上班|shàng bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I ride an e-bike to work every day.

vocab.note: The D trains of the railway; {高铁|gāo tiě} are the G trains. In speech the two are often mixed.
vocab.example: {坐|zuò}{动车|dòng chē}{去|qù}{天津|Tiān jīn}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's easy to get to Tianjin by bullet train.

vocab.note: {高速|gāo sù}{公路|gōng lù} is an expressway (a motorway).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{公路|gōng lù}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}，{一直|yì zhí}{到|dào}{山|shān}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This road is long: it goes all the way into the mountains.

meanings: to be in a traffic jam
vocab.note: {路上|lù shang}{堵车|dǔ chē}{了|le}: there's a jam on the way. {堵|dǔ} is "to block".
vocab.example: {下班|xià bān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{常常|cháng cháng}{堵车|dǔ chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are often jams at rush hour.

vocab.note: Before a time clause: {当|dāng}…{的|de}{时候|shí hou} / {当|dāng}…{时|shí}. As a verb, "to serve as": {当|dāng}{老师|lǎo shī}.
vocab.example: {当|dāng}{我|wǒ}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{车|chē}{已经|yǐ jīng}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I got to the stop, the bus had gone.

vocab.note: Also short for {高速|gāo sù}{公路|gōng lù}, the expressway: {走|zǒu}{高速|gāo sù}, {上|shàng}{高速|gāo sù}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{走|zǒu}{高速|gāo sù}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We took the expressway and got there in an hour.

vocab.note: {公共|gōng gòng}{交通|jiāo tōng} (public transport), {公共|gōng gòng}{厕所|cè suǒ} (public toilet).
vocab.example: {请问|qǐng wèn}，{公共|gōng gòng}{厕所|cè suǒ}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}？
vocab.exampleEn: Excuse me, where's the public toilet?

vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{离|lí}{这儿|zhèr}{五|wǔ}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school is five kilometres from here.

vocab.note: {加油|jiā yóu} is to fill up with fuel (and "come on!").
vocab.example: {前面|qián miàn}{有|yǒu}{个|gè}{加油站|jiā yóu zhàn}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{加|jiā}{点|diǎn}{儿|ér}{油|yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a petrol station ahead: let's get some fuel.

vocab.note: Short for {交通|jiāo tōng}{警察|jǐng chá}.
vocab.example: {十字路口|shí zì lù kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{交警|jiāo jǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a traffic police officer at the crossroads.

vocab.note: {交通|jiāo tōng}{方便|fāng biàn} (good transport links), {交通|jiāo tōng}{工|gōng}{具|jù} (means of transport).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{交通|jiāo tōng}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Getting around this city is easy.

vocab.note: Also a neighbourhood (the local district office is a {街道|jiē dào}).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{街道|jiē dào}{很|hěn}{干净|gān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This street is very clean.

vocab.example: {去|qù}{机场|jī chǎng}{要|yào}{在|zài}{这|zhè}{一|yí}{站|zhàn}{换乘|huàn chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: For the airport you change at this station.

vocab.example: {快|kuài}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{加快|jiā kuài}{速度|sù dù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're nearly late: let's speed up.

vocab.note: Noun "distance" and, in writing, a verb like {离|lí}: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{距离|jù lí}{公司|gōng sī}{五|wǔ}{公里|gōng lǐ}.
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{距离|jù lí}{是|shì}{一百|yì bǎi}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The distance between the two cities is 100 km.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{上班|shàng bān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{路过|lù guò}{一|yí}{个|gè}{公园|gōng yuán}。
