vocab.exampleEn: The first part of this book is rather hard.

meanings: to give rise to (interest, an effect)
vocab.note: For something that comes into being: {产生|chǎn shēng}{兴趣|xìng qù}, {产生|chǎn shēng}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}, {产生|chǎn shēng}{问题|wèn tí}. A reaction set off in someone is {引起|yǐn qǐ}.
vocab.example: {看|kàn}{了|le}{那个|nà ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{产生|chǎn shēng}{了|le}{兴趣|xìng qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: After seeing that film, I became interested in Chinese history.

vocab.note: Before a verb of change: {不断|bú duàn}{提高|tí gāo}, {不断|bú duàn}{增加|zēng jiā}, {不断|bú duàn}{学习|xué xí}.
vocab.example: {科技|kē jì}{在|zài}{不断|bú duàn}{地|de}{发展|fā zhǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Science and technology keep developing.

vocab.note: {在|zài}…{的|de}{过程|guò chéng}{中|zhōng}: in the course of, while.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{学习|xué xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{过程|guò chéng}{中|zhōng}，{我|wǒ}{认识|rèn shi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{中国|Zhōng guó}{朋友|péng you}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the course of learning Chinese, I've made lots of Chinese friends.

vocab.note: {为|wéi} is wéi here. In speech, {分成|fēn chéng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{分为|fēn wéi}{听力|tīng lì}、{阅读|yuè dú}{和|hé}{写作|xiě zuò}{三|sān}{部分|bù fen}。
vocab.exampleEn: This exam is divided into three parts, listening, reading and writing.

meanings: thick (a trunk, a rope, a line)
vocab.note: For long round things; the opposite is {细|xì}. A thick book or coat is {厚|hòu}. {粗心|cū xīn} (careless, lesson 22) uses the "rough" sense.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{棵|kē}{树|shù}{很|hěn}{粗|cū}，{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{才|cái}{能|néng}{抱|bào}{住|zhù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This tree is so thick that it takes two people to get their arms round it.

vocab.note: Mostly before a noun ({大量|dà liàng}{的|de}{水|shuǐ}, {大量|dà liàng}{研究|yán jiū}) or a verb ({大量|dà liàng}{砍树|kǎn shù}).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{植物|zhí wù}{要|yào}{大量|dà liàng}{的|de}{阳光|yáng guāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This plant needs a great deal of sunshine.

vocab.note: Set phrase: {多种多样|duō zhǒng duō yàng} (of every kind).
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{植物|zhí wù}{非常|fēi cháng}{多样|duō yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The plants here are extremely varied.

vocab.note: Before a verb or a verb of change: {大大|dà dà}{提高|tí gāo}, {大大|dà dà}{改变|gǎi biàn}.
vocab.example: {手机|shǒu jī}{大大|dà dà}{改变|gǎi biàn}{了|le}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mobile phones have greatly changed our lives.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{幅|fú}{画|huà}, {一|yì}{幅|fú}{地图|dì tú}. In speech {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{画|huà} is also heard; {幅|fú} is the standard word for a painting.
vocab.example: {客厅|kè tīng}{里|lǐ}{挂|guà}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{幅|fú}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{画|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: A very large painting hangs in the living room.

vocab.note: Both the technology of a field and a person's skill: {他|tā}{开车|kāi chē}{的|de}{技术|jì shù}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{技术|jì shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This company has very good technology.

vocab.note: Science and technology together, the word of the news: {科技|kē jì}{发展|fā zhǎn}, {高科技|gāo kē jì} (high tech).
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{的|de}{科技|kē jì}{发展|fā zhǎn}{得|de}{真|zhēn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Science and technology are developing really fast these days.

vocab.note: {科学家|kē xué jiā}: scientist. Also an adjective: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{很|hěn}{科学|kē xué} (this is a very scientific method).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{科学|kē xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've loved science since I was little.

vocab.note: {老|lǎo} here isn't "old": it's part of the animal's name, as in {老鼠|lǎo shǔ} (mouse, HSK 6).
vocab.example: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{老虎|lǎo hǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are two tigers at the zoo.

vocab.note: {活|huó}{着|zhe} (alive); {活|huó}{了|le}{三百|sān bǎi}{年|nián} (lived three hundred years); {活|huó}{的|de}{鱼|yú} (a live fish). The {活|huó} of {生活|shēng huó} and {活动|huó dòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{只|zhī}{猫|māo}{活|huó}{了|le}{二十|èr shí}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This cat lived to be twenty.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{棵|kē}{苹果|píng guǒ}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's an apple tree outside our door.

vocab.note: Thin flat pieces ({一|yí}{片|piàn}{叶子|yè zi}, {一|yí}{片|piàn}{面包|miàn bāo}) and wide stretches ({一|yí}{片|piàn}{草地|cǎo dì}, {一|yí}{片|piàn}{蓝天|lán tiān}). Also in {照片|zhào piàn} and {图片|tú piàn}.
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{我|wǒ}{吃|chī}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{片|piàn}{面包|miàn bāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I had two slices of bread this morning.

vocab.note: Written and in the news: {全球|quán qiú}{气候|qì hòu}, {全球|quán qiú}{有|yǒu}…
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{全球|quán qiú}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{关心|guān xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The whole world cares about this problem.

vocab.note: Life as what living things have. Daily life, the way you live, is {生活|shēng huó}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{生命|shēng mìng}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every life matters.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{鸟|niǎo}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{少见|shǎo jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This kind of bird is rarely seen in the city.

vocab.note: Not to be confused with {士|shì} ({护士|hù shi}, {博士|bó shì}), whose long horizontal is on top.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{土|tǔ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{种|zhòng}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The soil here is good: whatever you plant grows well.

vocab.note: The {熊|xióng} of {熊|xióng}{猫|māo} (panda).
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{有的|yǒu de}{熊|xióng}{会|huì}{睡|shuì}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: In winter, some bears sleep for a very long time.

vocab.note: After an adjective it's a degree complement, "to death": {累|lèi}{死|sǐ}{了|le}, {疼|téng}{死|sǐ}{了|le} (lesson 06).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{浇水|jiāo shuǐ}，{花|huā}{都|dōu}{死|sǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I forgot to water them, and the flowers have all died.

vocab.note: A verb and a noun: {研究|yán jiū}{老虎|lǎo hǔ}, {他|tā}{的|de}{研究|yán jiū}. {研究生|yán jiū shēng} (lesson 05) is a research student.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{里|lǐ}{研究|yán jiū}{植物|zhí wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: She researches plants at the university.

vocab.note: The opposite of {粗|cū}. Also "careful, detailed": {仔细|zǐ xì} (lesson 02), {细心|xì xīn} (lesson 22).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{根|gēn}{线|xiàn}{太|tài}{细|xì}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This thread is too fine; I can't see it clearly.

vocab.note: {树叶|shù yè}: the leaves of a tree. Measure word {片|piàn}.
vocab.example: {秋天|qiū tiān}，{树|shù}{上|shàng}{的|de}{叶子|yè zi}{变|biàn}{黄|huáng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: In autumn the leaves on the trees turn yellow.

vocab.note: Plants as living things ({动物|dòng wù} and {植物|zhí wù}). A plant you grow at home is often {花|huā}.
vocab.example: {植物|zhí wù}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{阳光|yáng guāng}{和|hé}{水|shuǐ}{才|cái}{能|néng}{活|huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: Plants need sunshine and water to live.

vocab.note: As an adjective, "natural, unforced": {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{自然|zì rán}。 The natural world as a place to be is {大自然|dà zì rán} (lesson 26).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{自然|zì rán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her Chinese sounds very natural.

vocab.note: {起|qǐ}{作用|zuò yòng} / {有|yǒu}{作用|zuò yòng} (to have an effect); {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{作用|zuò yòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{药|yào}{对|duì}{感冒|gǎn mào}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{作用|zuò yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This medicine works well for colds.

meanings: to cause, set off (a reaction, a problem)
vocab.note: {引起|yǐn qǐ}{注意|zhù yì} (attract attention), {引起|yǐn qǐ}{问题|wèn tí} (cause problems). Compare {产生|chǎn shēng} (interest, an effect, something new).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{话|huà}{引起|yǐn qǐ}{了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{注意|zhù yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: What he said caught everyone's attention.

vocab.note: {是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}…{的|de}: what something is for: {这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}{切|qiē}{菜|cài}{的|de}。 {用|yòng} X {来|lái} + verb: use X to….
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}{开会|kāi huì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This room is for meetings.

vocab.note: Written, before a noun or verb phrase: {用于|yòng yú}{研究|yán jiū}, {用于|yòng yú}{保护|bǎo hù}{动物|dòng wù}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{技术|jì shù}{已经|yǐ jīng}{用于|yòng yú}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{方面|fāng miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This technology is already used in many areas.

meanings: to have (written; a quality, a history)
vocab.note: Written, before an abstract object: {有着|yǒu zhe}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}. No {了|le} or {过|guo}, no negative (say {没有|méi yǒu}), not for ordinary things you own.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{城市|chéng shì}{有着|yǒu zhe}{两千|liǎng qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This city has a history of over two thousand years.

vocab.note: Fourth tone, zhòng: {种|zhòng}{树|shù}, {种|zhòng}{菜|cài}. HSK 3's {种|zhǒng} zhǒng is "kind, sort" ({这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{树|shù}): same character.
vocab.example: {爷爷|yé ye}{在|zài}{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}{种|zhòng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{菜|cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa has planted lots of vegetables in the yard.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{应该|yīng gāi}{保护|bǎo hù}{动物|dòng wù}{和|hé}{它们|tā men}{生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{环境|huán jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should protect animals and the places they live.

vocab.note: {塑料袋|sù liào dài} (a plastic bag), {环保袋|huán bǎo dài} (a reusable bag). Measure word {个|gè} or {只|zhī}.
vocab.example: {买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{总是|zǒng shì}{自己|zì jǐ}{带|dài}{袋子|dài zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I always bring my own bag when I go shopping.

vocab.note: {饭盒|fàn hé} (a lunch box); a large box for moving or posting is often {箱子|xiāng zi} (HSK 3).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{盒子|hé zi}{里|lǐ}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's in this box?

vocab.note: Short for {环境保护|huán jìng bǎo hù}. Also an adjective: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{很|hěn}{环保|huán bǎo} (this is a green way of doing it).
vocab.example: {骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{上班|shàng bān}{又|yòu}{健康|jiàn kāng}{又|yòu}{环保|huán bǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Cycling to work is both healthy and green.

vocab.note: The air you breathe: {空气|kōng qì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}, {空气|kōng qì}{污染|wū rǎn} (air pollution).
vocab.example: {下|xià}{过|guo}{雨|yǔ}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{空气|kōng qì}{特别|tè bié}{新鲜|xīn xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the rain, the air is especially fresh.

vocab.note: {扔|rēng}{垃圾|lā jī} (to throw rubbish away), {垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng} (a bin), {垃圾|lā jī}{分类|fēn lèi} (sorting rubbish). In Taiwan it's read lè sè.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{垃圾|lā jī}{扔|rēng}{进|jìn}{垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please put your rubbish in the bin.

vocab.note: Both "to reduce something" ({减少|jiǎn shǎo}{垃圾|lā jī}) and "to decrease" ({人数|rén shù}{减少|jiǎn shǎo}{了|le}). The opposite is {增加|zēng jiā}.
vocab.example: {为了|wèi le}{减少|jiǎn shǎo}{垃圾|lā jī}，{我们|wǒ men}{少|shǎo}{用|yòng}{塑料袋|sù liào dài}。
vocab.exampleEn: To cut down on rubbish, we use fewer plastic bags.

meanings: to save, use sparingly (water, time, money)
vocab.note: {节约|jié yuē}{用|yòng}{水|shuǐ} (save water), {节约|jié yuē}{时间|shí jiān}. The opposite is {浪费|làng fèi}.
vocab.example: {为了|wèi le}{节约|jié yuē}{用电|yòng diàn}，{离开|lí kāi}{房间|fáng jiān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{关灯|guān dēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: To save electricity, please turn off the light when you leave the room.

vocab.note: The word of signs and rules: {禁止|jìn zhǐ}{吸烟|xī yān} (No smoking), {禁止|jìn zhǐ}{停车|tíng chē} (No parking).
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{禁止|jìn zhǐ}{停车|tíng chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Parking is prohibited here.

vocab.note: The object follows directly: {浪费|làng fèi}{时间|shí jiān}, {浪费|làng fèi}{钱|qián}, {浪费|làng fèi}{水|shuǐ}. Also an adjective: {太|tài}{浪费|làng fèi}{了|le}！
vocab.example: {菜|cài}{点|diǎn}{得|de}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{吃|chī}{不|bu}{完|wán}{就|jiù}{浪费|làng fèi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've ordered too much; if we can't finish it, it'll go to waste.

vocab.note: A large forest; a smaller wood near people is {树林|shù lín}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{片|piàn}{森林|sēn lín}{里|lǐ}{生活|shēng huó}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{动物|dòng wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many animals live in this forest.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{后面|hòu miàn}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{片|piàn}{小|xiǎo}{树林|shù lín}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a little wood behind our house.

vocab.note: {起到|qǐ dào}…{作用|zuò yòng}: to play a… role, have a… effect: {起到|qǐ dào}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{作用|zuò yòng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{起到|qǐ dào}{了|le}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{作用|zuò yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This method has worked very well.

vocab.note: {扔|rēng}{垃圾|lā jī} (to throw rubbish away), {别|bié}{乱扔|luàn rēng} (don't litter). First tone; {仍|réng} réng (still, lesson 20) is second.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{旧|jiù}{报纸|bào zhǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{扔|rēng}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can these old newspapers be thrown away?

vocab.note: {塑料袋|sù liào dài} (a plastic bag), {塑料瓶|sù liào píng} (a plastic bottle).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{杯子|bēi zi}{是|shì}{塑料|sù liào}{的|de}，{不|bú}{怕|pà}{掉|diào}{在|zài}{地上|dì shang}。
vocab.exampleEn: This cup is plastic, so it doesn't matter if it falls on the floor.

vocab.note: {垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng} (a rubbish bin), {水桶|shuǐ tǒng} (a bucket). Also a measure word: {一|yì}{桶|tǒng}{水|shuǐ} (a bucket of water).
vocab.example: {门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are two bins at the door.

vocab.note: Smoke ({厨房|chú fáng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{烟|yān}) and a cigarette: {吸烟|xī yān} (written) / {抽烟|chōu yān} (spoken), to smoke.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{以前|yǐ qián}{抽烟|chōu yān}，{现在|xiàn zài}{不|bù}{抽|chōu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dad used to smoke, but he's stopped now.

vocab.note: Written and formal: {停止|tíng zhǐ}{使用|shǐ yòng}, {雨|yǔ}{停止|tíng zhǐ}{了|le}. In speech, {停|tíng} (lesson 16).
vocab.example: {因为|yīn wèi}{下|xià}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}，{比赛|bǐ sài}{停止|tíng zhǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The match was stopped because of heavy rain.

vocab.note: A noun ({空气|kōng qì}{污染|wū rǎn}, air pollution) and a verb ({污染|wū rǎn}{环境|huán jìng}; {水|shuǐ}{被|bèi}{污染|wū rǎn}{了|le}). Traditional {污染|wū rǎn} (Taiwan also writes {={汙染|wū rǎn}=}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{空气|kōng qì}{污染|wū rǎn}{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{少|shǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Air pollution in this city is much lower than it used to be.

vocab.note: {吸|xī}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}{气|qì} (take a breath), {吸烟|xī yān} (to smoke). The {吸|xī} of {吸引|xī yǐn} (lesson 18).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{吸|xī}{了|le}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}{气|qì}，{开始|kāi shǐ}{说话|shuō huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He took a breath and began to speak.

vocab.note: An adjective ({这儿|zhèr}{很|hěn}{危险|wēi xiǎn}) and a noun ({有|yǒu}{危险|wēi xiǎn}, {远离|yuǎn lí}{危险|wēi xiǎn}).
vocab.example: {下雪|xià xuě}{以后|yǐ hòu}{开车|kāi chē}{很|hěn}{危险|wēi xiǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Driving after it has snowed is dangerous.

vocab.note: On signs and in advice: {远离|yuǎn lí}{火|huǒ} (keep away from fire), {远离|yuǎn lí}{危险|wēi xiǎn}.
vocab.example: {小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{要|yào}{远离|yuǎn lí}{火|huǒ}{和|hé}{热|rè}{水|shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Small children should keep away from fire and hot water.

vocab.note: {增加|zēng jiā}{人数|rén shù}, {增加|zēng jiā}{收入|shōu rù}; {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (doubled). The opposite is {减少|jiǎn shǎo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}{的|de}{人|rén}{增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: The number of people coming to China to study has grown a lot in recent years.

meanings: to grow (a total, over time; written)
vocab.note: {长|zhǎng} is zhǎng here. For totals that grow over time: {经济|jīng jì}{增长|zēng zhǎng}, {人口|rén kǒu}{增长|zēng zhǎng} (population growth).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{人口|rén kǒu}{每|měi}{年|nián}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{增长|zēng zhǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The city's population grows every year.

vocab.note: What happened next, because of the first event: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{于是|yú shì}{我们|wǒ men}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}。 Not for advice or plans (use {所以|suǒ yǐ}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{觉得|jué de}{这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{没意思|méi yì si}，{于是|yú shì}{换|huàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}。
vocab.exampleEn: He found the job dull, so he changed it.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{门|mén}{外|wài}{就|jiù}{听|tīng}{到|dào}{了|le}{她|tā}{的|de}{歌声|gē shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I could hear her singing from outside the door.

vocab.note: Someone who sings as a profession or on stage; {手|shǒu} is "a person skilled at", as in {选手|xuǎn shǒu} (a contestant, HSK 5).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{歌手|gē shǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a very famous singer.

vocab.note: People who watch a show, a match or TV. Listeners are {听众|tīng zhòng} (lesson 24).
vocab.example: {演出|yǎn chū}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{观众|guān zhòng}{都|dōu}{站|zhàn}{起来|qǐ lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: When the show ended, the whole audience stood up.

vocab.note: Played with {弹|tán}: {弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}. {钢琴家|gāng qín jiā}: a pianist.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{从|cóng}{五|wǔ}{岁|suì}{开始|kāi shǐ}{学|xué}{钢琴|gāng qín}。
vocab.exampleEn: My younger sister started learning the piano at five.

vocab.note: A play with spoken dialogue, as against opera: {演|yǎn}{话剧|huà jù}, {看|kàn}{话剧|huà jù}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{话剧|huà jù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{演|yǎn}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{月|yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This play ran for three months in Beijing.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{特别|tè bié}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{听|tīng}{京剧|jīng jù}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandpa loves listening to Peking opera.

vocab.example: {剧院|jù yuàn}{离|lí}{这儿|zhèr}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}，{走路|zǒu lù}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: The theatre isn't far from here: it's a ten-minute walk.

vocab.note: Of shows, matches, talks and books, not of people or food: {演出|yǎn chū}{很|hěn}{精彩|jīng cǎi}, {精彩|jīng cǎi}{的|de}{比赛|bǐ sài}.
vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}{的|de}{比赛|bǐ sài}{太|tài}{精彩|jīng cǎi}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Yesterday's match was fantastic!

vocab.note: The general word for many stringed and keyboard instruments: {弹|tán}{琴|qín} (to play the piano, to play a stringed instrument), {钢琴|gāng qín}, {小提琴|xiǎo tí qín} (violin).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{都|dōu}{弹|tán}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{琴|qín}。
vocab.exampleEn: She plays for an hour every evening.

vocab.note: Opens a list of points ({首先|shǒu xiān}…{其次|qí cì}…{最后|zuì hòu}) or steps ({首先|shǒu xiān}…{然后|rán hòu}…).
vocab.example: {首先|shǒu xiān}，{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{感谢|gǎn xiè}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{支持|zhī chí}。
vocab.exampleEn: First of all, I'd like to thank you all for your support.

vocab.note: The second point after {首先|shǒu xiān}, often a less important one. For steps in time, use {然后|rán hòu}.
vocab.example: {租|zū}{房子|fáng zi}，{首先|shǒu xiān}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{离|lí}{地铁站|dì tiě zhàn}{远|yuǎn}{不|bu}{远|yuǎn}，{其次|qí cì}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{价格|jià gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you rent a flat, the first thing to look at is how far it is from the metro, and the second is the price.

meanings: to play (piano, guitar: with the fingers)
vocab.note: For instruments played with the fingers: {弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}, {弹|tán}{琴|qín}, {弹|tán}{吉他|jí tā} (guitar). Bowed ones take {拉|lā}, wind ones {吹|chuī}, drums {打|dǎ}. In {子弹|zǐ dàn} (bullet) it's dàn.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{会|huì}{弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you play the piano?

meanings: to act, play (a part); to put on (a play)
vocab.note: {演|yǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{医生|yī shēng} (to play a doctor); {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{演|yǎn}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{月|yuè} (the film ran for two months).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{这个|zhè ge}{话剧|huà jù}{里|lǐ}{演|yǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He plays a teacher in this play.

vocab.note: Singing on stage: {演唱会|yǎn chàng huì} (a concert by a singer or band).
vocab.example: {下面|xià miàn}{请|qǐng}{她|tā}{为|wèi}{大家|dà jiā}{演唱|yǎn chàng}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Next, she'll sing a song for you all.

vocab.note: Any performer on stage or screen: {电影|diàn yǐng}{演员|yǎn yuán}, {京剧|jīng jù}{演员|yǎn yuán}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{的|de}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}{是|shì}{当|dāng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{演员|yǎn yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: When she was little, her dream was to be an actor.

vocab.note: {艺术家|yì shù jiā}: an artist. Art history is {美术史|měi shù shǐ} ({美术|měi shù}: the fine arts, HSK 5).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{艺术|yì shù}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very interested in Chinese art.

vocab.note: The general word for a show, and "to perform": {今晚|jīn wǎn}{有|yǒu}{演出|yǎn chū}; {他们|tā men}{在|zài}{剧院|jù yuàn}{演出|yǎn chū}. Measure word {场|chǎng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{演出|yǎn chū}{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The show lasts two hours in all.

vocab.note: A verb ({总结|zǒng jié}{一下|yí xià}) and a noun ({写|xiě}{一|yí}{个|gè}{总结|zǒng jié}). To begin a conclusion, say {总之|zǒng zhī} (in short).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{总结|zǒng jié}{一下|yí xià}{今天|jīn tiān}{学|xué}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please sum up what we learned today.

vocab.note: A school composition, and the exam's writing task: {写|xiě}{作文|zuò wén}, {一|yì}{篇|piān}{作文|zuò wén}. (Also a verb in some dictionaries: to write a composition.)
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{写|xiě}{一|yì}{篇|piān}{关于|guān yú}{家乡|jiā xiāng}{的|de}{作文|zuò wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher asked us to write a composition about our hometowns.

vocab.note: Arriving at a new job, school or event and signing in: {到|dào}{人事部|rén shì bù}{报到|bào dào}. Not {报道|bào dào} (lesson 24: to report news), said the same.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{员工|yuán gōng}{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{报到|bào dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: New staff report for work at nine tomorrow morning.

vocab.note: Praise for work or a performance: {表现|biǎo xiàn}{出色|chū sè}, {工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{出色|chū sè}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{文章|wén zhāng}{写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{出色|chū sè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her article was outstandingly written.

vocab.note: Written partner of {曾经|céng jīng}: {本人|běn rén}{曾|céng}{在|zài}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{实习|shí xí}. Negative {不曾|bù céng} / {未|wèi}{曾|céng} (written).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{曾|céng}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He once worked in Shanghai.

meanings: once (at some time in the past)
vocab.note: The action or state is past and usually over, often with {过|guo}. Compare {已经|yǐ jīng} (already, still true).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{曾经|céng jīng}{当|dāng}{过|guo}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was once a teacher.

vocab.note: Formal "I" in letters and CVs; {本人|běn rén}{签字|qiān zì}: signed in person.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{份|fèn}{合同|hé tong}{必须|bì xū}{本人|běn rén}{签字|qiān zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This contract must be signed in person.

vocab.note: The whole package: pay, holidays, insurance. {待遇|dài yù}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{待遇|dài yù}{不错|bú cuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: This company's pay and conditions are good.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {个人|gè rén}{简历|jiǎn lì} (personal CV), {我|wǒ}{个人|gè rén}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ} (my personal view).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{只是|zhǐ shì}{我|wǒ}{个人|gè rén}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is just my personal view.

vocab.note: Formal; takes a field of work: {从事|cóng shì}{新闻|xīn wén}{工作|gōng zuò}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{从事|cóng shì}{教育|jiào yù}{工作|gōng zuò}{二十|èr shí}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has worked in education for twenty years.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. {向|xiàng}{别人|bié ren}{打听|dǎ ting}: ask others about something.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{帮|bāng}{你|nǐ}{打听|dǎ ting}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll ask around for you.

vocab.note: Idiom, pattern {各|gè}A{各|gè}B; usually with {都|dōu} or {的|de}: {各行各业|gè háng gè yè}{都|dōu}{需要|xū yào}{人才|rén cái}. 行 is háng.
vocab.example: {来|lái}{参加|cān jiā}{活动|huó dòng}{的|de}{人|rén}{来自|lái zì}{各行各业|gè háng gè yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The people at the event came from all walks of life.

vocab.note: {考|kǎo}{公务员|gōng wù yuán}: to sit the civil-service exam.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{哥哥|gē ge}{是|shì}{公务员|gōng wù yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: His brother is a civil servant.

vocab.note: háng; HSK 3's 行 xíng is "to go; OK". Also a row: {一|yì}{行|háng}{字|zì}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{做|zuò}{哪|nǎ}{一|yì}{行|háng}？
vocab.exampleEn: What line of work are you in?

vocab.note: {新闻|xīn wén}{行业|háng yè}, {服务|fú wù}{行业|háng yè}. 行 is háng.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{行业|háng yè}{的|de}{竞争|jìng zhēng}{很|hěn}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a lot of competition in this industry.

vocab.note: Light second syllable: hé tong. {签|qiān}{合同|hé tong} / {签订|qiān dìng}{合同|hé tong}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{下|xià}{周|zhōu}{签|qiān}{合同|hé tong}。
vocab.exampleEn: We sign the contract next week.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{份|fèn}{简历|jiǎn lì}; {写|xiě}{简历|jiǎn lì}, {投|tóu}{简历|jiǎn lì} (send in a CV).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{简历|jiǎn lì}{发|fā}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{邮箱|yóu xiāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please send your CV to this email address.

vocab.note: {固定|gù dìng}{工作|gōng zuò} (a permanent job); {时间|shí jiān}{不|bú}{固定|gù dìng} (irregular hours).
vocab.example: {记者|jì zhě}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}{时间|shí jiān}{不|bú}{固定|gù dìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: A reporter's working hours aren't fixed.

vocab.note: {大学生|dà xué shēng}{就业|jiù yè}: graduate employment. Formal.
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{就业|jiù yè}{情况|qíng kuàng}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The job situation this year is better than last year.

vocab.note: Takes abstract objects: {具备|jù bèi}{条件|tiáo jiàn}, {具备|jù bèi}{能力|néng lì}, {具备|jù bèi}{资格|zī gé}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{具备|jù bèi}{当|dāng}{经理|jīng lǐ}{的|de}{能力|néng lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has what it takes to be a manager.

vocab.note: Before a noun: temporary ({临时|lín shí}{工作|gōng zuò}); before a verb: at short notice ({临时|lín shí}{取消|qǔ xiāo}).
vocab.example: {会议|huì yì}{临时|lín shí}{改|gǎi}{到|dào}{了|le}{下午|xià wǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The meeting was moved to the afternoon at short notice.

vocab.note: {公司|gōng sī}{急需|jí xū}{人才|rén cái} (talent). {才|cái} is cái.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{需要|xū yào}{更|gèng}{多|duō}{人才|rén cái}。
vocab.exampleEn: This city needs more talented people.

vocab.note: {人力|rén lì}{部门|bù mén} (HR department), {人力|rén lì}{不够|bú gòu}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{人力|rén lì}{不够|bú gòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our company is short of people.

vocab.note: {新|xīn}{员工|yuán gōng}{培训|péi xùn}; {参加|cān jiā}{培训|péi xùn}.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{员工|yuán gōng}{要|yào}{参加|cān jiā}{两|liǎng}{周|zhōu}{的|de}{培训|péi xùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: New staff have to attend two weeks of training.

vocab.note: {聘请|pìn qǐng} X {为|wéi} Y (formal) or {聘请|pìn qǐng} X {当|dāng} Y.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{聘请|pìn qǐng}{了|le}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{新|xīn}{经理|jīng lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company has hired a new manager.

vocab.note: Traditional {+{签|qiān}+}. {签|qiān}{合同|hé tong}, {签|qiān}{个|gè}{字|zì}. Not {欠|qiàn} qiàn (to owe).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{签|qiān}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please sign here.

vocab.note: Formal; object: {合同|hé tong}, {协议|xié yì}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{昨天|zuó tiān}{签订|qiān dìng}{了|le}{合同|hé tong}。
vocab.exampleEn: They signed the contract yesterday.

vocab.note: Object built in: ×{签字|qiān zì}{合同|hé tong}; say {在|zài}{合同|hé tong}{上|shàng}{签字|qiān zì}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{您|nín}{在|zài}{这里|zhè lǐ}{签字|qiān zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please sign here.

vocab.note: {实习|shí xí}{生|shēng}: intern.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{实习|shí xí}{过|guo}{三|sān}{个|gè}{月|yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: She did a three-month internship at a website.

vocab.note: {学历|xué lì}{要求|yāo qiú}: education required.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}{对|duì}{学历|xué lì}{要求|yāo qiú}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This job requires a high level of education.

vocab.note: After a time or event: {去年|qù nián}{以来|yǐ lái}, {工作|gōng zuò}{以来|yǐ lái}; with {自从|zì cóng}: {自从|zì cóng}…{以来|yǐ lái}.
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{以来|yǐ lái}，{他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has been busy ever since the start of the year.

vocab.note: The everyday word for a company's staff.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{百|bǎi}{名|míng}{员工|yuán gōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company has two hundred employees.

vocab.note: {毕业|bì yè}{证书|zhèng shū} (degree certificate).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{有|yǒu}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}{证书|zhèng shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has a Chinese proficiency certificate.

vocab.note: {刚|gāng}{进|jìn}{职场|zhí chǎng}{的|de}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}.
vocab.example: {刚|gāng}{进|jìn}{职场|zhí chǎng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{懂|dǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I first started work, I knew nothing.

vocab.note: Older, official word; in names: {职工|zhí gōng}{食堂|shí táng}.
vocab.example: {工厂|gōng chǎng}{的|de}{职工|zhí gōng}{都|dōu}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{附近|fù jìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The factory's workers all live nearby.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{资格|zī gé} + verb: to be entitled to.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{没有|méi yǒu}{资格|zī gé}{参加|cān jiā}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He isn't eligible for this exam.

vocab.note: zhèng. {挣|zhèng}{钱|qián}, {挣|zhèng}{工资|gōng zī}. {赚|zhuàn} (HSK 4) is also from business.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{挣|zhèng}{八千|bā qiān}{块|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: He earns eight thousand a month.

vocab.note: Past starting point only; with {以来|yǐ lái} or {以后|yǐ hòu}.
vocab.example: {自从|zì cóng}{搬家|bān jiā}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{少见|shǎo jiàn}{到|dào}{他|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Since I moved, I've rarely seen him.

vocab.note: {包括|bāo kuò}{我|wǒ}{在内|zài nèi}: me included.
vocab.example: {费用|fèi yòng}{包括|bāo kuò}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The price includes breakfast.

vocab.note: {写|xiě}{报告|bào gào}; {向|xiàng}{领导|lǐng dǎo}{报告|bào gào}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{要|yào}{交|jiāo}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{报告|bào gào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have to hand in a report tomorrow.

vocab.note: A whole organisation; {公司|gōng sī}{成立|chéng lì}{于|yú}2010{年|nián} (written).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{成立|chéng lì}{十|shí}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company was founded ten years ago.

vocab.note: Formal; spoken {参加|cān jiā}. {出席|chū xí}{会议|huì yì}.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{领导|lǐng dǎo}{出席|chū xí}{了|le}{会议|huì yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many senior people attended the meeting.

vocab.note: Often in names: {国际|guó jì}{大厦|dà shà}. {厦|xià} is shà.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{那|nà}{座|zuò}{大厦|dà shà}{的|de}{十|shí}{层|céng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our company is on the tenth floor of that tower.

vocab.note: A concrete scheme, often one of several: {提出|tí chū}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{方案|fāng àn}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{方案|fāng àn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager agreed to our proposal.

vocab.note: {担任|dān rèn}{主任|zhǔ rèn}, {担任|dān rèn}{翻译|fān yì}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{担任|dān rèn}{部门|bù mén}{主任|zhǔ rèn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{三|sān}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: She has been head of the department for three years.

meanings: to transfer (to another post or place)
vocab.note: diào. {调|diào}{到|dào}{总部|zǒng bù}. {空调|kōng tiáo} has tiáo (lesson 09's {调|tiáo}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{调|diào}{到|dào}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{去|qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's being transferred to Shanghai next month.

vocab.note: {在|zài}{会|huì}{上|shàng}{发言|fā yán}.
vocab.example: {会|huì}{上|shàng}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{发|fā}{了|le}{言|yán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone spoke at the meeting.

vocab.note: {政府|zhèng fǔ}{机构|jī gòu}, {培训|péi xùn}{机构|jī gòu}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{培训|péi xùn}{机构|jī gòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a training organisation.

vocab.note: {按|àn}{键|jiàn}: to press a key.
vocab.example: {按|àn}{这个|zhè ge}{键|jiàn}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{打印|dǎ yìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Press this key to print.

vocab.note: {电脑|diàn nǎo}{键盘|jiàn pán}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{键盘|jiàn pán}{坏|huài}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My keyboard is broken.

vocab.note: A speech, especially a leader's: {经理|jīng lǐ}{的|de}{讲话|jiǎng huà}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{在|zài}{会|huì}{上|shàng}{讲|jiǎng}{了|le}{话|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager gave a talk at the meeting.

vocab.note: {接待|jiē dài}{客户|kè hù}, {接待|jiē dài}{室|shì} (reception room).
vocab.example: {下午|xià wǔ}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{接待|jiē dài}{两|liǎng}{位|wèi}{客户|kè hù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm receiving two clients this afternoon.

vocab.note: A business's client; a shop's customer is {顾客|gù kè}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{客户|kè hù}{来自|lái zì}{各行各业|gè háng gè yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our clients come from every line of work.

vocab.note: Spoken; traditional {+{老板|lǎo bǎn}+}. In an organisation, {领导|lǐng dǎo}.
vocab.example: {老板|lǎo bǎn}{今天|jīn tiān}{不|bú}{在|zài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The boss isn't in today.

vocab.note: {领|lǐng}{工资|gōng zī}, {领|lǐng}{快递|kuài dì}; {领|lǐng}{他|tā}{去|qù}{会议|huì yì}{室|shì} (show him to).
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{可以|kě yǐ}{去|qù}{领|lǐng}{工资|gōng zī}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We can collect our pay tomorrow.

vocab.note: {经理|jīng lǐ}{的|de}{秘书|mì shū}. {秘|mì} is mì.
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{事|shì}{可以|kě yǐ}{先|xiān}{找|zhǎo}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{秘书|mì shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: If anything comes up, you can see my secretary first.

vocab.note: {内部|nèi bù}{会议|huì yì}, {公司|gōng sī}{内部|nèi bù}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{公司|gōng sī}{内部|nèi bù}{的|de}{事|shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is an internal company matter.

vocab.note: Used for one's superiors in an organisation.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{要|yào}{先|xiān}{问问|wèn wen}{领导|lǐng dǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: We need to ask the bosses about this first.

vocab.note: Of a person who gets things done. Traditional {+{能干|néng gàn}+}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{又|yòu}{聪明|cōng ming}{又|yòu}{能干|néng gàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's clever and capable.

vocab.note: {手机|shǒu jī}{屏幕|píng mù}, {电脑|diàn nǎo}{屏幕|píng mù}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{屏幕|píng mù}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This screen is too small.

meanings: business (a company as an economic unit)
vocab.note: {大|dà}{企业|qǐ yè}, {小|xiǎo}{企业|qǐ yè}; {公司|gōng sī} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{大|dà}{企业|qǐ yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a large enterprise.

vocab.note: {公司|gōng sī}{派|pài}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{出差|chū chāi}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{派|pài}{他|tā}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company sent him to work in Shanghai.

vocab.note: Spoken; formal {批准|pī zhǔn}. {假|jià}{批|pī}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ The measure word {批|pī} (a batch) is lesson 04's.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{批|pī}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{假|jià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager approved three days' leave for me.

vocab.note: {批准|pī zhǔn}{方案|fāng àn}. In traditional {={准|zhǔn}=} stays {={准|zhǔn}=} here ({+{批准|pī zhǔn}+}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{已经|yǐ jīng}{批准|pī zhǔn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This plan has been approved.

meanings: to set up (an office or post)
vocab.note: A part of an organisation: {设立|shè lì}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{广州|Guǎng zhōu}{设立|shè lì}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company has set up an office in Guangzhou.

vocab.note: Before the event: {事先|shì xiān}{通知|tōng zhī}. Compare {提前|tí qián} (earlier than planned).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{应该|yīng gāi}{事先|shì xiān}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: You should have told me in advance.

vocab.note: Neutral ({管理|guǎn lǐ}{手段|shǒu duàn}) or negative ({用|yòng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{手段|shǒu duàn}).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{用|yòng}{了|le}{各种|gè zhǒng}{手段|shǒu duàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: They used every means.

vocab.note: {鼠|shǔ}: a mouse or rat.
vocab.example: {鼠标|shǔ biāo}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The mouse is on the desk.

vocab.note: {外部|wài bù}{客户|kè hù}, {外部|wài bù}{环境|huán jìng}.

vocab.example: {年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{应该|yīng gāi}{敢于|gǎn yú}{尝试|cháng shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Young people should dare to try things.

vocab.note: {跟|gēn}{同事|tóng shì}{告别|gào bié}; {告别|gào bié}{过去|guò qù}.
vocab.example: {离开|lí kāi}{以前|yǐ qián}，{他|tā}{去|qù}{跟|gēn}{老师|lǎo shī}{告别|gào bié}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before leaving, he went to say goodbye to his teacher.

vocab.note: {大胆|dà dǎn}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}; {大胆|dà dǎn}{地|de}{说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{大胆|dà dǎn}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: That's a bold idea.

vocab.note: {黄金|huáng jīn}{时间|shí jiān} (prime time).
vocab.example: {黄金|huáng jīn}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{贵|guì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Gold keeps getting more expensive.

vocab.note: Traditional {+{汇率|huì lǜ}+}. {率|lǜ} is lǜ.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{汇率|huì lǜ}{是|shì}{多少|duō shao}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's today's exchange rate?

vocab.note: {条件|tiáo jiàn}{艰苦|jiān kǔ}.
vocab.example: {那里|nà lǐ}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{条件|tiáo jiàn}{很|hěn}{艰苦|jiān kǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Living conditions there are very hard.

vocab.note: A little formal; {假如|jiǎ rú}…{的话|de huà}.
vocab.example: {假如|jiǎ rú}{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{你|nǐ}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: If I were you, I wouldn't go.

vocab.note: {下|xià}{决心|jué xīn}: to make up one's mind.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{下|xià}{决心|jué xīn}{要|yào}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has resolved to learn Chinese properly.

vocab.note: {经营|jīng yíng}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{是|shì}{他|tā}{父母|fù mǔ}{经营|jīng yíng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: His parents run this shop.

vocab.note: {新|xīn}{店|diàn}{开业|kāi yè}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{明天|míng tiān}{开业|kāi yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This restaurant opens tomorrow.

vocab.note: {克服|kè fú}{困难|kùn nan}.
vocab.example: {只要|zhǐ yào}{努力|nǔ lì}，{困难|kùn nan}{都|dōu}{能|néng}{克服|kè fú}。
vocab.exampleEn: As long as you work hard, difficulties can be overcome.

vocab.note: {亏|kuī}{钱|qián}; {多亏|duō kuī} (thanks to, HSK 6).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{买卖|mǎi mai}{亏|kuī}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This deal lost quite a lot of money.

vocab.note: Formal, for any reason: {离职|lí zhí}{手续|shǒu xù}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{离职|lí zhí}{以后|yǐ hòu}{去|qù}{了|le}{国|guó}{外|wài}。
vocab.exampleEn: After leaving his job he went abroad.

vocab.note: Spoken; written {无法|wú fǎ}. {没法儿|méi fǎr}{说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{工作|gōng zuò}，{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{没法儿|méi fǎr}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's no way I can finish this much work on my own.

vocab.note: Formal: {面临|miàn lín}{困难|kùn nan}, {面临|miàn lín}{选择|xuǎn zé}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{面临|miàn lín}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{挑战|tiǎo zhàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company faces a big challenge.

vocab.note: {做|zuò}{事|shì}{谨慎|jǐn shèn}.
vocab.example: {做|zuò}{这个|zhè ge}{决定|jué dìng}{要|yào}{谨慎|jǐn shèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: You have to be careful making this decision.

vocab.note: Opposite {悲观|bēi guān} (HSK 6).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{对|duì}{未来|wèi lái}{很|hěn}{乐观|lè guān}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's optimistic about the future.

vocab.note: {哪怕|nǎ pà}…{也|yě}: spoken, emphatic.
vocab.example: {哪怕|nǎ pà}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{他|tā}{也|yě}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{锻炼|duàn liàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Even when he's very tired, he exercises every day.

vocab.note: {很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{前途|qián tú}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{前途|qián tú}。
vocab.exampleEn: This young person has a bright future.

vocab.note: {期待|qī dài}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{回信|huí xìn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{期待|qī dài}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm really looking forward to this trip.

vocab.note: {继续|jì xù}{前进|qián jìn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{不断|bú duàn}{前进|qián jìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We must keep moving forward.

vocab.note: qiàn; not {签|qiān} qiān (to sign). {欠|qiàn}{钱|qián}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{还|hái}{欠|qiàn}{他|tā}{五百|wǔ bǎi}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I still owe him five hundred yuan.

vocab.note: One's life's work: {事业|shì yè}{很|hěn}{成功|chéng gōng}. {职业|zhí yè} is an occupation.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{全部|quán bù}{时间|shí jiān}{都|dōu}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{事业|shì yè}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He puts all his time into his career.

vocab.note: {交|jiāo}{税|shuì} (pay tax). Traditional {+{税|shuì}+}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{价格|jià gé}{包括|bāo kuò}{税|shuì}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Does this price include tax?

vocab.note: Unlikely and usually unwelcome: {万一|wàn yī}{下雨|xià yǔ}{怎么办|zěn me bàn}？ {以|yǐ}{防|fáng}{万一|wàn yī}.
vocab.example: {带|dài}{上|shàng}{雨|yǔ}{伞|sǎn}{吧|ba}，{万一|wàn yī}{下雨|xià yǔ}{呢|ne}。
vocab.exampleEn: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

vocab.note: {失业|shī yè}{率|lǜ} (unemployment rate).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{失业|shī yè}{半|bàn}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's been out of work for six months.

vocab.note: {实现|shí xiàn}{愿望|yuàn wàng}, {实现|shí xiàn}{目标|mù biāo}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{实现|shí xiàn}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{愿望|yuàn wàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She finally made her wish come true.

vocab.note: {不|bù} is light. {说不定|shuō bu dìng}{他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{知道|zhī dào}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {说不定|shuō bu dìng}{他|tā}{明天|míng tiān}{就|jiù}{回来|huí lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Maybe he'll be back tomorrow.

vocab.note: {挑|tiāo} is tiǎo here. {接受|jiē shòu}{挑战|tiǎo zhàn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{说|shuō}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{挑战|tiǎo zhàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This job is a challenge for me.

vocab.note: {退休|tuì xiū}{以后|yǐ hòu}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{已经|yǐ jīng}{退休|tuì xiū}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandfather has retired.

vocab.note: The future in general: {未来|wèi lái}{十|shí}{年|nián}.
vocab.example: {未来|wèi lái}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{会|huì}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Life in the future will be better.

vocab.note: {心态|xīn tài}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}, {乐观|lè guān}{的|de}{心态|xīn tài}.
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{心态|xīn tài}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Having a good attitude is very important.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{勇气|yǒng qì}, {鼓|gǔ}{起|qǐ}{勇气|yǒng qì}.
vocab.example: {说|shuō}{出|chū}{真|zhēn}{话|huà}{需要|xū yào}{勇气|yǒng qì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Telling the truth takes courage.

vocab.note: yìng. {应对|yìng duì}{风险|fēng xiǎn}, {应对|yìng duì}{挑战|tiǎo zhàn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{想|xiǎng}{办法|bàn fǎ}{应对|yìng duì}{这些|zhè xiē}{变化|biàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: We need to find ways to cope with these changes.

vocab.note: Formal for {有|yǒu}: {拥有|yōng yǒu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{公司|gōng sī}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{拥有|yōng yǒu}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{公司|gōng sī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He finally owns his own company.

vocab.note: {工作|gōng zuò}{稳定|wěn dìng}, {收入|shōu rù}{稳定|wěn dìng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{想|xiǎng}{找|zhǎo}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{稳定|wěn dìng}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He wants to find a stable job.

vocab.note: Opposite {积极|jī jí}.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{这么|zhè me}{消极|xiāo jí}，{你|nǐ}{一定|yí dìng}{能|néng}{行|xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't be so negative: you can do it.

vocab.note: Spoken. Also a suggestion: {要不|yào bù}{我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{去|qù}？
vocab.example: {要不|yào bù}{我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{去|qù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: How about we go tomorrow instead?

vocab.note: Counterfactual: the fact is true. {不|bù} is light.
vocab.example: {要不是|yào bu shì}{你|nǐ}{提醒|tí xǐng}{我|wǒ}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{忘|wàng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you hadn't reminded me, I'd have forgotten.

vocab.note: {实现|shí xiàn}{愿望|yuàn wàng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{愿望|yuàn wàng}{是|shì}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{旅行|lǚ xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My wish is to travel in China.

vocab.note: {银行|yín háng}{账户|zhàng hù}. Traditional {+{账户|zhàng hù}+}, the usual Taiwan form ({=賬戶=} is also seen).
vocab.example: {钱|qián}{已经|yǐ jīng}{到|dào}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{账户|zhàng hù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The money is in your account now.

vocab.note: {资金|zī jīn}{不足|bù zú}.
vocab.example: {创业|chuàng yè}{需要|xū yào}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{资金|zī jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Starting a business takes a lot of capital.

vocab.note: {争取|zhēng qǔ}{机会|jī huì}, {争取|zhēng qǔ}{时间|shí jiān}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{争取|zhēng qǔ}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{完成|wán chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should try to finish early.

vocab.note: A change of attitude or direction: {思想|sī xiǎng}{转变|zhuǎn biàn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{态度|tài du}{发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{转变|zhuǎn biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: His attitude has changed a great deal.

vocab.note: {追求|zhuī qiú}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}, {追求|zhuī qiú}{幸福|xìng fú}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{追求|zhuī qiú}{幸福|xìng fú}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone is in pursuit of happiness.

vocab.note: {作出|zuò chū}{决定|jué dìng}, {作出|zuò chū}{贡献|gòng xiàn}; {做|zuò}{出|chū} is also common.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{作出|zuò chū}{了|le}{决定|jué dìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He finally made a decision.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{犹豫|yóu yù}{了|le}. {豫|yù} is lesson 06's character.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{犹豫|yóu yù}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}，{最后|zuì hòu}{还是|hái shi}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He hesitated for a long time but agreed in the end.

vocab.note: A careful guess from what you can see, more formal than {好像|hǎo xiàng}; it seldom takes {似的|shì de}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{似乎|sì hū}{不|bú}{太|tài}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He doesn't seem very happy.

vocab.note: Written and literary; often with {似的|shì de} at the end of the comparison: {仿佛|fǎng fú}…{似的|shì de}.
vocab.example: {那|nà}{天|tiān}{的|de}{事|shì}{仿佛|fǎng fú}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{昨天|zuó tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: That day feels as if it were yesterday.

vocab.note: Read shì de. Closes a comparison opened by {像|xiàng}, {好像|hǎo xiàng} or {仿佛|fǎng fú}: {像|xiàng}{孩子|hái zi}{似的|shì de} (like a child).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{好像|hǎo xiàng}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}{似的|shì de}。
vocab.exampleEn: He acts as if he knows everything.

vocab.note: The conclusion holds whatever else is true; mostly spoken.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù}{吧|ba}，{反正|fǎn zhèng}{也|yě}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's take a taxi: it isn't far anyway.

vocab.note: As an adjective "just right" ({大小|dà xiǎo}{刚好|gāng hǎo}); before a verb "as it happens". Same as {正好|zhèng hǎo}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{找|zhǎo}{他|tā}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他|tā}{刚好|gāng hǎo}{在|zài}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I went to see him, he happened to be in.

vocab.note: A habit or rule; no {过|guo} after the verb. Experience is {从|cóng}{没|méi}…{过|guo}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{从不|cóng bù}{抽|chōu}{烟|yān}。
vocab.exampleEn: He never smokes.

vocab.note: As a measure word for looks: {看|kàn}{了|le}{他|tā}{一|yì}{眼|yǎn} (glanced at him).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{回|huí}{头|tóu}{看|kàn}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{眼|yǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: She looked back at me.

vocab.note: A separable verb: {熬|áo}{了|le}{一|yí}{夜|yè} (was up all night).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{已经|yǐ jīng}{是|shì}{他|tā}{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{第|dì}{三|sān}{次|cì}{熬夜|áo yè}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: That's the third time this week he's stayed up late.

vocab.note: {失|shī} (lose) + {眠|mián} (sleep).
vocab.example: {压力|yā lì}{太|tài}{大|dà}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{常常|cháng cháng}{失眠|shī mián}。
vocab.exampleEn: When the pressure's too high, I often can't sleep.

vocab.note: The noun; the verb is {睡觉|shuì jiào}.
vocab.example: {睡眠|shuì mián}{不足|bù zú}，{白天|bái tiān}{就|jiù}{没有|méi yǒu}{精神|jīng shén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Without enough sleep, you've no energy in the day.

vocab.note: {半夜|bàn yè}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}: two in the morning.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{半夜|bàn yè}{才|cái}{回|huí}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He didn't get home until the middle of the night.

vocab.note: {闹钟|nào zhōng}{响|xiǎng}{了|le}: the alarm went off.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{闹钟|nào zhōng}{定|dìng}{在|zài}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I set the alarm for seven.

vocab.note: Written style: {忙碌|máng lù}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó} (a busy life).
vocab.example: {城市|chéng shì}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{人|rén}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{忙碌|máng lù}。
vocab.exampleEn: People in the city are busy every day.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{闲|xián}{下来|xià lái} (as soon as one has nothing to do).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{闲|xián}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}。
vocab.exampleEn: He likes painting in his free time.

vocab.note: {休闲|xiū xián}{时间|shí jiān} (free time), {休闲|xiū xián}{服|fú} (casual clothes).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{休闲|xiū xián}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Weekends are my time to relax.

vocab.note: {娱乐|yú lè}{活动|huó dòng} (leisure activities).
vocab.example: {手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{的|de}{娱乐|yú lè}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's more and more entertainment on our phones.

vocab.note: {享受|xiǎng shòu}{生活|shēng huó} (to enjoy life).
vocab.example: {退休|tuì xiū}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{他|tā}{开始|kāi shǐ}{享受|xiǎng shòu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: After retiring he began to enjoy life.

vocab.note: Doing something yourself to see what it's like: {体验|tǐ yàn}{一下|yí xià}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{想|xiǎng}{体验|tǐ yàn}{一下|yí xià}{在|zài}{农村|nóng cūn}{生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{感觉|gǎn jué}。
vocab.exampleEn: He wants to see what living in the country is like.

vocab.note: Both "thrilling" and "to stimulate": {手机|shǒu jī}{的|de}{光|guāng}{会|huì}{刺激|cì jī}{眼睛|yǎn jing}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{游戏|yóu xì}{太|tài}{刺激|cì jī}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: This game is so exciting!

vocab.note: {便利|biàn lì} (convenient, lesson 21) + {店|diàn}.
vocab.example: {楼|lóu}{下|xià}{的|de}{便利店|biàn lì diàn}{二十四|èr shí sì}{小时|xiǎo shí}{开|kāi}{门|mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: The convenience store downstairs is open twenty-four hours.

vocab.note: {吧|ba} borrows the sound of English "bar".
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{他们|tā men}{常常|cháng cháng}{去|qù}{酒吧|jiǔ bā}。
vocab.exampleEn: They often go to a bar at weekends.

vocab.note: {抽|chōu}{时间|shí jiān} (to make time), {抽|chōu}{烟|yān} (to smoke).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{抽|chōu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: He makes an hour every day to go running.

vocab.note: Written: {不良|bù liáng}{习惯|xí guàn} (bad habits).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{应该|yīng gāi}{改|gǎi}{掉|diào}{不良|bù liáng}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{习惯|xí guàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should get rid of bad habits.

vocab.note: Before an adjective or verb: {过度|guò dù}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}, {过度|guò dù}{使用|shǐ yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}.
vocab.example: {过度|guò dù}{使用|shǐ yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{对|duì}{眼睛|yǎn jing}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Using your phone too much is bad for your eyes.

vocab.note: {长期|cháng qī}{熬夜|áo yè} (staying up late for a long time).
vocab.example: {长期|cháng qī}{睡眠|shuì mián}{不足|bù zú}，{身体|shēn tǐ}{会|huì}{变|biàn}{差|chà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lack of sleep over a long time makes you less healthy.

vocab.note: Energy to work or study; {精神|jīng shén} is spirit and liveliness.
vocab.example: {年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{精力|jīng lì}{好|hǎo}，{一|yì}{天|tiān}{能|néng}{做|zuò}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{事|shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Young people have plenty of energy and get a lot done in a day.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{精神|jīng shén} / {没有|méi yǒu}{精神|jīng shén}: lively / listless. Some speakers say jīng shen in the "lively" sense.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{今天|jīn tiān}{看|kàn}{起来|qǐ lái}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{精神|jīng shén}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looks very lively today.

vocab.note: {好|hǎo}{的|de}{状态|zhuàng tài}: good shape.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{以前|yǐ qián}，{要|yào}{调整|tiáo zhěng}{好|hǎo}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{状态|zhuàng tài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before an exam, get yourself into good shape.

vocab.note: Says how someone or something comes across; followed by an adjective.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{穿|chuān}{上|shàng}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{显得|xiǎn de}{很|hěn}{年轻|nián qīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She looks very young in this.

vocab.note: {保持|bǎo chí}{安静|ān jìng} (keep quiet), {保持|bǎo chí}{联系|lián xì} (keep in touch).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{保持|bǎo chí}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please keep quiet, everyone.

vocab.note: {调|diào} is tiáo here, as in {空调|kōng tiáo}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{调整|tiáo zhěng}{一下|yí xià}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: We need to adjust the timing a little.

vocab.note: Noun and adjective: {保持|bǎo chí}{平衡|píng héng} (keep one's balance), {工作|gōng zuò}{和|hé}{生活|shēng huó}{要|yào}{平衡|píng héng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一|yì}{只|zhǐ}{脚|jiǎo}{站|zhàn}{着|zhe}，{很|hěn}{难|nán}{保持|bǎo chí}{平衡|píng héng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Standing on one foot, he could hardly keep his balance.

vocab.note: {控制|kòng zhì}{时间|shí jiān}, {控制|kòng zhì}{体重|tǐ zhòng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{控制|kòng zhì}{自己|zì jǐ}{玩|wán}{手机|shǒu jī}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm controlling how long I spend on my phone.

vocab.note: {承受|chéng shòu}{压力|yā lì} (to bear pressure).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{承受|chéng shòu}{不了|bu liǎo}{这么|zhè me}{大|dà}{的|de}{压力|yā lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He can't take so much pressure.

vocab.note: {缓解|huǎn jiě}{压力|yā lì}, {缓解|huǎn jiě}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}.
vocab.example: {运动|yùn dòng}{可以|kě yǐ}{缓解|huǎn jiě}{压力|yā lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Exercise can relieve stress.

vocab.note: {忽视|hū shì}{健康|jiàn kāng}, {忽视|hū shì}{问题|wèn tí}.
vocab.example: {工作|gōng zuò}{再|zài}{忙|máng}，{也|yě}{不|bù}{能|néng}{忽视|hū shì}{健康|jiàn kāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: However busy you are, you can't neglect your health.

vocab.note: {增强|zēng qiáng}{体力|tǐ lì} (build up stamina), {增强|zēng qiáng}{信心|xìn xīn}.
vocab.example: {多|duō}{运动|yùn dòng}{可以|kě yǐ}{增强|zēng qiáng}{体力|tǐ lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: More exercise builds up your stamina.

vocab.note: The body as a subject: {人体|rén tǐ}{的|de}{肌肉|jī ròu}.
vocab.example: {人体|rén tǐ}{需要|xū yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{休息|xiū xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The human body needs proper rest.

vocab.note: {身材|shēn cái}{好|hǎo}, {身材|shēn cái}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{身材|shēn cái}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She has a good figure.

vocab.note: {肌|jī} (muscle) + {肉|ròu} (flesh).
vocab.example: {运动|yùn dòng}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{肌肉|jī ròu}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{疼|téng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My muscles ache a bit after exercise.

vocab.note: {腰|yāo}{疼|téng}: a backache.
vocab.example: {坐|zuò}{久|jiǔ}{了|le}，{腰|yāo}{会|huì}{疼|téng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sit too long and your back aches.

vocab.note: {指|zhǐ} (to point) with {手|shǒu}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{用|yòng}{手指|shǒu zhǐ}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He wrote a character on the table with his finger.

vocab.note: Spoken, a little childlike; {嘴|zuǐ} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{张|zhāng}{开|kāi}{嘴巴|zuǐ ba}{笑|xiào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child opened their mouth and laughed.

vocab.note: Written; {汗|hàn} (HSK 4) is the everyday word: {出|chū}{汗|hàn}.
vocab.example: {跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{步|bù}，{他|tā}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{上|shàng}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{汗水|hàn shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the run his clothes were wet with sweat.

vocab.note: {脚步|jiǎo bù}{声|shēng}: the sound of footsteps.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{听见|tīng jiàn}{门|mén}{外|wài}{有|yǒu}{脚步|jiǎo bù}{声|shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I heard footsteps outside the door.

vocab.note: {深|shēn}{呼吸|hū xī}: a deep breath.
vocab.example: {慢|màn}{慢|màn}{地|de}{呼吸|hū xī}，{别|bié}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Breathe slowly; don't be nervous.

vocab.note: Mostly in words and set phrases: {用力|yòng lì}, {力气|lì qi}, {体力|tǐ lì}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{用|yòng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{力|lì}，{才|cái}{把|bǎ}{门|mén}{打开|dǎ kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: It took him a lot of strength to get the door open.

vocab.note: Of the body, or of people together: {大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{力量|lì liang}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{力量|lì liang}，{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{搬|bān}{动|dòng}{这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{桌子|zhuō zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very strong: he can move this table on his own.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{太|tài}{用力|yòng lì} (don't push too hard).
vocab.example: {别|bié}{太|tài}{用力|yòng lì}，{门|mén}{一|yì}{推|tuī}{就|jiù}{开|kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't push too hard: the door opens with a little push.

vocab.note: {体力|tǐ lì}{好|hǎo} / {体力|tǐ lì}{不够|bú gòu}.
vocab.example: {爬|pá}{了|le}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{山|shān}，{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{体力|tǐ lì}{都|dōu}{用|yòng}{完|wán}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After a whole day's climbing, everyone's stamina had run out.

vocab.note: Opposite {强|qiáng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{身体|shēn tǐ}{很|hěn}{弱|ruò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He was frail as a child.

vocab.note: {鞋|xié}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{紧|jǐn} (the shoes are a bit tight); {时间|shí jiān}{很|hěn}{紧|jǐn} (time is tight).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{紧|jǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: These shoes are a bit tight.

vocab.note: {伸|shēn}{手|shǒu} (to hold out a hand); {伸|shēn}{一|yì}{伸|shēn} (a quick stretch).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{伸|shēn}{手|shǒu}{拿|ná}{了|le}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: He reached out and took a book.

vocab.note: {坐|zuò}{的|de}{姿势|zī shì} (the way one sits).
vocab.example: {写|xiě}{字|zì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{姿势|zī shì}{要|yào}{对|duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hold yourself properly when you write.

meanings: to the best of one's ability
vocab.note: Before the verb: {尽量|jǐn liàng}{少|shǎo}{吃|chī}, {尽量|jǐn liàng}{早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{回来|huí lái}. Read jǐn liàng.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{尽量|jǐn liàng}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{自己|zì jǐ}{做饭|zuò fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I try to cook for myself every day.

vocab.note: Also as an adverbial: {适当|shì dàng}{运动|yùn dòng} (exercise in moderation).
vocab.example: {适当|shì dàng}{运动|yùn dòng}{对|duì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{有益|yǒu yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Exercise in moderation is good for you.

vocab.note: Written {太|tài}: before an adjective, and seldom with {了|le} at the end.
vocab.example: {饮食|yǐn shí}{不要|bú yào}{过于|guò yú}{简单|jiǎn dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your diet shouldn't be too simple.

vocab.note: After {得|de}: {好吃|hǎo chī}{得|de}{不得了|bù dé liǎo} (unbelievably good). Alone: something terrible has happened.
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}，{她|tā}{高兴|gāo xìng}{得|de}{不得了|bù dé liǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: When she heard the news, she was over the moon.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{营养|yíng yǎng} (nourishing).
vocab.example: {豆浆|dòu jiāng}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{营养|yíng yǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Soy milk is very nourishing.

vocab.note: Written: {饮食|yǐn shí}{习惯|xí guàn} (eating habits).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{注意|zhù yì}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{饮食|yǐn shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's careful about what he eats.

vocab.note: {高|gāo}{热量|rè liàng} (high in calories).
vocab.example: {炸|zhá}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{热量|rè liàng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Fried food is high in calories.

vocab.note: On labels: {成分|chéng fèn}：{水|shuǐ}、{黄豆|huáng dòu}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{饮料|yǐn liào}{的|de}{成分|chéng fèn}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This drink has simple ingredients.

vocab.note: {糖|táng}{的|de}{含量|hán liàng} (sugar content).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{饼干|bǐng gān}{的|de}{糖|táng}{含量|hán liàng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: These biscuits have a high sugar content.

vocab.note: Short and written: {含|hán}{糖|táng} (contains sugar).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{瓶|píng}{饮料|yǐn liào}{不|bù}{含|hán}{糖|táng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This drink contains no sugar.

vocab.note: The full form of {含|hán}.
vocab.example: {西瓜|xī guā}{含有|hán yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{水分|shuǐ fèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Watermelon contains a lot of water.

vocab.note: {水|shuǐ} + {分|fēn} (part).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{西瓜|xī guā}{水分|shuǐ fèn}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This watermelon is very juicy and sweet.

vocab.note: {对|duì}……{有益|yǒu yì}.
vocab.example: {适当|shì dàng}{运动|yùn dòng}{对|duì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{有益|yǒu yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Moderate exercise is good for the body.

vocab.note: {对|duì}……{有害|yǒu hài}.
vocab.example: {抽|chōu}{烟|yān}{对|duì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{有害|yǒu hài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Smoking is bad for your health.

vocab.note: "Must have"; HSK 3's {必须|bì xū} (must) has the same sound. {必需|bì xū}{品|pǐn}: necessities.
vocab.example: {水|shuǐ}{是|shì}{人体|rén tǐ}{必需|bì xū}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Water is essential to the body.

vocab.note: {睡眠|shuì mián}{充足|chōng zú}, {阳光|yáng guāng}{充足|chōng zú}.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{阳光|yáng guāng}{充足|chōng zú}，{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's plenty of sun here, so the fruit is sweet.

vocab.note: {足够|zú gòu}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}; also after a verb.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{担心|dān xīn}，{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{足够|zú gòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't worry: we've got enough time.

vocab.note: The rice, noodles or bread of a meal.
vocab.example: {南方|nán fāng}{人|rén}{的|de}{主食|zhǔ shí}{是|shì}{大米|dà mǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the south the staple food is rice.

vocab.note: Food as a crop; read liáng shi.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{地方|dì fang}{粮食|liáng shi}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: This place produces a lot of grain.

vocab.note: Cooked rice is {米饭|mǐ fàn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{超市|chāo shì}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{斤|jīn}{大米|dà mǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought five jin of rice at the supermarket.

vocab.note: {玉|yù} (jade) + {米|mǐ}.
vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{的|de}{玉米|yù mǐ}{特别|tè bié}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Corn is especially sweet in summer.

vocab.note: In traditional this sense has its own character, unlike {面|miàn} "side, face". {一|yì}{碗|wǎn}{面|miàn} (a bowl of noodles).
vocab.example: {北方|běi fāng}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{面|miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Northerners love noodles.

vocab.note: {饼干|bǐng gān} (HSK 4) is biscuits; {月饼|yuè bǐng} mooncake.
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{饼|bǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought a flatbread this morning.

vocab.note: {菜|cài} alone is also "a dish".
vocab.example: {多|duō}{吃|chī}{蔬菜|shū cài}{对|duì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Eating more vegetables is good for you.

vocab.note: "Yellow melon".
vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{我|wǒ}{常|cháng}{吃|chī}{黄瓜|huáng guā}。
vocab.exampleEn: I often eat cucumbers in summer.

vocab.note: {土|tǔ} (earth) + {豆|dòu} (bean).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{土豆|tǔ dòu}{切|qiē}{成|chéng}{了|le}{小|xiǎo}{块|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: I cut the potatoes into small pieces.

vocab.note: The written word of menus and recipes; people mostly say {西红柿|xī hóng shì}.
vocab.example: {番茄|fān qié}{炒|chǎo}{鸡蛋|jī dàn}{是|shì}{一|yí}{道|dào}{家常菜|jiā cháng cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tomato and egg is an everyday home dish.

vocab.note: {橙|chéng}{色|sè} is the colour orange.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{橙子|chéng zi}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: These oranges are very sweet.

vocab.note: The small orange you peel by hand.
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{吃|chī}{橘子|jú zi}{的|de}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of people eat tangerines in winter.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{个|gè}{梨|lí}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{洗|xǐ}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{梨|lí}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He washed a pear for me.

vocab.note: Also {桃|táo}{子|zi}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{桃|táo}{又|yòu}{大|dà}{又|yòu}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This peach is big and sweet.

vocab.note: {臭|chòu}{豆腐|dòu fu}: stinky tofu, a famous snack.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{豆腐|dòu fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tofu is my favourite.

vocab.note: Drunk at breakfast with {油条|yóu tiáo}.
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{我|wǒ}{喝|hē}{了|le}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{豆浆|dòu jiāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I had a glass of soy milk this morning.

vocab.note: A long deep-fried dough stick, eaten at breakfast.
vocab.example: {豆浆|dòu jiāng}{配|pèi}{油条|yóu tiáo}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{的|de}{早饭|zǎo fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Soy milk with fried dough sticks is many people's breakfast.

vocab.note: {海|hǎi} (sea) + {鲜|xiān} (fresh).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{海鲜|hǎi xiān}{很|hěn}{新鲜|xīn xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The seafood at this restaurant is very fresh.

vocab.note: "Fire pot", cooked at the table.
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{吃|chī}{火锅|huǒ guō}{最|zuì}{舒服|shū fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hot pot is the best thing in winter.

vocab.note: Food grilled on skewers or a grill.
vocab.example: {夜市|yè shì}{的|de}{烧烤|shāo kǎo}{好吃|hǎo chī}{得|de}{不得了|bù dé liǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The barbecue at the night market is incredibly good.

vocab.note: {夜|yè} (night) + {市|shì} (market).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{逛|guàng}{夜市|yè shì}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go round the night market at the weekend.

vocab.note: Chinese food is {中餐|zhōng cān}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{英国|Yīng guó}{天天|tiān tiān}{吃|chī}{西餐|xī cān}。
vocab.exampleEn: In Britain he eats Western food every day.

vocab.note: A meal in a box, at work or on a train.
vocab.example: {中午|zhōng wǔ}{我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{吃|chī}{盒饭|hé fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: At lunchtime we eat boxed meals in the office.

vocab.note: {甜|tián} (sweet) + {品|pǐn} (item).
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{尽量|jǐn liàng}{少|shǎo}{吃|chī}{甜品|tián pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Eat as few desserts as you can in the evening.

vocab.note: "Snow cake".
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{买|mǎi}{个|gè}{雪糕|xuě gāo}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too hot: let's buy an ice lolly.

vocab.note: Written; as a noun, a delicacy.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{道|dào}{菜|cài}{又|yòu}{美味|měi wèi}{又|yòu}{有|yǒu}{营养|yíng yǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This dish is delicious and nourishing.

vocab.note: {口味|kǒu wèi}{重|zhòng} (likes strong flavours), {口味|kǒu wèi}{清淡|qīng dàn} (likes light food).
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{口味|kǒu wèi}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone's taste is different.

vocab.note: {浓|nóng}{茶|chá} (strong tea).
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{别|bié}{喝|hē}{太|tài}{浓|nóng}{的|de}{茶|chá}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't drink strong tea in the evening.

vocab.note: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{淡|dàn}: not salty enough.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{汤|tāng}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{淡|dàn}，{再|zài}{加|jiā}{点儿|diǎnr}{盐|yán}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: This soup is a bit bland: add a little more salt.

vocab.note: Read chòu.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{牛奶|niú nǎi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{臭|chòu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This milk smells a bit off.

vocab.note: Read qiē; in {一切|yí qiè} it's qiè.
vocab.example: {把|bǎ}{番茄|fān qié}{切|qiē}{成|chéng}{小|xiǎo}{块|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Cut the tomatoes into small pieces.

vocab.note: {炒|chǎo}{鸡蛋|jī dàn}, {炒|chǎo}{饭|fàn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{炒|chǎo}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{菜|cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: He stir-fried two dishes.

vocab.note: Read zhá; zhà (fourth tone) is "to explode".
vocab.example: {炸|zhá}{鸡|jī}{热量|rè liàng}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Fried chicken is high in calories.

vocab.note: {煮|zhǔ}{面|miàn}, {煮|zhǔ}{鸡蛋|jī dàn}.
vocab.example: {面|miàn}{煮|zhǔ}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The noodles take five minutes to cook.

vocab.note: {烧|shāo}{开水|kāi shuǐ} (boil water), {烧|shāo}{菜|cài} (to cook a dish).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{烧|shāo}{点儿|diǎnr}{开水|kāi shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll go and boil some water.

vocab.note: {用|yòng}{微波炉|wēi bō lú}{加热|jiā rè}.
vocab.example: {饭|fàn}{凉|liáng}{了|le}，{加热|jiā rè}{一下|yí xià}{再|zài}{吃|chī}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: The food's gone cold: heat it up before you eat.

vocab.note: {冻|dòng}{在|zài}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}.
vocab.example: {肉|ròu}{冻|dòng}{在|zài}{冰箱|bīng xiāng}{里|lǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The meat is frozen in the fridge.

vocab.note: Read chēng. {称|chēng}{一下|yí xià} (weigh it). The other {称|chēng} (to call) is lesson 12's.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{称|chēng}{一下|yí xià}{这些|zhè xiē}{桃|táo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Could you weigh these peaches for me?

vocab.note: {番茄|fān qié}{炒|chǎo}{蛋|dàn}{配|pèi}{米饭|mǐ fàn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{配|pèi}{什么|shén me}{鞋|xié}{好看|hǎo kàn}？
vocab.exampleEn: What shoes go with this outfit?

vocab.note: {一|yì}{口|kǒu}{锅|guō} (a wok).
vocab.example: {锅|guō}{里|lǐ}{放|fàng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{油|yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Put a little oil in the wok.

vocab.note: {刀|dāo}{叉|chā} (knife and fork).
vocab.example: {吃|chī}{西餐|xī cān}{要|yào}{用|yòng}{刀|dāo}{和|hé}{叉子|chā zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: You eat Western food with a knife and fork.

vocab.note: {吸|xī} (to suck) + {管|guǎn} (tube).
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{不|bú}{再|zài}{给|gěi}{一次性|yí cì xìng}{的|de}{吸管|xī guǎn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many restaurants no longer give out disposable straws.

vocab.note: {一次性|yí cì xìng}{筷子|kuài zi} (disposable chopsticks).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{尽量|jǐn liàng}{少|shǎo}{用|yòng}{一次性|yí cì xìng}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: We try to use as few disposable things as possible.

vocab.note: Drunk hot in many Chinese homes and offices.
vocab.example: {喝|hē}{点儿|diǎnr}{开水|kāi shuǐ}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Have some hot water.

vocab.note: {吃不完|chī bu wán}{的|de}{菜|cài}{可以|kě yǐ}{打包|dǎ bāo}.
vocab.example: {服务|fú wù}{员|yuán}，{请|qǐng}{帮|bāng}{我们|wǒ men}{打包|dǎ bāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Excuse me, could you pack this up for us?

vocab.note: {过期|guò qī}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{盒|hé}{牛奶|niú nǎi}{已经|yǐ jīng}{过期|guò qī}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This carton of milk is out of date.

vocab.note: {保|bǎo} (keep) + {质|zhì} (quality) + {期|qī} (period).
vocab.example: {买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{要|yào}{看看|kàn kan}{保质期|bǎo zhì qī}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you shop, check the date.

vocab.note: Labels: {过期|guò qī}{请勿|qǐng wù}{食用|shí yòng} (do not eat after the expiry date).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{花|huā}{可以|kě yǐ}{食用|shí yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This flower is edible.

vocab.note: {减|jiǎn} (reduce) + {肥|féi} (fat).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{又|yòu}{在|zài}{减肥|jiǎn féi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's on a diet again.

vocab.note: Spoken and written; fine in requests: {请|qǐng}{立刻|lì kè}{离开|lí kāi}.
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}，{他|tā}{立刻|lì kè}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{电话|diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: As soon as he heard the news, he phoned his mother.

vocab.note: Notices, rules and news: {请|qǐng}{立即|lì jí}{报告|bào gào}.
vocab.example: {发现|fā xiàn}{问题|wèn tí}，{请|qǐng}{立即|lì jí}{报告|bào gào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Report any problem immediately.

vocab.note: Narration only, not in requests: {他|tā}{连忙|lián máng}{跑|pǎo}{过去|guò qù}.
vocab.example: {看见|kàn jiàn}{老人|lǎo rén}{摔倒|shuāi dǎo}{了|le}，{他|tā}{连忙|lián máng}{跑|pǎo}{过去|guò qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Seeing the old man fall, he hurried over.

vocab.note: Narration only; doubles as {急急忙忙|jí jí máng máng}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{听说|tīng shuō}{孩子|hái zi}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{急忙|jí máng}{赶|gǎn}{到|dào}{医院|yī yuàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hearing her child was ill, she rushed to the hospital.

vocab.note: Read jǐn kuài; allows a little time, unlike {马上|mǎ shàng}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{尽快|jǐn kuài}{回复|huí fù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please reply as soon as possible.

vocab.note: {随时|suí shí}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}; {随时|suí shí}{可能|kě néng}{变化|biàn huà} (could change at any moment).
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{随时|suí shí}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Call me any time you have a problem.

vocab.note: With {就|jiù}: {一旦|yí dàn}{发烧|fā shāo}，{就|jiù}{要|yào}{立刻|lì kè}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}. Formal; often an unwelcome event.
vocab.example: {一旦|yí dàn}{发|fā}{高烧|gāo shāo}，{就|jiù}{要|yào}{立刻|lì kè}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you ever get a high fever, go to the hospital at once.

vocab.note: {看|kàn}{门诊|mén zhěn} (to see a doctor as an outpatient).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{预约|yù yuē}{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{的|de}{门诊|mén zhěn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to book an outpatient appointment for tomorrow morning.

vocab.note: {夜间|yè jiān}{急诊|jí zhěn} (night emergency service).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{半夜|bàn yè}{被|bèi}{送|sòng}{进|jìn}{了|le}{急诊|jí zhěn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He was taken into A&E in the middle of the night.

vocab.note: {挂|guà} (to hang) + {号|hào} (number); also {挂号|guà hào}{信|xìn} (a registered letter).
vocab.example: {看病|kàn bìng}{以前|yǐ qián}{要|yào}{先|xiān}{挂号|guà hào}。
vocab.exampleEn: You have to register before you see a doctor.

vocab.note: {在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{预约|yù yuē} (book online).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{预约|yù yuē}{了|le}{明天|míng tiān}{的|de}{门诊|mén zhěn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I booked an appointment for tomorrow on my phone.

vocab.note: At a hotel, a hospital or an office: {登记|dēng jì}{一下|yí xià}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{先|xiān}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{登记|dēng jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please sign in here first.

vocab.note: {办|bàn}{手续|shǒu xù} (to go through the formalities).
vocab.example: {住院|zhù yuàn}{的|de}{手续|shǒu xù}{都|dōu}{办|bàn}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The admission paperwork is all done.

vocab.note: Written; {等|děng} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{病房|bìng fáng}{外面|wài miàn}{等待|děng dài}{消息|xiāo xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He waited outside the ward for news.

vocab.note: Formal, in notices: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这里|zhè lǐ}{等候|děng hòu}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}{等候|děng hòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please wait at the door.

vocab.note: {咨询|zī xún}{台|tái} (information desk).
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{可以|kě yǐ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}{咨询|zī xún}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you have questions, you can phone for advice.

vocab.note: Written: {领取|lǐng qǔ}{药品|yào pǐn}, {领取|lǐng qǔ}{报告|bào gào}.
vocab.example: {药|yào}{在|zài}{一|yī}{楼|lóu}{领取|lǐng qǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: You collect the medicine on the ground floor.

vocab.note: Written: {夜间|yè jiān}{急诊|jí zhěn}, {夜间|yè jiān}{门诊|mén zhěn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{医院|yī yuàn}{夜间|yè jiān}{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{医生|yī shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are doctors at this hospital at night too.

vocab.note: {救|jiù} (save) + {护|hù} (protect) + {车|chē}.
vocab.example: {爸爸|bà ba}{立即|lì jí}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}{叫|jiào}{了|le}{救护车|jiù hù chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Dad called an ambulance immediately.

vocab.note: {住|zhù}{进|jìn}{病房|bìng fáng} (to be admitted to a ward).
vocab.example: {奶奶|nǎi nai}{住|zhù}{进|jìn}{了|le}{病房|bìng fáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandma was admitted to a ward.

vocab.note: {医疗|yī liáo}{费|fèi} (medical costs).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{地方|dì fang}{的|de}{医疗|yī liáo}{条件|tiáo jiàn}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Medical care here is good.

vocab.note: {学|xué}{医学|yī xué} (to study medicine).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{医|yī}{学院|xué yuàn}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a medical student.

vocab.note: Both the system and its doctors.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{了|le}{中医|zhōng yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He went to see a doctor of Chinese medicine.

vocab.note: The remedies of {中医|zhōng yī}.
vocab.example: {中药|zhōng yào}{的|de}{味道|wèi dao}{很|hěn}{苦|kǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Chinese herbal medicine tastes very bitter.

vocab.note: Written; {药|yào} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {药品|yào pǐn}{要|yào}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{孩子|hái zi}{拿不到|ná bu dào}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}。
vocab.exampleEn: Keep medicines out of children's reach.

vocab.note: Written: {药物|yào wù}{过敏|guò mǐn} (a drug allergy).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{对|duì}{一些|yì xiē}{药物|yào wù}{过敏|guò mǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's allergic to some medicines.

vocab.note: Written; {病|bìng} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {预防|yù fáng}{疾病|jí bìng}{比|bǐ}{治疗|zhì liáo}{更|gèng}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Preventing illness matters more than treating it.

vocab.note: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{胃|wèi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{毛病|máo bìng}; also a fault in a machine or a habit.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{出|chū}{毛病|máo bìng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Something's wrong with my computer.

vocab.note: {流行|liú xíng}{性|xìng}{感冒|gǎn mào} shortened.
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{得|dé}{流感|liú gǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of people get flu in winter.

vocab.note: {对|duì}……{过敏|guò mǐn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{海鲜|hǎi xiān}{过敏|guò mǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm allergic to seafood.

vocab.note: Read zháo liáng.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{睡觉|shuì jiào}{别|bié}{着凉|zháo liáng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't catch a chill at night.

vocab.note: {他|tā}{的|de}{伤|shāng}{不|bú}{重|zhòng} (his injury isn't serious); {摔|shuāi}{伤|shāng} (hurt in a fall).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{伤|shāng}{不|bú}{重|zhòng}，{过|guò}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His injury isn't serious: it'll heal in a few days.

vocab.note: Written; {疼|téng} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {吃|chī}{了|le}{药|yào}，{疼痛|téng tòng}{好多|hǎo duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The pain eased a lot after the medicine.

vocab.note: {摔倒|shuāi dǎo} (to fall over); {把|bǎ}{杯子|bēi zi}{摔|shuāi}{了|le} (dropped the cup).
vocab.example: {路上|lù shang}{有|yǒu}{冰|bīng}，{小心|xiǎo xīn}{别|bié}{摔倒|shuāi dǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's ice on the road: be careful not to fall.

vocab.note: {胃|wèi}{疼|téng} (stomach ache).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{胃|wèi}{不|bú}{太|tài}{舒服|shū fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: My stomach is a bit upset.

vocab.note: {消化|xiāo huà}{不|bù}{好|hǎo} (poor digestion).
vocab.example: {吃|chī}{得|de}{太|tài}{快|kuài}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}{消化|xiāo huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Food is hard to digest if you eat too fast.

vocab.note: Written; {牙|yá} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{牙齿|yá chǐ}{又|yòu}{白|bái}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: His teeth are white and nice.

vocab.note: Read bèi; HSK 4's {背|bēi} bēi is "to carry on the back".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{背|bēi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{疼|téng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My back hurts a bit.

vocab.note: {脸色|liǎn sè}{不|bù}{好|hǎo} (looking pale).

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{浇|jiāo}{花|huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: I water the plants every morning.

vocab.note: {水|shuǐ}{洒|sǎ}{了|le}{一|yí}{地|dì} (water all over the floor).
vocab.example: {小心|xiǎo xīn}，{别|bié}{把|bǎ}{茶|chá}{洒|sǎ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Careful, don't spill the tea.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{摸|mō} (don't touch); {摸|mō}{一|yì}{摸|mō} (have a feel).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{摸|mō}{了|le}{摸|mō}{孩子|hái zi}{的|de}{头|tóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He stroked the child's head.

vocab.note: {漏|lòu}{水|shuǐ} (to leak water).
vocab.example: {厨房|chú fáng}{的|de}{水管|shuǐ guǎn}{漏|lòu}{水|shuǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The kitchen pipe is leaking.

vocab.note: {打|dǎ}{碎|suì}, {摔|shuāi}{碎|suì}.
vocab.example: {杯子|bēi zi}{掉|diào}{在|zài}{地上|dì shang}{摔|shuāi}{碎|suì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The glass fell on the floor and smashed.

vocab.note: Read tiáo, as in {调整|tiáo zhěng} and {空调|kōng tiáo}. {调|diào} diào (to transfer) is another word.
vocab.example: {把|bǎ}{空调|kōng tiáo}{的|de}{温度|wēn dù}{调|diào}{高|gāo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: Turn the air conditioning up a bit.

vocab.note: {随手|suí shǒu}{关|guān}{门|mén} (shut the door behind you).
vocab.example: {出门|chū mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{随手|suí shǒu}{关|guān}{灯|dēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please turn off the lights as you go out.

vocab.note: {做|zuò}{家务|jiā wù} (do the housework).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{一起|yì qǐ}{做|zuò}{家务|jiā wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two of us do the housework together.

vocab.note: Read báo for "thin"; opposite {厚|hòu}.
vocab.example: {夏天|xià tiān}{盖|gài}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{薄|báo}{被子|bèi zi}{就|jiù}{够|gòu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: In summer a thin duvet is enough.

vocab.note: Opposite {硬|yìng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{沙发|shā fā}{很|hěn}{软|ruǎn}，{很|hěn}{舒服|shū fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This sofa is soft and comfortable.

vocab.note: Opposite {软|ruǎn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{床|chuáng}{太|tài}{硬|yìng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bed is too hard.

vocab.note: {方|fāng}{桌|zhuō} (a square table); {方|fāng}{的|de} / {圆|yuán}{的|de} (square / round).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{买|mǎi}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{方|fāng}{桌|zhuō}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to buy a square table.

vocab.note: {单|dān}{人|rén}{床|chuáng} (a single bed); {菜单|cài dān} (a menu).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{只|zhǐ}{放|fàng}{得|de}{下|xià}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{单|dān}{人|rén}{床|chuáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This room only has space for a single bed.

vocab.note: Written; {舒服|shū fu} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{书房|shū fáng}{又|yòu}{舒适|shū shì}{又|yòu}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new study is cosy and quiet.

vocab.note: {收拾|shōu shi}{得|de}{很|hěn}{整齐|zhěng qí}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{房间|fáng jiān}{总是|zǒng shì}{很|hěn}{整齐|zhěng qí}。
vocab.exampleEn: His room is always tidy.

vocab.note: {美术|měi shù}{学院|xué yuàn} (an art school), {美术|měi shù}{课|kè} (an art class).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{美术|měi shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's loved art since she was little.

vocab.note: Painted with a brush and ink on paper or silk.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{幅|fú}{国画|guó huà}{是|shì}{用|yòng}{毛笔|máo bǐ}{画|huà}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This Chinese painting was done with a brush.

vocab.note: {毛|máo} (hair) + {笔|bǐ} (pen).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{用|yòng}{毛笔|máo bǐ}{写|xiě}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{字|zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He wrote a few characters with a brush.

vocab.note: In children's books: {图画|tú huà}{书|shū} (a picture book).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{在|zài}{纸|zhǐ}{上|shàng}{画|huà}{图画|tú huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are drawing pictures on paper.
