vocab.note: {色彩|sè cǎi}{很|hěn}{淡|dàn} (pale colours), {色彩|sè cǎi}{丰富|fēng fù}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{幅|fú}{画|huà}{的|de}{色彩|sè cǎi}{非常|fēi cháng}{丰富|fēng fù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This painting is very rich in colour.

vocab.note: {彩色|cǎi sè}{照片|zhào piàn} (a colour photo).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{一|yì}{张|zhāng}{爷爷|yé ye}{的|de}{彩色|cǎi sè}{照片|zhào piàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I found a colour photo of Grandpa.

vocab.note: What you see in a painting, a photo or on a screen.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{的|de}{画面|huà miàn}{很|hěn}{美|měi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The pictures in this film are beautiful.

vocab.note: HSK 5 adds "popular": {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{红|hóng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{红|hóng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This song is really popular now.

vocab.note: Mostly in set words: {青|qīng}{山|shān} (green hills), {青|qīng}{菜|cài}.
vocab.example: {远|yuǎn}{处|chǔ}{是|shì}{一|yí}{片|piàn}{青|qīng}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the distance are green hills.

vocab.note: {紫|zǐ}{色|sè} (purple).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{穿|chuān}{了|le}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{紫|zǐ}{色|sè}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's wearing a purple outfit.

vocab.note: {灰|huī} is ash, dust.
vocab.example: {后面|hòu miàn}{是|shì}{灰色|huī sè}{的|de}{老|lǎo}{房子|fáng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Behind are grey old houses.

vocab.note: An idiom: five colours, six colours. As an attributive with {的|de} ({五颜六色|wǔ yán liù sè}{的|de}{花|huā}) or a predicate ({花|huā}{五颜六色|wǔ yán liù sè}).
vocab.example: {公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{花|huā}{五颜六色|wǔ yán liù sè}，{好看|hǎo kàn}{极|jí}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The flowers in the park are every colour you can think of.

vocab.note: {看|kàn}{戏|xì} (to see a play or an opera).
vocab.example: {奶奶|nǎi nai}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{看|kàn}{戏|xì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandma loves going to the theatre.

vocab.note: Drama as an art: {戏剧|xì jù}{学院|xué yuàn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{学|xué}{的|de}{是|shì}{戏剧|xì jù}。
vocab.exampleEn: He studied drama at university.

vocab.note: {大|dà}{剧场|jù chǎng} (a big theatre).
vocab.example: {今|jīn}{晚|wǎn}{剧场|jù chǎng}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{演出|yǎn chū}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a show at the theatre tonight.

vocab.note: {台|tái} stays {台|tái} in traditional.
vocab.example: {演员|yǎn yuán}{们|men}{走|zǒu}{上|shàng}{了|le}{舞台|wǔ tái}。
vocab.exampleEn: The performers walked onto the stage.

vocab.note: {跳舞|tiào wǔ} is the verb.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{从|cóng}{五|wǔ}{岁|suì}{开始|kāi shǐ}{学|xué}{舞蹈|wǔ dǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's studied dance since she was five.

vocab.note: {武|wǔ} (martial) + {术|shù} (art, skill).
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{外国|wài guó}{人|rén}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{学|xué}{武术|wǔ shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many foreigners come to China to learn martial arts.

vocab.note: {打|dǎ}{鼓|gǔ} (to play the drums).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{个|gè}{周末|zhōu mò}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{鼓|gǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He plays the drums every weekend.

vocab.note: Written; {歌|gē} is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{歌曲|gē qǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a very famous song.

vocab.note: {歌|gē} + {词|cí} (words).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{的|de}{歌词|gē cí}{很|hěn}{美|měi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The lyrics of this song are beautiful.

vocab.note: Noun and verb.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{是|shì}{谁|shéi}{导演|dǎo yǎn}{的|de}？
vocab.exampleEn: Who directed this film?

vocab.note: Read jué sè. {演|yǎn}…{的|de}{角色|jué sè} (to play the part of…).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{电影|diàn yǐng}{里|lǐ}{演|yǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{角色|jué sè}。
vocab.exampleEn: She plays a teacher in the film.

vocab.note: {电影|diàn yǐng}{明星|míng xīng} (a film star).
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{明星|míng xīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of young people love celebrities.

vocab.note: {动画|dòng huà}{片|piàn} (a cartoon).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{在|zài}{看|kàn}{动画|dòng huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are watching cartoons.

vocab.note: Written; {拍|pāi} (HSK 4) is the everyday word.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{是|shì}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{拍摄|pāi shè}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: The film was shot in Beijing.

vocab.note: {摄影|shè yǐng}{师|shī} (a photographer).
vocab.example: {退休|tuì xiū}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{他|tā}{迷|mí}{上|shàng}{了|le}{摄影|shè yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: After retiring he got hooked on photography.

vocab.note: {手工|shǒu gōng}{制作|zhì zuò} (made by hand).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{玩具|wán jù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{手工|shǒu gōng}{做|zuò}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: These toys are all handmade.

vocab.note: {手工艺|shǒu gōng yì} (handicraft), {老|lǎo}{工艺|gōng yì}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{工艺|gōng yì}{已经|yǐ jīng}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{百|bǎi}{年|nián}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This craft is several hundred years old.

vocab.note: {设计|shè jì}{师|shī} (a designer).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{舞台|wǔ tái}{设计|shè jì}{得|de}{很|hěn}{完美|wán měi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The stage is perfectly designed.

vocab.note: Writing, painting, music: {创作|chuàng zuò}{歌曲|gē qǔ}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{晚上|wǎn shang}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{创作|chuàng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He creates his work at home in the evenings.

vocab.note: A programme, a model, a dish: {手工|shǒu gōng}{制作|zhì zuò}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{节目|jié mù}{是|shì}{他们|tā men}{自己|zì jǐ}{制作|zhì zuò}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: They made this programme themselves.

vocab.note: {风格|fēng gé}{独特|dú tè} (a distinctive style).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这|zhè}{位|wèi}{画家|huà jiā}{的|de}{风格|fēng gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: I really like this painter's style.

vocab.note: {独|dú} (alone) + {特|tè} (special).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{独特|dú tè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The food at this restaurant is very distinctive.

vocab.note: {经典|jīng diǎn}{电影|diàn yǐng} (a classic film).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{部|bù}{经典|jīng diǎn}{的|de}{老|lǎo}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's a classic old film.

vocab.note: {博|bó} (wide) + {物|wù} (things) + {馆|guǎn} (building).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go to the museum at the weekend.

vocab.note: Mostly the noun: {看|kàn}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{结束|jié shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exhibition ends next month.

vocab.note: {展出|zhǎn chū}{了|le}{一百|yì bǎi}{多|duō}{件|jiàn}{作品|zuò pǐn}.
vocab.example: {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{展出|zhǎn chū}{了|le}{一百|yì bǎi}{多|duō}{件|jiàn}{作品|zuò pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum has over a hundred works on show.

vocab.note: Showing something to people: {展示|zhǎn shì}{作品|zuò pǐn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{向|xiàng}{大家|dà jiā}{展示|zhǎn shì}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{作品|zuò pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He showed everyone his work.

vocab.note: A quality or a side: {展现|zhǎn xiàn}{了|le}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{美|měi}.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{照片|zhào piàn}{展现|zhǎn xiàn}{了|le}{老|lǎo}{城|chéng}{的|de}{美|měi}。
vocab.exampleEn: These photos show the beauty of the old city.

vocab.note: {欣赏|xīn shǎng}{音乐|yīn yuè}; also {欣赏|xīn shǎng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén} (to admire someone).
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{在|zài}{这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{照片|zhào piàn}{前面|qián miàn}{欣赏|xīn shǎng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many people stood admiring this photo for a long time.

vocab.note: {鼓|gǔ} (drum, beat) + {掌|zhǎng} (palm).
vocab.example: {演出|yǎn chū}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{站|zhàn}{起来|qǐ lái}{鼓掌|gǔ zhǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: When the show ended, everyone stood up and applauded.

vocab.note: {热烈|rè liè}{的|de}{掌声|zhǎng shēng} (warm applause).
vocab.example: {剧场|jù chǎng}{里|lǐ}{响|xiǎng}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{掌声|zhǎng shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Applause rang out in the theatre.

vocab.note: For causes, arts, a country, life: {热爱|rè ài}{音乐|yīn yuè}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{很|hěn}{热爱|rè ài}{音乐|yīn yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's always loved music.

vocab.note: Needs an object: {擅长|shàn cháng}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{擅长|shàn cháng}{画|huà}{国画|guó huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's good at Chinese painting.

vocab.note: {迷|mí}{上|shàng} (to get hooked on); {球迷|qiú mí} (a football fan).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{最近|zuì jìn}{迷|mí}{上|shàng}{了|le}{摄影|shè yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's recently got hooked on photography.

vocab.note: {带|dài}{来|lái}{乐趣|lè qù} (bring pleasure).
vocab.example: {画|huà}{画儿|huàr}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{带|dài}{来|lái}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{乐趣|lè qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Painting has given me a lot of pleasure.

vocab.note: {业余|yè yú}{画家|huà jiā} (an amateur painter), {业余|yè yú}{时间|shí jiān} (free time).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{业余|yè yú}{画家|huà jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's an amateur painter.

vocab.note: {户外|hù wài}{活动|huó dòng} (outdoor activities).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{常|cháng}{去|qù}{户外|hù wài}{走走|zǒu zou}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends we often get out into the open air.

vocab.note: Read liǎo bu qǐ. {真|zhēn}{了不起|liǎo bu qǐ}！ (Amazing!)
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{做|zuò}{完|wán}{了|le}，{真|zhēn}{了不起|liǎo bu qǐ}！
vocab.exampleEn: He did it all by himself: amazing!

vocab.note: {完美|wán měi}{的|de}{演出|yǎn chū} (a perfect performance).
vocab.example: {世界|shì jiè}{上|shàng}{没有|méi yǒu}{完美|wán měi}{的|de}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Nobody in the world is perfect.

vocab.note: {优美|yōu měi}{的|de}{音乐|yīn yuè}, {风景|fēng jǐng}{优美|yōu měi}.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{风景|fēng jǐng}{很|hěn}{优美|yōu měi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The scenery here is lovely.

vocab.note: {动人|dòng rén}{的|de}{故事|gù shi} (a moving story).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{动人|dòng rén}{的|de}{故事|gù shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's a very moving story.

vocab.note: Spoken and lively: {超级|chāo jí}{好看|hǎo kàn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{超级|chāo jí}{好看|hǎo kàn}！
vocab.exampleEn: This film is super good!

vocab.note: {疯|fēng} (mad) + {狂|kuáng} (wild).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{他们|tā men}{打|dǎ}{鼓|gǔ}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{可|kě}{疯狂|fēng kuáng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends they really go wild on the drums.

vocab.note: {激烈|jī liè}{的|de}{比赛|bǐ sài} (a fierce match).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{非常|fēi cháng}{激烈|jī liè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The match was very intense.

vocab.note: Read hào: {好学|hào xué} (studious), {好动|hào dòng} (restless), {好客|hào kè} (hospitable), {爱好|ài hào}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{很|hěn}{好学|hào xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: This child is very studious.

vocab.note: {养|yǎng}{宠物|chǒng wù} (to keep a pet).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{家|jiā}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{宠物|chǒng wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: They have two pets at home.

vocab.note: {喂|wèi}{猫|māo} (feed the cat). Same sound as {喂|wèi} "hello", another word.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{得|děi}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{喂|wèi}{猫|māo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have to go home and feed the cat.

vocab.note: {玩|wán} + {具|jù} (implement).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{玩具|wán jù}{是|shì}{手工|shǒu gōng}{制作|zhì zuò}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: These toys are handmade.

vocab.note: {投|tóu}{球|qiú} (to throw a ball).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{球|qiú}{投|tóu}{给|gěi}{了|le}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He threw the ball to me.

vocab.note: {挥|huī}{手|shǒu} (to wave one's hand).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{车|chē}{上|shàng}{向|xiàng}{我们|wǒ men}{挥|huī}{手|shǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She waved to us from the bus.

vocab.note: {哈|hā}{哈|hā} (haha); {哈|hā}{哈|hā}{大|dà}{笑|xiào} (to roar with laughter).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{听|tīng}{了|le}{以后|yǐ hòu}{哈|hā}{哈|hā}{大|dà}{笑|xiào}。
vocab.exampleEn: He roared with laughter when he heard it.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{支|zhī}{歌|gē}, {一|yì}{支|zhī}{笔|bǐ}, {一|yì}{支|zhī}{球队|qiú duì}. {首|shǒu} is more common for songs.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{唱|chàng}{了|le}{一|yì}{支|zhī}{很|hěn}{好听|hǎo tīng}{的|de}{歌|gē}。
vocab.exampleEn: He sang a lovely song.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{匹|pǐ}{马|mǎ} (a horse), {一|yì}{匹|pǐ}{布|bù} (a bolt of cloth).
vocab.example: {草地|cǎo dì}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{匹|pǐ}{马|mǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are a few horses on the grass.

vocab.note: Can stand before {的|de} or {之间|zhī jiān} ({彼此|bǐ cǐ}{的|de}{了解|liǎo jiě}, {彼此|bǐ cǐ}{之间|zhī jiān}), which {互相|hù xiāng} (an adverb) seldom does. {彼此|bǐ cǐ}{彼此|bǐ cǐ}: same to you, likewise.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{认识|rèn shi}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年|nián}{了|le}，{彼此|bǐ cǐ}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{了解|liǎo jiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've known each other for years and understand each other well.

vocab.note: Often negative: {始终|shǐ zhōng}{没|méi}{说话|shuō huà}. Unlike {一直|yì zhí}, it can't run up to a point in time ({一直|yì zhí}{等到|děng dào}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}).
vocab.example: {开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他|tā}{始终|shǐ zhōng}{没|méi}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He didn't say a single word all through the meeting.

vocab.note: Verb: {我们|wǒ men}{分别|fēn bié}{了|le}{十|shí}{年|nián} (we were apart for ten years). Adverb: {分别|fēn bié}{跟|gēn}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{谈|tán} (separately), {分别|fēn bié}{来自|lái zì}{北京|Běi jīng}{和|hé}{上海|Shàng hǎi} (respectively).
vocab.example: {大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{分别|fēn bié}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After university we went our separate ways.

vocab.note: Before a verb ({单独|dān dú}{谈|tán}{谈|tán}) or with {的|de} before a noun ({单独|dān dú}{的|de}{房间|fáng jiān}). Compare {独自|dú zì}: by oneself, before a verb only.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{能|néng}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{单独|dān dú}{谈|tán}{谈|tán}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can I talk to you in private?

vocab.note: Before a verb only, often with {一|yì}{人|rén}: {独自|dú zì}{一|yì}{人|rén}. Not ×{独自|dú zì}{的|de}{房间|fáng jiān} (say {单独|dān dú}{的|de}{房间|fáng jiān}).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{独自|dú zì}{一|yì}{人|rén}{来|lái}{到|dào}{了|le}{这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She came to this city all on her own.

vocab.note: {处|chǔ} is chǔ here. {跟|gēn}…{相处|xiāng chǔ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}: get on well with.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{跟|gēn}{同事|tóng shì}{们|men}{相处|xiāng chǔ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He gets on well with his colleagues.

vocab.note: chǔ, third tone ({相处|xiāng chǔ}, {处理|chǔ lǐ}). The noun {处|chù} (a place, an office) is lesson 23's.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{俩|liǎ}{处|chǔ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two of us get on very well.

vocab.note: In {合得来|hé de lái} / {合不来|hé bu lái} (to get on / not get on), {合适|hé shì} (HSK 3); "to close": {合|hé}{上|shàng}{书|shū}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{性格|xìng gé}{合不来|hé bu lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: His personality and mine don't get on.

vocab.note: People or matters: {对待|duì dài}{朋友|péng you}, {对待|duì dài}{工作|gōng zuò}. "Treat (someone to a meal)" is {请|qǐng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{真诚|zhēn chéng}{地|de}{对待|duì dài}{别人|bié ren}，{别人|bié ren}{也|yě}{会|huì}{真诚|zhēn chéng}{地|de}{对待|duì dài}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you treat others sincerely, they'll treat you sincerely too.

vocab.note: A little formal for friends; between two people it often means dating.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{交往|jiāo wǎng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}{就|jiù}{结婚|jié hūn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: They went out for two years and then got married.

vocab.note: People, a culture, a new field: {接触|jiē chù}{新|xīn}{的|de}{文化|wén huà}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{国|guó}{外|wài}{留学|liú xué}，{能|néng}{接触|jiē chù}{到|dào}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Studying abroad, you come into contact with lots of different people.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{信任|xìn rèn}{他|tā}; {建立|jiàn lì}{信任|xìn rèn} (build trust). Not {新人|xīn rén} xīn rén (newlyweds, lesson 12).
vocab.example: {朋友|péng you}{之间|zhī jiān}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{是|shì}{信任|xìn rèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Between friends, trust matters most.

vocab.note: Literally ({靠|kào}{在|zài}{墙|qiáng}{上|shàng}) and figuratively ({靠|kào}{自己|zì jǐ}, rely on yourself).
vocab.example: {在|zài}{国|guó}{外|wài}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{事情|shì qing}{只能|zhǐ néng}{靠|kào}{自己|zì jǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Abroad, you have to rely on yourself for a lot of things.

vocab.note: People and information: {可靠|kě kào}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}, {可靠|kě kào}{的|de}{消息|xiāo xi}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{可靠|kě kào}{的|de}{人|rén}，{交|jiāo}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{的|de}{事|shì}{都|dōu}{能|néng}{办|bàn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very reliable: whatever you give him to do, he gets done.

vocab.note: {学习|xué xí}{伙伴|huǒ bàn} (study partner), {合作|hé zuò}{伙伴|huǒ bàn} (business partner). Not a romantic partner ({对象|duì xiàng}, lesson 12).
vocab.example: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou}，{他|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{最好|zuì hǎo}{的|de}{伙伴|huǒ bàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: When we were little, he was my best companion.

vocab.note: Informal, often a little negative: {一|yì}{伙|huǒ}{人|rén}. For a neutral group, say {一些|yì xiē}{人|rén}.
vocab.example: {门口|mén kǒu}{站|zhàn}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{伙|huǒ}{人|rén}，{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{在|zài}{等|děng}{谁|shéi}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a bunch of people standing at the door; no idea who they're waiting for.

vocab.note: Between {朋友|péng you} and {陌生|mò shēng}{人|rén}. {熟|shú} also has the spoken reading shóu.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{一|yí}{个|gè}{熟人|shú rén}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I don't know a soul here.

vocab.note: {陌生|mò shēng}{人|rén}: a stranger. {陌|mò} is mò.
vocab.example: {刚|gāng}{来|lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{说|shuō}{很|hěn}{陌生|mò shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I first came, this city was quite strange to me.

vocab.note: Written partner of {别人|bié ren}: {尊重|zūn zhòng}{他人|tā rén}, {帮助|bāng zhù}{他人|tā rén}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{应该|yīng gāi}{尊重|zūn zhòng}{他人|tā rén}{的|de}{选择|xuǎn zé}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should respect other people's choices.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {私人|sī rén}{问题|wèn tí}, {私人|sī rén}{生活|shēng huó}, {私人|sī rén}{医生|yī shēng}.
vocab.example: {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{私人|sī rén}{问题|wèn tí}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sorry, that's a personal matter.

vocab.note: Noun and adjective: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{秘密|mì mì}; {秘密|mì mì}{地|de} (secretly).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{俩|liǎ}{的|de}{秘密|mì mì}，{别|bié}{告诉|gào su}{别人|bié ren}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is our secret: don't tell anyone.

vocab.note: Mostly in {人际|rén jì}{关系|guān xi} (relationships with other people) and {人际|rén jì}{交往|jiāo wǎng}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{新|xīn}{公司|gōng sī}，{人际|rén jì}{关系|guān xi}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: In a new company, relationships with people are important.

vocab.note: {建立|jiàn lì}{关系|guān xi}, {建立|jiàn lì}{友谊|yǒu yì}, {建立|jiàn lì}{信任|xìn rèn}. Not {简历|jiǎn lì} jiǎn lì (CV, lesson 01).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{在|zài}{工作|gōng zuò}{中|zhōng}{建立|jiàn lì}{了|le}{深厚|shēn hòu}{的|de}{友谊|yǒu yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: They built a deep friendship through work.

vocab.note: {增进|zēng jìn}{了解|liǎo jiě}, {增进|zēng jìn}{感情|gǎn qíng}, {增进|zēng jìn}{友谊|yǒu yì}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{交流|jiāo liú}{活动|huó dòng}{增进|zēng jìn}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{国|guó}{学生|xué sheng}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{了解|liǎo jiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exchange improved understanding between students of the two countries.

vocab.note: {付出|fù chū}{时间|shí jiān}, {付出|fù chū}{努力|nǔ lì}, {付出|fù chū}{感情|gǎn qíng}.
vocab.example: {好|hǎo}{的|de}{友谊|yǒu yì}{需要|xū yào}{双方|shuāng fāng}{的|de}{付出|fù chū}。
vocab.exampleEn: A good friendship takes effort from both sides.

vocab.note: The written partner of {找|zhǎo}: {寻找|xún zhǎo}{机会|jī huì}, {寻找|xún zhǎo}{答案|dá àn}.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{来|lái}{大|dà}{城市|chéng shì}{寻找|xún zhǎo}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many young people come to big cities to look for opportunities.

vocab.note: {提起|tí qǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén} / {一|yí}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}; {一|yì}{提起|tí qǐ}…{就|jiù}… (whenever… is mentioned).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一|yì}{提起|tí qǐ}{他|tā}{的|de}{故乡|gù xiāng}，{就|jiù}{特别|tè bié}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Whenever he mentions his hometown, he lights up.

vocab.note: {换|huàn}{个|gè}{话题|huà tí} (change the subject), {共同|gòng tóng}{的|de}{话题|huà tí} (things in common to talk about).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{共同|gòng tóng}{的|de}{话题|huà tí}，{一|yì}{聊|liáo}{就是|jiù shì}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: We have so much to talk about that we chat for hours.

vocab.note: Verb and noun; can split: {谈|tán}{了|le}{一|yí}{次|cì}{话|huà}.
vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{想|xiǎng}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{谈|tán}{一|yí}{次|cì}{话|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager would like to have a talk with you.

meanings: to agree on (a time, a plan)
vocab.note: Verb and noun: {约定|yuē dìng}{时间|shí jiān}; {遵守|zūn shǒu}{约定|yuē dìng} (keep an agreement).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{约定|yuē dìng}{每|měi}{年|nián}{见|jiàn}{一|yí}{次|cì}{面|miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We agreed to meet once a year.

vocab.note: Of people and feelings: {真诚|zhēn chéng}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}, {真诚|zhēn chéng}{地|de}{道歉|dào qiàn}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{对|duì}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{真诚|zhēn chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's sincere with everyone.

vocab.note: {热心|rè xīn}{人|rén}: someone always ready to help. {热心|rè xīn}{地|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}{别人|bié ren}.
vocab.example: {邻居|lín jū}{李阿姨|Lǐ ā yí}{是|shì}{个|gè}{热心|rè xīn}{人|rén}，{谁|shéi}{家|jiā}{有|yǒu}{事|shì}{她|tā}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{帮忙|bāng máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our neighbour Auntie Li is so helpful: whenever anyone has a problem, she comes to help.

vocab.note: Of a person's nature; {善|shàn} is "good".
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{善良|shàn liáng}{的|de}{人|rén}，{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{坏|huài}{话|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a kind person who never speaks ill of anyone.

vocab.note: What makes someone different: {很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{个性|gè xìng} (a real character). {性格|xìng gé} (HSK 4) is temperament.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{俩|liǎ}{个性|gè xìng}{不同|bù tóng}，{可是|kě shì}{很|hěn}{合得来|hé de lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our personalities are different, but we get on well.

vocab.note: Opposite {短处|duǎn chù}. {处|chǔ} is chù here (fourth tone).
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{长处|cháng chù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone has their own strong points.

vocab.note: Opposite {长处|cháng chù}; {缺点|quē diǎn} (HSK 4) is close.
vocab.example: {朋友|péng you}{之间|zhī jiān}{应该|yīng gāi}{多|duō}{看|kàn}{长处|cháng chù}，{少|shǎo}{说|shuō}{短处|duǎn chù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Friends should look at each other's strong points and not dwell on the weak ones.

vocab.note: {深厚|shēn hòu}{的|de}{友谊|yǒu yì}, {深厚|shēn hòu}{的|de}{感情|gǎn qíng}; also knowledge: {深厚|shēn hòu}{的|de}{基础|jī chǔ}.
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{位|wèi}{老人|lǎo rén}{之间|zhī jiān}{有|yǒu}{深厚|shēn hòu}{的|de}{友谊|yǒu yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a deep friendship between the two old people.

vocab.note: {关系|guān xi}{密切|mì qiè}; {密切|mì qiè}{联系|lián xì} (keep in close touch); {密切|mì qiè}{注意|zhù yì} (watch closely).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{关系|guān xi}{很|hěn}{密切|mì qiè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two companies have very close ties.

vocab.note: {长久|cháng jiǔ}{的|de}{友谊|yǒu yì}; {长久|cháng jiǔ}{以来|yǐ lái} (for a long time).
vocab.example: {真诚|zhēn chéng}{是|shì}{长久|cháng jiǔ}{友谊|yǒu yì}{的|de}{基础|jī chǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sincerity is the basis of a lasting friendship.

vocab.note: With {的|de} before a noun: {唯一|wéi yī}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}. "I only have one…" is {我|wǒ}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}….
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{唯一|wéi yī}{的|de}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is our only chance.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{次|cì}{偶然|ǒu rán}{的|de}{机会|jī huì}; {偶然|ǒu rán}{遇见|yù jiàn}. Not {偶尔|ǒu ěr} (occasionally, HSK 4).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{是|shì}{在|zài}{一|yí}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{中|zhōng}{偶然|ǒu rán}{认识|rèn shi}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: We met by chance on a trip.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{碰|pèng} (don't touch); {碰|pèng}{到|dào} (to bump into; to come across).
vocab.example: {小心|xiǎo xīn}，{别|bié}{碰|pèng}{到|dào}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{的|de}{杯子|bēi zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Careful: don't knock the cup on the table.

vocab.note: Spoken partner of {遇见|yù jiàn}.
vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{地铁|dì tiě}{上|shàng}{碰见|pèng jiàn}{了|le}{中学|zhōng xué}{同学|tóng xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: Yesterday I ran into a school friend on the metro.

vocab.note: Falling tone ò: understanding something just now.
vocab.example: {哦|ò}，{原来|yuán lái}{是|shì}{你|nǐ}{啊|a}！
vocab.exampleEn: Oh, it's you!

vocab.note: The same as {竟然|jìng rán} (HSK 4); the surprise can be good or bad. Opposite: {果然|guǒ rán} (as expected).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{学|xué}{了|le}{半|bàn}{年|nián}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{居然|jū rán}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{懂|dǒng}{中文|Zhōng wén}{电影|diàn yǐng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's only studied Chinese for half a year, and would you believe it, he can understand Chinese films.

vocab.note: Confirms something said or thought before: {听说|tīng shuō}…，{果然|guǒ rán}…. Can open a clause: {果然|guǒ rán}，….
vocab.example: {听说|tīng shuō}{今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{雨|yǔ}，{下午|xià wǔ}{果然|guǒ rán}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd heard it would rain today, and sure enough it rained in the afternoon.

vocab.note: dàng, fourth tone: {把|bǎ} A {当|dàng} B; {他们|tā men}{当|dàng}{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{一|yì}{家人|jiā rén}. HSK 4's {当|dāng} dāng is "to act as, to be".
vocab.example: {别|bié}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{当|dàng}{孩子|hái zi}，{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{二十五|èr shí wǔ}{岁|suì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't treat me like a child: I'm twenty-five.

vocab.note: {把|bǎ} A {当成|dàng chéng} B: treat A as B, or take A for B by mistake.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{当成|dàng chéng}{服务员|fú wù yuán}{了|le}，{真|zhēn}{不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}。
vocab.exampleEn: I took him for a waiter: how embarrassing.

vocab.note: A little more written than {当成|dàng chéng}: {把|bǎ}{阳台|yáng tái}{当作|dàng zuò}{书房|shū fáng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一直|yì zhí}{把|bǎ}{这里|zhè lǐ}{当作|dàng zuò}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's always treated this place as his own home.

vocab.note: Written: {称|chēng} A {为|wéi} B; A {被|bèi}{称为|chēng wéi} B. Spoken: {叫|jiào}. The same character is "to weigh" (lesson 07).
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{称|chēng}{她|tā}{为|wéi}"{李老师|Lǐ lǎo shī}"，{其实|qí shí}{她|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone calls her "Teacher Li", but she isn't actually a teacher.

meanings: to be in love (be going out)
vocab.note: {谈|tán}{恋爱|liàn ài}: to go out with someone ({谈|tán}{了|le}{三|sān}{年|nián}{恋爱|liàn ài}).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{就|jiù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{谈|tán}{恋爱|liàn ài}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: They started going out at university.

vocab.note: {找|zhǎo}{对象|duì xiàng} (look for a partner); also "target, the people concerned": {调查|diào chá}{对象|duì xiàng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{对象|duì xiàng}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Are you seeing anyone?

vocab.note: {追|zhuī} + a person: to court; {追|zhuī}{上|shàng} (to catch up with).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{追|zhuī}{了|le}{她|tā}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}，{她|tā}{才|cái}{答应|dā ying}{做|zuò}{他|tā}{的|de}{女朋友|nǚ péng you}。
vocab.exampleEn: He courted her for two years before she agreed to be his girlfriend.

vocab.note: {很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{魅力|mèi lì} (very charming); {城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{魅力|mèi lì}. Not {美丽|měi lì} měi lì (beautiful).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{老|lǎo}{城|chéng}{的|de}{魅力|mèi lì}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{它|tā}{的|de}{老|lǎo}{房子|fáng zi}{和|hé}{小|xiǎo}{街|jiē}。
vocab.exampleEn: The charm of this old town lies in its old houses and little streets.

vocab.note: {打扮|dǎ ban}{得|de}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}; {他|tā}{的|de}{打扮|dǎ ban}{很|hěn}{随便|suí biàn} (he dresses casually).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{有|yǒu}{婚礼|hūn lǐ}，{她|tā}{早上|zǎo shang}{打扮|dǎ ban}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{多|duō}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a wedding today, and she spent over an hour getting ready this morning.

vocab.note: Blunt; about people, {不|bù}{好看|hǎo kàn} is kinder. Traditional 醜 (the simple {丑|chǒu} there is the clown role).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{颜色|yán sè}{太|tài}{丑|chǒu}{了|le}，{换|huàn}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: This colour's hideous: try another one.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{束|shù}{玫瑰|méi guī} (a bunch of roses, lesson 15); the second syllable is often light in speech.
vocab.example: {情人节|qíng rén jié}{那|nà}{天|tiān}，{花店|huā diàn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{玫瑰|méi guī}{特别|tè bié}{贵|guì}。
vocab.exampleEn: On Valentine's Day, the roses at the florist's are especially expensive.

vocab.note: Noun and adjective: {给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{惊喜|jīng xǐ}; {又惊又喜|yòu jīng yòu xǐ} (surprised and delighted).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{在|zài}{她|tā}{生日|shēng rì}{那|nà}{天|tiān}{给|gěi}{她|tā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{惊喜|jīng xǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I want to give her a surprise on her birthday.

vocab.note: A little more formal than {抱|bào}; {拥抱|yōng bào}{在|zài}{一起|yì qǐ}.
vocab.example: {十|shí}{年|nián}{没|méi}{见|jiàn}，{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{老|lǎo}{朋友|péng you}{紧紧|jǐn jǐn}{地|de}{拥抱|yōng bào}{在|zài}{一起|yì qǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Not having seen each other for ten years, the two old friends hugged tightly.

vocab.note: Mostly {亲爱|qīn ài}{的|de}: to open a letter ({亲爱|qīn ài}{的|de}{妈妈|mā ma}) and between couples.
vocab.example: {亲爱|qīn ài}{的|de}，{你|nǐ}{今天|jīn tiān}{累|lèi}{不|bu}{累|lèi}？
vocab.exampleEn: Darling, are you tired today?

vocab.note: {珍惜|zhēn xī}{时间|shí jiān}, {珍惜|zhēn xī}{机会|jī huì}, {珍惜|zhēn xī}{彼此|bǐ cǐ}.
vocab.example: {要|yào}{珍惜|zhēn xī}{和|hé}{家人|jiā rén}{在|zài}{一起|yì qǐ}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Treasure the time you have with your family.

vocab.note: More written and warmer than {陪|péi} (HSK 4); also the noun: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{陪伴|péi bàn}.
vocab.example: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{这些|zhè xiē}{年|nián}{一直|yì zhí}{陪伴|péi bàn}{着|zhe}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you for being there with me all these years.

vocab.note: From the side of the one left: {他|tā}{失恋|shī liàn}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{刚|gāng}{失恋|shī liàn}，{心情|xīn qíng}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}，{你|nǐ}{多|duō}{陪|péi}{陪|péi}{他|tā}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's just been dumped and he's feeling low: spend some time with him.

vocab.note: Can split: {分|fēn}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{手|shǒu}. {跟|gēn}…{分手|fēn shǒu} (break up with…).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{跟|gēn}{男朋友|nán péng you}{分手|fēn shǒu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's broken up with her boyfriend.

vocab.note: Can split: {离|lí}{过|guo}{婚|hūn}. {跟|gēn}…{离婚|lí hūn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{父母|fù mǔ}{很|hěn}{早|zǎo}{就|jiù}{离婚|lí hūn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His parents divorced a long time ago.

vocab.note: {举行|jǔ xíng}{婚礼|hūn lǐ} (hold a wedding); {参加|cān jiā}{婚礼|hūn lǐ} (go to a wedding).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{的|de}{婚礼|hūn lǐ}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{举行|jǔ xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Their wedding was held in a small park.

vocab.note: At the wedding; afterwards he's simply {丈夫|zhàng fu} or {先生|xiān sheng}.
vocab.example: {新郎|xīn láng}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}{得|de}{说不出话来|shuō bu chū huà lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: The groom was so nervous he couldn't get a word out.

vocab.note: {新郎|xīn láng} and {新娘|xīn niáng}: a sound pair (-áng).
vocab.example: {新娘|xīn niáng}{今天|jīn tiān}{特别|tè bié}{漂亮|piào liang}。
vocab.exampleEn: The bride looks especially beautiful today.

vocab.note: At a wedding, the couple: {一|yí}{对|duì}{新人|xīn rén}; at work, a newcomer. Not {信任|xìn rèn} xìn rèn (trust).
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{一起|yì qǐ}{祝|zhù}{这|zhè}{对|duì}{新人|xīn rén}{幸福|xìng fú}！
vocab.exampleEn: Let's all wish the happy couple happiness!

vocab.note: Written; after a name: {王先生|Wáng xiān sheng}{夫妇|fū fù} (Mr and Mrs Wang). In speech, {夫妻|fū qī} (HSK 3).
vocab.example: {住|zhù}{在|zài}{楼|lóu}{上|shàng}{的|de}{是|shì}{一|yí}{对|duì}{老|lǎo}{夫妇|fū fù}。
vocab.exampleEn: An elderly couple live upstairs.

vocab.note: Warm and casual; to strangers, {我|wǒ}{先生|xiān sheng} or {我|wǒ}{丈夫|zhàng fu} is safer.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{老公|lǎo gōng}{今天|jīn tiān}{加班|jiā bān}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: My husband's working late today, so I'm eating alone tonight.

vocab.note: Warm and casual; to strangers, {我|wǒ}{太太|tài tai} or {我|wǒ}{妻子|qī zi} is safer.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{下班|xià bān}{都|dōu}{给|gěi}{老婆|lǎo po}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He rings his wife every day after work.

vocab.note: After a surname, Mrs: {王太太|Wáng tài tai}. {我|wǒ}{太太|tài tai} is a polite "my wife".
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{太太|tài tai}，{她|tā}{也|yě}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is my wife; she works at the university too.

vocab.note: In {结婚|jié hūn}, {结束|jié shù}, {结果|jié guǒ}; {结|jié}{成|chéng} (to form): {结|jié}{成|chéng}{好|hǎo}{朋友|péng you}. The jiē of {结果|jiē guǒ} (to bear fruit) is HSK 6's.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{是|shì}{在|zài}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{中|zhōng}{结|jié}{成|chéng}{好|hǎo}{朋友|péng you}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: They became good friends on a trip.

vocab.note: {人生|rén shēng}{大事|dà shì} (a great event of a lifetime: marriage).
vocab.example: {结婚|jié hūn}{是|shì}{人生|rén shēng}{大事|dà shì}，{你|nǐ}{要|yào}{想|xiǎng}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Marriage is a big step in life: think it through.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{套|tào}{西装|xī zhuāng}; {穿|chuān}{西装|xī zhuāng}.
vocab.example: {面试|miàn shì}{那|nà}{天|tiān}，{他|tā}{穿|chuān}{了|le}{一|yí}{套|tào}{新|xīn}{西装|xī zhuāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the day of the interview he wore a new suit.

vocab.note: {打|dǎ}{领带|lǐng dài} / {系|jì}{领带|lǐng dài} (jì, lesson 15): to put on a tie.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{领带|lǐng dài}{的|de}{颜色|yán sè}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: That tie's a nice colour.

vocab.note: {戴|dài}{手套|shǒu tào}; {一|yí}{副|fù}{手套|shǒu tào} (a pair, lesson 15).
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{戴|dài}{手套|shǒu tào}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's cold out: don't forget your gloves.

vocab.note: {戴|dài}{围巾|wéi jīn} or {围|wéi}{围巾|wéi jīn}; {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{围巾|wéi jīn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{围巾|wéi jīn}{是|shì}{妈妈|mā ma}{送|sòng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: My mum gave me this scarf.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{牛仔裤|niú zǎi kù}; {穿|chuān}{牛仔裤|niú zǎi kù}.
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{他|tā}{总是|zǒng shì}{穿|chuān}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{牛仔裤|niú zǎi kù}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends he always wears jeans.

meanings: when all is said and done
vocab.note: Gives the deciding fact: {他|tā}{毕竟|bì jìng}{是|shì}{个|gè}{孩子|hái zi}. Not in questions (there, {到底|dào dǐ}: on earth).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{怪|guài}{他|tā}{了|le}，{他|tā}{毕竟|bì jìng}{才|cái}{来|lái}{公司|gōng sī}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't blame him: after all, he's only been with the company a month.

vocab.note: Before a negative: {根本|gēn běn}{不|bù} / {根本|gēn běn}{没|méi} (not at all). Before a noun: fundamental ({根本|gēn běn}{原因|yuán yīn}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}{我|wǒ}{根本|gēn běn}{听不懂|tīng bu dǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't understand a word he says.

vocab.note: Written {本来|běn lái}: {本|běn}{想|xiǎng}…, {本|běn}{应|yīng}…. Also "this, our" in formal language: {本人|běn rén}, {本|běn}{公司|gōng sī}, {本|běn}{周|zhōu}. HSK 1's {本|běn} is the measure word.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{本|běn}{想|xiǎng}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{出发|chū fā}，{可是|kě shì}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd meant to set off earlier, but it rained.

vocab.note: kān, first tone: {看|kān}{孩子|hái zi}, {看|kān}{家|jiā}, {看|kān}{门|mén}. HSK 1's {看|kàn} is kàn (to look).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{看|kān}{孩子|hái zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the weekend I have to stay home and mind the kids.

vocab.note: {年轻|nián qīng}{一代|yí dài}, {我们|wǒ men}{这|zhè}{一代|yí dài}{人|rén}, {下|xià}{一代|yí dài}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{一代|yí dài}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{烦恼|fán nǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every generation has its own worries.

vocab.note: With a number: {三|sān}{代|dài}{人|rén}. A period: {唐代|Táng dài}. A verb: {代|dài}{我|wǒ}{问|wèn}{好|hǎo} (give my regards).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{家|jiā}{四|sì}{代|dài}{人|rén}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Four generations of their family live in one courtyard.

meanings: to be reluctant to part with
vocab.note: {舍不得|shě bu de} + a noun ({舍不得|shě bu de}{这些|zhè xiē}{书|shū}) or a verb ({舍不得|shě bu de}{离开|lí kāi}, {舍不得|shě bu de}{花|huā}{钱|qián}).
vocab.example: {要|yào}{走|zǒu}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{都|dōu}{舍不得|shě bu de}{离开|lí kāi}{外婆|wài pó}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: When it was time to go, the children couldn't bear to leave their grandma's.

meanings: to be willing to part with
vocab.note: Mostly in questions and contrasts: {你|nǐ}{舍得|shě de}{吗|ma}？ {他|tā}{很|hěn}{舍得|shě de}{花|huā}{钱|qián}.
vocab.example: {这么|zhè me}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{房子|fáng zi}，{你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{舍得|shě de}{卖|mài}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you really bring yourself to sell such a lovely flat?

vocab.note: Opens stories ({从前|cóng qián}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}…); also "formerly", in contrast with now.
vocab.example: {从前|cóng qián}{这里|zhè lǐ}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{村|cūn}{子|zi}，{现在|xiàn zài}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{一|yí}{座|zuò}{城市|chéng shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This used to be a little village; now it's become a city.

vocab.note: dāng nián: the time you're talking about. ({当年|dāng nián} dàng nián, "that same year", is another word.)
vocab.example: {当年|dāng nián}{我们|wǒ men}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{胡同|hú tòng}{里|lǐ}，{冬天|dōng tiān}{特别|tè bié}{冷|lěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Back then we lived in a hutong, and the winters were bitterly cold.

vocab.note: A little written; usually in contrast with the past.
vocab.example: {如今|rú jīn}，{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{也|yě}{会|huì}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: These days more and more old people can shop on their phones too.

vocab.note: The written {还是|hái shi} / {仍然|réng rán}: {依然|yī rán}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}, {依然|yī rán}{没|méi}{变|biàn}.
vocab.example: {十|shí}{年|nián}{过去|guò qù}{了|le}，{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{风景|fēng jǐng}{依然|yī rán}{那么|nà me}{美|měi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Ten years on, the scenery here is still just as beautiful.

vocab.note: A little literary; in speech {老家|lǎo jiā} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{离开|lí kāi}{故乡|gù xiāng}{已经|yǐ jīng}{三十|sān shí}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's thirty years since he left his hometown.

vocab.note: Northern China, Beijing included; elsewhere {外婆|wài pó}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{是|shì}{姥姥|lǎo lao}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{带|dài}{大|dà}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandma brought me up when I was little.

vocab.note: Northern; elsewhere {外公|wài gōng}.
vocab.example: {姥爷|lǎo ye}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}{锻炼|duàn liàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa goes to the park to exercise every morning.

vocab.note: Southern and standard; in the north {姥爷|lǎo ye}.
vocab.example: {外公|wài gōng}{做|zuò}{的|de}{红烧肉|hóng shāo ròu}{最|zuì}{好吃|hǎo chī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa's braised pork is the best.

vocab.note: Southern and standard; in the north {姥姥|lǎo lao}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{年|nián}{过年|guò nián}，{我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{外婆|wài pó}{家|jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every New Year we go to Grandma's.

vocab.note: Polite address for an older man, especially in Beijing: {大爷|dà ye}，{请问|qǐng wèn}…
vocab.example: {大爷|dà ye}，{请问|qǐng wèn}{去|qù}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{怎么|zěn me}{走|zǒu}？
vocab.exampleEn: Excuse me, sir, how do I get to the metro station?

vocab.note: Polite address for a woman of about your parents' or grandparents' age, especially in the north.
vocab.example: {楼|lóu}{下|xià}{的|de}{大妈|dà mā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The lady downstairs goes dancing every evening.

vocab.note: A person's own children: {他|tā}{的|de}{儿女|ér nǚ}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{外地|wài dì}{工作|gōng zuò}.
vocab.example: {老人|lǎo rén}{最|zuì}{大|dà}{的|de}{愿望|yuàn wàng}{就是|jiù shì}{儿女|ér nǚ}{都|dōu}{健康|jiàn kāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The old couple's greatest wish is for their children to be healthy.

vocab.note: More formal than {儿女|ér nǚ}: {子女|zǐ nǚ}{教育|jiào yù}, {独生子女|dú shēng zǐ nǚ} (only child).
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{父母|fù mǔ}{愿意|yuàn yì}{为|wèi}{子女|zǐ nǚ}{的|de}{教育|jiào yù}{花|huā}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many parents are willing to spend a lot on their children's education.

vocab.note: What parents call a small child: {宝贝|bǎo bèi}，{快|kuài}{来|lái}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}！ Also a treasured object.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{只|zhī}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{女儿|nǚ ér}{的|de}{宝贝|bǎo bèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This puppy is my daughter's treasure.

vocab.note: {宝宝|bǎo bao} (baby); something treasured: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{宝|bǎo}.
vocab.example: {爷爷|yé ye}{说|shuō}，{这些|zhè xiē}{老|lǎo}{书|shū}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{他|tā}{的|de}{宝|bǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa says these old books are his treasures.

vocab.note: {宝贵|bǎo guì}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}, {宝贵|bǎo guì}{的|de}{经验|jīng yàn}, {宝贵|bǎo guì}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}. For objects and memories, {珍贵|zhēn guì}.
vocab.example: {谢谢|xiè xie}{您|nín}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{提|tí}{了|le}{这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{宝贵|bǎo guì}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you for all your valuable suggestions.

vocab.note: {珍贵|zhēn guì}{的|de}{照片|zhào piàn}, {珍贵|zhēn guì}{的|de}{礼物|lǐ wù}, {珍贵|zhēn guì}{的|de}{回忆|huí yì}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{老|lǎo}{照片|zhào piàn}{对|duì}{我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{来|lái}{说|shuō}{非常|fēi cháng}{珍贵|zhēn guì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This old photo is very precious to our family.

vocab.note: Adjective ({难得|nán dé}{的|de}{机会|jī huì}) and adverb ({难得|nán dé}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{一|yí}{次|cì}: hardly ever / for once comes home).
vocab.example: {这么|zhè me}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{天气|tiān qì}{真|zhēn}{难得|nán dé}，{我们|wǒ men}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Weather this good is rare: let's go out for a walk.

vocab.note: {藏|cáng}{在|zài}…{里|lǐ}, {藏|cáng}{起来|qǐ lái}. {藏|cáng} cáng; the zàng of {宝|bǎo}{藏|cáng} (hidden treasure) is another reading.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{把|bǎ}{礼物|lǐ wù}{藏|cáng}{在|zài}{了|le}{床|chuáng}{下面|xià miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children hid the present under the bed.

vocab.note: A person's growing up, often figurative: {在|zài}{工作|gōng zuò}{中|zhōng}{成长|chéng zhǎng}. {长|zhǎng} is zhǎng here.
vocab.example: {父母|fù mǔ}{都|dōu}{希望|xī wàng}{孩子|hái zi}{健康|jiàn kāng}{快乐|kuài lè}{地|de}{成长|chéng zhǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: All parents hope their children grow up healthy and happy.

vocab.note: People ({他|tā}{很|hěn}{成熟|chéng shú}), fruit ({苹果|píng guǒ}{成熟|chéng shú}{了|le}), plans ({条件|tiáo jiàn}{还|hái}{不|bù}{成熟|chéng shú}).
vocab.example: {经历|jīng lì}{了|le}{这么|zhè me}{多|duō}{事|shì}，{他|tā}{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{成熟|chéng shú}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After all he's been through, he's much more mature than before.

vocab.note: {成年|chéng nián}{人|rén} (an adult); {十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{成年|chéng nián}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}，{十八|shí bā}{岁|suì}{就是|jiù shì}{成年|chéng nián}{人|rén}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: In China you're an adult at eighteen.

vocab.note: Before nouns: {成人|chéng rén}{票|piào}, {成人|chéng rén}{教育|jiào yù}. Not {承认|chéng rèn} chéng rèn (to admit, lesson 14).
vocab.example: {成人|chéng rén}{票|piào}{八十|bā shí}{块|kuài}，{儿童|ér tóng}{票|piào}{四十|sì shí}{块|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Adult tickets are eighty yuan, children's forty.

vocab.note: {独立|dú lì}{生活|shēng huó} (live independently); {很|hěn}{独立|dú lì} (very independent).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}{以后|yǐ hòu}{就|jiù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{独立|dú lì}{生活|shēng huó}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's lived independently since she started university.

vocab.note: People kept apart, often for a long time: {跟|gēn}{家人|jiā rén}{分离|fēn lí}; things separated: {把|bǎ}…{分离|fēn lí}.
vocab.example: {为了|wèi le}{工作|gōng zuò}，{他|tā}{和|hé}{家人|jiā rén}{分离|fēn lí}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Because of work, he was apart from his family for two years.

vocab.note: {您|nín}{多|duō}{大|dà}{年纪|nián jì}{了|le}？ (to an older person); {年纪|nián jì}{大|dà}{了|le} (getting on). Not {年级|nián jí} nián jí (school year).
vocab.example: {奶奶|nǎi nai}{年纪|nián jì}{大|dà}{了|le}，{耳朵|ěr duo}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandma's getting on, and her hearing isn't very good.

vocab.note: The respectful word; {死|sǐ} is blunt.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{外公|wài gōng}{去年|qù nián}{去世|qù shì}{了|le}，{他|tā}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}。
vocab.exampleEn: His grandfather passed away last year, and he's very sad.

vocab.note: Of children (and pets), often affectionately.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{很|hěn}{调皮|tiáo pí}，{一|yí}{刻|kè}{也|yě}{停不下来|tíng bu xià lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: This child is so mischievous: never still for a moment.

vocab.note: People, buildings, trees: {高大|gāo dà}{的|de}{男子|nán zǐ}, {高大|gāo dà}{的|de}{树|shù}.
vocab.example: {路|lù}{两|liǎng}{边|biān}{是|shì}{高大|gāo dà}{的|de}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tall trees line both sides of the road.

vocab.note: News and signs: {一|yì}{名|míng}{男子|nán zǐ}, {男子|nán zǐ}{组|zǔ}. In speech {男|nán}{的|de} / {男人|nán rén}.
vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}，{一|yì}{名|míng}{男子|nán zǐ}{在|zài}{河|hé}{边|biān}{救|jiù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{孩子|hái zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Yesterday a man saved a child by the river.

vocab.note: News and signs: {一|yì}{名|míng}{女子|nǚ zǐ}, {女子|nǚ zǐ}{组|zǔ}. In speech {女|nǚ}{的|de} / {女人|nǚ rén}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{得|dé}{了|le}{女子|nǚ zǐ}{跳高|tiào gāo}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She came first in the women's high jump.

vocab.note: Formal, of women as a social group: {妇女|fù nǚ}{的|de}{地位|dì wèi}, {妇女|fù nǚ}{节|jié}. Not {父女|fù nǚ} fù nǚ (father and daughter).
vocab.example: {三|sān}{月|yuè}{八|bā}{日|rì}{是|shì}{国际|guó jì}{妇女|fù nǚ}{节|jié}。
vocab.exampleEn: The eighth of March is International Women's Day.

vocab.note: The people closest to you; for wider family, {亲戚|qīn qi} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {在|zài}{国|guó}{外|wài}{过年|guò nián}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他|tā}{特别|tè bié}{想念|xiǎng niàn}{亲人|qīn rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Spending New Year abroad, he misses his family terribly.

vocab.note: Compare {友情|yǒu qíng} (friendship) and {爱情|ài qíng} (romantic love).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{讲|jiǎng}{的|de}{是|shì}{父子|fù zǐ}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{亲情|qīn qíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This film is about the love between a father and his son.

vocab.note: {亲|qīn}{兄弟|xiōng dì}, {亲|qīn}{姐妹|jiě mèi}, {亲生|qīn shēng}; also close: {他们|tā men}{俩|liǎ}{很|hěn}{亲|qīn}. As a verb, to kiss: {亲|qīn}{了|le}{一下|yí xià}.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{虽然|suī rán}{不|bú}{是|shì}{亲|qīn}{兄弟|xiōng dì}，{可是|kě shì}{比|bǐ}{亲|qīn}{兄弟|xiōng dì}{还|hái}{亲|qīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: They aren't real brothers, but they're closer than real brothers.

vocab.note: A person: {尊敬|zūn jìng}{老人|lǎo rén}, {尊敬|zūn jìng}{老师|lǎo shī}; {尊敬|zūn jìng}{的|de}… opens formal letters. {尊重|zūn zhòng} (HSK 4) is to respect a choice, a right.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{尊敬|zūn jìng}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a teacher people look up to.

vocab.note: Someone you care about: {看望|kàn wàng}{父母|fù mǔ}, {看望|kàn wàng}{病人|bìng rén}. {看|kàn} is kàn here.
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}{看望|kàn wàng}{了|le}{生病|shēng bìng}{的|de}{同事|tóng shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the weekend we went to the hospital to visit a colleague who was ill.

vocab.note: A little more written than {想|xiǎng}: {想念|xiǎng niàn}{家人|jiā rén}, {想念|xiǎng niàn}{故乡|gù xiāng}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{国|guó}{外|wài}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{想念|xiǎng niàn}{的|de}{是|shì}{妈妈|mā ma}{做|zuò}{的|de}{饭|fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I was abroad, what I missed most was my mum's cooking.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {依靠|yī kào}{自己|zì jǐ}; {他|tā}{是|shì}{全|quán}{家|jiā}{的|de}{依靠|yī kào}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{现在|xiàn zài}{只能|zhǐ néng}{依靠|yī kào}{自己|zì jǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Now he can only rely on himself.

vocab.note: {扶|fú}{老人|lǎo rén}{过|guò}{马路|mǎ lù}; {扶|fú}{起来|qǐ lái} (help up); {扶|fú}{着|zhe}{墙|qiáng} (hold on to the wall).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{扶|fú}{着|zhe}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{慢慢|màn màn}{地|de}{走|zǒu}{上|shàng}{楼|lóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She helped her grandma slowly up the stairs.

vocab.note: {社会|shè huì}{地位|dì wèi} (social status), {妇女|fù nǚ}{的|de}{地位|dì wèi}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{公司|gōng sī}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{地位|dì wèi}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She holds a senior position in the company.

vocab.note: {身份证|shēn fèn zhèng} (identity card); also one's position or role: {他|tā}{的|de}{身份|shēn fèn}{是|shì}{记者|jì zhě}.
vocab.example: {坐|zuò}{火车|huǒ chē}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài}{身份证|shēn fèn zhèng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't forget your ID card when you take the train.

vocab.note: A result against expectation: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{帮|bāng}{他|tā}，{他|tā}{反而|fǎn ér}{生气|shēng qì}{了|le}. With {不但|bú dàn}{不|bù} / {没|méi}…{反而|fǎn ér}….
vocab.example: {休息|xiū xi}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}，{他|tā}{的|de}{病|bìng}{反而|fǎn ér}{更|gèng}{重|zhòng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After a few days' rest, his illness actually got worse.

vocab.note: {简直|jiǎn zhí}{太|tài}…{了|le}, {简直|jiǎn zhí}{像|xiàng}…{一样|yí yàng}, {简直|jiǎn zhí}{不|bù}{敢|gǎn}{相信|xiāng xìn}. Needs something to exaggerate.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{简直|jiǎn zhí}{太|tài}{难|nán}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{也|yě}{没|méi}{做|zuò}{出来|chū lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: This question is just impossible: I've thought about it for an hour and still can't do it.

vocab.note: + a two-syllable verb: {难以|nán yǐ}{相信|xiāng xìn}, {难以|nán yǐ}{接受|jiē shòu}, {难以|nán yǐ}{忘记|wàng jì}. Spoken: {很|hěn}{难|nán}….
vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}{话|huà}{令|lìng}{人|rén}{难以|nán yǐ}{相信|xiāng xìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: What he says is hard to believe.

vocab.note: Mostly {令|lìng}{人|rén} + a feeling: {令|lìng}{人|rén}{失望|shī wàng}, {令|lìng}{人|rén}{感动|gǎn dòng}, {令|lìng}{人|rén}{难忘|nán wàng}. Spoken: {让|ràng}{人|rén}.
vocab.example: {比赛|bǐ sài}{的|de}{结果|jié guǒ}{令|lìng}{所有|suǒ yǒu}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{吃惊|chī jīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The result of the match astonished everyone.

vocab.note: Noun ({有|yǒu}{矛盾|máo dùn}, {解决|jiě jué}{矛盾|máo dùn}) and adjective ({心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{矛盾|máo dùn}: torn). From the spear-and-shield story of the {韩非子|Hán Fēi zǐ}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{和|hé}{同事|tóng shì}{之间|zhī jiān}{有|yǒu}{一些|yì xiē}{小|xiǎo}{矛盾|máo dùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a bit of friction between her and a colleague.

vocab.note: Adjective: {太|tài}{吵|chǎo}{了|le}. Verb: {吵|chǎo}{了|le}{一|yí}{架|jià} (had a row), {吵|chǎo}{醒|xǐng} (wake with noise).
vocab.example: {楼|lóu}{上|shàng}{太|tài}{吵|chǎo}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{根本|gēn běn}{睡不着|shuì bu zháo}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's so noisy upstairs I can't sleep at all.

vocab.note: {争|zhēng}{了|le}{起来|qǐ lái} (started arguing); {争|zhēng}{第|dì}{一|yī} (compete for first place).
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{孩子|hái zi}{为了|wèi le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{玩具|wán jù}{争|zhēng}{了|le}{起来|qǐ lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two children started squabbling over a toy.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{闹|nào}{了|le} (stop it); {闹|nào}{矛盾|máo dùn} (to fall out); {热闹|rè nao} (lively, HSK 4).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{在|zài}{外面|wài miàn}{闹|nào}{了|le}{一|yí}{下午|xià wǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children were making a racket outside all afternoon.

vocab.note: {被|bèi}…{骂|mà}{了|le}{一|yí}{顿|dùn} (got a telling-off); {骂|mà}{人|rén} (to swear at people).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{上班|shàng bān}{迟到|chí dào}，{被|bèi}{经理|jīng lǐ}{骂|mà}{了|le}{一|yí}{顿|dùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He was late for work and got a telling-off from the manager.

vocab.note: Verb: {这|zhè}{不|bù}{能|néng}{怪|guài}{你|nǐ} (it's not your fault), {都|dōu}{怪|guài}{我|wǒ}. Adjective: {很|hěn}{怪|guài} (strange, HSK 3).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{都|dōu}{怪|guài}{我|wǒ}，{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{说|shuō}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is all my fault: I didn't make myself clear.

vocab.note: {球|qiú}{滚|gǔn}{到|dào}{了|le}{床|chuáng}{下|xià} (the ball rolled under the bed). Said to a person, {滚|gǔn}！ is very rude.
vocab.example: {小心|xiǎo xīn}，{苹果|píng guǒ}{滚|gǔn}{到|dào}{地上|dì shang}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Careful, the apple's rolled onto the floor.

vocab.note: {你|nǐ}{太|tài}{过分|guò fèn}{了|le}! (you've gone too far); {过分|guò fèn}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú} (an unreasonable demand).
vocab.example: {开玩笑|kāi wán xiào}{可以|kě yǐ}，{可是|kě shì}{不|bù}{能|néng}{开|kāi}{得|de}{太|tài}{过分|guò fèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Joking is fine, but don't take it too far.

vocab.note: {抱怨|bào yuàn}{工作|gōng zuò} / {抱怨|bào yuàn}{天气|tiān qì}; {抱怨|bào yuàn}{说|shuō}….
vocab.example: {他|tā}{总是|zǒng shì}{抱怨|bào yuàn}{工资|gōng zī}{太|tài}{低|dī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's always complaining his pay is too low.

vocab.note: Opposite {承认|chéng rèn}: {否认|fǒu rèn}{自己|zì jǐ}{做|zuò}{过|guo}….
vocab.example: {他|tā}{否认|fǒu rèn}{自己|zì jǐ}{拿|ná}{了|le}{那|nà}{本|běn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: He denies taking the book.

vocab.note: {承认|chéng rèn}{错误|cuò wù} (admit a mistake). Not {成人|chéng rén} chéng rén (adult, lesson 13).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{承认|chéng rèn}，{这|zhè}{次|cì}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{得|de}{不|bú}{对|duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I admit I got it wrong this time.

vocab.note: {打断|dǎ duàn}{别人|bié ren}{说话|shuō huà} (interrupt someone).
vocab.example: {别|bié}{打断|dǎ duàn}{我|wǒ}，{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{话|huà}{说|shuō}{完|wán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't interrupt: let me finish.

vocab.note: Verb, adjective and noun: {沉默|chén mò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}; {他|tā}{很|hěn}{沉默|chén mò}; {打破|dǎ pò}{沉默|chén mò} (break the silence).
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{沉默|chén mò}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: When they heard the news, everyone fell silent.

vocab.note: Literally ({低|dī}{着|zhe}{头|tóu}) and figuratively, "to give in" ({向|xiàng}{困难|kùn nan}{低头|dī tóu}). Opposite {抬头|tái tóu}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{低|dī}{着|zhe}{头|tóu}，{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}{也|yě}{不|bù}{说|shuō}。
vocab.exampleEn: He kept his head down and didn't say a word.

vocab.note: {劝|quàn}{他|tā}{别|bié}…, {劝|quàn}{他|tā}{去|qù}…; trying, not necessarily succeeding ({说服|shuō fú} is succeeding).
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{劝|quàn}{他|tā}{少|shǎo}{喝|hē}{点儿|diǎnr}{酒|jiǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone urged him to drink less.

vocab.note: {说服|shuō fú} + a person + a verb: {我|wǒ}{终于|zhōng yú}{说服|shuō fú}{他|tā}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{医生|yī shēng}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{花|huā}{了|le}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}{才|cái}{说服|shuō fú}{爸爸|bà ba}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{新|xīn}{手机|shǒu jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: It took us ages to talk Dad into buying a new phone.

vocab.note: Verb and noun, a little formal: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{请求|qǐng qiú}; {请求|qǐng qiú}{帮助|bāng zhù}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{请求|qǐng qiú}{老师|lǎo shī}{再|zài}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{一|yí}{次|cì}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He asked the teacher to give him one more chance.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {安慰|ān wèi}{她|tā}; {给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{安慰|ān wèi}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{没|méi}{考|kǎo}{好|hǎo}，{我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{安慰|ān wèi}{她|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: She didn't do well in the exam, so we all went to comfort her.

vocab.note: {同情|tóng qíng}{他|tā} (feel for him); {得到|dé dào}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{同情|tóng qíng}.
vocab.example: {听说|tīng shuō}{他|tā}{丢|diū}{了|le}{工作|gōng zuò}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{同情|tóng qíng}{他|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone felt sorry for him when they heard he'd lost his job.

vocab.note: {忍|rěn}{着|zhe}; {忍不住|rěn bu zhù} (can't help); {忍|rěn}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{忍|rěn}{着|zhe}{疼|téng}，{把|bǎ}{比赛|bǐ sài}{跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He ran the rest of the race through the pain.

vocab.note: Often negative or in questions: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{在乎|zài hu}; {你|nǐ}{在乎|zài hu}{吗|ma}？
vocab.example: {别人|bié ren}{怎么|zěn me}{说|shuō}，{我|wǒ}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bú}{在乎|zài hu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I don't care at all what other people say.

vocab.note: Bodies and feelings: {伤害|shāng hài}{了|le}{她|tā}{的|de}{感情|gǎn qíng}; {受到|shòu dào}{伤害|shāng hài}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{故意|gù yì}{要|yào}{伤害|shāng hài}{你|nǐ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: I didn't mean to hurt you.

vocab.note: Strong: physical or mental suffering. {很|hěn}{痛苦|tòng kǔ}; {痛苦|tòng kǔ}{的|de}{经历|jīng lì}.
vocab.example: {分手|fēn shǒu}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{他|tā}{痛苦|tòng kǔ}{了|le}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the break-up he was miserable for a long time.

vocab.note: {很|hěn}{遗憾|yí hàn} (what a pity; regrettably); {太|tài}{遗憾|yí hàn}{了|le}; {唯一|wéi yī}{的|de}{遗憾|yí hàn}.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{遗憾|yí hàn}，{这|zhè}{次|cì}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{能|néng}{去|qù}{参加|cān jiā}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{婚礼|hūn lǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm very sorry, but I won't be able to come to your wedding.

vocab.note: {无奈|wú nài}{地|de}{笑|xiào}{了|le}{笑|xiào} (smiled helplessly); {很|hěn}{无奈|wú nài}.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{比赛|bǐ sài}{只能|zhǐ néng}{取消|qǔ xiāo}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{无奈|wú nài}。
vocab.exampleEn: It rained, the match had to be cancelled, and there was nothing anyone could do.

vocab.note: {不幸|bú xìng}{的|de}{是|shì}… (unfortunately…); {不幸|bú xìng}{的|de}{消息|xiāo xi}.
vocab.example: {不幸|bú xìng}{的|de}{是|shì}，{那|nà}{天|tiān}{他|tā}{正好|zhèng hǎo}{生病|shēng bìng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Unfortunately, he happened to be ill that day.

vocab.note: Of people ({她|tā}{很|hěn}{敏感|mǐn gǎn}) and topics ({敏感|mǐn gǎn}{的|de}{话题|huà tí}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{敏感|mǐn gǎn}，{你|nǐ}{说话|shuō huà}{要|yào}{注意|zhù yì}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very sensitive: be careful what you say.

vocab.note: Strength of character: {坚强|jiān qiáng}{的|de}{人|rén}; {要|yào}{坚强|jiān qiáng}.
vocab.example: {妈妈|mā ma}{病|bìng}{了|le}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{她|tā}{变|biàn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{坚强|jiān qiáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: After her mother fell ill, she became very strong.

vocab.note: Opposite {大胆|dà dǎn} (lesson 05).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{胆小|dǎn xiǎo}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{不|bù}{敢|gǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{出门|chū mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very timid: he won't go out alone at night.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{傻|shǎ}{了|le} (don't be silly); {傻|shǎ}{笑|xiào} (to grin foolishly). Can be affectionate.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{傻|shǎ}，{这么|zhè me}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{机会|jī huì}{都|dōu}{不要|bú yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: You're so silly, turning down such a good chance.

vocab.note: {严肃|yán sù}{的|de}{表情|biǎo qíng}; {严肃|yán sù}{地|de}{说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{表情|biǎo qíng}{突然|tū rán}{变|biàn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{严肃|yán sù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher's expression suddenly turned serious.

vocab.note: Of people and water: {平静|píng jìng}{地|de}{说|shuō}; {湖|hú}{面|miàn}{很|hěn}{平静|píng jìng}.
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{完|wán}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}，{她|tā}{很|hěn}{平静|píng jìng}，{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}{也|yě}{没|méi}{说|shuō}。
vocab.exampleEn: When she heard the news she stayed calm and said nothing.

vocab.note: {强烈|qiáng liè}{的|de}{感情|gǎn qíng}, {强烈|qiáng liè}{的|de}{阳光|yáng guāng}; {强烈|qiáng liè}{反对|fǎn duì}.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{强烈|qiáng liè}{反对|fǎn duì}{这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many people are strongly against the plan.

vocab.note: {彻底|chè dǐ}{解决|jiě jué}, {彻底|chè dǐ}{改变|gǎi biàn}, {彻底|chè dǐ}{失败|shī bài}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{把|bǎ}{问题|wèn tí}{彻底|chè dǐ}{解决|jiě jué}。
vocab.exampleEn: This time the problem has to be solved once and for all.

vocab.note: Usually with a negative: {不要|bú yào}{轻易|qīng yì}{放弃|fàng qì} (don't give up lightly).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{轻易|qīng yì}{答应|dā ying}{别人|bié ren}。
vocab.exampleEn: He never makes promises lightly.

vocab.note: {悄悄|qiāo qiāo}{地|de}{走|zǒu}{了|le} (slipped away); {悄悄|qiāo qiāo}{地|de}{告诉|gào su}{你|nǐ} (between you and me).
vocab.example: {为了|wèi le}{不|bù}{吵|chǎo}{醒|xǐng}{孩子|hái zi}，{她|tā}{悄悄|qiāo qiāo}{地|de}{关|guān}{上|shàng}{了|le}{门|mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: So as not to wake the baby, she closed the door very quietly.

vocab.note: Place ({房子|fáng zi}{背后|bèi hòu}) and manner: {在|zài}{背后|bèi hòu}{说|shuō}{别人|bié ren} (talk behind people's backs).
vocab.example: {在|zài}{别人|bié ren}{背后|bèi hòu}{说|shuō}{坏|huài}{话|huà}{是|shì}{不|bú}{对|duì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's wrong to speak ill of people behind their backs.

vocab.note: Written: {大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{目光|mù guāng}; also foresight: {目光|mù guāng}{长远|cháng yuǎn}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{一|yì}{走|zǒu}{进来|jìn lái}，{所有|suǒ yǒu}{人|rén}{的|de}{目光|mù guāng}{都|dōu}{看|kàn}{向|xiàng}{了|le}{她|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: The moment she walked in, every eye turned to her.

vocab.note: {表情|biǎo qíng}{很|hěn}{严肃|yán sù} / {很|hěn}{奇怪|qí guài}; {没有|méi yǒu}{表情|biǎo qíng}.
vocab.example: {看|kàn}{他|tā}{的|de}{表情|biǎo qíng}，{就|jiù}{知道|zhī dào}{他|tā}{不|bú}{太|tài}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can tell from his face that he's not happy.

vocab.note: {情绪|qíng xù}{不|bù}{好|hǎo} (in a bad mood); {控制|kòng zhì}{情绪|qíng xù} (control one's emotions).
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{以前|yǐ qián}，{他|tā}{的|de}{情绪|qíng xù}{很|hěn}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before the exam he was very tense.

vocab.note: More written than {感情|gǎn qíng}: {人|rén}{的|de}{情感|qíng gǎn}, {表达|biǎo dá}{情感|qíng gǎn}.
vocab.example: {音乐|yīn yuè}{能|néng}{表达|biǎo dá}{语言|yǔ yán}{难以|nán yǐ}{表达|biǎo dá}{的|de}{情感|qíng gǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Music can express feelings that words can hardly express.

vocab.note: {当时|dāng shí}{的|de}{情景|qíng jǐng} (the scene at the time); {想|xiǎng}{起|qǐ}{那个|nà ge}{情景|qíng jǐng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{到|dào}{现在|xiàn zài}{还|hái}{记得|jì de}{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{见面|jiàn miàn}{的|de}{情景|qíng jǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I still remember the scene when we first met.

vocab.note: {心理|xīn lǐ}{压力|yā lì}, {心理|xīn lǐ}{学|xué}, {心理|xīn lǐ}{医生|yī shēng}. Not {心里|xīn li} xīn li (in one's heart).
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{前|qián}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{心理|xīn lǐ}{压力|yā lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many students feel under pressure before exams.

vocab.note: Verb mostly as {意识|yì shí}{到|dào} (to realise); noun: {安全|ān quán}{意识|yì shí} (safety awareness).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{这|zhè}{才|cái}{意识|yì shí}{到|dào}，{自己|zì jǐ}{说|shuō}{错|cuò}{话|huà}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Only then did I realise I'd said the wrong thing.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {他|tā}{的|de}{反应|fǎn yìng}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}; {没有|méi yǒu}{反应|fǎn yìng}. Not {反映|fǎn yìng} fǎn yìng (to reflect, lesson 24).
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{他|tā}{半天|bàn tiān}{没有|méi yǒu}{反应|fǎn yìng}{过来|guò lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: When he heard the question, it took him ages to react.

vocab.note: Alone mostly in set phrases and writing: {流|liú}{泪|lèi} (to shed tears).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{看|kàn}{着|zhe}{老|lǎo}{照片|zhào piàn}，{流|liú}{下|xià}{了|le}{泪|lèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: She looked at the old photos, and tears ran down her face.

vocab.note: Written partner of {眼泪|yǎn lèi}: {泪水|lèi shuǐ}{流|liú}{了|le}{下来|xià lái}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{眼|yǎn}{里|lǐ}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{泪水|lèi shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: His eyes were full of tears.

vocab.note: The everyday word: {流|liú}{眼泪|yǎn lèi}, {擦|cā}{眼泪|yǎn lèi} (wipe away tears).
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{好|hǎo}{消息|xiāo xi}，{妈妈|mā ma}{高兴|gāo xìng}{得|de}{流|liú}{下|xià}{了|le}{眼泪|yǎn lèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mum was so happy at the news that she cried.

vocab.note: āi, first tone: calling someone, or mild surprise. Not {唉|ài} ài (a sigh).
vocab.example: {哎|āi}，{你|nǐ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{掉|diào}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Hey, you've dropped your phone!

vocab.note: Dismay or surprise: {哎呀|āi yā}，{我|wǒ}{忘|wàng}{了|le}！
vocab.example: {哎呀|āi yā}，{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{钥匙|yào shi}{忘|wàng}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Oh no, I've left my keys at home!

vocab.note: ài, fourth tone: a sigh of regret or tiredness.
vocab.example: {唉|ài}，{又|yòu}{要|yào}{加班|jiā bān}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sigh, overtime again.

vocab.note: yā: surprise. As a particle after a, e, i, o, ü it is light ya ({好|hǎo}{呀|yā}).
vocab.example: {呀|yā}，{外面|wài miàn}{下|xià}{雪|xuě}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Oh, it's snowing outside!

vocab.note: {替|tì} + person + verb: {我|wǒ}{替|tì}{你|nǐ}{去|qù} (I'll go instead of you), {替|tì}{我|wǒ}{问|wèn}{好|hǎo}, {替|tì}{你|nǐ}{高兴|gāo xìng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{太|tài}{累|lèi}{了|le}，{今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{替|tì}{你|nǐ}{做饭|zuò fàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: You're worn out: I'll cook for you today.

vocab.note: Someone takes the trouble personally: {校长|xiào zhǎng}{亲自|qīn zì}{来|lái}{了|le}. For everyday things, {自己|zì jǐ}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{封|fēng}{信|xìn}{是|shì}{总经理|zǒng jīng lǐ}{亲自|qīn zì}{写|xiě}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: The general manager wrote this letter himself.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{朵|duǒ}{花|huā}, {一|yì}{朵|duǒ}{白|bái}{云|yún}. A bunch is {一|yí}{束|shù}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{头发|tóu fa}{上|shàng}{别|bié}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{朵|duǒ}{小|xiǎo}{红|hóng}{花|huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: She had a little red flower pinned in her hair.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{束|shù}{花|huā}, {一|yí}{束|shù}{玫瑰|méi guī}; {一|yí}{束|shù}{光|guāng} (a beam of light).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{给|gěi}{老师|lǎo shī}{送|sòng}{了|le}{一|yí}{束|shù}{鲜花|xiān huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: We gave our teacher a bunch of flowers.

meanings: pair, set (measure word: {一|yí}{副|fù}{眼镜|yǎn jìng})
vocab.note: Things used as a set: {一|yí}{副|fù}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}, {一|yí}{副|fù}{手套|shǒu tào}; also a look: {一|yí}{副|fù}{笑|xiào}{脸|liǎn}. Shoes and socks take {双|shuāng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yí}{副|fù}{新|xīn}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's bought a new pair of glasses.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{朵|duǒ}{花|huā} (with a flower pinned on). HSK 2's {别|bié} is "don't".
vocab.example: {新郎|xīn láng}{的|de}{西装|xī zhuāng}{上|shàng}{别|bié}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{朵|duǒ}{玫瑰|méi guī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The groom has a rose pinned to his suit.

vocab.note: jì: {系|jì}{领带|lǐng dài}, {系鞋带|jì xié dài}. Traditional 繫. {={系|xì}=} (a department) is lesson 17's.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{礼物|lǐ wù}{上|shàng}{系|jì}{了|le}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{红|hóng}{带|dài}{子|zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He tied a red ribbon round the present.

vocab.note: Of guests ({主人|zhǔ rén}{和|hé}{客人|kè rén}) and of things ({这|zhè}{只|zhī}{狗|gǒu}{的|de}{主人|zhǔ rén}). Not {主任|zhǔ rèn} zhǔ rèn (director, lesson 02).
vocab.example: {主人|zhǔ rén}{请|qǐng}{我们|wǒ men}{坐|zuò}{下|xià}，{又|yòu}{给|gěi}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{倒|dào}{了|le}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{茶|chá}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our hosts asked us to sit down and poured everyone a cup of tea.

vocab.note: Only for the other person: {您|nín}{贵姓|guì xìng}？—{我|wǒ}{姓|xìng}{王|Wáng} (or, modestly, {免贵|miǎn guì}{姓|xìng}{王|Wáng}).
vocab.example: {请问|qǐng wèn}，{您|nín}{贵姓|guì xìng}？
vocab.exampleEn: Excuse me, may I ask your surname?

vocab.note: {欢迎|huān yíng}{光临|guāng lín} (shops, restaurants); {敬请光临|jìng qǐng guāng lín} (on invitations).
vocab.example: {欢迎|huān yíng}{光临|guāng lín}，{请问|qǐng wèn}{几|jǐ}{位|wèi}？
vocab.exampleEn: Welcome! How many of you are there?

vocab.note: {恭喜|gōng xǐ}{恭喜|gōng xǐ}！ {恭喜|gōng xǐ}{你|nǐ}！ {恭喜发财|gōng xǐ fā cái} (New Year: wishing you prosperity). {祝贺|zhù hè} (HSK 4) is more formal.
vocab.example: {听说|tīng shuō}{你|nǐ}{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{新|xīn}{工作|gōng zuò}{了|le}，{恭喜|gōng xǐ}{恭喜|gōng xǐ}！
vocab.exampleEn: I hear you've found a new job: congratulations!

vocab.note: {称赞|chēng zàn}{他|tā}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}; {受到|shòu dào}{称赞|chēng zàn} (be praised). In speech, {夸|kuā} (HSK 6) is common.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{称赞|chēng zàn}{她|tā}{的|de}{作文|zuò wén}{写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher praised her composition.

vocab.note: A quiet smile; {笑|xiào} (HSK 2) is laughing or smiling. {微笑|wēi xiào}{着|zhe}{说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{微笑|wēi xiào}{着|zhe}{向|xiàng}{我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{点头|diǎn tóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She smiled and nodded to us.

vocab.note: {握|wò}{着|zhe}{他|tā}{的|de}{手|shǒu} (holding his hand); {握手|wò shǒu} (to shake hands); {掌握|zhǎng wò} (to master, lesson 16).
vocab.example: {奶奶|nǎi nai}{紧紧|jǐn jǐn}{地|de}{握|wò}{着|zhe}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手|shǒu}，{舍不得|shě bu de}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{走|zǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandma held my hand tight and couldn't bear to let me go.

vocab.note: Can split: {握|wò}{了|le}{握手|wò shǒu}; {跟|gēn}…{握手|wò shǒu}.
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{见面|jiàn miàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{握|wò}{了|le}{握手|wò shǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two of them shook hands when they met.

vocab.note: {摇|yáo}{头|tóu} (shake one's head: no), {摇|yáo}{手|shǒu} (wave one's hand).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{问|wèn}{他|tā}{去|qù}{不|bu}{去|qù}，{他|tā}{摇|yáo}{了|le}{摇|yáo}{头|tóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I asked him if he was going, and he shook his head.

vocab.note: How a person seems: {亲切|qīn qiè}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}; also what feels close and familiar: {很|hěn}{亲切|qīn qiè}.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{来|lái}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}{说话|shuō huà}{很|hěn}{亲切|qīn qiè}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new teacher has a warm way of talking, and the students all like her.

vocab.note: {热烈|rè liè}{欢迎|huān yíng}, {热烈|rè liè}{的|de}{掌声|zhǎng shēng}; a lively discussion: {讨论|tǎo lùn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{热烈|rè liè}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{讲|jiǎng}{完|wán}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{大家|dà jiā}{热烈|rè liè}{地|de}{鼓掌|gǔ zhǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: When he finished, everyone applauded warmly.

vocab.note: Weather, a home, kindness: {温暖|wēn nuǎn}{的|de}{家|jiā}; {你|nǐ}{的|de}{话|huà}{很|hěn}{温暖|wēn nuǎn}.
vocab.example: {虽然|suī rán}{外面|wài miàn}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{可是|kě shì}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{温暖|wēn nuǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's cold outside, but it's warm at home.

vocab.note: In {平安|píng ān}, {晚安|wǎn ān}, {不|bù}{安|ān} (uneasy), and in wishes: {一路|yí lù}{平安|píng ān}.
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{还|hái}{没|méi}{回|huí}{家|jiā}，{妈妈|mā ma}{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{安|ān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child isn't home yet, and Mum is uneasy.

vocab.note: {改天|gǎi tiān}{再说|zài shuō} (let's talk about it another day); {改天|gǎi tiān}{再|zài}{来|lái} (come again some time).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{太|tài}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{改天|gǎi tiān}{再|zài}{聊|liáo}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too late today: let's talk another day.

vocab.note: In wishes and letters: {愿|yuàn}{你|nǐ}{一切|yí qiè}{顺利|shùn lì}. {愿意|yuàn yì} (HSK 3) is "to be willing".
vocab.example: {愿|yuàn}{你们|nǐ men}{永远|yǒng yuǎn}{幸福|xìng fú}！
vocab.exampleEn: May you be happy for ever!

vocab.note: Written: {赠|zèng}{书|shū}, {赠|zèng}{给|gěi}…; on signed books, {赠|zèng} + name.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{是|shì}{作者|zuò zhě}{赠|zèng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: The author gave me this book.

vocab.note: Formal: {赠送|zèng sòng}{礼物|lǐ wù}; in shops, {买一送一|mǎi yí sòng yī} / {赠送|zèng sòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}….
vocab.example: {买|mǎi}{两|liǎng}{本|běn}{书|shū}，{赠送|zèng sòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{笔记本|bǐ jì běn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Buy two books and get a free notebook.

vocab.note: {交换|jiāo huàn}{礼物|lǐ wù}, {交换|jiāo huàn}{名片|míng piàn}, {交换|jiāo huàn}{意见|yì jiàn}; {交换生|jiāo huàn shēng} (exchange student).
vocab.example: {新年|xīn nián}{晚会|wǎn huì}{上|shàng}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{互相|hù xiāng}{交换|jiāo huàn}{了|le}{礼物|lǐ wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the New Year party, the students swapped presents.

meanings: to pass on (from one to the next)
vocab.note: {传递|chuán dì}{消息|xiāo xi}, {传递|chuán dì}{信息|xìn xī}, {传递|chuán dì}{东西|dōng xi}.
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{一|yí}{个|gè}{地|de}{把|bǎ}{水|shuǐ}{传递|chuán dì}{了|le}{过去|guò qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone passed the water along one by one.

vocab.note: {把|bǎ}…{递|dì}{给|gěi}…: {把|bǎ}{名片|míng piàn}{递|dì}{给|gěi}{他|tā}; {递|dì}{过来|guò lái} (hand it over).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{盐|yán}{递|dì}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}，{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Could you pass me the salt, please?

vocab.note: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{家乡|jiā xiāng}{的|de}{特产|tè chǎn} (a speciality of my home town).
vocab.example: {每|měi}{次|cì}{回|huí}{老家|lǎo jiā}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{给|gěi}{同事|tóng shì}{带|dài}{一些|yì xiē}{特产|tè chǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every time he goes home, he brings his colleagues some local specialities.

vocab.note: Small things to eat between meals, often as a gift; in the south, dim sum.
vocab.example: {奶奶|nǎi nai}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{点心|diǎn xin}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandma loves this shop's pastries.

vocab.note: {吹|chuī}{气球|qì qiú} (blow up a balloon).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{手|shǒu}{里|lǐ}{拿|ná}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{红|hóng}{气球|qì qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: The child is holding a red balloon.

vocab.note: {相|xiàng} is xiàng here (a likeness, a photo), as in {照相|zhào xiàng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{相册|xiàng cè}{里|lǐ}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{的|de}{照片|zhào piàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This album is full of photos of us as children.

meanings: to have a photo taken together
vocab.note: Verb ({合|hé}{个|gè}{影|yǐng}) and noun ({一|yì}{张|zhāng}{合影|hé yǐng}).
vocab.example: {毕业|bì yè}{那|nà}{天|tiān}，{全|quán}{班|bān}{同学|tóng xué}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{合|hé}{了|le}{影|yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: On graduation day, the whole class had their photo taken at the school gate.

vocab.note: Can split: {签|qiān}{个|gè}{名|míng}. {签字|qiān zì} (lesson 01) is signing a document.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{您|nín}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{签|qiān}{个|gè}{名|míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please sign here.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{名片|míng piàn}; {交换|jiāo huàn}{名片|míng piàn}. Give and take it with both hands.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{名片|míng piàn}，{有|yǒu}{事|shì}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Here's my card: call me if you need anything.

vocab.note: A pocket ({衣服|yī fu}{的|de}{口袋|kǒu dài}) or a bag ({一|yì}{口袋|kǒu dài}{米|mǐ}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{了|le}{口袋|kǒu dài}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He put his phone in his pocket.

vocab.note: Verb ({讲究|jiǎng jiu}{吃|chī} / {讲究|jiǎng jiu}{穿|chuān}); adjective ({很|hěn}{讲究|jiǎng jiu}: tasteful); noun ({有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{讲究|jiǎng jiu}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{很|hěn}{讲究|jiǎng jiu}，{不|bù}{新鲜|xīn xiān}{的|de}{菜|cài}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}{也|yě}{不|bù}{吃|chī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very particular about food: he won't touch anything that isn't fresh.

vocab.note: {喝|hē}{醉|zuì}{了|le} (got drunk); also figurative: {醉|zuì}{人|rén}{的|de}{风景|fēng jǐng} (intoxicating scenery).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{喝|hē}{醉|zuì}{了|le}，{今天|jīn tiān}{头|tóu}{很|hěn}{疼|téng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He got drunk last night and has a headache today.

vocab.note: A noun phrase, subject or object: {请|qǐng}{亲朋好友|qīn péng hǎo yǒu}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}. A little formal; at home, {亲戚|qīn qi}{朋友|péng you}.
vocab.example: {结婚|jié hūn}{那|nà}{天|tiān}，{我们|wǒ men}{请|qǐng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{亲朋好友|qīn péng hǎo yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: We invited lots of friends and relatives on our wedding day.

vocab.note: {去|qù}{邮局|yóu jú}{寄|jì}{信|xìn} / {寄|jì}{包裹|bāo guǒ}.
vocab.example: {邮局|yóu jú}{就|jiù}{在|zài}{银行|yín háng}{旁边|páng biān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The post office is right next to the bank.

vocab.note: {贴|tiē}{邮票|yóu piào} (put a stamp on); {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{邮票|yóu piào}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{邮票|yóu piào}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{留下来|liú xià lái}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This stamp was my grandpa's.

vocab.note: The written partner of {寄|jì} (HSK 4): {邮寄|yóu jì}{包裹|bāo guǒ}.
vocab.example: {您|nín}{可以|kě yǐ}{把|bǎ}{申请|shēn qǐng}{表|biǎo}{邮寄|yóu jì}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can post the application form to us.

vocab.note: {在|zài}{信封|xìn fēng}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{地址|dì zhǐ}; {一|yí}{个|gè}{信封|xìn fēng}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{把|bǎ}{照片|zhào piàn}{放|fàng}{进|jìn}{了|le}{信封|xìn fēng}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: She put the photo in the envelope.

vocab.note: Where a person lives; {地址|dì zhǐ} (HSK 4) is any address.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{您|nín}{的|de}{姓名|xìng míng}{和|hé}{住址|zhù zhǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your name and address here.

vocab.note: {贴|tiē}{邮票|yóu piào}; {贴|tiē}{在|zài}{墙|qiáng}{上|shàng} (put up on the wall); {贴|tiē}{春联|chūn lián} (put up New Year couplets).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{孩子|hái zi}{的|de}{画儿|huàr}{贴|tiē}{在|zài}{了|le}{墙|qiáng}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He stuck his child's drawing on the wall.

vocab.note: Formal, in notices and speeches: {欢迎|huān yíng}{前来|qián lái}{参观|cān guān}; {前来|qián lái}{参加|cān jiā}.
vocab.example: {感谢|gǎn xiè}{各位|gè wèi}{前来|qián lái}{参加|cān jiā}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{活动|huó dòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you all for coming to today's event.

vocab.note: Written partner of {问|wèn}: {询问|xún wèn}{价格|jià gé}, {向|xiàng}{工作|gōng zuò}{人员|rén yuán}{询问|xún wèn}.
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{可以|kě yǐ}{向|xiàng}{服务台|fú wù tái}{询问|xún wèn}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you have any questions, ask at the service desk.

vocab.note: After a surname ({王小姐|Wáng xiǎo jie}) and in formal letters. Calling out {小姐|xiǎo jie}！ to staff can sound disrespectful in the mainland today.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{位|wèi}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{李小姐|Lǐ xiǎo jie}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is Ms Li from our company.

vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{的|de}{比分|bǐ fēn}{是|shì}{二|èr}{比|bǐ}{一|yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The score is now two–one.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {有|yǒu}{把握|bǎ wò} (to be confident of doing it), {没有|méi yǒu}{把握|bǎ wò} (not sure you can).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{把握|bǎ wò}{好|hǎo}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We must make the most of this opportunity.

vocab.example: {裁判|cái pàn}{说|shuō}{这个|zhè ge}{球|qiú}{不|bú}{算|suàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The referee said the goal didn't count.

vocab.note: {参考|cān kǎo}{书|shū} (a reference book), {参考|cān kǎo}{答案|dá àn} (model answers).
vocab.example: {写|xiě}{作文|zuò wén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{可以|kě yǐ}{参考|cān kǎo}{这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{本|běn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can consult these books when you write your essay.

vocab.note: Before nouns like {准备|zhǔn bèi} and {时间|shí jiān}, or as a predicate: {时间|shí jiān}{很|hěn}{充分|chōng fèn}.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{以前|yǐ qián}{要|yào}{做|zuò}{充分|chōng fèn}{的|de}{准备|zhǔn bèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: You need to prepare thoroughly before the exam.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{强|qiáng}{的|de}{对手|duì shǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's my strongest opponent.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{打破|dǎ pò}{了|le}{学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{跳高|tiào gāo}{纪录|jì lù}。
vocab.exampleEn: She broke the university's high-jump record.

vocab.note: Also "to translate" in {翻译|fān yì} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{翻|fān}{了|le}{翻|fān}{词典|cí diǎn}，{找|zhǎo}{到|dào}{了|le}{这个|zhè ge}{词|cí}。
vocab.exampleEn: He leafed through the dictionary and found the word.
