vocab.exampleEn: The first of the twelve Chinese zodiac animals is the rat.

vocab.note: shān (verb); the fan itself is {扇子|shàn zi} shàn zi.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{他|tā}{一边|yì biān}{走|zǒu}{一边|yì biān}{扇|shān}{扇子|shàn zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: It was so hot that he fanned himself as he walked.

vocab.note: {赏月|shǎng yuè} (enjoy the moon), {赏花|shǎng huā}; {欣赏|xīn shǎng} (lesson 10).
vocab.example: {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{晚上|wǎn shang}，{一家人|yì jiā rén}{一起|yì qǐ}{赏月|shǎng yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival the family enjoys the moon together.

vocab.note: {一路平安|yí lù píng ān} (have a safe journey), {平平安安|píng píng ān ān}.
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一路平安|yí lù píng ān}！
vocab.exampleEn: Have a safe journey!

vocab.note: {神秘|shén mì}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}, {很|hěn}{神秘|shén mì}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{给|gěi}{人|rén}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{神秘|shén mì}{的|de}{感觉|gǎn jué}。
vocab.exampleEn: This ancient place has a mysterious feel.

vocab.note: {网络时代|wǎng luò shí dài} (the internet age); {时代|shí dài}{变|biàn}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{生活|shēng huó}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{网络时代|wǎng luò shí dài}。
vocab.exampleEn: We live in the internet age.

vocab.note: With a start and an end: {唐朝时期|Táng cháo shí qī}, {大学|dà xué}{时期|shí qī} (university days).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{他|tā}{一生|yì shēng}{中|zhōng}{最|zuì}{困难|kùn nan}{的|de}{时期|shí qī}。
vocab.exampleEn: This was the hardest period of his life.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{特色|tè sè}, {地方|dì fang}{特色|tè sè}, {特色|tè sè}{菜|cài} (the house speciality).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{特色|tè sè}{菜|cài}{是|shì}{烤|kǎo}{鸭|yā}。
vocab.exampleEn: This restaurant's speciality is roast duck.

vocab.note: In the zodiac, {兔|tù}: {属|shǔ}{兔|tù} (born in a rabbit year).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{家|jiā}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{兔子|tù zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her family keeps two rabbits.

vocab.note: {统一|tǒng yī}{了|le}{中国|Zhōng guó}; {统一|tǒng yī}{的|de}{标准|biāo zhǔn} (a common standard).
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{给|gěi}{学生|xué sheng}{们|men}{发|fā}{了|le}{统一|tǒng yī}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school gave the students uniform clothes.

vocab.note: {中国|Zhōng guó}{特有|tè yǒu}{的|de}{动物|dòng wù} (an animal found only in China).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{这个|zhè ge}{地区|dì qū}{特有|tè yǒu}{的|de}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a fruit found only in this region.

vocab.note: {伟大|wěi dà}{的|de}{发明|fā míng}, {伟大|wěi dà}{的|de}{人物|rén wù}.
vocab.example: {纸|zhǐ}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{古代|gǔ dài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{伟大|wěi dà}{的|de}{发明|fā míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Paper was a great invention of ancient China.

vocab.note: {中|zhōng}{式|shì}, {西|xī}{式|shì}, {新|xīn}{式|shì}; {开幕式|kāi mù shì} (a ceremony).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{家|jiā}{是|shì}{中|zhōng}{式|shì}{的|de}{装修|zhuāng xiū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Their home is decorated in Chinese style.

meanings: the joys and sorrows of life
vocab.note: Literally sour, sweet, bitter, spicy; a noun phrase: {生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{国|guó}{外|wài}{留学|liú xué}{的|de}{这|zhè}{一|yì}{年|nián}，{酸甜苦辣|suān tián kǔ là}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year studying abroad has had all its ups and downs.

vocab.note: {现代|xiàn dài}{社会|shè huì}, {现代化|xiàn dài huà}; after {近代|jìn dài} in Chinese history books.
vocab.example: {现代|xiàn dài}{人|rén}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}。
vocab.exampleEn: People today lead busy lives.

vocab.note: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{幸运|xìng yùn}; {幸运|xìng yùn}{的|de}{是|shì}… (luckily…).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{幸运|xìng yùn}，{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{就|jiù}{通过|tōng guò}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was lucky: I passed at the first attempt.

vocab.note: Given to children at New Year, in a {红包|hóng bāo}.
vocab.example: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou}，{过年|guò nián}{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{的|de}{就是|jiù shì}{压岁钱|yā suì qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: As a child, what I loved most about New Year was the New Year money.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {龙|lóng}{象征|xiàng zhēng}{着|zhe}{力量|lì liang}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}，{红色|hóng sè}{象征|xiàng zhēng}{着|zhe}{快乐|kuài lè}{和|hé}{好运|hǎo yùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: In China, red symbolises happiness and good luck.

vocab.note: In set phrases: {欢迎|huān yíng}, {迎新年|yíng xīn nián}, {迎|yíng}{客|kè}.
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{迎新年|yíng xīn nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone is getting ready to welcome the New Year.

vocab.note: {迎接|yíng jiē}{客人|kè rén}, {迎接|yíng jiē}{新|xīn}{的|de}{一|yì}{年|nián}, {迎接|yíng jiē}{挑战|tiǎo zhàn}.
vocab.example: {学生|xué sheng}{们|men}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}{迎接|yíng jiē}{新|xīn}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The students welcomed the new teacher at the door.

vocab.note: Almost always with {历史|lì shǐ}: {历史|lì shǐ}{悠久|yōu jiǔ}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{有着|yǒu zhe}{悠久|yōu jiǔ}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This city has a long history.

vocab.note: The Gregorian New Year; {春节|Chūn jié} is the lunar one.
vocab.example: {元旦|yuán dàn}{我们|wǒ men}{放|fàng}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{假|jiǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: We get three days off for New Year's Day.

vocab.note: {运气|yùn qi}{好|hǎo} / {不|bù}{好|hǎo}; light second syllable.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{运气|yùn qi}{真|zhēn}{好|hǎo}，{一|yì}{出门|chū mén}{就|jiù}{打|dǎ}{到|dào}{了|le}{车|chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: What luck today: I got a taxi as soon as I stepped out.

vocab.note: {早期|zǎo qī}{的|de}{作品|zuò pǐn} (early works), {早期|zǎo qī}{发现|fā xiàn} (early detection).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{他|tā}{早期|zǎo qī}{的|de}{一|yí}{部|bù}{作品|zuò pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is one of his early works.

vocab.note: Formal and cultural: {中华文化|Zhōng huá wén huà}, {中华民族|Zhōng huá mín zú}.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{是|shì}{中华文化|Zhōng huá wén huà}{里|lǐ}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{节日|jié rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in Chinese culture.

vocab.note: {结婚|jié hūn}{十|shí}{周年|zhōu nián}, {一百|yì bǎi}{周年|zhōu nián}.
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{成立|chéng lì}{十|shí}{周年|zhōu nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year is our company's tenth anniversary.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{头|tóu}{猪|zhū}; {属|shǔ}{猪|zhū} (born in a pig year).
vocab.example: {外公|wài gōng}{家|jiā}{养|yǎng}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{头|tóu}{猪|zhū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa keeps a few pigs.

vocab.note: Written: {至今|zhì jīn}{还|hái} / {仍|réng} / {没|méi}…; spoken {到|dào}{现在|xiàn zài}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{至今|zhì jīn}{还没|hái méi}{有|yǒu}{收到|shōu dào}{他|tā}{的|de}{回信|huí xìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We still haven't had a reply from him.

vocab.note: Formal: {中华民族|Zhōng huá mín zú}{的|de}{传统|chuán tǒng}.
vocab.example: {春节|Chūn jié}{是|shì}{中华民族|Zhōng huá mín zú}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{传统|chuán tǒng}{节日|jié rì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival of the Chinese nation.

vocab.note: A view you argue for. {看法|kàn fǎ} (HSK 4) is everyday "opinion"; {观点|guān diǎn} is more formal and is the word of essays and debates.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{同意|tóng yì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{观点|guān diǎn}，{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I agree with your view, but I'd like to add one point.

meanings: reason (for a view or a choice)
vocab.note: {原因|yuán yīn} is the cause of something that happened; {理由|lǐ yóu} is a reason you give for a view or a decision: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{理由|lǐ yóu}？
vocab.example: {他|tā}{没有|méi yǒu}{说明|shuō míng}{请假|qǐng jià}{的|de}{理由|lǐ yóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He didn't explain his reason for asking for leave.

vocab.note: {事实|shì shí}{上|shàng} (in fact) starts a sentence that corrects an impression.
vocab.example: {事实|shì shí}{证明|zhèng míng}，{他|tā}{的|de}{判断|pàn duàn}{是|shì}{对|duì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: The facts proved his judgement right.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{这么|zhè me}{说|shuō}，{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{证据|zhèng jù}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's your evidence for saying that?

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}: makes sense, has a point. The second syllable is light.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{道理|dào li}。
vocab.exampleEn: You've got a point there.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{现象|xiàn xiàng}{在|zài}{大|dà}{城市|chéng shì}{很|hěn}{普遍|pǔ biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This kind of thing is very common in big cities.

vocab.example: {天气|tiān qì}{是|shì}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{重要|zhòng yào}{因素|yīn sù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The weather is an important factor in the match.

vocab.note: {换|huàn}{个|gè}{角度|jiǎo dù}: from another angle.
vocab.example: {换|huàn}{个|gè}{角度|jiǎo dù}{看|kàn}，{这|zhè}{也|yě}{是|shì}{一|yí}{次|cì}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Seen from another angle, this is a chance too.

vocab.note: {在|zài}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{程度|chéng dù}{上|shàng}: to a great extent.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{达到|dá dào}{了|le}{能|néng}{当|dāng}{翻译|fān yì}{的|de}{程度|chéng dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: His Chinese has reached the point where he could work as an interpreter.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{调查|diào chá}{的|de}{范围|fàn wéi}{太|tài}{小|xiǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The scope of this survey is too small.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{价值|jià zhí}: valuable.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{意见|yì jiàn}{对|duì}{我们|wǒ men}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{价值|jià zhí}。
vocab.exampleEn: These suggestions are very valuable to us.

vocab.example: {如果|rú guǒ}{大家|dà jiā}{没有|méi yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{开始|kāi shǐ}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: If nobody has any questions, let's begin.

vocab.note: Also an adjective: {不|bú}{现实|xiàn shí} (unrealistic).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{可是|kě shì}{不|bú}{太|tài}{现实|xiàn shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's a good plan, but not very realistic.

vocab.example: {好|hǎo}{的|de}{报道|bào dào}{既|jì}{有|yǒu}{事实|shì shí}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{细节|xì jié}。
vocab.exampleEn: A good report has both facts and details.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {特点|tè diǎn} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{鸟|niǎo}{最|zuì}{大|dà}{的|de}{特征|tè zhēng}{是|shì}{尾巴|wěi ba}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bird's most striking feature is its long tail.

vocab.note: {差|chā} here, as in {差距|chā jù} (lesson 28).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{的|de}{差别|chā bié}{不|bú}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: There isn't much difference between the two methods.

vocab.note: {从|cóng}{整体|zhěng tǐ}{来|lái}{看|kàn}: taken as a whole.
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{整体|zhěng tǐ}{来|lái}{看|kàn}，{这|zhè}{次|cì}{活动|huó dòng}{很|hěn}{成功|chéng gōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Taken as a whole, the event was a success.

vocab.note: {表面|biǎo miàn}{上|shàng}: on the surface (but really…).
vocab.example: {表面|biǎo miàn}{上|shàng}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{冷静|lěng jìng}，{其实|qí shí}{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the surface he's calm, but inside he's very nervous.

vocab.note: {在|zài}…{当中|dāng zhōng}: among.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{我|wǒ}{认识|rèn shi}{的|de}{人|rén}{当中|dāng zhōng}，{他|tā}{最|zuì}{幽默|yōu mò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Of all the people I know, he's the funniest.

vocab.note: {物质|wù zhì}{生活|shēng huó} / {精神|jīng shén}{生活|shēng huó}: material and spiritual life.
vocab.example: {除了|chú le}{物质|wù zhì}{生活|shēng huó}，{精神|jīng shén}{生活|shēng huó}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Besides material comforts, the life of the mind matters too.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {自己|zì jǐ}.
vocab.example: {问题|wèn tí}{在于|zài yú}{产品|chǎn pǐn}{自身|zì shēn}{的|de}{质量|zhì liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The problem lies in the quality of the product itself.

vocab.note: Opposite: {主观|zhǔ guān}.
vocab.example: {写|xiě}{报道|bào dào}{一定|yí dìng}{要|yào}{客观|kè guān}。
vocab.exampleEn: A report must be objective.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{太|tài}{主观|zhǔ guān}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His view is too subjective.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{举|jǔ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{具体|jù tǐ}{的|de}{例子|lì zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please give a specific example.

vocab.note: Also a verb: {明确|míng què}{目标|mù biāo} (to make the goal clear).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{目标|mù biāo}{很|hěn}{明确|míng què}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our goal is clear.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{很|hěn}{合理|hé lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop's prices are very reasonable.

vocab.note: Same sound as {有利|yǒu lì} (favourable): {有力|yǒu lì}{的|de}{证据|zhèng jù} is strong evidence.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{有力|yǒu lì}{的|de}{证据|zhèng jù}。
vocab.exampleEn: That's a very strong piece of evidence.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{有利|yǒu lì}: good for. Same sound as {有力|yǒu lì} (strong).
vocab.example: {这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{天气|tiān qì}{对|duì}{我们|wǒ men}{很|hěn}{有利|yǒu lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Weather like this is in our favour.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{不利|bú lì}: bad for.
vocab.example: {长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{对|duì}{眼睛|yǎn jing}{不利|bú lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Looking at a phone for a long time is bad for your eyes.

vocab.note: Often at the start of a sentence: {显然|xiǎn rán}，…
vocab.example: {显然|xiǎn rán}，{他|tā}{还|hái}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Obviously he doesn't know about this yet.

vocab.example: {不|bù}{努力|nǔ lì}，{失败|shī bài}{是|shì}{必然|bì rán}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you don't work at it, failure is inevitable.

vocab.note: {没有|méi yǒu}{必要|bì yào}: there's no need.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{必要|bì yào}{为|wèi}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{小|xiǎo}{事|shì}{担心|dān xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's no need for you to worry about such a small thing.

vocab.note: {印象|yìn xiàng}{深刻|shēn kè}: a deep impression.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{留下|liú xià}{了|le}{深刻|shēn kè}{的|de}{印象|yìn xiàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The trip left a deep impression on me.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{对|duì}{他|tā}{的|de}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{非常|fēi cháng}{深远|shēn yuǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This had a very far-reaching effect on him.

vocab.note: Adjective and verb: {表现|biǎo xiàn}{突出|tū chū} (outstanding), {突出|tū chū}{重点|zhòng diǎn} (to bring out the main points).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{比赛|bǐ sài}{中|zhōng}{的|de}{表现|biǎo xiàn}{很|hěn}{突出|tū chū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her performance in this competition was outstanding.

vocab.example: {除非|chú fēi}{有|yǒu}{特殊|tè shū}{情况|qíng kuàng}，{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{迟到|chí dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please don't be late unless something unusual comes up.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}{写|xiě}{完整|wán zhěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your full name.

vocab.example: {只|zhǐ}{用|yòng}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{学习|xué xí}，{太|tài}{单一|dān yī}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Studying with just one method is too limited.

vocab.note: Listed as an adverb; used mostly before nouns: {个别|gè bié}{同学|tóng xué}.
vocab.example: {个别|gè bié}{同学|tóng xué}{还|hái}{没|méi}{交|jiāo}{作业|zuò yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: A few students still haven't handed in their homework.

vocab.note: {同一|tóng yī}{个|gè} + measure word.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{同一|tóng yī}{个|gè}{小区|xiǎo qū}。
vocab.exampleEn: We live in the same compound.

vocab.note: {穿|chuān}{反|fǎn}{了|le}: put on inside out or back to front. {相反|xiāng fǎn} (HSK 4) is "opposite".
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{穿|chuān}{反|fǎn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: You've got your top on inside out.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{一直|yì zhí}{存在|cún zài}。
vocab.exampleEn: This problem has always been there.

vocab.note: With abstract nouns: {具有|jù yǒu}{意义|yì yì}, {具有|jù yǒu}{特点|tè diǎn}; {有|yǒu} for things.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{会议|huì yì}{具有|jù yǒu}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{意义|yì yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This meeting is of great significance.

vocab.note: {包括|bāo kuò} (lesson 02) lists the parts; {包含|bāo hán} says what is inside.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{价格|jià gé}{包含|bāo hán}{早餐|zǎo cān}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Does the price include breakfast?

vocab.note: {由|yóu}…{构成|gòu chéng}: to be made up of.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{由|yóu}{三|sān}{个|gè}{部分|bù fen}{构成|gòu chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The book is made up of three parts.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{小|xiǎo}{事|shì}{体现|tǐ xiàn}{了|le}{他|tā}{的|de}{性格|xìng gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: This small thing shows what kind of person he is.

vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{强调|qiáng diào}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{重点|zhòng diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher stressed three key points.

vocab.note: {补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}: to add a point.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let me add one point.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{不|bù}{能|néng}{完全|wán quán}{否定|fǒu dìng}{他|tā}{的|de}{成绩|chéng jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We can't dismiss what he's achieved altogether.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{赞成|zàn chéng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{计划|jì huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm in favour of your plan.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {网上|wǎng shàng}{的|de}{评价|píng jià} (online reviews).
vocab.example: {大家|dà jiā}{对|duì}{他|tā}{的|de}{评价|píng jià}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone thinks very highly of him.

vocab.note: {满足|mǎn zú}{需求|xū qiú}: to meet a need.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{尽量|jǐn liàng}{满足|mǎn zú}{顾客|gù kè}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should do our best to meet customers' requests.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {缺少|quē shǎo} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{聪明|cōng ming}，{只是|zhǐ shì}{缺乏|quē fá}{经验|jīng yàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's clever; he just lacks experience.

vocab.note: Also a verb: {确定|què dìng}{时间|shí jiān} (to fix a time).
vocab.example: {开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{还|hái}{没|méi}{确定|què dìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The time of the meeting hasn't been fixed yet.

meanings: to be in (a state or position)
vocab.note: {处|chǔ} is chǔ here. Written: {处于|chǔ yú}…{阶段|jiē duàn} / {时期|shí qī} / {状态|zhuàng tài}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{现在|xiàn zài}{处于|chǔ yú}{困难|kùn nan}{时期|shí qī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company is going through a difficult time.

vocab.note: No {是|shì} before it in writing.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{书|shū}{属于|shǔ yú}{学校|xué xiào}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: These books belong to the school library.

vocab.note: {问题|wèn tí}{在于|zài yú} / {关键|guān jiàn}{在于|zài yú}…: the problem / the key is….
vocab.example: {成功|chéng gōng}{的|de}{关键|guān jiàn}{在于|zài yú}{坚持|jiān chí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The key to success lies in keeping at it.

vocab.example: {针对|zhēn duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{学校|xué xiào}{采取|cǎi qǔ}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{措施|cuò shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: To deal with this problem, the school has taken new measures.

vocab.note: Also literal: {地球|dì qiú}{围绕|wéi rào}{着|zhe}{太阳|tài yang}{转|zhuàn} (the earth goes round the sun).
vocab.example: {讨论|tǎo lùn}{围绕|wéi rào}{网上|wǎng shàng}{评价|píng jià}{展开|zhǎn kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: The discussion centred on online reviews.

vocab.note: Written: {把|bǎ} A {视为|shì wéi} B, A {被|bèi}{视为|shì wéi} B. Neutral: {看作|kàn zuò}.
vocab.example: {茶|chá}{被|bèi}{视为|shì wéi}{中国|Zhōng guó}{文化|wén huà}{的|de}{代表|dài biǎo}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tea is regarded as one of the symbols of Chinese culture.

vocab.note: {把|bǎ} A {看作|kàn zuò} B. Lesson 12's {当作|dàng zuò} is "to treat as".
vocab.example: {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{失败|shī bài}{看作|kàn zuò}{一|yí}{次|cì}{学习|xué xí}{的|de}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He sees this failure as a chance to learn.

vocab.note: {促使|cù shǐ} + person + action.
vocab.example: {那|nà}{次|cì}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{促使|cù shǐ}{她|tā}{下|xià}{决心|jué xīn}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{中文|Zhōng wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: That trip made her determined to learn Chinese properly.

vocab.note: {使得|shǐ de} + a clause: {大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{使得|shǐ de}{航班|háng bān}{推迟|tuī chí}{了|le}。 Not {似的|shì de} shì de (as if, lesson 06).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{使得|shǐ de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{航班|háng bān}{推迟|tuī chí}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The heavy rain caused many flights to be delayed.

vocab.note: After a fact: {这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{做|zuò}{对|duì}{了|le}，{可见|kě jiàn}{很|hěn}{难|nán}。 {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} (from this it can be seen) starts a sentence.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{没|méi}{来|lái}{上课|shàng kè}，{可见|kě jiàn}{病|bìng}{得|de}{不|bù}{轻|qīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He hasn't been to class for three days, so he must be quite ill.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {也许|yě xǔ} (HSK 4).
vocab.example: {或许|huò xǔ}{他|tā}{说|shuō}{得|de}{对|duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Perhaps he's right.

vocab.note: Written {就|jiù}, after the subject: {一|yī}…{便|biàn}…. {便|biàn} is biàn here ({便宜|pián yi} has pián).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{一|yí}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{便|biàn}{开始|kāi shǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He started work the moment he got to the office.

vocab.note: Before an adjective: {较|jiào}{高|gāo} (rather high); before a noun it is {比|bǐ}: {今年|jīn nián}{较|jiào}{去年|qù nián}{多|duō}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{较|jiào}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop's prices are rather high.

vocab.note: Joins nouns, not clauses: {老师|lǎo shī}{及|jí}{学生|xué sheng}.
vocab.example: {参加|cān jiā}{会议|huì yì}{的|de}{有|yǒu}{老师|lǎo shī}{及|jí}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Those at the meeting included teachers and students.

vocab.note: Often before the last item of a list, and can join longer phrases.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{姓名|xìng míng}、{电话|diàn huà}{以及|yǐ jí}{住址|zhù zhǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your name, phone number and address.

vocab.note: Points back to something just named: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{及|jí}{其|qí}{员工|yuán gōng}. You know it from {其中|qí zhōng} and {其他|qí tā}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{及|jí}{其|qí}{员工|yuán gōng}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{重视|zhòng shì}{质量|zhì liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company and its staff all take quality very seriously.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{先|xiān}{走|zǒu}，{其余|qí yú}{的|de}{人|rén}{明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: We'll go first; the rest will come tomorrow.

vocab.note: {某|mǒu}{人|rén} (someone), {某|mǒu}{天|tiān} (one day), {某|mǒu}{些|xiē} (some).
vocab.example: {某|mǒu}{公司|gōng sī}{正在|zhèng zài}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{工程师|gōng chéng shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: A certain company is recruiting engineers.

vocab.note: {你|nǐ}{觉得|jué de}{如何|rú hé}？ (What do you think?)
vocab.example: {如何|rú hé}{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{中文|Zhōng wén}，{是|shì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{关心|guān xīn}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}。
vocab.exampleEn: How to learn Chinese well is a question many people care about.

vocab.note: {原来|yuán lái}{如此|rú cǐ} (so that's how it is).
vocab.example: {没|méi}{想|xiǎng}{到|dào}{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{风景|fēng jǐng}{如此|rú cǐ}{美丽|měi lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I never expected the scenery here to be so beautiful.

vocab.note: In notices {如|rú} is {如果|rú guǒ}: {如|rú}{有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn} (if you have any questions).
vocab.example: {如|rú}{有|yǒu}{疑问|yí wèn}，{请|qǐng}{咨询|zī xún}{服务|fú wù}{台|tái}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you have any questions, please ask at the information desk.

vocab.example: {时间|shí jiān}{如同|rú tóng}{流|liú}{水|shuǐ}，{一|yí}{去|qù}{不|bù}{回|huí}。
vocab.exampleEn: Time is like flowing water: once gone, it never comes back.

vocab.note: Introduces a list: {具体|jù tǐ}{安排|ān pái}{如下|rú xià}.
vocab.example: {具体|jù tǐ}{安排|ān pái}{如下|rú xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The arrangements are as follows.

vocab.note: Before a verb or noun: {需|xū}{提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē} (booking required).
vocab.example: {参观|cān guān}{需|xū}{提前|tí qián}{预约|yù yuē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Visits must be booked in advance.

vocab.note: Rules and formal advice: {应当|yīng dāng}{遵守|zūn shǒu}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{应当|yīng dāng}{遵守|zūn shǒu}{交通|jiāo tōng}{规则|guī zé}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone should obey the traffic rules.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {一定|yí dìng} or {必须|bì xū}. {必|bì}{读|dú} (required reading).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}{必|bì}{读|dú}{的|de}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a book every student must read.

vocab.note: {周|zhōu}{二|èr}{至|zhì}{周|zhōu}{日|rì} (Tuesday to Sunday), {至今|zhì jīn} (until now).
vocab.example: {本|běn}{店|diàn}{营业|yíng yè}{时间|shí jiān}{为|wéi}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{至|zhì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The shop is open from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

vocab.note: As a preposition it's written or regional ("with"); in {同一|tóng yī}, {相同|xiāng tóng} it means "the same".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{同|tóng}{他|tā}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{北京|Běi jīng}{出差|chū chāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm going on a business trip to Beijing with him.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{周|zhōu}{六|liù}{或是|huò shì}{周|zhōu}{日|rì}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can come on Saturday or Sunday.

vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{画|huà}{是|shì}{首次|shǒu cì}{在|zài}{国|guó}{内|nèi}{展出|zhǎn chū}。
vocab.exampleEn: These paintings are on show in this country for the first time.

vocab.note: Notices and news: {今日|jīn rì}{闭馆|bì guǎn} (closed today).
vocab.example: {本馆|běn guǎn}{今日|jīn rì}{闭馆|bì guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum is closed today.

vocab.note: News: {近日|jìn rì}{宣布|xuān bù} (announced recently).
vocab.example: {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{近日|jìn rì}{宣布|xuān bù}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum recently announced its new opening hours.

vocab.note: It looks both ways; the verb decides: {近期|jìn qī}{将|jiāng}{举办|jǔ bàn} (will soon hold).
vocab.example: {近期|jìn qī}，{我们|wǒ men}{将|jiāng}{举办|jǔ bàn}{一|yí}{次|cì}{大型|dà xíng}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We'll be holding a major exhibition soon.

vocab.example: {此时|cǐ shí}，{台|tái}{上|shàng}{的|de}{灯|dēng}{忽然|hū rán}{亮|liàng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: At that moment the lights on the stage suddenly came on.

vocab.example: {他|tā}2025{年|nián}{来|lái}{到|dào}{北京|Běi jīng}，{此后|cǐ hòu}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{这里|zhè lǐ}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He came to Beijing in 2025 and has worked here ever since.

vocab.example: {此前|cǐ qián}，{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{闭馆|bì guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before this, the museum closed at five in the afternoon.

vocab.example: {经理|jīng lǐ}{先|xiān}{介绍|jiè shào}{了|le}{新|xīn}{项目|xiàng mù}，{随后|suí hòu}{大家|dà jiā}{开始|kāi shǐ}{讨论|tǎo lùn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The manager first presented the new project; then everyone began the discussion.

vocab.note: After a time phrase: {暑假|shǔ jià}{期间|qī jiān} (during the summer holidays).
vocab.example: {会议|huì yì}{期间|qī jiān}，{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī}{调|tiáo}{成|chéng}{静|jìng}{音|yīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: During the meeting, please set your phone to silent.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {先后|xiān hòu}{去|qù}{过|guo} (went to… one after another).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{先后|xiān hòu}{去|qù}{过|guo}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{国家|guó jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has been to more than a dozen countries, one after another.

vocab.note: Written {一|yì}{开始|kāi shǐ}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{最初|zuì chū}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这|zhè}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: At first he didn't like the job at all.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{到|dào}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他|tā}{早已|zǎo yǐ}{离开|lí kāi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: By the time I arrived, he had long since left.

vocab.note: {关键|guān jiàn}{时刻|shí kè} (a crucial moment); {时刻|shí kè} + verb: at all times.
vocab.example: {开车|kāi chē}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{时刻|shí kè}{注意|zhù yì}{安全|ān quán}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you drive, pay attention to safety at all times.

vocab.note: {早晚|zǎo wǎn}{各|gè}{一|yí}{次|cì} (once morning and evening); {早晚|zǎo wǎn}{会|huì}… (will sooner or later).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{他|tā}{早晚|zǎo wǎn}{会|huì}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: He'll find out about this sooner or later.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {众多|zhòng duō}{观众|guān zhòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{展览|zhǎn lǎn}{吸引|xī yǐn}{了|le}{众多|zhòng duō}{观众|guān zhòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exhibition drew huge numbers of visitors.

vocab.note: {价格|jià gé}{随|suí}{季节|jì jié}{变化|biàn huà} (prices change with the season); you know {随着|suí zhe} and {随时|suí shí}.
vocab.example: {菜|cài}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{随|suí}{季节|jì jié}{变化|biàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Vegetable prices change with the season.

vocab.example: {馆|guǎn}{内|nèi}{的|de}{物品|wù pǐn}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{随意|suí yì}{摸|mō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please don't touch the things in the museum.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {白|bái}{跑|pǎo}{一|yí}{趟|tàng} (made the trip for nothing).
vocab.example: {博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{今天|jīn tiān}{闭馆|bì guǎn}，{我们|wǒ men}{白|bái}{跑|pǎo}{了|le}{一|yí}{趟|tàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The museum is closed today: we came for nothing.

vocab.note: {正如|zhèng rú}{大家|dà jiā}{所|suǒ}{知|zhī} (as everyone knows).
vocab.example: {正如|zhèng rú}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{的|de}{那样|nà yàng}，{坚持|jiān chí}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Just as the teacher said, keeping at it is what matters most.

vocab.note: {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn} (it can be seen from this).
vocab.example: {由此|yóu cǐ}{可见|kě jiàn}，{方法|fāng fǎ}{比|bǐ}{时间|shí jiān}{更|gèng}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: So it's clear that method matters more than time.

vocab.note: {以|yǐ}…{为|wéi}… (to take X as Y): {以|yǐ}{学生|xué sheng}{为|wéi}{主|zhǔ} (mostly students).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{班|bān}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{以|yǐ}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{为|wéi}{主|zhǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The students in this class are mostly young people.

vocab.note: Written {因此|yīn cǐ} / {所以|suǒ yǐ}: a result follows from a cause.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{路|lù}{车辆|chē liàng}{较|jiào}{多|duō}，{因而|yīn ér}{经常|jīng cháng}{堵车|dǔ chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a lot of traffic on this road, so it's often jammed.

vocab.note: Joins a means to the result it brings: {改进|gǎi jìn}{服务|fú wù}，{从而|cóng ér}{吸引|xī yǐn}{更|gèng}{多|duō}{顾客|gù kè}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{坚持|jiān chí}{练习|liàn xí}，{从而|cóng ér}{提高|tí gāo}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{水平|shuǐ píng}。
vocab.exampleEn: By practising every day he raised his level.

meanings: by (as in 为人们所熟悉)
vocab.note: wéi, in {为|wéi} + doer + {所|suǒ} + verb: {为|wéi}{大家|dà jiā}{所|suǒ}{接受|jiē shòu}. Not {为|wèi} (for, {为了|wèi le}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{为|wéi}{人|rén}{们|men}{所|suǒ}{熟悉|shú xī}。
vocab.exampleEn: This story is familiar to people.

vocab.note: After {包括|bāo kuò}: {包括|bāo kuò}{我|wǒ}{在内|zài nèi} (including me).
vocab.example: {包括|bāo kuò}{我|wǒ}{在内|zài nèi}，{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are five people altogether, including me.

vocab.note: Before a noun: {原|yuán}{计划|jì huà} (the original plan), {原|yuán}{价|jià} (the original price).
vocab.example: {原|yuán}{计划|jì huà}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{完成|wán chéng}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}，{现在|xiàn zài}{提前|tí qián}{完成|wán chéng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The work that was originally planned for next month has been finished early.

vocab.note: {原有|yuán yǒu}{的|de}{规定|guī dìng} (the existing rules).
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{规定|guī dìng}{实施|shí shī}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{原有|yuán yǒu}{的|de}{规定|guī dìng}{停止|tíng zhǐ}{执行|zhí xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Once the new rules take effect, the existing ones no longer apply.

vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{制定|zhì dìng}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{制度|zhì dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company has drawn up a new set of management rules.

vocab.note: {制定|zhì dìng} for rules and plans; {制订|zhì dìng} (lesson 03) is also used for plans.
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{正在|zhèng zài}{制定|zhì dìng}{新|xīn}{的|de}{规定|guī dìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school is drawing up new rules.

vocab.note: {执行|zhí xíng}{任务|rèn wu} (to carry out a task).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{项|xiàng}{规定|guī dìng}{从|cóng}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{开始|kāi shǐ}{执行|zhí xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The rule will be enforced from next month.

vocab.note: Plans, rules and laws: {实施|shí shī}{计划|jì huà}.
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{的|de}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{七|qī}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{起|qǐ}{实施|shí shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new opening hours will take effect from 1 July.

vocab.note: Systems and methods: {实行|shí xíng}{新|xīn}{制度|zhì dù}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{实行|shí xíng}{垃圾|lā jī}{分类|fēn lèi}{已经|yǐ jīng}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The city has had rubbish sorting for five years now.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{权|quán} (to have the right to).
vocab.example: {顾客|gù kè}{有|yǒu}{权|quán}{要求|yāo qiú}{商家|shāng jiā}{退|tuì}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: Customers have the right to ask the seller for their money back.

vocab.note: Not {权力|quán lì} (power, authority: HSK 6).
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{受|shòu}{教育|jiào yù}{的|de}{权利|quán lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone has the right to an education.

vocab.note: {权利|quán lì}{和|hé}{义务|yì wù} (rights and duties).
vocab.example: {遵守|zūn shǒu}{规定|guī dìng}{是|shì}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{义务|yì wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Obeying the rules is everyone's duty.

vocab.example: {这样|zhè yàng}{做|zuò}{对|duì}{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{公平|gōng píng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Doing it this way is fair to everyone.

vocab.note: {自由|zì yóu}{时间|shí jiān} (free time), {自由|zì yóu}{选择|xuǎn zé} (to choose freely).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自由|zì yóu}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Weekends are my free time.

vocab.note: {这|zhè}{类|lèi} (this kind of), {各|gè}{类|lèi} (all kinds of).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{类|lèi}{问题|wèn tí}{以后|yǐ hòu}{会|huì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Problems of this kind will become more and more common.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{什么|shén me}{类型|lèi xíng}{的|de}{电影|diàn yǐng}？
vocab.exampleEn: What kind of films do you like?

vocab.note: {种类|zhǒng lèi}{很|hěn}{多|duō} (there are many kinds).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{超市|chāo shì}{的|de}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{种类|zhǒng lèi}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: This supermarket has a wide variety of fruit.

vocab.note: For things and organisations, not people ({名字|míng zi}).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{公司|gōng sī}{的|de}{名称|míng chēng}{和|hé}{地址|dì zhǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write the company's name and address.

vocab.note: {问题|wèn tí}{的|de}{性质|xìng zhì} (the nature of the problem).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{的|de}{性质|xìng zhì}{完全|wán quán}{不同|bù tóng}。
vocab.exampleEn: These two matters are completely different in nature.

vocab.note: {文章|wén zhāng}{的|de}{结构|jié gòu} (the structure of an essay).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{结构|jié gòu}{清楚|qīng chu}，{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{懂|dǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This essay is clearly structured and easy to follow.

vocab.note: {从|cóng}{本质|běn zhì}{上|shàng}{看|kàn} (in essence).
vocab.example: {从|cóng}{本质|běn zhì}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}，{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}{是|shì}{一样|yí yàng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: In essence, the two problems are the same.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{新|xīn}{的|de}{概念|gài niàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a very new idea.

vocab.note: {新|xīn}{事物|shì wù} (new things).
vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{对|duì}{新|xīn}{事物|shì wù}{总是|zǒng shì}{很|hěn}{好奇|hào qí}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children are always curious about new things.

vocab.note: {甲方|jiǎ fāng} / {乙方|yǐ fāng} (party A / party B, in contracts); {甲|jiǎ}{类|lèi} (class A).
vocab.example: {合同|hé tong}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}{甲|jiǎ}、{乙|yǐ}{双方|shuāng fāng}{的|de}{名称|míng chēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The contract gives the names of both parties, A and B.

vocab.note: After {甲|jiǎ}: {甲|jiǎ}、{乙|yǐ}{两|liǎng}{类|lèi} (two classes, A and B).
vocab.example: {讲解员|jiǎng jiě yuán}{分为|fēn wéi}{甲|jiǎ}、{乙|yǐ}{两|liǎng}{类|lèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Guides are divided into two classes, A and B.

meanings: to rise (on a scale: figures, temperature)
vocab.note: Figures, temperatures and ranks; prices more often {上涨|shàng zhǎng}.
vocab.example: {最近|zuì jìn}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{气温|qì wēn}{上升|shàng shēng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The temperature has been rising fast these last few days.

vocab.note: {升|shēng}{到|dào} (rise to), {升|shēng}{为|wéi} (be promoted to). Not {升|shēng} the litre (HSK 6).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{去年|qù nián}{升|shēng}{为|wéi}{经理|jīng lǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He was promoted to manager last year.

vocab.note: Also of interest or a market: {旅游|lǚ yóu}{市场|shì chǎng}{开始|kāi shǐ}{升温|shēng wēn}。
vocab.example: {下|xià}{周|zhōu}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{各地|gè dì}{将|jiāng}{逐渐|zhú jiàn}{升温|shēng wēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: From next week temperatures will gradually rise everywhere.

vocab.note: Prices, rents and water levels.
vocab.example: {最近|zuì jìn}{菜|cài}{价|jià}{上涨|shàng zhǎng}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Vegetable prices have gone up quite a bit lately.

vocab.note: zhǎng, the same sound as {长|zhǎng} (to grow).
vocab.example: {下|xià}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{雨|yǔ}，{河|hé}{水|shuǐ}{涨|zhǎng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After three days of rain the river has risen.

vocab.note: By effort: {提升|tí shēng}{水平|shuǐ píng}, {提升|tí shēng}{质量|zhì liàng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{不断|bú duàn}{提升|tí shēng}{服务|fú wù}{质量|zhì liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We must keep raising the quality of our service.

vocab.note: Written, in set phrases: {增|zēng}{至|zhì} (to rise to).
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{参观|cān guān}{人数|rén shù}{增|zēng}{至|zhì}{十万|shí wàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year visitor numbers rose to 100,000.

vocab.note: Its opposite is {缩小|suō xiǎo}.
vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{扩大|kuò dà}{规模|guī mó}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company plans to expand next year.

vocab.note: {差距|chā jù}{缩小|suō xiǎo}{了|le} (the gap has narrowed).
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{差距|chā jù}{正在|zhèng zài}{缩小|suō xiǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The gap between the two cities is narrowing.

vocab.note: Its opposite is {缩短|suō duǎn}.
vocab.example: {暑假|shǔ jià}{期间|qī jiān}，{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{延长|yán cháng}{了|le}{开放|kāi fàng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: During the summer holidays the museum stays open longer.

vocab.example: {新|xīn}{的|de}{高铁|gāo tiě}{把|bǎ}{两|liǎng}{地|dì}{之间|zhī jiān}{的|de}{交通|jiāo tōng}{时间|shí jiān}{缩短|suō duǎn}{了|le}{一半|yí bàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The new high-speed line has halved the journey between the two places.

vocab.example: {近年来|jìn nián lái}，{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{发展|fā zhǎn}{明显|míng xiǎn}{加速|jiā sù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: In recent years the city's development has clearly speeded up.

vocab.note: Without a break; {连续|lián xù} counts units in a row.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}{持续|chí xù}{了|le}{整整|zhěng zhěng}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The heavy rain went on for two whole days.

vocab.note: {连续|lián xù}{三|sān}{年|nián} (three years running).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{连续|lián xù}{三|sān}{年|nián}{得|dé}{了|le}{冠军|guàn jūn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He won three years running.

vocab.note: Short, before an amount: {超|chāo}{两万|liǎng wàn}{人|rén}; also {超速|chāo sù}, {超级|chāo jí} (super).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{的|de}{话费|huà fèi}{又|yòu}{超|chāo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My phone bill has gone over again this month.

vocab.note: {超出|chāo chū}{预计|yù jì}, {超出|chāo chū}{范围|fàn wéi} (beyond the scope).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{超出|chāo chū}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{能力|néng lì}{范围|fàn wéi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This question is beyond me.

vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{收入|shōu rù}{大于|dà yú}{去年|qù nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year's income is greater than last year's.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{的|de}{面积|miàn jī}{小于|xiǎo yú}{二十|èr shí}{平方米|píng fāng mǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This room is less than twenty square metres.

vocab.note: Also "to amount to": {不|bù}{说|shuō}{等于|děng yú}{同意|tóng yì} (saying nothing amounts to agreeing).
vocab.example: {一|yì}{吨|dūn}{等于|děng yú}{一千|yì qiān}{公斤|gōng jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: A tonne equals a thousand kilos.

vocab.note: A verb: {接近|jiē jìn}{一半|yí bàn}, {接近|jiē jìn}{目标|mù biāo}.
vocab.example: {报名|bào míng}{的|de}{人数|rén shù}{已经|yǐ jīng}{接近|jiē jìn}{一千|yì qiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: The number of people signed up is already close to a thousand.

vocab.note: An adverb, straight before a number: {将近|jiāng jìn}{一|yì}{年|nián}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{住|zhù}{了|le}{将近|jiāng jìn}{十|shí}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've lived in Beijing for nearly ten years.

vocab.note: After a number: {三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{上下|shàng xià} (about thirty).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{看|kàn}{起来|qǐ lái}{三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{上下|shàng xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looks about thirty.

vocab.note: Before an amount: {整整|zhěng zhěng}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{整整|zhěng zhěng}{等|děng}{了|le}{他|tā}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: I waited for him for three whole hours.

vocab.note: {大多|dà duō} + verb: {大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}.
vocab.example: {来|lái}{参观|cān guān}{的|de}{人|rén}{大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Most of the visitors are students.

vocab.note: {比例|bǐ lì}{是|shì}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}…; {按|àn}{比例|bǐ lì} (in proportion).
vocab.example: {班|bān}{里|lǐ}{女生|nǚ shēng}{的|de}{比例|bǐ lì}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The proportion of girls in the class is higher than last year.

vocab.note: zhàn. {占|zhàn} + share: {占|zhàn}{总数|zǒng shù}{的|de}{一半|yí bàn}.
vocab.example: {年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{占|zhàn}{总数|zǒng shù}{的|de}{一半|yí bàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Young people make up half the total.

vocab.note: {平均|píng jūn}{每|měi}{天|tiān} (on average every day).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{平均|píng jūn}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{工作|gōng zuò}{十|shí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: On average he works ten hours a day.

vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{报名|bào míng}{的|de}{总数|zǒng shù}{将近|jiāng jìn}{八百|bā bǎi}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: The total number signed up this year is nearly eight hundred.

vocab.note: {总体|zǒng tǐ}{来|lái}{看|kàn} (on the whole).
vocab.example: {总体|zǒng tǐ}{来|lái}{看|kàn}，{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: On the whole, this year is better than last.

vocab.note: {差|chā}, as in {差别|chā bié} (lesson 26).
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{队|duì}{的|de}{差距|chā jù}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{小|xiǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The gap between the two teams is getting smaller.

vocab.note: Also a noun: {做|zuò}{个|gè}{对比|duì bǐ} (make a comparison).
vocab.example: {跟|gēn}{去年|qù nián}{对比|duì bǐ}，{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}{多|duō}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: Compared with last year, there are many more tourists this year.

vocab.note: {上升|shàng shēng} / {下降|xià jiàng}{的|de}{趋势|qū shì} (an upward / downward trend).
vocab.example: {电子|diàn zǐ}{阅读|yuè dú}{有|yǒu}{上升|shàng shēng}{的|de}{趋势|qū shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Electronic reading is on the rise.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{份|fèn}{报告|bào gào}{介绍|jiè shào}{了|le}{中|zhōng}{小学|xiǎo xué}{教育|jiào yù}{的|de}{现状|xiàn zhuàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The report describes the present state of primary and secondary education.

vocab.note: Of a market, a match, a field: {市场|shì chǎng}{形势|xíng shì}. Not {形式|xíng shì} (form, lesson 18).
vocab.example: {当前|dāng qián}{的|de}{市场|shì chǎng}{形势|xíng shì}{对|duì}{我们|wǒ men}{很|hěn}{有利|yǒu lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The current state of the market is very favourable to us.

vocab.note: Listed as a verb; used as "current, present": {当前|dāng qián}{的|de}{形势|xíng shì}.
vocab.example: {当前|dāng qián}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{是|shì}{提高|tí gāo}{质量|zhì liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: What matters most at present is raising quality.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{项目|xiàng mù}{已经|yǐ jīng}{进入|jìn rù}{最后|zuì hòu}{阶段|jiē duàn}。

meanings: quantity (an amount, as in 重量)

readingList.title: Mandarin Companion graded readers (level 2)
readingList.note: Short novels for learners, many of them retellings of well-known stories set in China, written with a fixed set of characters. After HSK 5 they read fast and easily, which is the point now - read a whole book in a few sittings, with pinyin off, for fluency rather than new words. Simplified and traditional editions, as books and e-books. Paid.

readingList.title: Graded Readers "Reading China" (FLTRP)
readingList.publisher: Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press
readingList.note: A series of graded readers sized by vocabulary; levels 3 and 4 match the 3,600 words of this course. The link is a bookseller's comparison of graded-reader series, with the vocabulary size of each level, useful for choosing your next books. Paid.

readingList.title: The Chairman's Bao
readingList.level: Graded news articles by HSK level
readingList.note: Short news stories rewritten for learners and graded by HSK level, with audio, a pop-up dictionary and a choice of simplified or traditional characters. After this course, read the upper levels: they are the kind of written news Chinese of lessons 24 and 27 (据报道, 近日, 此次). A subscription service.

readingList.title: Du Chinese
readingList.note: An app and website of graded lessons and stories, with audio by native speakers. After HSK 5, the Upper Intermediate and Advanced lessons fit. Each story has a free chapter; the rest is paid (see the site's pricing).

readingList.title: Mandarin Bean
readingList.note: Short graded texts marked with HSK levels, with recordings, pinyin, tap-to-translate words and a choice of simplified or traditional characters. Read the HSK 5 texts with pinyin off, then try the HSK 6 ones. The graded reading lessons are free.

readingList.title: Chinese Reading Practice (练读中文)
readingList.note: Short texts in simplified characters; point at a word for its pinyin and meaning. Free, with no ads and no account needed. The advanced texts are within reach now; read each one first without the translation, then summarise it in two or three Chinese sentences, since the exam's reading part asks about main ideas.

readingList.title: Chinese Grammar Wiki
readingList.note: A free reference of Chinese grammar points sorted by level, each with many example sentences in characters, pinyin and English. Its B1 and B2 points cover much of this course's grammar (一旦…就, 哪怕…也, 不但不…反而, 被…给, 把 with two objects); use it when you want more examples of a pattern.

readingList.title: HSK sample papers and syllabus
readingList.note: The official HSK site, with the HSK 3.0 syllabus, sample papers and online demos of the new exam, test dates and test centres. Do a complete sample paper in the last month (lesson 30), and check the format, the speaking test and the pass mark there before you register.
